name: Roland Banks
text:
[reaction] After you defeat an enemy: Discover 1 clue at your location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each clue on your location.
flavor: Everything by the book: every "i" dotted, every "t" crossed. It had worked, until now.

name: Wendy Adams
text:
[reaction] When you reveal a chaos token, choose and discard 1 card from your hand: Cancel that chaos token and return it to the bag. Reveal a new chaos token. (Limit once per test/ability.)
[elder_sign] effect: +0. If Wendy's Amulet is in play, you automatically succeed instead.

name: "Skids" O'Toole
text:
[fast] During your turn, spend 2 resources: You may take an additional action this turn. (Limit once per turn.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. If you succeed, gain 2 resources.
flavor: "I didn't get out of the joint just to watch the world end."

name: Dr. Milan Christopher
text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After you successfully investigate: Gain 1 resource.
flavor: "While I truly believe that this nightmare is just a singular abomination, I must admit that I am exhilarated by the possibility that this is but one specimen of a new genus!"

name: Stray Cat
text: [fast] Discard Stray Cat: Automatically evade a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location.
flavor: He never came if you called for him. It always seemed like he had his own agenda.

name: Amnesia
text: Revelation - Choose and discard all but 1 card from your hand.
flavor: Wait... where am I? What was I doing?

name: Wendy's Amulet
text: Wendy Adams deck only. You may play the topmost event in your discard pile as if it were in your hand. Forced - After you play an event or discard an event from play: Place it on the bottom of your deck instead of in your discard pile.

name: Roland's .38 Special
text: Roland Banks deck only. Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack (if there are 1 or more clues on your location, you get +3 [combat], instead). This attack deals +1 damage.

name: Dodge
text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack.

name: Lucky!
text:
Fast. Play when you would fail a skill test.
Get +2 to your skill value for that test.

name: Blinding Light
text: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to the enemy just evaded. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this evasion attempt, lose 1 action this turn.

name: Dig Deep
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.

name: Guts
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card.
flavor: Stay back! I'll handle this.

name: Flashlight
text: Uses (3 supplies). [action] Spend 1 supply: Investigate. Your location gets -2 shroud for this investigation.

name: Magnifying Glass
text:
Fast.
You get +1 [intellect] while investigating.
flavor: A lens into a world unseen can reveal things you wish it hadn't.

name: .45 Automatic
text: Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage.

name: Cover Up
text: Revelation - Put Cover Up into play in your threat area, with 3 clues on it. [reaction] When you would discover 1 or more clues at your location: Discard that many clues from Cover Up instead. Forced - When the game ends, if there are any clues on Cover Up: You suffer 1 mental trauma.

name: Abandoned and Alone
text: Revelation - Take 2 direct horror and remove all cards in your discard pile from the game.
flavor: I don't need them. I don't need anyone.

name: Paranoia
text: Revelation - Discard all your resources.
flavor: What was that noise?

name: Knife
text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. [action] Discard Knife: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage.

name: Evidence!
text:
Fast. Play after you defeat an enemy.
Discover 1 clue at your location.
flavor: Just as I suspected!

name: Guard Dog
text: [reaction] When an enemy attack deals damage to Guard Dog: Deal 1 damage to the attacking enemy.
flavor: Fiercely loyal, these trained canines make for perfect companions.

name: Manual Dexterity
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card.
flavor: Too easy.

name: Emergency Cache
text: Gain 3 resources.
flavor: You can never be too prepared.

name: Dynamite Blast
text: Choose either your location or a connecting location. Deal 3 damage to each enemy and to each investigator at the chosen location.

name: Overpower
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card.
flavor: Die, you beast!

name: Lucky!
text:
Fast. Play when you would fail a skill test.
Get +2 to your skill value for that test. Draw 1 card.

name: Blinding Light
text: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, deal 2 damage to the enemy just evaded. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this evasion attempt, lose 1 action this turn and take 1 horror.

name: Lita Chantler
text:
While you control Lita Chantler, she gains:
"Each investigator at your location gets +1 [combat].
[reaction] When an investigator at your location successfully attacks a [[Monster]] enemy: That investigator deals +1 damage."

name: "Look what I found!"
text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 2 or less while investigating.
Discover 2 clues in your location.

name: Physical Training
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.

name: Baseball Bat
text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. If a [skull] or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this attack, discard Baseball Bat after the attack resolves.

name: Rabbit's Foot
text: [reaction] After you fail a skill test, exhaust Rabbit's Foot: Draw 1 card.
flavor: They claimed it would bring me good luck. I wouldn't say that's true. But now I feel like it would be even worse luck to get rid of it.

name: Daisy Walker
text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used on [[Tome]] [action] abilities.
[elder_sign] effect: +0. If you succeed, draw 1 card for each [[Tome]] you control.
flavor: "I know of books so powerful, they can rewrite reality."

name: The Necronomicon
text: Revelation - Put The Necronomicon into play in your threat area, with 3 horror on it. It cannot leave play while it has 1 or more horror on it. Treat each [elder_sign] you reveal on a chaos token as a [auto_fail]. [action]: Move 1 horror from The Necronomicon to Daisy Walker. Then, if The Necronomicon has no horror on it, discard it.

name: Holy Rosary
text: You get +1 [willpower].
flavor: Whether focused through a mundane trinket or a mystical artifact, there is real power in faith all the same.

name: Backstab
text: Fight. This attack uses [agility] instead of [combat]. This attack deals +2 damage.

name: Machete
text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. If the attacked enemy is the only enemy engaged with you, this attack deals +1 damage.
flavor: Cuts through vines, underbrush, and tentacles equally well.

name: Cunning Distraction
text: Evade. Automatically evade all enemies at your location.
flavor: That should buy us some time.

name: Unexpected Courage
text: Max 1 committed per skill test.
flavor: Sometimes, the most selfless acts can come from the strangest places

name: Icy Ghoul
text: Spawn - Cellar.
flavor: Inside the tunnels beneath the house, a massive beast tears its way out of the ice. It is covered in a think layer of frost, its breath visible in the bitter cold.

name: Study
flavor: The door to your study has vanished.

name: The Gathering
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull] -X. X is the number of [[Ghoul]] enemies at your location.
[cultist] -1. If you fail, take 1 horror.
[tablet] -2. If there is a [[Ghoul]] enemy at your location, take 1 damage.

name: What's Going On?!
flavor: It is late at night. You are holed up in your study, researching the bloody disappearances that have been taking place in the region. A few hours into your research, you hear the sound of strange chanting coming from your parlor, down the hall. At the same time, you hear dirt churning, as if something were digging beneath the floor.

name: Rise of the Ghouls
flavor: The floor beneath you is giving way, and you see a vast network of tunnels, twisting into the darkness below. Shapes and silhouettes of strange creatures move swiftly through the tunnels, trying to find a way up. You probably don't want to be here when they do...

name: Trapped
flavor: As you leap to investigate, the door to your study vanishes before your eyes, leaving behind only solid wall. You're trapped inside your study until you can find another way out.

name: The Barrier
text: Objective - When the round ends, investigators in the hallway may, as a group, spend the requisite number of clues to advance.
flavor: A glowing barrier blocks the path to your parlor. As you move toward it, intense heat forces you to back away. Picking up a handful of dirt, you toss it as the barrier and watch in horror as the dirt incinerates. Perhaps there's something in the cellar or attic that can help.

name: Hallway
flavor: The walls of your house are splattered with mud, and your hardwood floor is gone, replaced with a dirt path.

name: Attic
text: Forced - After you enter the Attic: Take 1 horror.
flavor: The bloody carcass of a malformed beast swings from a meat hook chained to the ceiling. Blood drains slowly from the carcass, dripping into a small barrel.

name: Cellar
text: Forced - After you enter the Cellar: Take 1 damage.
flavor: Your cellar seems to have been replaced with an underground network of icy tunnels and caverns. The cold chills you to the bone.

name: Parlor
text: [action] Resign. "This is too much for me!" You run out the front door, fleeing in panic. While Lita Chantler is not controlled by a player, she gains: "[action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, take control of Lita Chantler."

name: Flesh-Eater
text: Spawn - Attic.
flavor: A monstrous creature feeds from the rotting carcass in the attic.

name: Swarm of Rats
text: Hunter.
flavor: A horde of cruel rats skitters forth in an undulating wave of claws, teeth, and mottled fur.

name: Ghoul Minion
flavor: It was a colossal and nameless blasphemy with glaring red eyes, and it held in bony claws a thing that had been a man, gnawing at the head as a child nibbles at a stick of candy. <cite>H. P. Lovecraft, "Pickman's Model"</cite>

name: Ravenous Ghoul
text: Prey - Lowest remaining health.
flavor: The sight of the thing raised the question: Do we eat to live, or do we live to eat?

name: Grasping Hands
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.
flavor: Decaying hands rise up from below and grasp and claw at your ankles.

name: Rotting Remains
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror.
flavor: A sickening display of gore causes you to retch. You're glad this wasn't you.

name: Dissonant Voices
text: Revelation - Put Dissonant Voices into play in your threat area. You cannot play assets or events. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Dissonant Voices.

name: Acolyte
text: Spawn - Any empty location. Forced - After Acolyte enters play: Place 1 doom on it.
flavor: It was only a small sacrifice.

name: Mysterious Chanting
text: Revelation - Place 2 doom on the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy. If there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.

name: Hunting Nightgaunt
text:
Hunter.
While attempting to evade Hunting Nightgaunt, double the negative modifier of each revealed chaos token.
flavor: ... they had no faces at all to smile with, but only a suggestive blankness where a face ought to be. <cite>H. P. Lovecraft</cite>

name: Yithian Observer
text: Prey - Fewest cards in hand. Forced - When Yithian Observer attacks you: Discard 1 card at random from your hand. If you cannot, Yithian Observer deals +1 damage and +1 horror for this attack.

name: Ancient Evils
text: Revelation - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.
flavor: Dark forces stir against you. If you do not act quickly, a sinister plot will be fulfilled.

name: Obscuring Fog
text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. Attached location gets +2 shroud. Forced - After attached location is successfully investigated: Discard Obscuring Fog.

name: Umôrdhoth's Wrath
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). For each point you fail by, you must either (choose one): Choose and discard a card from your hand, or take 1 damage and 1 horror.
flavor: A deathly chill from below engulfs you, attempting to suck your life force away.

name: Ruth Turner
text: Spawn - St. Mary's Hospital. Forced - After Ruth Turner is evaded: Add her to the victory display.
flavor: Bodies from the morgue have mysteriously gone missing. Perhaps the mortician in St. Mary's had something to do with these disappearances.

name: Victoria Devereux
text: Spawn - Northside. [action] Spend 5 resources: Parley. Add Victoria Devereux to the victory display.
flavor: Oliver Thomas, the proprietor of the Curiositie Shoppe, has informed you that a new client has taken a keen interest in a mysterious mask...

name: Agnes Baker
text:
[reaction] After 1 or more horror is placed on Agnes Baker: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. (Limit once per phase.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each horror on Agnes Baker.
flavor: "I remember another life, one of sorcery and conquest."

name: Heirloom of Hyperborea
text:
Agnes Baker deck only.
[reaction] After you play a [[Spell]] card: Draw 1 card.
flavor: The etchings on its surface change from day to day, shifting and moving whenever I'm not looking.

name: Hyperawareness
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.

name: Barricade
text: Attach to your location. Non-[[Elite]] enemies cannot move into attached location. Forced - When an investigator leaves attached location: Discard Barricade.

name: Encyclopedia
text: [action] Exhaust Encyclopedia: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator gets +2 to a skill of your choice until the end of the phase.
flavor: It's supposed to be comprehensive, but the more I search through its pages, the more I realize we know nothing about the real truths of the cosmos.

name: Switchblade
text: Fast. [action]: Fight. If you succeed by 2 or more, this attack deals +1 damage.

name: Pickpocketing
text: [reaction] After you evade an enemy, exhaust Pickpocketing: Draw 1 card.

name: Leo De Luca
text: You may take an additional action during your turn.
flavor: "I was born in Mississippi. Louisiana just sounded better."

name: Leather Coat
flavor: The coat was not the most fashionable choice, but it did feel warm and reassuring in its bulk.

name: Survival Instinct
text: If this skill test is successful during an evasion attempt, the evading investigator may immediately disengage from each other enemy engaged with him or her, and may move to a connecting location.

name: Perception
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card.
flavor: At last, I've found it!

name: Hypochondria
text: Revelation - Add Hypochondria to your threat area. Forced - After you take 1 or more damage: Take 1 direct horror. [action] [action]: Discard Hypochondria.

name: Beat Cop
text:
You get +1 [combat].
[fast] Discard Beat Cop: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.

name: First Aid
text:
Uses (3 supplies). If First Aid has no supplies, discard it.
[action] Spend 1 supply: Heal 1 damage or horror from an investigator at your location.

name: Vicious Blow
text: If this skill test is successful during an attack, that attack deals +1 damage.
flavor: With a sickening smack, he struck the abomination over and over... until at last, it stopped moving.

name: Old Book of Lore
text: [action] Exhaust Old Book of Lore: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator searches the top 3 cards of his or her deck for a card, draws it, and shuffles the remaining cards into his or her deck.

name: Research Librarian
text: [reaction] After Research Librarian enters play: Search your deck for a [[Tome]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
flavor: "There have been problems at the Orne Library, as we both know, given poor Armitage's condition, and the other, unrelated... incident of a few years ago..."

name: Medical Texts
text: [action] Choose an investigator at your location and test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, heal 1 damage from that investigator. If you fail, deal 1 damage to that investigator.

name: Mind over Matter
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Until the end of the round, you may use your [intellect] in place of your [combat] and [agility].

name: Working a Hunch
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Discover 1 clue at your location.

name: Deduction
text: If this skill test is successful while investigating a location, discover 1 additional clue at that location.
flavor: I knew I had seen this symbol before. I must warn the others before it is too late!

name: Burglary
text: [action] Exhaust Burglary: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, gain 3 resources.

name: .41 Derringer
text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed by 2 or more, this attack deals +1 damage.

name: Hard Knocks
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.

name: Elusive
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Disengage from each enemy engaged with you and move to a revealed location with no enemies.

name: Sneak Attack
text: Deal 2 damage to an exhausted enemy at your location.

name: Opportunist
text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing.
If you succeed by 3 or more, return Opportunist to your hand after this test instead of discarding it.

name: Scavenging
text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate by 2 or more, exhaust Scavenging: Choose an [[Item]] card in your discard pile and add it to your hand.

name: Haunted
text: Revelation - Add Haunted to your threat area. You get -1 to each of your skills. [action] [action]: Discard Haunted.

name: Ghoul Priest
text: Prey - Highest [combat]. Hunter. Retaliate.
flavor: A figure in red robes wearing a bone mask. It gibbers and snarls before leaping to attack.

name: Frozen in Fear
text: Revelation - Put Frozen in Fear into play in your threat area. The first time you perform one of the following actions (move, fight, or evade) each round, it costs 1 additional action. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Frozen in Fear.

name: They're Getting Out!
text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Each unengaged [[Ghoul]] enemy moves 1 location towards the Parlor. Forced - At the end of the round: Place 1 doom on this agenda for each [[Ghoul]] enemy in the Hallway or Parlor.
flavor: You hear a crazed howl outside, and suddenly all the creatures turn their attention to that sound. They rush to escape the house, breaking down doors and clawing at everything in their way.

name: What Have You Done?
text: Objective - If the Ghoul Priest is Defeated, advance.
flavor: A woman with a torch stands in your parlor, a glimmer of hatred in her eyes. "What have you done to my barrier?" she screams, furious. Before you can enter, a ghastly wail sounds behind you, and a creature wearing robes and a deer skull mask tears through the wall, advancing toward you.

name: Hospital Debts
text: Revelation - Put Hospital Debts into play in your threat area. [fast]: Move 1 resource from your resource pool to Hospital Debts. (Limit twice per round.) Forced - When the game ends, if Hospital Debts has fewer than 6 resources on it: You earn 2 fewer experience for this scenario.

name: Extra Ammunition
text: Place 3 ammo tokens on a [[Firearm]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location.
flavor: I've never met a beast that could outsmart a bullet.

name: Shotgun
text: Uses (2 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +3 [combat] for this attack. Instead of its standard damage, this attack deals 1 damage for each point you succeed by (to a minimum of 1, to a maximum of 5). If you fail and would damage another investigator, this attack deals 1 damage for each point you fail by (to a minimum of 1, to a maximum of 5).

name: Magnifying Glass
text:
Fast.
You get +1 [intellect] while investigating.
[fast] If there are no clues on your location: Return Magnifying Glass to your hand.
flavor: A lens into a world unseen can reveal things you wish it hadn't.

name: Zoey Samaras
text:
[reaction] After you become engaged with an enemy: Gain 1 resource.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If this skill test is successful during an attack, that attack deals +1 damage.
flavor: "God has spoken. I will do His work without hesitation."

name: Jim Culver
text:
Treat the modifier on [skull] tokens you reveal as "0."
Anytime you reveal a [elder_sign] token, you may choose to instead treat it as a [skull] token.
[elder_sign] effect: +1.
flavor: "No, not quiet at all. Dead folks get downright rambunctious when I play my horn."

name: Double or Nothing
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
Double the difficulty of this skill test. If this skill test is successful, resolve the effects of the successful test twice.

name: Teamwork
text: Investigators at your location may give or trade any number of [[Item]] assets, [[Ally]] assets, or resources among one another.
flavor: It's dangerous to go alone.

name: Rite of Seeking
text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using [willpower] instead of [intellect]. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at this location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this test, after this test resolves lose all remaining actions and immediately end your turn.

name: Dark Memory
text: Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance. Forced - If Dark Memory is in your hand at the end of your turn, reveal it and take 2 horror.
flavor: No... not again!

name: Daisy's Tote Bag
text:
Daisy Walker deck only.
You have 2 additional hand slots, which can only be used to hold [[Tome]] assets.

name: Close Call
text:
Fast. Play after a non-weakness, non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location is evaded.
Shuffle that enemy into the encounter deck.

name: Grotesque Statue
text:
Uses (4 charges). If Grotesque Statue has no charges, discard it.
[reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token, spend 1 charge: Reveal 2 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose 1 of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the other.

name: Drawn to the Flame
text: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. Then, discover 2 clues at your location.
flavor: "We live on a placid island of ignorance in the midst of black seas of infinity, and it was not meant that we should voyage far." <cite>H. P. Lovecraft, "The Call of Cthulhu"</cite>

name: Arcane Studies
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test.

name: Hot Streak
text: Gain 10 resources.
flavor: "I win again! Sorry sugar, it's just not your night."

name: Beat Cop
text:
You get +1 [combat].
[fast] Exhaust Beat Cop and deal 1 damage to it: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.

name: Leo De Luca
text: You may take an additional action during your turn.
flavor: "I was born in Mississippi. Louisiana just sounded better."

name: Will to Survive
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Until the end of your turn, do not reveal chaos tokens for any skill tests you perform.

name: St. Mary's Hospital
text: [action]: Heal 3 damage. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: An extended stay at St. Mary's can do wonders for the body, but its effect on one's psyche is unclear.

name: Miskatonic University
text: [action]: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for a [[Tome]] or [[Spell]] card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
flavor: The campus is quiet and lonely. Several of the buildings have been left unlocked for students and faculty working late into the night.

name: Main Path
text: The Main Path is connected to each other [[Woods]] location. [action]: Resign. "There's nothing we can do to stop them!" You flee from the woods, leaving Arkham to its grisly fate.

name: Zoey's Cross
text:
Zoey Samaras deck only.
[reaction] After an enemy becomes engaged with you, exhaust Zoey's Cross and spend 1 resource: Deal 1 damage to that enemy.

name: Smite the Wicked
text: Revelation - Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded. Attach Smite the Wicked to that enemy and spawn it at the location farthest from you. Forced - When the game ends, if attached enemy is in play: Zoey Samaras suffers 1 mental trauma.

name: Internal Injury
text: Revelation - Place Internal Injury into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn: Take 1 direct damage. [action] [action]: Discard Internal Injury.

name: Police Badge
text:
You get +1 [willpower].
[fast] While an investigator at your location is taking his or her turn, discard Police Badge: That investigator may take 2 additional actions this turn.

name: Shrivelling
text: Uses (4 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat] and deals +1 damage. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this attack, take 1 horror.

name: Scrying
text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Exhaust Scrying and spend 1 charge: Look at the top 3 cards of any investigator's deck or the encounter deck. Return them to the top of that deck in any order.

name: Bulletproof Vest
flavor: Bullets are one thing... twelve-inch fangs quite another.

name: Elder Sign Amulet
flavor: This has been in my family for generations. Take care of it, and it will take care of you.

name: Forbidden Knowledge
text:
Uses (4 secrets). If Forbidden Knowledge has no secrets, discard it.
[fast] Exhaust Forbidden Knowledge and take 1 horror: Move 1 secret from Forbidden Knowledge to your resource pool, as a resource.

name: Trapper's Cabin
text:
While you are at Trapper's Cabin, you cannot gain resources.
[action] Spend 5 resources: Test [intellect] (3) to convince an old trapper to sell you his last bear trap. If you succeed, take control of the set-aside Bear Trap asset.

name: Lady Esprit
text: [action] Exhaust Lady Esprit and deal her 1 horror: Heal 2 damage or gain 2 resources. Any investigator at Lady Esprit's location may activate this ability.

name: Marsh Gug
text: Spawn - Any [[Bayou]] location. Hunter.
flavor: A great thrashing accompanied by an echoing roar turns your blood to ice.

name: Beast of the Bayou
text: Revelation - The Rougarou makes an immediate attack against each investigator at The Rougarou's location and each connecting location. If no attacks were made by this effect, place 1 doom on the current agenda.
flavor: Driven by hunger, it cares for naught but its next meal.

name: On the Prowl
text: Surge. Revelation - Find a non-[[Bayou]] location with the fewest clues on it. Move The Rougarou (one location at a time) until it enters that location.
flavor: A dreadful howl pierces your eardrums. The Rougarou is on the move...

name: Vengeance Awaits
text: Forced - When this agenda advances: - If the investigators are at Act 1, put the set-aside Ritual Site into play and spawn the set-aside Umôrdhoth there. - If the investigators are at Act 2 or 3, discard all enemies at the Ritual Site and spawn the set-aside Umôrdhoth there.
flavor: The world begins to shift and change as the ritual nears its conclusion. The air grows chilly, and the entire forest is covered in a layer of rime. The trees bend unnaturally, and their shadows lengthen into weird shape.

name: Adaptable
text:
Permanent.
In between each game of a campaign, you may swap up to two level 0 cards out of your deck in exchange for an equal number of level 0 cards. (You must still follow all deckbuilding rules for your investigator).

name: Delve Too Deep
text: In player order, each investigator draws 1 card from the top of the encounter deck. Then, add Delve Too Deep to the victory display.
flavor: Some things, once seen, can't be unseen.

name: Time Is Running Short
text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.
flavor: The minutes pass quickly as your investigation continues.

name: Uncovering the Conspiracy
text: [action] The investigators spend 2 clues per investigator, as a group: Draw the top card of the Cultist deck. Objective - Find as many unique [[Cultist]] enemies as you can and add them to the victory display. If there are 6 unique [[Cultist]] enemies in the victory display, advance. (Note: Not all 6 of them are in the Cultist deck.)
flavor: You have one night to find the members of this cult and unveil their plan. The more members of the cult you can find and interrogate before midnight, the better.

name: Rivertown
flavor: There is something unsettling about the water of the Miskatonic River tonight. It ripples and bubbles as though something is moving beneath the surface.

name: On the Lam
text:
"Skids" O'Toole deck only.
Fast. Play after your turn begins.
Until the end of the round, non-[[Elite]] enemies cannot attack you.
flavor: I ain't going to the pen a second time.

name: Disc of Itzamna
text: [reaction] When a non-[[Elite]] enemy spawns at your location, discard Disc of Itzamna: Discard that enemy.
flavor: Do they fear it because of what it will do to them? Or, do they fear it because of what it will do to you?

name: Cryptic Research
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator draws 3 cards.

name: Cat Burglar
text:
You get +1 [agility].
[action] Exhaust Cat Burglar: Disengage from each enemy engaged with you and move to a connecting location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Sure Gamble
text:
Fast. Play after you reveal a chaos token with a negative modifier.
Switch that token's "-" to a "+".

name: Arcane Initiate
text: Forced - After Arcane Initiate enters play: Place 1 doom on it. [fast] Exhaust Arcane Initiate: Search the top 3 cards of your deck for a [[Spell]] card and draw it. Shuffle your deck.

name: Ward of Protection
text:
Fast. Play when you draw a non-weakness treachery card.
Cancel that card's revelation effect. Then, take 1 horror.

name: Fearless
text: If this skill test is successful, heal 1 horror.
flavor: Only by standing firm against the darkness can we live to see the light of another day.

name: Mind Wipe
text:
Fast. Play after a phase begins.
Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. Treat the chosen enemy's printed text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]) until the end of the phase.

name: Book of Shadows
text:
You have 1 additional arcane slot.
[action] Exhaust Book of Shadows: Add 1 charge to a [[Spell]] asset you control.

name: Aquinnah
text: [reaction] When an enemy attacks you, exhaust Aquinnah and deal 1 horror to her: Deal that enemy's damage to another enemy at your location, instead. (You still take horror dealt by the attack.)
flavor: "Do not be frightened by what you see. Be frightened by what you cannot see."

name: Psychosis
text: Revelation - Add Psychosis to your threat area. Forced - After you take 1 or more horror: Take 1 direct damage. [action] [action]: Discard Psychosis.

name: Mob Enforcer
text: Prey - Bearer only. Hunter. [action] Spend 4 resources: Parley. Discard Mob Enforcer.
flavor: You knew you shouldn't have borrowed money from the O'Bannion gang. It seems like they're always looking to collect at the worst times.

name: Silver Twilight Acolyte
text: Prey - Bearer only. Hunter. Forced - After Silver Twilight Acolyte attacks: Place 1 doom on the current agenda.
flavor: You'll never forget the day you learned the true secret of the Silver Twilight Lodge's inner circle. The truth is too terrible for the Lodge to let you live.

name: Stubborn Detective
text: Prey - Bearer only. Hunter. While Stubborn Detective is at your location, treat your investigator as if his or her printed text box were blank (except for [[Traits]]).
flavor: Despite everything, he still won't believe you had nothing to do with those murders.

name: Hunting Shadow
text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): Spend 1 clue or take 2 damage.
flavor: A shadowy figure follows you in the rain. When you look back, your head pounds in agony and your vision blurs.

name: False Lead
text: Revelation - If you have no clues, False Lead gains surge. If you have 1 or more clues, test [intellect] (4). For each point you fail by, place 1 of your clues on your location.

name: "Wolf-Man" Drew
text: Spawn - Downtown. Forced - When "Wolf-Man" Drew attacks: Heal 1 damage from him.
flavor: Drew is a longtime patient at Arkham Asylum. Rumor has it he was locked up for committing cannibalism several years ago. He is considered extremely dangerous.

name: Relentless Dark Young
text: Prey - Lowest [agility]. Forced - At the end of the round: Heal 2 damage from Relentless Dark Young.
flavor: The trees trembled, leaves fluttering around us. The earth shook as the thuds of giant hooved feet grew ever closer...

name: Crypt Chill
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, choose and discard 1 asset you control (if you cannot, take 2 damage instead).
flavor: The supernatural cold threatens to freeze your soul.

name: The Midnight Masks
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the highest number of doom on a [[Cultist]] enemy in play.
[cultist]: -2. Place 1 doom on the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.

name: Predator or Prey?
text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.
flavor: Lita seems convinced of a conspiracy within the city of Arkham. She believes that a secret cult serves the ghouls that live in the crypts beneath the city, and that several of the cult's prominent members are scattered throughout Arkham. As you begin searching for them, you can't shake the feeling that you, too, are being hunted.

name: The Masked Hunter
text: Spawn - Engaged with Prey. Prey - Most clues. Hunter. The Masked Hunter gets +2 health per investigator. While you are engaged with The Masked Hunter, you cannot discover or spend clues.

name: Your House
text: Forced - When the Ghoul Priest spawns: Spawn it here instead of at its normal location. [action]: Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource. (Limit once per turn.)
flavor: You still feel uneasy about going back.

name: Southside
text: [action]: Draw 3 cards. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: The Georgian manor housing the Historical Society is well known for its private library, where local records, maps, and artifacts from Arkham's past hint at secrets better left alone.

name: Southside
text: [action]: Search your deck for an [[Ally]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: Ma's is famous for its cheap rooms and Mystery Meat Mondays. A motley variety of characters can be found coming and going at all times of day.

name: Downtown
text: [action]: Gain 3 resources. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: We'll call this a "loan."

name: Downtown
text: [action]: Heal 3 horror. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: A refuge for the mind, or a prison for the soul?

name: Easttown
text: While you are in Easttown, reduce the cost of each [[Ally]] asset you play by 2.

name: Graveyard
text: Forced - After you enter the Graveyard: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, you must either take 2 horror or move to Rivertown.

name: Northside
text: [action] Spend 5 resources: Gain 2 clues from the token pool. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: In Northside, nothing gets people talking faster than a piece of dough.

name: Herman Collins
text: Spawn - Graveyard. [action] Choose and discard 4 cards from your hand: Parley. Add Herman Collins to the victory display.
flavor: The undertaker in the local graveyard has been digging strange tunnels underneath the mausoleum... but for what purpose?

name: Peter Warren
text: Spawn - Miskatonic University. [action] Spend 2 clues: Parley. Add Peter Warren to the victory display.
flavor: A professor of the occult has been seen reading strange books that relate to cannibalism. Maybe he knows something we don't?

name: The Devourer Below
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of [[Monster]] enemies in play.
[cultist]: -2. Place 1 doom on the nearest enemy.
[tablet]: -3. If there is a [[Monster]] enemy at your location, take 1 damage.
[elder_thing]: -5. If there is an [[Ancient One]] enemy in play, reveal another token.

name: The Arkham Woods
flavor: After interrogating members of the conspiracy within Arkham, you have learned that they are performing a rite of vengeance in response to the destruction of one of their master's lairs. You have entered the woods outside Arkham to try and stop them. The woods seem unnaturally cold, and filled with a deathly silence.

name: The Ritual Begins
text: Each enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
flavor:
"Umôrdhoth... Umôrdhoth... Umôrdhoth..."
The chanting builds in intensity, echoing into the cold air of the night. The sparse clouds in the sky coalesce above the Arkham woods, blotting out the faint light of the stars.

name: Investigating the Trail
flavor: The evidence you've gathered has led you to the woods south of Arkham, where you believe a ritual to summon a being called "Umôrdhoth" is about to take place. Steeling your resolve, you set forth deeper into the woods, hoping to find the site of this ritual.

name: Into the Darkness
text: Objective - If an investigator enters the Ritual Site, advance.
flavor: The remaining cultists have followed you into the woods to try to stop you, and now they block the path to your objective. They stand ominously beneath the overhanging trees, silent sentinels in the night. You must defeat them or sneak past if you are to gain access to the site of their ritual.

name: Disrupting the Ritual
text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Test [willpower] (3) or [agility] (3). If you succeed, place 1 clue on this Act. Objective - If there are 2 clues per investigator on this Act, advance.
flavor: The site of the cult's ritual is inside a large cavern in a dark corner of the woods. In the center of the chamber is a candlelit circle marked by rocks and arcane runes.

name: Arkham Woods
text: Forced - After you enter this location: Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, take 1 horror and 1 damage.
flavor: This clearing has been the site of dark rites since colonists first came to the area over two centuries ago.

name: Arkham Woods
text: Forced - When you move out of this location: Test [intellect] (3). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move.
flavor: This path seems to twist and turn upon itself, almost as if it were alive.

name: Arkham Woods
text: This location is investigated using [willpower] instead of the skill indicated by the investigation attempt.
flavor: A house at the edge of the trail, covered in vines. Inside, the walls and floors are bloodstained and littered with dirt, mud, and discarded bones.

name: Arkham Woods
text: This location is investigated using [agility] instead of the skill indicated by the investigation attempt.
flavor: Atop a nearby plateau, you can see signs of cultist activity. You will have to climb the cliff in order to reach the top.

name: Arkham Woods
text: This location is investigated using [combat] instead of the skill indicated by the investigation attempt.
flavor: An old horse trail in colonial days, this overgrown path hasn't been used in over a decade.

name: Arkham Woods
text: [action]: Heal 1 damage or heal 1 horror. (Limit once per turn.)
flavor: This would be a nice picnic spot, if it weren't for all the monsters.

name: Ritual Site
text: Forced - At the end of the round, if there are fewer than 2 clues per investigator on Ritual Site: Add clues to it until it has 2 clues per investigator on it.
flavor: The sigils on the wall begin to flicker in and out of focus, and the air grows heavy with the smell of death.

name: Umôrdhoth
text: Hunter. Massive. Umôrdhoth gets +4 health per investigator. Forced - At the end of each investigator's turn: Ready Umôrdhoth. [action] If you control Lita Chantler: "It's only after her!" You throw Lita to Umôrdhoth in order to spare your lives. (→R3)

name: Wizard of the Order
text: Spawn - Any empty location. Retaliate. Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Place 1 doom on Wizard of the Order.

name: On Wings of Darkness
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail, take 1 horror and 1 damage. Then, disengage with each non-[[Nightgaunt]] enemy engaged with you and move to a [[Central]] location.
flavor: A nightgaunt swoops down from the sky and grabs you with its clawed hands, carrying you off into the night.

name: Locked Door
text: Revelation - Attach to the location in play with the most clues, and without a Locked Door attached. The attached location cannot be investigated. [action]: Test [combat] (4) to break down the door or [agility] (4) to pick the lock. If you succeed, discard Locked Door.

name: Screeching Byakhee
text: Prey - Lowest remaining sanity. Hunter. While engaged with an investigator with remaining sanity 4 or fewer, Screeching Byakhee gets +1 fight and +1 evade.

name: The Yellow Sign
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, take 2 horror and search your deck for a [[Madness]] weakness. Draw that card and shuffle your deck.
flavor: They came to me slowly as if I had forgotten them, and at last I could make some sense out of the sounds. It was this: "Have you found the Yellow Sign?" <cite>Robert W. Chambers, "The Yellow Sign"</cite>

name: Offer of Power
text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): draw 2 cards and place 2 doom on the current agenda (this effect can cause the current agenda to advance), or take 2 horror.
flavor: A voice inside your head offers you power... For a price.

name: Goat Spawn
text: Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - When Goat Spawn is defeated: Each investigator at this location takes 1 horror.
flavor: The creature was at once terrible and graceful, the result of blasphemous trafficks with some otherworldly horror.

name: Young Deep One
text: Prey - Lowest [combat]. Hunter. Forced - After Young Deep One engages you: Take 1 horror.

name: Dreams of R'lyeh
text: Revelation - Put Dreams of R'lyeh into play in your threat area. You get -1 [willpower] and -1 sanity. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, Discard Dreams of R'lyeh.

name: Curse of the Rougarou
text: Revelation - Put Curse of the Rougarou into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn, if you have not dealt any damage this turn: Take 1 horror.
flavor: Your stomach convulses and you feel the first ghastly pangs of hunger.

name: Monstrous Transformation
text: Fast. Set the base value of your [willpower] and [intellect] to 2. Set the base value of your [combat] and [agility] to 5. [action] Exhaust Monstrous Transformation: Fight. You deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: Stand Together
text: Choose another investigator at your location. Both you and that investigator draw 2 cards and gain 2 resources.
flavor: They won't take us down that easily!

name: "I'm outta here!"
text: Play only if there is a scenario card with a 'resign' ability in play. Resign. You get the hell out of here.
flavor: Quitters may never win, but they also rarely die.

name: Charisma
text:
Permanent.
You have 1 additional ally slot.
flavor: When you turn on the charm, it could light the entire town.

name: A Creature of the Bayou
flavor: After arriving in New Orleans the next day, you start your investigation by asking the locals what they knew of the recent killings. As you suspected, most know very little of the incidents. You do manage to find several eyewitnesses who give similar descriptions of the creature: its lithe, muscular form, lanky arms, and wolf-like visage. A promising start - but if there is any truth to the rumors about this "curse", you'll have to talk to Lady Esprit herself.

name: The Rougarou Feeds
flavor: Around you, the bayou feasts. Flesh rips and jaws snap just beyond the trees, and light droplets of rain ripple upon the surface of the water. You can't tell exactly where the sounds are coming from. Perhaps it's the dreadful ambience of the bayou itself.

name: The Curse Spreads
text: Forced - At the end of the investigation phase, if The Rougarou is not engaged with an investigator: Add 1 doom to this agenda.
flavor: Tendrils of slime ooze from the bogs, crawling over tree roots and grasping at you as you pass. The air hangs heavy with a noxious heat. You feel as though you are sinking, sinking deep into the bayou, sinking beneath the heaviness of the black sky and the rank mist...

name: Finding Lady Esprit
text: Objective - Only investigators at a [[Bayou]] location may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: According to your contact, Lady Esprit is a Voodoo priestess who lives deep within the bayou. Most tend to stay clear of her lonely shack. After all, the bayou can be a dangerous place, even were it not for the recent rash of savage killings.

name: Hunting the Rougarou
text: Forced - After The Rougarou leaves a location: Place 1 clue from the token bank on that location. Objective - "We have to destroy the beast!" If The Rougarou is defeated: (→R2) Objective - "Maybe there's another way..." While an investigator is engaged with The Rougarou, he or she may choose to advance. (Limit once per phase.)
flavor: The Rougarou is somewhere within the vast bayou. You must track it down and destroy it, lest the beast's curse consume you as well.

name: Rex Murphy
text:
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more while investigating: Discover 1 clue at your location.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may instead choose to automatically fail this skill test to draw 3 cards.
flavor: "This time, nothing will stop me from getting at the truth!"

name: Jenny Barnes
text:
You collect 1 additional resource during each upkeep phase.
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each resource you have.
flavor: "No more 'Miss Barnes' from you. My friends call me Jenny."

name: Search for the Truth
text:
Rex Murphy deck only.
Draw X cards, where X is the number of clues on Rex Murphy (to a maximum of 5).
flavor: When things went his way, which wasn't often these days, Rex was a good reporter, with a nose for a story and an eye for detail... <cite>Graham McNeill, Ghouls of the Miskatonic,</cite>

name: Rex's Curse
text: Revelation - Put Rex's Curse into play in your threat area. Forced - When you would succeed at a skill test: Return the revealed chaos token to the bag and reveal a new chaos token. If this effect causes you to fail the test, shuffle Rex's Curse into your deck. (Limit once per test.)

name: Jenny's Twin .45s
text: Jenny Barnes deck only. Uses (X ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage.
flavor: "...Say, are those Mr. Donohue's guns?" Jenny held a pistol over her shoulder and struck a pose. "I think they suit me better than him. Don't you agree?"

name: Searching for Izzie
text: Revelation - Attach Searching for Izzie to the location farthest from you. [action] [action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, discard Searching for Izzie. Forced - When the game ends, if Searching for Izzie is in play: Jenny Barnes suffers 1 mental trauma.

name: Jim's Trumpet
text:
Jim Culver deck only.
[reaction] When a [skull] token is revealed during a skill test, exhaust Jim's Trumpet: Heal 1 horror from an investigator at your location or a connecting location.
flavor: Daddy used to say, "Jazz is a lot like liquor, it makes everything go down a little smoother." Daddy used to say a lot of stupid things.

name: Final Rhapsody
text: Revelation - Reveal 5 chaos tokens from the chaos bag. For each [skull] and [auto_fail] token revealed, take 1 damage and 1 horror.
flavor: When the dead start talking about what scares them, that's when it's time to listen.

name: Shortcut
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose an investigator at your location. Move that investigator to a connecting location.
flavor: You know this town like the back of your hand.

name: Indebted
text:
Permanent.
You start each game with 2 fewer resources.
flavor: One man's loan is another man's treasure.

name: Chronophobia
text: Revelation - Place Chronophobia into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn: Take 1 direct horror. [action] [action]: Discard Chronophobia.

name: Cursed Shores
text: [action]: Take 1 damage. You get +2 to your skill value for the next skill test you make this turn. Forced - When you leave Cursed Shores: Choose and discard a skill card from your hand.

name: Garden District
text: [action]: Test [agility] (7) to try to break into a nearby greenhouse and take a look around. If you succeed, remember that the investigators have "found a strange doll."
flavor: A trail of blood and mangled flesh led you here. You suspect this is no ordinary garden.

name: Broadmoor
text: [action]: Resign. "We can't catch the beast!" You make your way to safety, letting the beast roam free.
flavor: People are just now beginning to settle what began as an untamed marsh. Truth is, some evils run too deep to exorcise that easily.

name: Brackish Waters
text:
While you are at Brackish Waters, you cannot play assets.
[action] Discard 2 assets from your hand or from play: Test [agility] (3) to wade through the dark waters and retrieve an abandoned fishing net. If you succeed, take control of the set-aside Fishing Net asset.

name: Audubon Park
text: Forced - When you evade an enemy at Audubon Park: Discard a random card from your hand.
flavor: Leaves flutter in the cold wind, breaking the stillness of the park. With an area strangely abandoned, you feel as though you don't belong here.

name: Faubourg Marigny
text: While you are at Fauborg Marigny, reduce the cost of each asset you play by 1. [action]: Resign. "We can't catch the beast!" You make your way to safety, letting the beast roam free.

name: Forgotten Marsh
text: Forced - When you leave Forgotten Marsh: Lose 2 resources.

name: Twisted Underbrush
text: [action]: Gain 2 resources and take 1 horror.
flavor: This region is covered in twisted plants that grow odd-looking berries. They look absolutely delicious...

name: Foul Swamp
text:
While you are at Foul Swamp, you cannot heal horror or cancel horror.
[action] Take up to 3 horror: Test [willpower] (7) to search the boneyard. You get +1 [willpower] for this test for each horror taken as part of this ability's cost. If you succeed, remember that the investigators have "found an ancient binding stone."

name: Ritual Grounds
text: Forced - After you end your turn at Ritual Grounds: Draw 1 card and take 1 horror.
flavor: A macabre display greets you as you venture deeper into the bayou, where black magick and occult rituals find their home.

name: Overgrown Cairns
text: [action] Spend 2 resources: Heal 2 horror. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: These cairnstones were placed here centuries ago, their purpose unknown.

name: Bear Trap
text: [fast]: Attach Bear Trap to your location. Forced - After The Rougarou enters attached location: Attach Bear Trap to The Rougarou. Attached enemy gets -1 fight and -1 evade.

name: Fishing Net
text:
[fast] If The Rougarou is exhausted and at your location: Attach Fishing Net to The Rougarou.
Attached enemy loses retaliate.

name: Bog Gator
text: Prey - Lowest [agility]. While Bog Gator is at a [[Bayou]] location, it gets +2 fight and +2 evade.
flavor: They were apex predators even before the curse took hold.

name: Swamp Leech
text: Spawn - Any [[Bayou]] location. Swamp Leech cannot be evaded. Forced - When Swamp Leech enters a non-[[Bayou]] location: Discard it.

name: Cursed Swamp
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 damage. If you are at a [[Bayou]] location, you cannot commit cards to this skill test.

name: Spectral Mist
text: Revelation - Attach to a [[Bayou]] location. Limit 1 per location. Each skill test performed at attached location gets +1 difficulty. [action]: Test [intellect] (2) to disrupt the source of the mist. If you succeed, discard Spectral Mist.

name: Dragged Under
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, add Dragged Under to your threat area. Forced - When you leave your current location: take 2 damage and discard Dragged Under. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, discard Dragged Under.

name: Ripples on the Surface
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror. If you are at a [[Bayou]] location, you cannot commit cards to this skill test.
flavor: There are dangers deep within the mire you can only begin to imagine.

name: The Rougarou
text: Aloof. Retaliate. As an additional cost for an investigator to engage The Rougarou, the investigators must spend 1 clue, as a group (2 clues instead if there are 3 or 4 investigators). Forced - After The Rougarou takes 1 [per_investigator] damage during a single phase: Find the location that is farthest from all investigators. Move The Rougarou (one location at a time) until it enters that location.

name: Slime-Covered Dhole
text: Spawn - Any non-[[Bayou]] location. Prey - Lowest remaining health. Hunter. Forced - When Slime-Covered Dhole enters a location: Each investigator at that location takes 1 horror.

name: Dark Young Host
text: Spawn - Any [[Bayou]] location. Forced - When 1 or more clues are placed on Dark Young Host's location: Place those clues on Dark Young Host. Forced - When Dark Young Host is defeated: Move all clues on Dark Young Host to its location.

name: Insatiable Bloodlust
text: Revelation - Attach to The Rougarou. The Rougarou gets +1 fight, +1 damage, +1 horror, and cannot be evaded. Forced - After The Rougarou takes damage: Discard Insatiable Bloodlust.

name: Curse of the Rougarou
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -2 (-4 instead if you are at a [[Bayou]] location).
[cultist]: -2. If the Rougarou is in your location, reveal another token.
[tablet]: Reveal another token. If you fail, until the end of the round, you cannot move.
[elder_thing]: -4. If the Rougarou is at your location, it attacks you.

name: Random Basic Weakness
text:
This is a placeholder random basic weakness
 You can replace it with a specific weakness using the Special tab or click the random button to replace it with a random weakness from your collection.

name: Strange Solution
text: [action] Test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, discard Strange Solution and draw 2 cards. Record in your Campaign Log that "you have identified the solution."
flavor: By all accounts, it should not even exist.

name: San Marco Basilica
text:
San Marco Basilica is connected to the location in the clockwise direction.
[action]: Place an Innocent Reveler you control underneath the act deck, out of play.
flavor: Blessed and warded by the abbess, the Basilica is about as safe a place as you can find in Venice. But it is not safe enough.

name: Don Lagorio
text:
Hunter.
While resolving the hunter keyword on Don Lagorio, his location is connected to the location in the counter-clockwise direction, as well as the clockwise direction.

name: Salvatore Neri
text:
Retaliate.
Salvatore Neri's fight value is equal to the attacking investigator's base [combat].
Salvatore Neri's evade value is equal to the evading investigator's base [agility].

name: Savio Corvi
text:
Hunter.
While resolving the hunter keyword on Savio Corvi, his location is connected to the location across from him, as well as in the clockwise direction.

name: Innocent Reveler
text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2) to convince the reveler to follow you to safety. If you succeed, take control of Innocent Reveler. Forced - When Innocent Reveler would be discarded: Place it underneath the agenda deck, out of play. Each investigator takes 1 horror.

name: Pantalone
text:
Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
[reaction] After Pantalone enters play: Draw 2 cards.
[reaction] When you initiate a non-[intellect] test, discard Pantalone: Use [intellect] for this test, instead of the skill indicated.

name: Gilded Volto
text:
Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
[reaction] After Gilded Volto enters play: Treat the next asset you play this turn as if it has fast.
[reaction] When you initiate a non-[agility] test, discard Gilded Volto: Use [agility] for this test, instead of the skill indicated.

name: Abbess Allegria Di Biase
text: [fast]: Exhaust Abbess Allegria Di Biase: Move from her location to a connecting location, or to her location from a location connected to it. Any investigator may trigger this ability.

name: Bauta
text:
Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
[reaction] After Bauta enters play: Gain 2 resources.
[reaction] When you initiate a non-[combat] test, discard Bauta: Use [combat] for this test, instead of the skill indicated.

name: Cnidathqua
text: You may fight Cnidathqua as if it were at your location (it is not engaged with you). Cnidathqua cannot be evaded. Forced - After you fail a test while attacking Cnidathqua: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Writhing Appendage and spawn it engaged with you. Objective - If Cnidathqua is defeated, (→R2).

name: Lost in Venice
text: Peril. Revelation - You must either take 2 horror or move to the location across from you.
flavor: How exactly did you end up here?

name: Watchers' Gaze
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). Each investigator who controls an Innocent Reveler must also perform this skill test. Each investigator who fails takes 1 horror, which must be assigned to Innocent Reveler first, if able.

name: Marie Lambeau
text:
While you have 1 or more doom among cards you control, you may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to play [[Spell]] cards or activate [[Spell]] [action] abilities.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may add 1 doom to or remove 1 doom from a card you control.

name: Mystifying Song
text:
Marie Lambeau deck only.
Fast. Play when the agenda would advance by reaching its doom threshold.
Until the end of the phase, the agenda cannot advance by reaching its doom threshold. Remove Mystifying Song from the game.

name: Baron Samedi
text: Revelation - Put Baron Samedi into play. He cannot leave play while he has less than 3 doom on him. Forced - When any amount of damage is placed on an investigator in Baron Samedi's location: Place 1 additional damage on that investigator. [fast] Exhaust Baron Samedi: Place 1 doom on Baron Samedi. If he has 3 or more doom on him, discard him.

name: "Ashcan" Pete
text:
You begin the game with Duke in play.
[fast] Discard a card from your hand: Ready an asset you control. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Ready Duke.
flavor: "C'mere, boy. We got work to do."

name: Duke
text: "Ashcan" Pete deck only. [action] Exhaust Duke: Fight. You attack with a base [combat] skill of 4. This attack deals +1 damage. [action] Exhaust Duke: Investigate. You investigate with a base [intellect] skill of 4. You may move to a connecting location immediately before investigating with this effect.

name: Wracked by Nightmares
text: Revelation - Exhaust all assets you control and put Wracked by Nightmares into play in your threat area. Assets you control cannot ready. [action] [action]: Discard Wracked by Nightmares.

name: Blackjack
text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. If you perform this attack against an enemy engaged with another investigator and you fail, you deal no damage.

name: Taunt
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Engage any number of enemies at your location.
flavor: You steel your nerves and shout into the darkness. "Come and get me!"

name: Taunt
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Engage any number of enemies at your location. Draw 1 card for each enemy engaged in this way.
flavor: You steel your nerves and shout into the darkness. "Come and get me!"

name: Laboratory Assistant
text:
Your maximum hand size is increased by 2.
[reaction] After Laboratory Assistant enters play: Draw 2 cards.

name: Seeking Answers
text: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering a clue at your location, discover a clue at a connecting location.
flavor: Some people need to know the truth at any cost. Some truths can cut like knives.

name: Liquid Courage
text:
Uses (4 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply: Choose an investigator at your location to heal 1 horror. Then, that investigator tests [willpower] (2). If the test succeeds, he or she heals 1 additional horror. If the test fails, he or she discards 1 card at random from his or her hand.

name: Think on Your Feet
text:
Fast. Play when an enemy would spawn at your location.
Immediately move to a connecting location. (The enemy still spawns at your previous location.)

name: Hired Muscle
text: You get +1 [combat]. Forced - At the end of the upkeep phase: You must either pay 1 resource or discard Hired Muscle.

name: Ritual Candles
text: [reaction] After a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol is revealed during a test you are performing: You get +1 skill value for this test.
flavor: The wax tapers give off an eerie glow, and the flames move as if they are alive.

name: Clarity of Mind
text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Spend 1 charge: Heal 1 horror from an investigator at your location.
flavor:
From the unreal lead me to the real
From the darkness lead me to the light
From the dead lead me to the immortal

name: Bind Monster
text: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. If you succeed and the enemy is non‑[[Elite]], evade it and attach Bind Monster to it. [reaction] When attached enemy would ready: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, attached enemy does not ready. If you fail, discard Bind Monster.

name: Fire Axe
text: [action]: Fight. If you have no resources in your resource pool, this attack deals +1 damage. [fast] During an attack using Fire Axe, spend 1 resource: You get +2 [combat] for this skill test. (Limit three times per attack.)

name: Peter Sylvestre
text:
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] After your turn ends: Heal 1 horror from Peter Sylvestre.
flavor: The broad-shouldered young man exudes the sort of confidence one only finds in youth.

name: Bait and Switch
text: Evade. If you succeed, if the enemy is non-[[Elite]], evade the enemy and move it to a connecting location.

name: Peter Sylvestre
text:
You get +1 [agility] and +1 [willpower].
[reaction] After your turn ends: Heal 1 horror from Peter Sylvestre.
flavor: The broad-shouldered young man exudes the sort of confidence one only finds in youth.

name: Kukri
text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, you may spend 1 additional action to deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: Keen Eye
text:
Permanent.
[fast] Spend 2 resources: You get +1 [intellect] until the end of the phase.
[fast] Spend 2 resources: You get +1 [combat] until the end of the phase.

name: Blood Pact
text:
Permanent.
[fast] Add 1 doom to Blood Pact: You get +3 [willpower] for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)
[fast] Add 1 doom to Blood Pact: You get +3 [combat] for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)

name: Emergency Cache
text: Gain 3 resources and draw 1 card.
flavor: You can never be too prepared.

name: Writhing Appendage
text: Retaliate. Forced - After Writhing Appendage attacks you: Discard a random card from your hand. Forced - When Writhing Appendage is defeated, if Cnidathqua is in play: Deal 1 damage to Cnidathqua.

name: Dr. Henry Armitage
text: [reaction] After you draw a non-weakness card, discard that card and exhaust Dr. Henry Armitage: Gain 3 resources.
flavor: Armitage knew he would be meddling with terrible powers, yet saw that there was no other way to annul the deeper and more malign meddling which others had done before him. - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"

name: Extracurricular Activity
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1. If you fail, discard the top 3 cards of your deck.
[cultist]: -1 (-3 instead if there are 10 or more cards in your discard pile).
[elder_thing]: -X. Discard the top 2 cards of your deck. X is the total printed cost of those discarded cards.

name: Quiet Halls
flavor: You have arrived at the Miskatonic University campus in search of Professor Warren Rice. Classes are over, and a mysterious silence hangs in the air over the quad.

name: Dead of Night
text: Each investigator's maximum hand size is reduced by 3 while checking his or her hand size during the upkeep phase.
flavor: Professor Rice's disappearance isn't the only thing amiss at the university. You're unsure exactly what is going on, but you're starting to believe Armitage was right in asking for your help.

name: The Beast Unleashed
text: Forced - When this agenda would advance by reaching its doom threshold: Instead, remove all doom in play and move The Experiment 1 location toward the Dormitories. Objective - If The Experiment enters the Dormitories, advance.
flavor: Some kind of wild creature is on the loose. Whatever it is, it appears to be headed toward the university dormitories.

name: After Hours
flavor: Professor Rice was last seen several hours ago by one of Armitage's students, in the Humanities building.

name: Rice's Whereabouts
text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck (top 10 instead if there is only 1 player in the game). Forced - If you discard "Jazz" Mulligan for any reason, resolve his revelation effect. Objective - When you take control of "Jazz" Mulligan, advance.
flavor: Concerned for Professor Rice's safety, you seek out the head janitor, who can let you into the locked sections of the campus.

name: Campus Safety
text: Objective - Find and complete an objective on another encounter card.
flavor: You have only moments to react. You could warn the students in the dormitories and escort them to safety, or continue your task of searching the faculty offices for Professor Rice. Or, perhaps you could try to slay the beast that threatens the campus.

name: Miskatonic Quad
text: [action]: Resign. "We can't find Rice anywhere..." You leave the campus, hoping Armitage will forgive you.
flavor: Surrounded by fences and gates of wrought iron, you can't help but feel as much a prisoner here as a guest.

name: Humanities Building
text: Forced - At the end of your turn, if you are in the Humanities Building: Discard the top X cards of your deck, where X is the amount of horror on you.
flavor: The power is out, plunging the building's halls into heavy darkness. There is no sign of Professor Rice.

name: Orne Library
text: You must spend 1 additional action to investigate the Orne Library.
flavor: The Orne Library is a labyrinth of dusty bookshelves and poorly lit halls.

name: Student Union
text: Forced - After Student Union is revealed: Put the set-aside Dormitories into play. [action] [action]: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror.

name: Dormitories
text: Objective - If investigators in the Dormitories spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: (→R2)
flavor: As you explore these old, well-kept buildings, you find yourself wondering whether the beds are comfortable...

name: Administration Building
text: Forced - After Administration Building is revealed: Put the set-aside Faculty Offices into play. Forced - At the end of your turn, if you are in the Administration Building: Discard the top card of your deck.

name: Faculty Offices
text: Forced - After Faculty Offices is revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Humanoid]] enemy and spawn it here. Shuffle the encounter deck. Objective - If investigators in the Faculty Offices spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: (→R1)

name: Faculty Offices
flavor: There is no sign of Professor Rice in his office. You call his name, and it echoes fruitlessly through the hall.

name: Science Building
text: Forced - After Science Building is revealed: Put the set-aside Alchemy Labs into play. Forced - When you fail a [willpower] test in the Science Building: Take 1 damage.
flavor: A trail of viscous ooze snakes through the halls of the Science building's first floor, leading down into the basement.

name: Alchemy Labs
text: [action]: Investigate. If you are successful, instead of discovering clues, take the Alchemical Concoction from underneath this location if able.
flavor: Peculiar concoctions and obscure reagents line the shelves of the laboratory. What manner of science is going on down here?

name: The Experiment
text: Massive. The Experiment gets +3 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When the enemy phase begins: Ready The Experiment. Objective - If The Experiment is defeated, advance to act 3b.

name: Alchemical Concoction
text: [action]: Fight. This attack uses [intellect] instead of [combat]. If used to attack The Experiment, this attack deals +6 damage. If you succeed, remove Alchemical Concoction from the game.

name: "Jazz" Mulligan
text: Revelation - Put "Jazz" Mulligan into play at your location. While "Jazz" Mulligan is not controlled by a player, he gains: "[action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (3). If successful, take control of "Jazz" Mulligan." While you control "Jazz" Mulligan, you ignore the text on each unrevealed [[Miskatonic]] location.

name: Professor Warren Rice
text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After you discover the last remaining clue in your location, exhaust Professor Warren Rice: Draw 1 card.

name: The House Always Wins
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -2. You may spend 2 resources to treat this token as a 0, instead.
[cultist]: -3. If you succeed, gain 3 resources.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail, discard 3 resources.

name: The Clover Club
text: Each [[Criminal]] enemy gains Aloof. Forced - If an investigator deals damage to a [[Criminal]] enemy: Immediately advance.
flavor: You have entered the Clover Club Casino in search of Dr. Morgan. The club is bustling at this late hour, filled with patrons looking to relax and drink, or make it big. You don't appear to be in much danger.

name: Underground Muscle
flavor: Most of the other patrons seem oblivious to the mobsters and goons closing in around you. But you recognize this for what it really is - you're about to get roughed up.

name: Chaos in the Clover Club
text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Discard each [[Criminal]] enemy in the same location as an [[Abomination]] enemy.
flavor: Amidst the chaos and confusion, the strange abominations attack everyone in the club. Screams echo through the halls as the blood begins to spray.

name: Beginner's Luck
text: [reaction] When you reveal a chaos token: You may treat that token as if it were any other token in the chaos bag. If you do, remember that you have "cheated." (Group limit once per round.) Objective - When the investigators have collected the requisite number of clues, they must immediately spend them and advance.
flavor: You need to find Dr. Morgan. The club is packed; perhaps somebody knows where he is.

name: Skin Game
text: Objective - Only investigators in the VIP Area may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: Dr. Morgan is somewhere in the private section of the club, where only VIPs and the club's managers are allowed. If you are to find him, you're going to have to sneak or even fight your way in.

name: All In
text: While Dr. Morgan is not controlled by a player, he gains "[action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (3) to shake Dr. Morgan out of his daze. If you succeed, place 1 clue from the token bank on him. If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Dr. Morgan, take control of him." Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
flavor: With or without Dr. Morgan, you have to get out of here. Fast.

name: Fold
text: While Peter Clover is not controlled by a player, he gains "[action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (3) to convince Peter to follow you. If you succeed, place 1 clue from the token bank on him. If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Peter Clover, take control of him." Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
flavor: "Free drinks for whoever gets me the hell out of here!" A man exclaims from the bar.

name: La Bella Luna
text: [action]: Resign. This was a bust.
flavor: The music is cliché and they only serve spaghetti. As far as covers for underground speakeasies go, it's not particularly creative.

name: Clover Club Lounge
text:
While it is Act 1, Clover Club Lounge gains:
"[action] Discard an [[Ally]] asset from your hand: Gain 2 clues from the token pool. (Limit once per game.)"

name: Clover Club Bar
text:
While it is Act 1, Clover Club Bar gains:
"[action] Spend 2 resources: Gain 2 clues from the token pool and draw 2 cards. Remember that you have 'had a drink.' (Limit once per game.)"

name: Clover Club Cardroom
text:
While it is Act 1, Clover Club Cardroom gains:
"[action] Spend 2 resources: Reveal a random chaos token.
If it is a [elder_sign] symbol, gain 2 clues and 2 resources from the token bank.
If it is an even number, gain 2 clues from the token bank.
If it is an odd number or a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, nothing happens."

name: Darkened Hall
text: Forced - When Darkened Hall is revealed: Put into play the 3 set-aside Back Hall Doorway locations.
flavor: The door slams shut behind you, and you stand in sudden silence. This area of the club is lonesome and devoid of warmth and color. Somehow, the spotless floor and walls seem more sinister than inviting.

name: Art Gallery
text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating the Art Gallery: Lose 2 resources.
flavor: Exotic art and antiques adorn the walls of Peter Clover's private gallery. An evening breeze rustles the worn pages of a ledger back and forth.

name: VIP Area
text: While you are in the VIP Area, you cannot draw cards or gain resources during the upkeep phase.
flavor: The coppery smell of blood assaults your senses. The floor is littered with broken glass, and the upholstery has been torn to shreds. Where is Dr. Morgan?

name: Back Alley
text: [action]: Resign. We can get out this way!
flavor: A steep, narrow staircase ascends to a second unmarked door. To your surprise, it leads into a back alley behind La Bella Luna. This must be where they smuggle in their "goods."

name: Clover Club Pit Boss
text: Prey - Highest [intellect]. Hunter. Forced - After an investigator at Clover Club Pit Boss's location gains any number of clues: Clover Club Pit Boss readies, engages that investigator, and makes an immediate attack.

name: Peter Clover
text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase, if no investigator controls Peter Clover: Deal 1 damage to him. [fast] Exhaust Peter Clover: Automatically evade a [[Criminal]] enemy in your location.

name: Dr. Francis Morgan
text:
You get +1 [combat].
[reaction] After you defeat an enemy, exhaust Dr. Francis Morgan: Draw 1 card.

name: Something in the Drinks
text: Surge. Revelation - Each player who has "had a drink" loses 1 action.
flavor: An unpleasant warmth fills your body, and you sluggishly look at your empty glass.

name: Arousing Suspicions
text: Revelation - Place 1 doom on each [[Criminal]] enemy at your location. If no doom was placed by this effect, lose 2 resources.
flavor: Eyes are all around you, watching your every move.

name: Visions of Futures Past
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). For each point you fail by, discard the top card of your deck.
flavor: Are these visions of things to be, or things as they might be? Or could these horrors have already happened?

name: Beyond the Veil
text: Surge. Revelation - Put Beyond the Veil into play in your threat area if there is no copy of Beyond the Veil in your threat area. Forced - If your deck has no cards in it: Take 10 damage and discard Beyond the Veil.

name: Light of Aforgomon
text: Peril. Revelation - You must attach Light of Aforgomon to either the current agenda or the current act. Limit 1 per agenda/act. Treat all damage as direct damage and all horror as direct horror.

name: Thrall
text: Spawn - Location with the most clues. Retaliate.
flavor: A malevolence has overtaken their minds, turning them into soulless puppets.

name: Wizard of Yog-Sothoth
text: Prey - Least cards in hand. Hunter. Forced - When the engaged investigator draws a [[Hex]] or [[Pact]] card: Wizard of Yog-Sothoth attacks that investigator.

name: Unhallowed Country
text: Revelation - Put Unhallowed Country into play in your threat area. You cannot play [[Ally]] assets. Treat the printed text box of each [[Ally]] asset you control as if it were blank. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Unhallowed Country.

name: Sordid and Silent
text: Revelation - Attach Sordid and Silent to your location. Forced - At the end of the round: Each investigator at attached location takes 1 horror. Forced - When the agenda advances: Discard Sordid and Silent.

name: Whippoorwill
text:
Aloof. Hunter.
Each investigator at Whippoorwill's location gets -1 [willpower], -1 [intellect], -1 [combat], and -1 [agility].
flavor: "It is vowed that the birds are psychopomps lying in wait for the souls of the dying..." <cite>H. P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"</cite>

name: Eager for Death
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). Increase this skill test's difficulty by 1 for each damage on you. If you fail, take 2 horror.
flavor: "If they can catch the fleeing soul when it leaves the body, they instantly flutter away chittering in daemonic laughter..." <cite>H. P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"</cite>

name: Cursed Luck
text: Revelation - Put Cursed Luck into play in your threat area. You get -1 skill value during skill tests. Forced - After you succeed at a skill test by 1 or more: Discard Cursed Luck.

name: Twist of Fate
text: Revelation - Reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [elder_sign] symbol or positive number, nothing happens. If you reveal any other number, take 1 damage. If you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, take 2 horror.

name: Avian Thrall
text: Prey - Lowest [intellect]. Hunter. While Avian Thrall is being attacked using a [[Ranged]], [[Firearm]], or [[Spell]] asset, it gets -3 fight.

name: Lupine Thrall
text: Spawn - Farthest location from you. Prey - Lowest [agility]. Hunter. Retaliate.
flavor: What manner of wolf has that many teeth?

name: Altered Beast
text: Revelation - If there are no [[Abomination]] enemies in play, Altered Beast gains surge. Otherwise, choose an [[Abomination]] enemy. Heal all damage from that enemy and attached Altered Beast to it. Forced - When you enter attached enemy's location (or vice-versa): Take 1 horror.

name: O'Bannion's Thug
