flavor: Dark storm clouds swirl overhead. A vortex of eldritch energy rages in the center of the storm. The ritual has begun. The gate may appear above the abbey, or below it. You must choose which route to pursue and reach the gate before Hastur’s agents do.

name: The Entity Above
text:
Each [[Monster]] enemy gets +1 fight.
[fast] The investigators spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 doom on this agenda (this effect can cause this agenda to advance). Each investigator draws 1 card. (Group limit once per round.)
flavor: The whirlwind over the island continues to rage. Blinding flashes of lightning and deafening thunder assault your senses. Is the vortex above the key to opening the path? If so, you have no choice but to beckon the entity closer…

name: The Entity Above
text:
Each [[Monster]] enemy gets +1 fight.
[fast] The investigators spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 doom on this agenda (this effect can cause this agenda to advance). Each investigator draws 1 card. (Group limit once per round.)
flavor: The whirlwind over the island continues to rage. Blinding flashes of lightning and deafening thunder assault your senses. Is the vortex above the key to opening the path? If so, you have no choice but to beckon the entity closer…

name: Swallowed Sky
text: Each [[Monster]] enemy gets +1 fight.
flavor: The maelstrom in the sky envelops the horizon. The island starts to break into pieces. The screeches of uncanny creatures fill the air, an unholy choir praying to a force beyond your comprehension. If you do not act soon, the path will be forever lost, and nobody will be able to prevent Hastur’s agents from releasing his bonds.

name: Open The Path Below
text: Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at the Chapel of St. Aubert and there are no clues on that location, advance.
flavor: Tidewater churns around the walls of the city. Layers of reality unfold. Reflected in the depths below, you can see the twisted spires of Carcosa. You have no choice but to dive in.

name: Open The Path Above
text: Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at the Abbey Tower and there are no clues on that location, advance.
flavor: Clouds churn over the abbey tower. Layers of reality unfold. Through the dark storm clouds, you can see the twisted spires of Carcosa. You have no choice but to make the leap.

name: Porte de l'Avancée
text: [action] [action]: Move 1 doom from one agenda deck to the other. Then, place 2 clues on Porte de l'Avancée (from the token bank).

name: Grand Rue
text: Forced - After you succeed at a skill test by 1 or less while investigating Grand Rue: Place 1 doom on the agenda with the most doom (if they are tied for the most doom, choose one to place 1 doom on).

name: Outer Wall
text: Forced - After 1 or more doom is placed on the "a" agenda deck: Each investigator at the Outer Wall takes 1 damage.
flavor: Waves slam against the stone walls, water spraying onto the pathways above. If you don't act quickly, even these stalwart walls won't be able to stop the rising tide.

name: Outer Wall
text: While the current "c" agenda has more doom on it than the current "a" agenda, double the number of skill icons on cards committed to skill tests at the Outer Wall.
flavor: Waves slam against the stone walls, water spraying onto the pathways above. If you don't act quickly, even these stalwart walls won't be able to stop the rising tide.

name: North Tower
text: Forced - After 1 or more doom is placed on the "c" agenda deck: Each investigator at North Tower takes 1 horror.
flavor: Wet, stone steps lead higher up the path, toward the abbey. Above, black storm clouds threaten to overtake the island.

name: North Tower
text: While the current "a" agenda has more doom on it than the current "c" agenda, reduce the difficulty of each skill test at North Tower by 1.
flavor: Wet, stone steps lead higher up the path, toward the abbey. Above, black storm clouds threaten to overtake the island.

name: Broken Steps
text: Forced - After you enter Broken Steps: You must either lose 1 action or draw the topmost [[Omen]] treachery in the encounter discard pile.

name: Broken Steps
text: Forced - After you enter Broken Steps: You must either discard an asset you control or draw the topmost [[Cultist]] enemy in the encounter discard pile.

name: Abbey Church
text: If there are two agendas in play with different agenda numbers, Abbey Church gets +2 shroud. Forced - When Abbey Church is revealed: Put the set-aside Chœur Gothique, Knight's Hall, Cloister, Chapel of St. Aubert, and Abbey Tower locations into play.

name: Chœur Gothique
text: [action] Place 1 doom on the current "a" agenda: Heal 2 damage. (Group limit once per game).
flavor: Lightning flashes through the windows of the abbey, thunder quickly answering in a booming voice all around the island.

name: Chœur Gothique
text: [action] Place 1 doom on the current "c" agenda: Heal 2 horror. (Group limit once per game).
flavor: Lightning flashes through the windows of the abbey, thunder quickly answering in a booming voice all around the island.

name: Cloister
text: [action] If there are no clues on Cloister: Parley. Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, remember that you have "found a guide."
flavor: A lone monk patrols the covered walk, surrounding himself in whispered prayer. He doesn't seem to notice the storm threatening to tear the abbey down.

name: Knight's Hall
text: [action] If there are no clues on Knight's Hall: Investigate. Investigate using [agility] instead of [intellect]. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, remember that you have "found the tower key."

name: Chapel of St. Aubert
text:
You can only discover clues in the Chapel of St. Aubert if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity.
[action]: Take up to 3 horror.
flavor: In the water below, you can see the spires of Carcosa. You are almost there - you need only open the gate.

name: Chapel of St. Aubert
flavor: As you peer into the water below, you can see the hooded shape of Hastur looming beyond, hand outstretched. His laughter echoes throughout your mind.

name: Abbey Tower
text:
You can only discover clues in the Abbey Tower if you have no cards in your hand.
[action]: Discard up to 3 cards from your hand.
flavor: In the vortex above, you can see the spires of Carcosa. You are almost there - you need only open the gate.

name: Abbey Tower
flavor: As you peer into the vortex above, you can see the hooded shape of Hastur looming beyond, hand outstretched. His laughter echoes throughout your mind.

name: Tidal Terror
text: Spawn - Porte de l'Avancée or Chapel of St. Aubert. Hunter.
flavor: When the tide is high, they emerge from the sea to feed.

name: Rift Seeker
text: Forced - After Rift Seeker attacks you: You must either take 1 additional damage and 1 additional horror, or place 1 doom on each agenda in play. [action] Place 1 doom on each agenda in play and take 2 horror: Parley. Discard Rift Seeker.

name: Crashing Floods
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail: - If agenda 1a is in play, take 1 damage and lose 1 action. - If agenda 2a is in play, take 2 damage and lose 2 actions. - If act 3a or agenda 3a is in play, take 3 damage and lose 3 actions.

name: Worlds Merge
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail: - If agenda 1c is in play, take 1 horror and discard 1 card from your hand. - If agenda 2c is in play, take 2 horror and discard 2 cards from your hand. - If act 3c or agenda 3c is in play, take 3 horror and discard 3 cards from your hand.

name: Time Warp
text: Fast. Play immediately after an investigator at your location finishes resolving an action during his or her turn. Undo that action (return the game state to exactly the way it was before that action was performed, except for the playing of Time Warp and its costs).

name: Shrewd Analysis
text: Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Anytime you upgrade a card with the (Unidentified) or (Untranslated) subtitle, you may upgrade a second copy of that card at no experience cost. If you do, the two upgraded versions are chosen at random from among the eligible options. (You must still meet all deckbuilding restrictions.)

name: Arcane Research
text:
Permanent.
When you purchase Arcane Research, suffer 1 mental trauma.
After each scenario of a campaign, reduce the experience cost of the first [[Spell]] card you upgrade before the next scenario by 1.

name: Armor of Ardennes
text: [reaction] When damage is assigned to Armor of Ardennes, exhaust Armor of Ardennes: Cancel 1 of that damage.

name: Eidetic Memory
text: Play Eidetic Memory as an exact copy of an [[Insight]] event in any investigator's discard pile (including its resource cost). Remove that event from the game. Remove Eidetic Memory from the game instead of discarding it.

name: Charon's Obol
text: Permanent. Exceptional. When earning experience during the resolution of a scenario, if you were not defeated during that scenario, you earn 2 additional experience. If you were defeated during that scenario, you are killed.

name: Lupara
text: Uses (2 ammo). Playing Lupara does not provoke attacks of opportunity. [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If Lupara entered play this turn, you get an additional +1 [combat] and deal an additional +1 damage for this attack.

name: Seal of the Elder Sign
text:
Do not reveal chaos tokens from the chaos bag for this test. Treat the chaos token revealed for this test as an [elder_sign].
When this test ends, remove Seal of the Elder Sign from the game.

name: Newspaper
text:
You get +2 [intellect] while investigating if you have no clues.
[reaction] When you would discover 1 or more clues at your location, if you have no clues: Discover an additional clue at your location.
flavor: There's nothing in the headlines about the horrors you've witnessed. But the obituaries section is disturbingly long.

name: Infighting
text:
Fast. Play after the enemy phase begins.
Cancel all attacks made by non-[[Elite]] enemies against you this phase.

name: Key of Ys
text: You get +1 to each of your skills for each horror on Key of Ys. Forced - When any amount of horror would be placed on you: Place 1 of that horror on Key of Ys. Forced - When Key of Ys leaves play: Discard the top 10 cards of your deck.

name: Take the Initiative
text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing.
Take the Initiative loses [wild] for each action that has been completed by any investigator this phase.

name: Quick Study
text: [fast] Place 1 of your clues on your location and exhaust Quick Study: You get +3 skill value for this skill test.

name: Recall the Future
text: [reaction] When a skill test you are performing begins, if Recall the Future is ready, name a chaos token: If the named chaos token is revealed during this skill test, exhaust Recall the Future. Then, you get +2 skill value for this skill test.

name: Calvin Wright
text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect] for each horror on you.
You get +1 [combat] and +1 [agility] for each damage on you.
[elder_sign] effect: +0. You may either heal 1 damage or horror, or take 1 direct damage or direct horror.
flavor: "If you hurt him, I'll kill you."

name: Until the End of Time
text:
Calvin Wright deck only.
Direct damage and direct horror may be assigned to Until the End of Time.
flavor:
Unyielding, uncompromising,
he stood resolute in defiance of his fate.

name: Voice of the Messenger
text: Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Take 1 direct damage and suffer 1 physical trauma. - Take 1 direct horror and suffer 1 mental trauma.

name: Carolyn Fern
text:
[reaction] After one of your card effects heals horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset: The healed card's controller gains 1 resource.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.
flavor: The mind is fragile, but through understanding, we can protect it.

name: Foolishness
text:
Carolyn Fern deck only. Replacement.
Foolishness enters play with 3 horror on him. Horror on him may be healed as if it were on Carolyn Fern. While Foolishness has no horror on him, you get +1 to all skills.
flavor: "Will we need to save you again?" Foolishness flicked his tail back and forth. "Perhaps. Perhaps I'll do the saving."

name: To Fight the Black Wind
text: Carolyn Fern deck only. Replacement. Revelation - Attach To Fight the Black Wind to the current agenda. Carolyn Fern takes 1 direct horror. Forced - At the end of the round, if any amount of horror was assigned to an investigator this round and it was not healed: Place 1 doom on attached agenda.

name: Dim Carcosa
text: Easy / Standard [skull]: -2 (-4 instead if you have no sanity remaining). [cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, take 1 horror. [tablet]: -3. If you fail and Hastur is in play, place 1 clue on your location (from the token bank). [elder_thing]: -3. If this token is revealed during an attack or evasion attempt against a [[Monster]] or [[Ancient One]] enemy, lose 1 action.

name: Madness Coils
text: Hastur cannot be defeated. Forced - If there is at least 3 [per_investigator] damage on Hastur: Advance this agenda.
flavor:
And now, far away, over leagues of tossing cloud-waves, I saw the moon dripping with spray; and beyond, the towers of Carcosa rose behind the moon.
 - Robert W. Chambers, "In the Court of the Dragon," <u>The King in Yellow</u>

name: Madness Drowns
text: Hastur gets +1 fight and cannot be defeated. Forced - If there is at least 5 [per_investigator] damage on Hastur: Advance this agenda.
flavor:
I thought, too, of The King in Yellow wrapt in the fantastic colors of his tattered mantle, and that bitter cry of Cassilda, "Not upon us, oh King, not upon us!"
- Robert W. Chambers, "The Mask," <u>The King in Yellow</u>

name: Madness Dies
text:
Hastur gets +2 fight.
Hastur cannot be defeated unless an investigator "know the secret."
flavor:
...I cannot forget Carcosa, where black stars hang in the heavens, where the shadows of men’s thoughts lengthen in the afternoon, when the twin suns sink into the Lake of Hali, and my mind will bear forever the memory of the Pallid Mask.
 - Robert W. Chambers, "The Repairer of Reputations," <u>The King in Yellow</u>

name: In Lost Carcosa
text: Objective - When the investigators have collected the requisite number of clues, they must immediately spend them and advance.
flavor: You have opened the path to Carcosa in order to stop those who wish to free Hastur from his prison in the stars. Only you can put an end to this madness!

name: Search For the Stranger (v.I)
text: Each investigator cannot discover clues. The Man in the Pallid Mask cannot be defeated. Objective - While the lead investigator is at The Man in the Pallid Mask's location, he or she may spend [action] [action] [action] to advance.
flavor: It is time to finally confront the Stranger and learn the truth about his identity, once and for all.

name: The Pallid Mask
text: Revelation - Put The Pallid Mask into play, under the lead investigator's control. Remove The Man in the Pallid Mask from the game. Spawn the set-aside Hastur (The Tattered King) enemy at the Palace of the King. The Pallid Mask cannot leave play. You get -2 sanity.

name: Search For the Stranger (v.II)
text: Each investigator cannot discover clues. The Man in the Pallid Mask cannot be defeated except by his [action] ability. Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be defeated by his [action] ability, advance.
flavor: It is time to finally confront the Stranger and learn the truth about his identity, once and for all.

name: Search For the Stranger (v.III)
text: Each investigator cannot discover clues. The Man in the Pallid Mask cannot be defeated except by damage. Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be defeated by damage, advance.
flavor: It is time to finally confront the Stranger and learn the truth about his identity, once and for all.

name: The King in Tatters
text: [fast] If there are no clues on your location: Remove each investigator's clues from the game. Flip your location over and resolve the text on the other side. Objective - If Hastur is defeated, advance.
flavor:
...I heard the King in Yellow whispering to my soul: "It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God!"
 - Robert W. Chambers, "In the Court of the Dragon," <u>The King in Yellow</u>

name: Shores of Hali
flavor:
Along the shore the cloud waves break,
The twin suns sink behind the lake,
The shadows lengthen
In Carcosa
 - Robert W. Chambers, <u>The King in Yellow</u>

name: Songs That the Hyades Shall Sing
text:
Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to Hastur, exhaust him, and disengage him from all investigators.
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
flavor: Black stars sing in the reflection of the water, their melody impossible and uncanny. Yet somehow, you remember the tune. It is as though your earliest living memory has returned to you. You hum at first, ripples appearing along the water's surface as your volume increases. The lyrics return to you, and you join in the stars' singing, your voice echoing across the twisted realm.

name: Bleak Plains
text: While you are at Bleak Plains, you cannot play [[Ally]] assets.
flavor:
On every side of me stretched a bleak and desolate expanse of plain, covered with a tall overgrowth of sere grass, which rustled and whistled in the autumn wind...
 - Ambrose Bierce, "An Inhabitant of Carcosa"

name: Stars of Aldebaran
text:
Each investigator heals 3 horror.
Deal 4 damage to an enemy in play other than Hastur.
Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Bleak Plains (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Bleak Plains). Add clues to that copy of Bleak Plains until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.
flavor: A sudden rift in the clouds above allows you to see the sky for the first time since arriving in this strange place. The sky is orange-tinted and devoid of darkness, but black stars shine above you. If the workings of Earthly science mean anything in this world, perhaps you can create a map of the stars above to find your way home. You find a long stick and begin to draw in the sand...

name: Bleak Plains
text: While you are at Bleak Plains, you cannot play [[Ally]] assets.
flavor:
On every side of me stretched a bleak and desolate expanse of plain, covered with a tall overgrowth of sere grass, which rustled and whistled in the autumn wind...
 - Ambrose Bierce, "An Inhabitant of Carcosa"

name: Bleak Desolation
text:
Deal 2 [per_investigator] damage to Hastur.
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
flavor:
This world is but a remnant of what it once was. The grand majesty of Carcosa spoken of in <u>The King in Yellow</u> is lost in this expanse of endless desolation. Dead, twisted trees, starving animals, and barren fields greet you everywhere you turn.
You begin to look for evidence of what might have caused such devastation. Across the lake, you see dark, twisted structures similar to those in Carcosa. At least one appears as large and as grand as Hastur's domain. You wonder if perhaps some kind of conflict took place between the two cities.

name: Ruins of Carcosa
text: Forced - After you discover the last remaining clue on Ruins of Carcosa: Take 1 damage.
flavor:
So old seemed these relics, these vestiges of vanity and memorials of affection and piety, so battered and worn and stained...
 - Ambrose Bierce, "An Inhabitant of Carcosa"

name: Inhabitant of Carcosa
text:
Each investigator heals 3 horror.
Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Ruins of Carcosa (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Ruins of Carcosa). Add clues to that copy of Ruins of Carcosa until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.
flavor:
You encounter a man among the ruins of the city, haggard and tired. "Good stranger," he says, "I am ill and lost. Direct me, I beseech you, to Carcosa." You tell him that you believe you are in the realm of Carcosa right now, and he falls to his knees in despair. "No... But that cannot be!"
The man cries and raves, telling you more of the ancient and famous city. Though his words have little meaning to you, deep within your mind, you begin to understand.

name: Ruins of Carcosa
text: Forced - After you discover the last remaining clue on Ruins of Carcosa: Take 1 damage.
flavor:
So old seemed these relics, these vestiges of vanity and memorials of affection and piety, so battered and worn and stained...
 - Ambrose Bierce, "An Inhabitant of Carcosa"

name: A Moment's Rest
text:
You must decide (choose one):
 - Choose an enemy in play. Exhaust that enemy and disengage it from all investigators.
 - You heal 5 horror.
Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Ruins of Carcosa (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Ruins of Carcosa). Add clues to that copy of Ruins of Carcosa until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.
flavor: During your exploration, you find an old, crumbled building that makes for an ideal refuge from this world's dry heat and its horrifying creatures. For the first time since entering this realm, you take a moment to rest in the building's cool shade. The quiet calm soothes your aching muscles and weary mind. But you cannot stay for long.

name: Ruins of Carcosa
text: Forced - After you discover the last remaining clue on Ruins of Carcosa: Take 1 damage.
flavor:
So old seemed these relics, these vestiges of vanity and memorials of affection and piety, so battered and worn and stained...
 - Ambrose Bierce, "An Inhabitant of Carcosa"

name: The Coffin
text:
Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to Hastur.
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
flavor: In the outskirts of the city, you find a ruined mausoleum. Its entrance is not unlike the entrance to the Catacombs of Paris: archways of stone decorated with bone and mocking skulls. The Yellow Sign is inscribed in the stone above the final archway. The narrow, cluttered passageway leads into a circular chamber with a domed ceiling. In the center of the chamber lies an egg-shaped coffin made of stone, unmarked and firmly sealed. Curious, you attempt to open the coffin. It takes all of your strength to pull the heavy lid off, and it slides to the floor with a resounding thud. Inside, you see a familiar face - a woman in a tattered dress, her countenance noble and grim.

name: Dim Streets
text: Forced - After you discover the last remaining clue on Dim Streets: Lose 1 action.
flavor: The streets twist and churn without any semblance of logic or reason.

name: Mapping the Streets
text:
Test [intellect] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror. Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to Hastur regardless of whether you succeed or fail.
After this test ends, flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
flavor: You find yourself easily lost within the city's narrow, twisting streets. Routes that should lead back to familiar places lead instead to new parts of the city, and retracing your steps is impossible. Perhaps objects here do not exist in three dimensions like they do on Earth. Conventional maps cannot possibly begin to depict the complexity of Carcosa's design. You explore the streets carefully, and begin to puzzle out a shocking map of the city...

name: Dim Streets
text: Forced - After you discover the last remaining clue on Dim Streets: Lose 1 action.
flavor: The streets twist and churn without any semblance of logic or reason.

name: The King's Parade
text:
Test [combat] (2). If you succeed, exhaust Hastur and disengage him from all investigators.
Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Dim Streets (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Dim Streets). Add clues to that copy of Dim Streets until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.
flavor:
You turn a corner, and before you lies a wide, grand street. A great parade marches by, in honor of the King. Banners of tattered yellow cloth sway in the wind.
Then it strikes you: you remember this scene from the play. You wrack your mind trying to remember what is supposed to happen next. The parade is interrupted and the entourage is attacked...

name: Dim Streets
text: Forced - After you discover the last remaining clue on Dim Streets: Lose 1 action.
flavor: The streets twist and churn without any semblance of logic or reason.

name: The Archway
text:
Test [willpower] (1). For each point you succeed by, heal 1 horror.
Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Dim Streets (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Dim Streets). Add clues to that copy of Dim Streets until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.
flavor: You pass under an archway of ebony stone linking two spires. The inscription on the archway is written in a language you have never seen before, but somehow you are able to understand it. When you read the inscription aloud, the portal of stone shimmers, and you see a glimpse into an alternate vision of the city of Carcosa. It is vibrant and mesmerizing, like no place you have ever seen before. The vision dissolves shortly after, and you find yourself back in the ruined streets.

name: Depths of Demhe
text: While you are at Depths of Demhe, you cannot play fast cards.
flavor: Don’t look up.

name: The Height of the Depths
text:
Each investigator heals 5 horror.
Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Depths of Demhe (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Depths of Demhe). Add clues to that copy of Depths of Demhe until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.
flavor: Nothing in this realm seems to make sense. The stairs before you both ascend and descend. The cloudy depths sink and rise and sway, and yet remain still. You are floating in a cloud-wisp of mist and swimming under the sunken waves. The stairs are just a part of your imagination. You decide to jump.

name: Depths of Demhe
text: While you are at Depths of Demhe, you cannot play fast cards.
flavor: Don’t look up.

name: Steps of the Palace
text:
Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to Hastur, exhaust him, and disengage him from all investigators.
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
flavor: You come across a set of steps that look similar to the grand staircase of the palace from Act 1, Scene 4 of <u>The King in Yellow</u> - The very same stairs Cassilda nearly fell down when she fainted upon seeing the Stranger for the very first time. Shattering your reverie is the sound of a woman's gasp, and when you look up, you see Cassilda at the top of the steps, her expression shocked upon seeing your face. You rush up the staircase and catch her as she falls, wrapping your arms around her body. She dissolves into the cloudy mists around you.

name: Dark Spires
flavor:
Night fell and the hours dragged on, but still we murmured to each other of the King and the Pallid Mask, and midnight sounded from the misty spires in the fog-wrapped city.
 - Robert W. Chambers, "The Yellow Sign," <u>The King in Yellow</u>

name: The Fall
text: You must decide (choose one): - You cannot bring yourself to do what must be done. Flip this card back over. - Realizing what you must do, you step forward and push her. Take 2 horror and deal 2 [per_investigator] damage to Hastur. Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
flavor:
A woman stands atop a tall balcony, her yellow dress tattered and stained. You call out to her, but she does not respond to anything you say. Then, you suddenly remember a scene from <u>The King in Yellow</u>, in which a woman plunges herself into the streets below.
Are you seeing the past? The future?

name: Palace of the King
text: Palace of the King cannot be flipped over unless Hastur has at least 5 [per_investigator] damage on him.
flavor:
I pray God will curse the writer, as the writer has cursed the world with this beautiful, stupendous creation, terrible in its simplicity, irresistible in its truth...
 - Robert W. Chambers, "The Repairer of Reputations," <u>The King in Yellow</u>

name: Hastur's End
text:
Remember that you "know the secret."
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
flavor:
You stand before the palace of the King. Hastur's incessant whispering fills your mind, and you find it difficult to block his poisonous words from your thoughts. Seeing the palace in all its spectacle and glory, the memories come flooding back to you.
The Stranger. The King. Act 2.
The doors to the palace are open.

name: Hastur
text: Cannot be damaged except by story card effects. Forced - At the beginning of the enemy phase, if Hastur is ready: Hastur attacks each investigator, in player order (regardless of their location). If Hastur's attack deals you horror in excess of your sanity, you take 1 damage, as well. [action]: Test [willpower] (X), where X is Hastur's fight value. If you succeed, exhaust Hastur. Any investigator may trigger this action.

name: Hastur
text: Prey - Most remaining sanity. Hunter. Massive. If Hastur's attack deals you horror in excess of your sanity, you take 1 damage, as well. While Hastur is being attacked or evaded by an investigator with no remaining sanity, treat each [elder_sign], "+1," "0," or "-1" token that investigator reveals as a [auto_fail] token.

name: Hastur
text: Prey - Most remaining sanity. Hunter. If Hastur's attack deals you horror in excess of your sanity, you take 1 damage, as well. While Hastur is being attacked or evaded by an investigator with no remaining sanity, treat each [elder_sign], "+1," "0," or "-1" token that investigator reveals as a [auto_fail] token.

name: Creature Out of Demhe
text: Spawn - Depths of Demhe. Massive. Forced - When Creature out of Demhe's location or a connecting location is flipped over, if Creature out of Demhe is ready: It attacks each investigator at that location.

name: Winged One
text: Spawn - Bleak Plains. Retaliate. Forced - After a location is flipped over, if Winged One is ready and unengaged: Move it once toward that location.

name: Dismal Curse
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you have no remaining sanity, this test gets +2 difficulty. If you fail, take 2 damage (4 damage instead if you have horror on you greater than twice your sanity).

name: Realm of Madness
text: Revelation - Discard cards from your play area and/or from your hand with a total printed resource cost of at least X, where X is the amount of horror on your investigator. If no cards are discarded by this effect, take 2 horror.
flavor: ...But stranger still is Lost Carcosa.

name: The Final Act
text: Surge. Revelation - If you have no remaining sanity, place 2 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.

name: Possession
text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Possession (Traitorous) to your hand. If you have horror on you greater than twice your sanity, you are immediately eliminated and killed. You may commit this card to a skill test at your location. That test automatically fails.

name: Possession
text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Possession (Torturous) to your hand. If you have horror on you greater than twice your sanity, you are immediately eliminated and killed. [action] Spend 5 resources: Discard Possession (Torturous) from your hand.

name: Possession
text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Possession (Murderous) to your hand. If you have horror on you greater than twice your sanity, you are immediately eliminated and killed. [action] Deal 2 damage to an investigator at your location: Discard Possession (Murderous) from your hand.

name: Backpack
text:
[reaction] After Backpack enters play: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for up to 3 non-weakness [[Item]] or [[Supply]] cards, and attach them facedown to Backpack. Shuffle your deck.
Cards attached to Backpack may be played as if they were in your hand. If there are no cards attached to Backpack, discard it.

name: Lola Santiago
text:
You get +1 [intellect] and +1 [agility].
[fast] Exhaust Lola Santiago and spend X resources: Discover 1 clue at your location. X is the shroud value of your location.
flavor:
"My line of work encounters a lot of so-called 'curses.'
It is a topic I would rather not discuss."

name: Olive McBride
text: [reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token, exhaust Olive McBride: Reveal 3 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose 2 of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the other.
flavor: You must invest yourself in every spell. Sometimes literally.

name: Against All Odds
text:
Fast. Play when you perform a skill test with a difficulty higher than your base skill value.
Reveal X additional chaos tokens for this skill test. Choose one to resolve and ignore the rest. X is the difference between the test's difficulty and your base skill value.

name: Father Mateo
text:
[reaction] When an investigator reveals an [auto_fail] chaos token: Cancel that token and treat it as an [elder_sign] token, instead. (Limit once per game.)
[elder_sign] effect: You automatically succeed. After this test ends, either (choose one):
 - Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.
 - If it is your turn, you may take an additional action this turn.

name: The Codex of Ages
text: Father Mateo deck only. Seal ([elder_sign]). You get +1 [willpower] while there is a token sealed here. [reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token from the chaos bag, discard The Codex of Ages: Resolve the [elder_sign] token that was sealed here as if it were just revealed from the chaos bag (instead of revealing a token from the chaos bag).

name: Serpents of Yig
text: Prey - Father Mateo only. Hunter. Revelation - Search the chaos bag for the [elder_sign] chaos token and seal it on Serpents of Yig.
flavor: "I know not what Yig is, but I know I have wounded his children." - Father Mateo, <u>Investigators of Arkham Horror</u>

name: The Chthonian Stone
text: Seal ([skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing]). Forced - After you reveal an [auto_fail] symbol during a skill test: Return The Chthonian Stone to your hand.
flavor: It was left behind for a purpose.

name: Leo Anderson
text:
[reaction] After your turn begins: Play an [[Ally]] asset, reducing its cost by 1.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Search the top 3 cards of your deck for an [[Ally]] asset and draw it. Shuffle your deck.
flavor: "Keep moving. You can die on your own time."

name: Ursula Downs
text:
[reaction] After you move to a location: Take an investigate action. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. After this test ends, you may move to a connecting location.
flavor: "Discovery is easy. Understanding is the hard part."

name: Finn Edwards
text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to evade.
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each exhausted enemy in play. If you succeed by 2 or more, you may discover 1 clue at your location.
flavor: "Never lose track of the exit. Or the merchandise."

name: Mitch Brown
text:
Leo Anderson deck only.
You have 2 additional ally slots, which can only be used to hold non-unique allies.
flavor:
"You ain't going nowhere without me, Leo.
So you might as well tell me what's going on."

name: Bought in Blood
text: Revelation - You must either discard an [[Ally]] asset you control from play, or discard each [[Ally]] asset from your hand. If no assets are discarded by this effect, shuffle Bought in Blood back into your deck.
flavor: We paid a terrible price for the knowledge we sought. Was it worth it?

name: Smuggled Goods
text:
Finn Edwards deck only.
Play only if there are no ready enemies at your location.
Search either your discard pile or the top 9 cards of your deck for an [[Illicit]] card and draw it. If you searched your deck, shuffle Smuggled Goods into your deck.

name: Finn's Trusty .38
text: Finn Edwards deck only. Fast. Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If the attacked enemy is not engaged with you, you deal +1 damage for this attack.
flavor: It was an old gun - battered, scraped, and well used - but it had never let him down.

name: Caught Red-Handed
text: Revelation - Ready each enemy at your location or a connecting location. Each hunter enemy at a connecting location moves 1 location toward you. If no enemies move as a result of this effect, shuffle Caught Red-Handed back into your deck.

name: Survival Knife
text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. [reaction] After an enemy attack deals damage to you during the enemy phase, exhaust Survival Knife: Fight. This attack targets the attacking enemy. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: Venturer
text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Venturer: Place 1 supply or ammo on an asset controlled by an investigator at your location.

name: Trusted
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to an [[Ally]] asset you control.
Attached asset gets +1 health and +1 sanity.

name: Reliable
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to an [[Item]] asset you control.
While resolving a triggered ability on attached asset, you get +1 to each of your skills.

name: Dr. Elli Horowitz
text: [reaction] After Dr. Elli Horowitz enters play: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Relic]] asset and attach it to her. Shuffle your deck. Each [[Relic]] asset attached to Dr. Elli Horowitz does not take up any slots (it is still considered to be in play and under your control).

name: Ancient Stone
text: [action]: Investigate. Your location gets +3 shroud for this investigation. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at your location, discard Ancient Stone, and record in your Campaign Log that "you have identified the stone." Next to this, in parentheses, record the difficulty of this skill test.

name: Tooth of Eztli
text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [agility] while resolving an ability on a treachery card.
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test while resolving an ability on a treachery card, exhaust Tooth of Eztli: Draw 1 card.

name: Unearth the Ancients
text: Investigate. Choose a [seeker] asset in your hand. The difficulty of this skill test is equal to the chosen asset's printed cost. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, put the chosen asset into play. If that asset has the [[Relic]] trait, draw 1 card.

name: Treasure Hunter
text: You get +1 [intellect]. Forced - At the end of the upkeep phase: You must either pay 1 resource or discard Treasure Hunter.

name: Decorated Skull
text: Uses (0 charges). [reaction] After an investigator, [[Ally]] asset, or enemy at your location is defeated: Place 1 resource (from the token bank) on Decorated Skull, as a charge. [action] Spend 1 charge: Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.

name: Eavesdrop
text: Choose an unengaged enemy at your location. Test [intellect] (X), where X is the evade value of the chosen enemy. If you succeed, discover 2 clues at your location.

name: "You handle this one!"
text:
Fast. Play after you draw a non-peril encounter card, but before resolving that card's effects.
Choose another investigator. That investigator is considered to have drawn that encounter card instead. Gain 1 resource.

name: Mists of R'lyeh
text: Uses (4 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, after evading the chosen enemy, you may move to a connecting location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this evasion attempt, choose and discard a card from your hand.

name: Protective Incantation
text: Group limit 2 copies of Protective Incantation in play. Seal (any except [auto_fail]). Forced - At the end of your turn: You must either spend 1 resource or discard Protective Incantation.

name: Dark Prophecy
text:
Fast. Play when you would reveal a chaos token.
Reveal 5 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose one of those tokens with a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol to resolve, and ignore the rest. (If no such token is revealed, choose any one of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the rest.)
flavor: The secrets were written in the stars.

name: Improvised Weapon
text: You may play Improvised Weapon from your discard pile. If you do, shuffle it into your deck after resolving its effects. Fight. The attacked enemy gets -1 fight for this attack. (If you played Improvised Weapon from your discard pile, this attack deals +1 damage.)

name: Dumb Luck
text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 2 or less during an evasion attempt against a non-[[Elite]] enemy.
Place that enemy on top of the encounter deck.
flavor: Fortune favors the oblivious.

name: Yaotl
text:
[fast] Exhaust Yaotl: During this skill test, you get a bonus to each skill equal to the number of matching skill icons on the top card of your discard pile (not counting [wild] icons).
[fast]: Discard the top card of your deck. (Limit once per phase.)

name: Last Chance
text:
Commit only to a skill test with no other cards committed to it. Other cards cannot be committed to this skill test.
Last Chance loses [wild] for each card in your hand.

name: Dark Pact
text: Campaign Mode only. Deal 2 damage to an investigator at your location. Forced - When the game ends or you are eliminated, if Dark Pact is still in your hand: Remove Dark Pact from your deck. Search the collection for The Price of Failure and add it to your deck.

name: The Price of Failure
text: Revelation - Take 2 damage and 2 horror. Place 1 doom on the current agenda (this effect can cause the current agenda to advance). Remove The Price of Failure from your deck. Search the collection for Dark Pact and place it in your discard pile.

name: Doomed
text: Campaign Mode only. Revelation - Take 1 horror. In your Campaign Log, under your investigator's earned story assets/weaknesses, record that "doom approaches." If this was already recorded, remove Doomed from your deck, search the collection for Accursed Fate, and place it on the bottom of your deck.

name: Accursed Fate
text: Revelation - Take 2 horror. In your Campaign Log, under your investigator's earned story assets/weaknesses, record that "the hour is nigh." If this was already recorded, remove Accursed Fate from your deck, search the collection for The Bell Tolls, and place it on the bottom of your deck.

name: The Bell Tolls
text: Revelation - The hour of your demise has arrived. You are killed.
flavor:
It is meant for you.
It always has been.

name: The Untamed Wilds
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of vengeance points in the victory display.
[cultist]: -X. X is the number of locations in play (max 5).
[tablet]: -X. X is the number of cards in the exploration deck (max 5).
[elder_thing]: -2. If you are poisoned, this test automatically fails instead.

name: Expedition into the Wild
text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
flavor: Your expedition has ventured far into the rainforests of southern Mexico in search of a forgotten Aztec city-state. What will you find when you head deeper into the untamed jungle?

name: Intruders
text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
flavor: What was once excitement has turned to dread. This place is far deadlier than you could have imagined. It is as though the jungle itself wants you out.

name: Exploring the Rainforest
text: Objective - When the round ends, investigators at any non-[[Campsite]] locations may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: Today, you depart from your camp in order to find the ruins Alejandro seeks. That is, if they even exist…

name: Huntress of the Eztli
text: Objective - If Ichtaca is defeated, advance. Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Ichtaca, place her in the victory display and advance.
flavor: "I don't trust them," Alejandro says as soon as the natives are out of earshot. "They mean to kill us, not aid us. If you think this 'Ichtaca' is going to help us find the ruins, be my guest. But I refuse to follow where she leads." You can feel the discomfort and confusion in Alejandro's voice. You can attempt to speak with Ichtaca, or you can take Alejandro's advice and fight your way to the ruins you seek.

name: Search for the Ruins
text: Each Eztli Guardian enemy cannot attack or be attacked. Ignore the effects of each Arrows from the Trees treachery. Objective - Only investigators at the Ruins of Eztli can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: "If I cannot dissuade you, so be it. Follow me, and I will lead you to the place you seek. But heed my warning: Disturb the ruins at your own risk. They have remained hidden for a reason." Alejandro warily keeps a safe distance from Ichtaca as she shows you the way.

name: The Guarded Ruins
text: Each Eztli Guardian enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade. Each Arrows from the Trees treachery gains surge. Objective - Only investigators at the Ruins of Eztli can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: Ichtaca swiftly retreats, and Alejandro places a hand on your shoulder. "Thank you for taking my advice," he says, relieved. "Now that she's gone, I'll take point from now on. I know the river she speaks of. Come, follow me!"

name: Expedition Camp
text: [action]: Resign. The wilds are too dangerous! [action]: Check your supplies. If you have a map, look at the top 3 cards of the exploration deck. Place 1 on the bottom and the other 2 on top, in any order.
flavor: The expedition has staked its claim on the jungle, and the jungle doesn't seem too happy about it.

name: Alejandro Vela
text:
You get +1 skill value while investigating an [[Ancient]] location.
[action] If you are at an [[Ancient]] location, exhaust Alejandro Vela: Draw 2 cards.

name: Ichtaca
text: Alert. Retaliate. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (4) to convince Ichtaca you are not her enemy. If you succeed, place 1 clue on her. If you fail and Ichtaca is ready, she attacks you.

name: Ruins of Eztli
text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Ruins of Eztli: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.
flavor: Serpent statues carved from limestone surround the central temple, glaring at you ominously from afar.

name: The Doom of Eztli
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if there is doom on your location).
[cultist] [tablet]: -X. X is the number of locations with doom on them.
[elder_thing]: Reveal another chaos token. If you fail, place 1 doom on your location.

name: Something Stirs…
text: *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold. Forced - When this agenda advances: Do not remove doom from each location in play.
flavor: Despite Ichtaca's warnings, you've entered the ruins of the temple in search of ancient knowledge and artifacts.

name: The Temple Warden
text: *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold.
flavor: The serpent creature emerges from the shadows with terrifying speed. It is bedecked in ornate gold feathers, and it wields a golden spear, the blade tip unravaged by time. The rattle at the end of the creature's tail produces a tremendous noise as the creature hunts you throughout the ruins.

name: Into the Ruins
text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
flavor: After your hellish journey through the jungle, the quiet solitude of the temple ruins sows paranoia in your mind. Serpent eyes glare at you from the darkness. Every drop of water and fallen pebble causes you to whirl about in search of danger… But the real danger is yet to come.

name: Magic and Science
text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - Only investigators in the Chamber of Time may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: Whatever is inside this central chamber must be very important; much care was taken to obscure its location.

name: Escape the Ruins
text: While there are 3 or more vengeance points in the victory display, each [[Serpent]] enemy gets +1 evade. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
flavor: The ruins are shuddering with a tremendous power. You fear that the structure may collapse if this keeps up. You have to escape with the relic!

name: Entryway
text: [action]: Resign. You've escaped… for now. [action]: Check your supplies. If you have torches, look at the top 2 cards of the exploration deck. Discard each treachery looked at by this effect. Shuffle the exploration deck.
flavor: Many hundreds of years ago, this temple might have been a bastion of beauty and reverence in this perilous jungle.

name: Relic of Ages
flavor: You have no idea what it is or what it might have been used for. But perhaps with time, you could discover its true purpose.

name: Harbinger of Valusia
text: Alert. Hunter. Retaliate. Harbinger of Valusia can retaliate while exhausted. Forced - After Harbinger of Valusia is successfully attacked or evaded: Place 1 resource on it. Then, if there are 2 [per_investigator] resources on it, it vanishes with a sinister hiss. (Set it aside, out of play. It keeps all damage tokens.)

name: Ancient Hall
text: Forced - At the end of the round: Flip 1 of the clues on Ancient Hall to its doom side. Any investigator at Ancient Hall may spend 3 resources to cancel this effect.
flavor: A hall of crumbling stone looms before you, daring you to venture deeper into the ruins.

name: Grand Chamber
text: Forced - When you investigate Grand Chamber and do not succeed by at least 2: Before resolving any other effects from this skill test, flip 1 of the clues on Grand Chamber to its doom side.
flavor: The ornate dais in the center of this chamber is covered in detailed hand-carved hieroglyphs. A site for ancient gatherings or rituals, perhaps?

name: Burial Pit
text: Forced - After you put Burial Pit into play by exploring successfully: You must either draw 2 cards from the top of the encounter deck or place 2 doom on Burial Pit, or any combination thereof.
flavor: Urns and broken bones fill this pit of ash and sand. The stench of rot has long since dissipated, leaving behind only stale‑smelling air saturated with choking dust.

name: Underground Ruins
text: While there is an enemy in Underground Ruins, Underground Ruins is considered to be in the victory display (for the purposes of counting vengeance). Forced - After an enemy in Underground Ruins leaves play: Place 1 doom on Underground Ruins.

name: Secret Passage
text: Forced - After you enter Secret Passage: You must either take 1 horror and 1 damage, or place 1 doom on Secret Passage. Check your supplies. If you or an investigator at Secret Passage has a rope, ignore this effect.
flavor: A boulder obscured the route to this dark passageway. As soon as you step through the doorway, it opens into a vast underground pit below…

name: Chamber of Time
text: Forced - After Chamber of Time enters play: Attach the set-aside Relic of Ages asset to the Chamber of Time. Place 1 doom on Chamber of Time.
flavor: The floor of this central chamber is intricately carved and glows strangely…

name: Path of Thorns
text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Path of Thorns: Take 1 damage. Forced - After you explore while at Path of Thorns, if the exploration was not successful: Take 1 damage.

name: River Canyon
text: [action]: Heal 1 damage from an investigator at River Canyon. Check your supplies. If you have a canteen, heal 2 additional damage. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: The river is deeper than it appears. Ripples along its surface obscure the creatures that lie within. Water cascades into the river from above, causing a strong, steady current.

name: Rope Bridge
text: Forced - When you attempt to explore while at Rope Bridge: Test [agility] (2). If you fail, cancel the exploration, take 2 damage, lose all remaining actions, and end your turn. Place your investigator in the River Canyon (if it is not in play, search the exploration deck for River Canyon and put it into play first; shuffle the exploration deck).

name: Serpent's Haven
text: Each [[Serpent]] enemy at Serpent's Haven gets +1 fight. Forced - After you investigate or explore while at Serpent's Haven, if you are poisoned: Take 1 damage.

name: Circuitous Trail
text: As an additional cost for you to investigate or explore while at Circuitous Trail, check your supplies. If no investigator at your location has a compass, you must spend 3 resources.
flavor: Haven't you been here before?

name: Temple of the Fang
text: Temple of the Fang gets +1 shroud for each vengeance point in the victory display.
flavor: Rising just over the tree canopy is a timeworn step pyramid of pale stone. A storm of hisses surrounds you from the trees.

name: Overgrown Ruins
text: Forced - After you enter this location, if you are poisoned: Lose all remaining actions and end your turn.
flavor: A dense thicket of flora obscures the route to these ruins. Tendrils of vine grip the pyramid steps as though holding on for dear life.

name: Overgrowth
text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. You cannot explore at attached location. [action]: Test [combat] (4) to hack through the brush or [intellect] (4) to find another route. If you succeed, discard Overgrowth.

name: Voice of the Jungle
text: Revelation - Put Voice of the Jungle into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn, if you did not successfully explore this turn: Take 1 horror. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Voice of the Jungle.

name: Pit Viper
text: Forced - After Pit Viper deals you damage from its attack: If you are not poisoned, put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area.
flavor: Deadlier than it seems.

name: Boa Constrictor
text: Hunter. Forced - After Boa Constrictor attacks you: During the next upkeep phase, your exhausted cards cannot ready.
flavor: Fourteen feet of scaled hunger.

name: Snake Bite
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, you must either (choose one): - Deal 5 damage to an [[Ally]] asset you control. - Take 1 direct damage. If you are not poisoned, put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area.

name: Lost in the Wilds
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror for each point you fail by and add Lost in the Wilds to your threat area. You cannot move or explore. Forced - At the end of your turn: Discard Lost in the Wilds.

name: Low on Supplies
text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Each investigator loses 2 resources. - Each investigator takes 1 damage. - Each investigator chooses and discards an asset he or she controls.

name: Brood of Yig
text:
Hunter.
Brood of Yig gets +1 fight for each vengeance point in the victory display.
flavor: A serpentine creature with scaled arms, bearing primitive armor and weaponry.

name: Serpent from Yoth
text:
While there are 1 or more vengeance points in the victory display, Serpent from Yoth gains retaliate.
While there are 2 or more vengeance points in the victory display, Serpent from Yoth gains hunter.
While there are 3 or more vengeance points in the victory display, Serpent from Yoth takes 1 less damage from each attack made against it.

name: Curse of Yig
text: Revelation - Put Curse of Yig into play in your threat area. You get -1 [combat], -1 health, and gain the [[Serpent]] trait. [action]: Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each vengeance point in the victory display. If you succeed, discard Curse of Yig.

name: Eztli Guardian
text: Spawn - Any empty location ([[Ancient]], if able). Alert. Aloof. Forced - When enemies attack during the enemy phase, if Eztli Guardian is ready and unengaged: It attacks each investigator in each connecting location.
flavor: The secret must be kept.

name: Arrows from the Trees
text: Revelation - Take 1 damage, plus 1 additional damage for each [[Ally]] asset you control. Each other investigator at an [[Ancient]] location must also resolve that effect.
flavor: You are caught in a volley of obsidian-tipped arrows fired by unseen assailants, a dire warning to leave this place at once.

name: Final Mistake
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each doom on your location. If you fail, take 2 damage.
flavor: Do we dare follow in his footsteps?

name: Entombed
text: Revelation - Put Entombed into play in your threat area. You cannot disengage from enemies or move. [action]: Test [agility] (4) to escape the tomb or [combat] (4) to break out. If you succeed, discard Entombed. If you fail, reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 until the end of the round.

name: A Tear in Time
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either lose 1 action or take 1 horror.
flavor: "We've been conceptualizing time as if it were a straight line, moving forward from one point to the next. The truth is quite different."

name: Lost in Time
text: Revelation - Shuffle a non-story asset you control into your deck, moving all damage and horror from that asset to your investigator. If no asset is shuffled into your deck by this effect, choose and discard 3 cards from your hand.

name: Ill Omen
text: Peril. Revelation - Choose a location where there is at least 1 investigator. Place 1 doom on that location. Each investigator at the chosen location takes 1 horror.
flavor: It was not a natural death.

name: Ancestral Fear
text: Peril. Surge. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Place 1 doom on your location and discard Ancestral Fear (instead of placing it in the victory display). - Place Ancestral Fear in the victory display.

name: Deep Dark
text: Revelation - Put Deep Dark into play next to the agenda deck. No more than 1 clue may be discovered from each location by each investigator each round. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Deep Dark from play. (Max once per round.)

name: Brotherhood Cultist
text: Hunter. Brotherhood Cultist gets +1 fight and +1 evade for each doom on it. Forced - When you initiate an attack against Brotherhood Cultist: Place 1 doom on Brotherhood Cultist.

name: Shadowed
text: Revelation - If there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, take 1 horror and Shadowed gains surge. Otherwise, find the [[Cultist]] enemy nearest to you. Place 1 doom on that enemy and test [willpower] (X), where X is that enemy's fight value. If you fail, take 2 horror.

name: Words of Power
text: Revelation - Put Words of Power into play in your threat area. If there are 1 or more enemies at your location with doom on them, you cannot damage those enemies or discover clues at your location. [action] [action]: Discard Words of Power.

name: Fang of Yig
text: Prey - Poisoned investigator. Retaliate. While Fang of Yig is engaged with a poisoned investigator, that investigator cannot play cards or commit cards to skill tests.

name: Snakescourge
text: Revelation - Put Snakescourge into play in your threat area. If you are poisoned, Snakescourge gains surge. Treat each of your non-weakness [[Item]] assets as if its text box were blank (except for [[Traits]]). Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Snakescourge.

name: Serpent's Call
text: Revelation - You must either (choose one): Put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area, or draw the top 2 cards of the encounter deck.

name: Creeping Poison
text: Surge. Revelation - Each investigator who is poisoned takes 1 damage.
flavor: Black veins crawled underneath her skin, pulsating with every heartbeat. It would not be long now.

name: Poisoned
text: Limit 1 per investigator. Limit 1 per deck. Permanent. You are poisoned. (This has no game effect on its own. Other card effects may change or become stronger while you are poisoned.)

name: Silas Marsh
text:
[reaction] After you reveal a chaos token during a skill test you are performing. Return a skill you committed to this test to your hand. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +0. You may commit a skill from your discard pile to this test. After this test ends, return that skill to your hand instead of discarding it.
flavor: "Leave your fears on the docks, lads."

name: Nautical Prowess
text:
Silas Marsh deck only. Replacement.
If a chaos token with a negative modifier is revealed during this test, either draw 1 card or Nautical Prowess gains [wild][wild].

name: Dreams of the Deep
text: Silas Marsh deck only. Replacement. This skill's icons subtract from your skill value instead of adding to it. If this skill test fails, return this skill to your hand. Forced - If Dreams of the Deep is in your hand at the end of your turn: Reveal it and take 2 damage.

name: Scene of the Crime
text:
Play only as your first action.
Discover 1 clue at your location (2 clues instead if there is an enemy at that location). This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Marksmanship
text: Fast. Play when you activate the Fight ability on a [[Firearm]] or [[Ranged]] asset. This attack can target an enemy at a connecting location. Ignore the aloof and retaliate keywords for this attack. If this attack succeeds against an enemy not engaged with you, the attack deals +1 damage.

name: Persuasion
text: Parley. Choose a non-weakness [[Humanoid]] enemy at your location and test [intellect] (3). This test gets +X difficulty, where X is that enemy's horror value. If you succeed, shuffle the chosen enemy into the encounter deck. If the chosen enemy is [[Elite]], automatically evade it instead.

name: Lucky Cigarette Case
text: [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more, exhaust Lucky Cigarette Case: Draw 1 card.
flavor: "It’s not really all that lucky. Just in the mood for a smoke."

name: Fence
text: [reaction] When you play an [[Illicit]] card during your turn, exhaust Fence: The [[Illicit]] card gains fast. If it was already fast, reduce its cost by 1 instead.
flavor: "Don’t worry. I know a guy." - Leo De Luca

name: Counterspell
text: Fast. Play when a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] chaos token is revealed during a skill test at your location. Cancel that chaos token. (Do not reveal a new chaos token to replace it.)
flavor: "Not on my watch."

name: Perseverance
text:
Fast. Play when you are assigned damage and/or horror that would defeat you.
Cancel up to 4 of that damage and/or horror.
flavor: Calloused hands and a determined heart were all she needed.

name: Stunning Blow
text: If this skill test is successful during an attack, automatically evade the attacked enemy.
flavor: Thud.

name: Threads of Fate
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull] : -X. X is the highest number of doom on a [[cultist]] enemy.
[cultist]: -2. If you do not succeed by at least 1, take 1 damage.
[tablet]: -2. If you do not succeed by at least 1, place 1 doom on the nearest [[cultist]] enemy.
[elder_thing]: -2. If you fail, lose 1 of your clues.

name: Three Fates
text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.
flavor: You have three tasks before you and a limited amount of time before the trail goes cold. Where do you search first?

name: Behind the Curtain
text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.
flavor: This conspiracy runs much deeper than you had imagined. The more time you spend investigating these mysteries, the more you come to realize they are linked to one another. At the center of these secrets is an enigmatic organization, manipulating events behind the scenes...

name: Hidden Entanglements
text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.
flavor: Who can you trust in this city of lies? Arkham may be safe from the perils of the jungle, but you are far from safe here. Each passing stranger in the dark of night could be a kidnapper, a thief, or a killer. Each glance they send your way could be the last thing you ever see.

name: The Relic Is Missing!
text: Objective - Only investigators in Miskatonic University can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: The Eztli relic was last seen in its display case in the Eztli exhibit at the Miskatonic Museum. Ichtaca fears that the relic could be used for terrible purposes if left in the wrong hands. You must recover it!

name: Eztli Exhibit
text: Revelation - Put the Eztli Exhibit into play. Forced - After you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol while investigating the Eztli Exhibit: Take 1 horror.

name: Harlan Is in Danger!
text: Objective - Only investigators in Miskatonic University can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: Harlan has custody of the relic, but he believes he is being followed. The last time you heard from him, he was in his office at the university.

name: Harlan Earnstone
text: Revelation - Put Harlan Earnstone into play in Easttown. [action] Discard the top 3 cards of your deck: Parley. You try to snap Earnstone out of his daze. Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, place 1 clue on him (from the token pool).
flavor: When you find him, Harlan is babbling incoherently and won't respond to anything you say.

name: At the Exhibit
text: Objective - Only investigators in the Eztli Exhibit can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: One of the museum security guards, a man named Drew Walker, recognizes you from your prior work with Alejandro and Dr. Horowitz. "Look, I ain’t supposed to be letting anybody into the exhibit... But the coppers don’t know from nothing when it comes to this hokum." He steps aside and lets you pass. "If anybody asks, you slipped in while I was using the john, all right? Don’t take any wooden nickels."

name: At the Exhibit
text: Objective - Only investigators in the Eztli Exhibit can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: One of the museum security guards, a man named Drew Walker, recognizes you from your prior work with Alejandro and Dr. Horowitz. "Look, I ain’t supposed to be letting anybody into the exhibit... But the coppers don’t know from nothing when it comes to this hokum." He steps aside and lets you pass. "If anybody asks, you slipped in while I was using the john, all right? Don’t take any wooden nickels."

name: Harlan's Curse
text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Harlan Earnstone: You must remove them and immediately advance.
flavor: There is no sign of Harlan in his office, but one of the assistants in the administration building informs you that he took the day off and went to his home in Easttown.

name: Harlan's Curse
text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Harlan Earnstone: You must remove them and immediately advance.
flavor: There is no sign of Harlan in his office, but one of the assistants in the administration building informs you that he took the day off and went to his home in Easttown.

name: Harlan Earnstone
text: Revelation - Switch this card with the [[Bystander]] version of Harlan Earnstone, removing that version from the game. Attach the set-aside Relic of Ages to Harlan Earnstone. Advance to Act 3a - "Recover the Relic." Forced - After you successfully evade Harlan Earnstone by 3 or more: Add him to the victory display.
flavor: Afflicted by a strange curse, Harlan suddenly attacks!

name: Find the Relic
text: While Relic of Ages is attached to a location, that location gets +2 shroud. Objective - If Relic of Ages is attached to a location with no remaining clues, advance.
flavor: You believe you have discovered the relic’s whereabouts. Now, you must scour this place from bottom to top in order to find it.

name: Recover the Relic
text: While Relic of Ages is attached to an enemy, that enemy gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Objective - If the enemy the Relic of Ages is attached to leaves play, advance.
flavor: You’ve discovered who is carrying the relic. Now, you must secure it from them, whatever the cost!

name: Search for Alejandro
text: Objective - Only investigators in Easttown can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: You’ve decided to search for Alejandro on your own, believing you will have a better shot at finding him without involving the police. His hotel is in Easttown, so you begin your search there.

name: Henry Deveau
text: Revelation - Put Henry Deveau into play in Velma's Diner. [action] Choose and discard a card from your hand: Parley. You discuss Alejandro's whereabouts. Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, place 1 clue on this card (from the token pool).
flavor: Henry sits at the counter, sipping at a cup of black coffee.

name: Missing Persons
text: Objective - Only investigators in Easttown can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: Suspecting foul play, you’ve decided to go to the police to enlist their help in searching for Alejandro.

name: Arkham Police Station
text: Revelation - Put the Arkham Police Station into play. Easttown is connected to Arkham Police Station. [action]: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for a [[weapon]] card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

name: At the Station
text: Objective - Only investigators in the Arkham Police Station can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: The police station might be open to the public in theory, but getting your story heard by the proper authorities requires a bit more finesse than you imagined.

name: At the Station
text: Objective - Only investigators in the Arkham Police Station can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: The police station might be open to the public in theory, but getting your story heard by the proper authorities requires a bit more finesse than you imagined.

name: Train Tracks
text: Revelation - Put Train Tracks into play. Attach the set-aside Alejandro Vela to Train Tracks. Advance to Act 3c - "Alejandro's Prison." Northside is connected to Train Tracks. [action] Spend 1 clue: Draw 4 cards. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: One of the police officers claims to have seen Alejandro down by the train tracks, flanked by several robed figures...

name: Friends in High Places
text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Henry Deveau: You must remove them and immediately advance.
flavor: You can’t get into Alejandro’s hotel room, so you decide to question several of the occupants in the neighboring rooms. One of them informs you that Alejandro has been meeting often with an acquaintance of his, a government official named Henry Deveau. They tend to meet nightly at Velma’s Diner. Perhaps you should pay Henry a visit?

name: Friends in High Places
text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Henry Deveau: You must remove them and immediately advance.
flavor: You can’t get into Alejandro’s hotel room, so you decide to question several of the occupants in the neighboring rooms. One of them informs you that Alejandro has been meeting often with an acquaintance of his, a government official named Henry Deveau. They tend to meet nightly at Velma’s Diner. Perhaps you should pay Henry a visit?

name: Henry Deveau
text: Revelation - Switch this card with the [[Bystander]] version of Henry Deveau, removing that version from the game. Attach the set-aside Alejandro Vela to Henry Deveau. Advance to Act 3c - "Alejandro's Plight." Retaliate.
flavor: Henry claims to know where Alejandro is and leads you out of the diner. As you follow him down a nearby alley, he pulls out a knife and attacks you!

name: Alejandro's Prison
text: While Alejandro Vela is attached to a location, that location gets +2 shroud. Objective - If Alejandro Vela is attached to a location with no remaining clues, advance.
flavor: You believe that Alejandro is held captive somewhere in this location. You must rescue him!

name: Alejandro's Plight
text: While Alejandro Vela is attached to an enemy, that enemy gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Objective - If the enemy Alejandro Vela is attached to leaves play, advance.
flavor: You believe you have discovered the identity of Alejandro’s kidnapper. Now you must fight to rescue your companion!

name: Trial of the Huntress
text: Objective - Only investigators in Rivertown can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: Ichtaca told you not to follow her, though you can’t help but wonder what she is up to. You decide to pursue her as she heads down toward the riverside…

name: Black Cave
text: Revelation - Put Black Cave into play. Forced - At the end of your turn, if you are in the Black Cave: You must either take 1 horror or choose and discard 2 cards from your hand.

name: The Guardian's Inquiry
text: Objective - Only investigators in Northside can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: Ichtaca tells you that she saw several Eztli artifacts on sale in the strange shop near the northwestern edge of the city. She wants to head in that direction to investigate further.

name: Maria DeSilva
text: Revelation - Put Maria DeSilva into play in the Curiositie Shoppe. [action] Spend 1 resource: Parley. You chat with Maria about the artifacts on sale. Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, place 1 clue on her (from the token pool).
flavor: "Exquisite, aren't they?"

name: The Cave of Darkness
text: Objective - Only investigators in the Black Cave can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. There must be no clues remaining on the Black Cave in order to advance this act.
flavor: You watched Ichtaca enter this abandoned cave on her own. What is she doing in such a strange place?

name: The Cave of Darkness
text: Objective - Only investigators in the Black Cave can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. There must be no clues remaining on the Black Cave in order to advance this act.
flavor: You watched Ichtaca enter this abandoned cave on her own. What is she doing in such a strange place?

name: Strange Relics
text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Maria DeSilva: You must remove them and immediately advance.
flavor: Inside the shop, an middle-aged woman wearing the height of fashion inspects the Eztli relics on display with admiration. How did those relics get here? And what does this woman know about all of this?

name: Maria DeSilva
subname: Knows More Than She Lets On
text: Revelation - Switch this card with the [[Bystander]] version of Maria DeSilva, removing that version from the game. Remember that she is "Ichtaca's prey." Advance to Act 3e - "The Brotherhood is Revealed." Retaliate.
flavor: "You don't understand what you are meddling in!"

name: Strange Relics
text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Maria DeSilva: You must remove them and immediately advance.
flavor: Inside the shop, an middle-aged woman wearing the height of fashion inspects the Eztli relics on display with admiration. How did those relics get here? And what does this woman know about all of this?

name: Strange Occurrences
text: While you are at any of "Ichtaca's destinations," the first treachery you draw from the encounter deck each round gains surge. Objective - If there are no clues remaining on each of "Ichtaca's destinations," advance.
flavor: Ichtaca has found the target of her investigation. The trail of the mysterious cult leads here. A thorough search of the area may reveal more...

name: The Brotherhood Is Revealed
text: "Ichtaca's prey" each get +1 fight, +1 [per_investigator] health, and +1 evade while at a location with no clues on it. Objective - If each of "Ichtaca's prey" is no longer in play, advance.
flavor: Ichtaca has found target of her hunt. The mysterious cult has been revealed - but what is their ultimate purpose?

name: Velma's Diner
text:
Easttown is connected to Velma's Diner.
[action] [action] [action]: You kill some time at the diner and listen to the conversations of the patrons around you. Gain 2 clues from the token pool. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: A bit of warmth in an otherwise dreary town.

name: Curiositie Shoppe
text:
Northside is connected to Curiositie Shoppe.
While you are in the Curiositie Shoppe, reduce the cost of each [[relic]] asset you play by 2.
flavor: A brass bell clangs as you push open the front door. Inside, the shop is dusty and disorganized. Inspecting the unusual wares on display causes the hair on your arms to stand on end.

name: Town Hall
text: Downtown is connected to Town Hall. Forced - After you enter Town Hall, if you have 4 or more cards in your hand: Choose and discard cards from your hand until you have 3 cards in your hand.

name: The Secret Must Be Kept
text: Peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 damage and 1 horror. For each act deck the investigators have completed, this skill test gets +1 difficulty and deals +1 damage and +1 horror if it is failed.

name: Nobody's Home
text: Revelation - Attach to your location. If there are no clues on your location, Nobody's Home gains surge. You must spend 1 additional action to investigate attached location. Forced - If there are no clues on attached location: Discard Nobody's Home.

name: Conspiracy of Blood
text: Revelation - Attach Conspiracy of Blood to the current agenda. Attached agenda gets -1 doom threshold. Each [[cultist]] enemy gains: "[action] Parley. Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, discard 1 copy of Conspiracy of Blood from play. If you fail, place 1 doom on this enemy."

name: Ichtaca
text: You get +1 [combat] (+2 [combat] instead while attacking an enemy with Victory X). You get +1 [agility] (+2 [agility] instead while attempting to evade an enemy with Vengeance X). [reaction] After you add an enemy to the victory display, exhaust Ichtaca: You and Ichtaca each heal 1 horror.

name: Expedition Journal
text: You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to explore.
flavor:
Sunday, July 12th, 1925
…What have we done?

name: Physical Training
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.

name: Dynamite Blast
text: Choose either your location or a connecting location. Deal 3 damage to each enemy and to each investigator at the chosen location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Hyperawareness
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.

name: Barricade
