text: Attach to your location. Non-[[Elite]] enemies cannot move into or spawn at attached location. Each time a non-[[Elite]] enemy would spawn at attached location, spawn it at a connecting location instead, if able. Forced - When an investigator leaves attached location: Discard Barricade.

name: Hard Knocks
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.

name: Hot Streak
text: Gain 10 resources.
flavor: "I win again! Sorry sugar, it’s just not your night."

name: Arcane Studies
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test.

name: Mind Wipe
text:
Fast. Play after a phase begins.
Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy in your location. Until the end of the phase, reduce the chosen enemy's damage and horror values by 1, and treat its printed text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]).

name: Dig Deep
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.

name: Rabbit's Foot
text: [reaction] After you fail a skill test, exhaust Rabbit's Foot: Search the top X cards of your deck for a card, draw it, and shuffle the remaining cards into your deck. X is the amount you failed by.
flavor: They claimed it would bring me good luck. I wouldn’t say that’s true. But now I feel like it would be even worse luck to get rid of it.

name: Slip Away
text: Evade. Add your [intellect] to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you succeed by 2 or more and the evaded enemy is non-[[Elite]], it does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

name: Crystalline Elder Sign
text:
Seal (+1 or [elder_sign]).
You get +1 [willpower], +1 [intellect], +1 [combat], and +1 [agility].
flavor: Priceless in every sense of the word.

name: The Skeleton Key
text:
Exceptional. Fast.
[action]: If the Skeleton Key is in your play area, attach it to your location. If it is already attached to your location, detach it and return it to your play area instead.
Set the attached location's shroud value to 1.

name: Mists of R'lyeh
text: Uses (5 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. You get +3 [willpower] for this evasion attempt. If you succeed, after evading the chosen enemy, you may move to a connecting location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this evasion attempt, choose and discard a card from your hand.

name: Second Wind
text:
Play only as your first action.
Heal 1 damage (2 instead if you drew a treachery this round). Then, draw 1 card.

name: Well Prepared
text: [fast] Exhaust Well Prepared: Choose an asset you control. You get +X skill value for this skill test, where X is the number of matching skill icons on the chosen asset.

name: Truth from Fiction
text:
Play only if there is a clue on your location.
Place 2 secrets on an asset you control.
flavor:
“How do you know I’m mad?” said Alice.
“You must be,” said the Cat, “or you wouldn’t have come here.”
- Lewis Carroll, Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland

name: True Understanding
text:
Commit only to a skill test from an ability printed on a scenario card.
If this skill test is successful, discover 1 clue at your location.

name: Hatchet Man
text: If this skill test is successful during an evasion attempt, the next time the evaded enemy takes damage this turn, deal it 1 additional damage.
flavor: Only someone who is half seas over would lather up the O’Bannions.

name: High Roller
text: [fast] Spend 3 resources and exhaust High Roller: You get +2 skill value for this skill test. If you succeed, gain 3 resources.
flavor: The higher the stakes, the better his luck.

name: Enraptured
text: If this skill test is successful during an investigation, place 1 charge or secret on an asset you control.
flavor: Voyaging far from our placid island of ignorance.

name: Try and Try Again
text:
Uses (3 tries). If Try and Try Again has no tries, discard it.
[reaction] After a skill test is failed, if a skill card you own is committed to that test, exhaust Try and Try Again and spend 1 try: Return that skill card to your hand.

name: Cornered
text: [fast] Discard 1 card from your hand: You get +2 skill value for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)
flavor: Bravery is born when there is no other choice.

name: Return to The Gathering
text:
Perform the setup as indicated in the Night of the Zealot Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions:
- When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Gathering shown here.
- Remove Act 1a- "Trapped" from the game and replace it with the new Act 1a- "Mysterious Gateway."
(Continued on reverse side.)

name: Mysterious Gateway
text: Objective - Only investigators in the Guest Hall may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: As you leap to investigate, the door to your study vanishes before your eyes, leaving behind a strange gateway to another part of your house. There must be a reason why this is happening…

name: Study
text:
[action] [action]: Draw 3 cards. Only the lead investigator can activate this ability.
Forced - When an enemy attempts to spawn at a location that is not in play: Put that location into play and spawn that enemy there.
flavor: The door to your study has vanished, leaving in its wake a gateway to another part of your house.

name: Guest Hall
text: Investigators in this location cannot take draw actions.
flavor: How did you end up here… ?

name: Bedroom
text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating the Bedroom: Discard 1 card at random from your hand.
flavor: The bedsheets are tattered, and a strange symbol is drawn on the fabric. Blood pools at the foot of the closet door, and you can hear something chewing inside.

name: Bathroom
text: Forced - After you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [auto_fail] symbol while investigating the Bathroom: Lose all remaining actions and end your turn.
flavor: The guest bathroom looks as though it hasn't been cleaned in years. A viscous green liquid fills the bathtub in the far corner of the room, and mold has grown across the walls.

name: Hallway
text: Forced - After you reveal this location: Put the set-aside Attic, Cellar, and Parlor locations into play.
flavor: The walls of your house are splattered with mud, and your hardwood floor is gone, replaced with a dirt path.

name: Attic
text: Forced - After you reveal the Attic: Put the set-aside Far Above Your House location into play.
flavor: The bloody carcass of some sort of beast swings from a meat hook chained to the ceiling. Blood drains slowly from the carcass, dripping into a small barrel. To your surprise, a wooden ladder at the far end of the attic ascends through your roof, to an even higher area

name: Field of Graves
text: Forced - After you reveal Field of Graves: Test [willpower] (4). For each point you fail by, discard 1 card at random from each player's hand.
flavor: You climb the ladder and emerge from a pit in the ground amidst an endless field of graves. Each bears a branch from your family tree.

name: Cellar
text: Forced - After you reveal the Cellar: Put the set-aside Deep Below Your House location into play.
flavor: Your cellar seems to have been replaced with an underground network of icy tunnels and caverns. The tunnels continue for miles, deeper and deeper beneath the surface.

name: Ghoul Pits
text: Forced - After you reveal Ghoul Pits: Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Swarm of Rats and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
flavor: These pits seem to be the creatures' lairs. They are ice-cold and filled with the decaying remains of humans and other animals.

name: Corpse-Hungry Ghoul
text:
Spawn - Bedroom.
Hunter.
flavor: Behind the door to your closet, the creature finishes its meal. Its appetite insatiable, it quickly turns its attention to you.

name: Ghoul from the Depths
text:
Spawn - Bathroom.
Retaliate.
flavor: Tearing its way out of the floor, a crazed beast emerges from the tunnels below. Its eyes are red with hunger and hate.

name: The Zealot's Seal
text: Revelation - Each investigator with 3 or fewer cards in hand must take 1 damage and 1 horror. Each investigator with 4 or more cards in hand tests [willpower] (2). Each investigator who fails must discard 2 cards at random from his or her hand.
flavor: The third seal will be the last.

name: Return to The Midnight Masks
text:
Perform the setup as indicated in the Night of the Zealot Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions:
- When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to the Midnight Masks shown here.
- Construct the act deck using one of the two copies of Agenda 1a- "Predator or Prey" at random, without looking at their other sides. Remove the other version of Agenda 1a from the game.
(Continued on reverse side.)

name: Predator or Prey?
text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.
flavor: Lita seems convinced of a conspiracy within the city of Arkham. She believes that a secret cult serves the ghouls that live in the crypts beneath the city, and that several of the cult’s prominent members are scattered throughout Arkham. As you begin searching for them, you can’t shake the feeling that you, too, are being hunted.

name: Narôgath
text:
Spawn - Engaged with Prey.
Prey - Nearest to another [[Cultist]] enemy.
Hunter.
Narôgath gets +3 health per investigator.
While Narôgath is ready, each investigator at its location or a connecting location cannot Parley with [[Cultist]] enemies.

name: Easttown
text: [action]: Add 2 supply tokens or ammo tokens to an asset you control. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: You doubt that Sheriff Engle will believe your story, but you might be able to convince some of the other officers to assist in your investigation.

name: Northside
text: [action]: Move to any [[Arkham]] location. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: The train has many stops throughout Arkham, and many more beyond. You are tempted to leave all of this behind.

name: Miskatonic University
text: [action] Take 2 horror: Gain 1 clue from the token pool. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: The university's museum holds many peculiar exhibits and ominous relics from expeditions all over the world.

name: Rivertown
text: [action] Discard a card with X [willpower] icons: Remove X doom from a [[Cultist]] enemy in play. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: The lone warehouse next to the river is quiet and secluded: an ideal venue for unsavory dealings.

name: Masked Horrors
text: Revelation - Each investigator with 2 or more clues takes 2 horror. If no horror is dealt by this effect, place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.
flavor: "Umôrdhoth…Umôrdhoth…Umôrdhoth…"

name: Return to The Devourer Below
text:
Perform the setup as indicated in the Night of the Zealot Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions:
- When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Devourer Below shown here.
- When choosing 4 Arkham Woods locations to put into play at random, include the 4 new Arkham Woods locations included in this encounter set, for a total of 10 possibilities.
- After setting the Umôrdhoth enemy aside, flip this card over and attach it to Umôrdhoth.

name: Vault of Earthly Demise
text:
Vault of Earthly Demise cannot leave play.
Umôrdhoth gets +X health per investigator and gets +X fight, where X is the number of resources on this card.
Forced - When Umôrdhoth enters play, place 1 resource on this card for each act remaining in the act deck.

name: Arkham Woods
text: Forced - After an investigator at this location succeeds at a skill test on a treachery: That treachery gains surge. (Group limit once per round.)
flavor: It seems to groan and twist in the chill wind, as though alive.

name: Arkham Woods
text: Forced - After you reveal a chaos token from the chaos bag while investigating this location: Reveal and resolve an additional chaos token. (Limit once per test.)
flavor: This used to be a popular spot for fishing, but it doesn't look like anybody has fished here in years.

name: Arkham Woods
text: Each enemy at this location cannot take more than 1 damage from each attack performed against it.
flavor: The remains of half-eaten animal corpses litter this section of the woods, befouling the air with their stench.

name: Arkham Woods
text: Forced - After you reveal a chaos token from the chaos bag during an evasion attempt at this location: Reveal and resolve an additional chaos token. (Limit once per test.)
flavor: Not even on a dare would you attempt to cross this rotted, rickety bridge.

name: Umôrdhoth's Hunger
text: Revelation - Each investigator must discard 1 card at random from his or her hand. Each investigator who has no cards in his or her hand is killed. Heal 1 damage from each enemy in play.
flavor: It prefers to feast on the rot of the deceased, but when the hunger is overpowering, the living will suffice.

name: Grave-Eater
text: Forced - After Grave-Eater attacks you: Discard 1 card at random from your hand.
flavor:
Its position was a kind of crouch, and as one looked one felt that at any moment it might drop its present prey and seek a juicier morsel.
-H. P. Lovecraft, “Pickman’s Model”

name: Acolyte of Umôrdhoth
text:
Prey - Fewest cards in hand.
While engaged with an investigator with no cards in his or her hand, Acolyte of Umôrdhoth cannot be evaded.
flavor: Its dreadful mask conceals the true horror beneath.

name: Chill from Below
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must discard 1 card at random from your hand. For each card you cannot discard, take 1 damage.
flavor: The ground is covered in ice and frost, and a deep chill courses through the air.

name: Disciple of the Devourer
text:
Spawn - Farthest empty location.
Forced - After you spawn Disciple of the Devourer: You must either place 1 doom on it or place 1 of your clues on its location. If the current agenda is not agenda 1, do both instead.
flavor: Placate the beast, and we are allowed to live. When we die, it will feast on our remains.

name: Corpse-Taker
text:
Spawn - Farthest empty location.
Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Place 1 doom on Corpse-Taker.
Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Corpse-Taker moves once toward Rivertown or Main Path. If Corpse-Taker is already at Rivertown or Main Path, move all doom from Corpse-Taker to the current agenda, instead.

name: Mask of Umôrdhoth
text:
Revelation - Attach to the farthest [[Cultist]] enemy and place 1 doom on that enemy. If there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy, draw it, and attach Mask of Umôrdhoth to it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
Attached enemy gets +2 health. If attached enemy is unique, it gains retaliate. If it is non-unique, it gains aloof instead.

name: Jeremiah Pierce
text:
Spawn - Your House. Otherwise, Rivertown.
[action]: Parley. Add Jeremiah Pierce to the victory display. Then, test [willpower] (4). Place 1 doom on the current agenda for each point you fail by (this can cause the current agenda to advance).
flavor: He seems a little too interested in what you’ve been up to these days.

name: Billy Cooper
text:
Spawn - Easttown.
Forced - After a [[Monster]] enemy is defeated at Billy Cooper's location: Add Billy Cooper to the victory display.
flavor: The cops have been writing off these disappearances as animal attacks. One cop, in particular…

name: Alma Hill
text:
Spawn - Southside.
[action]: Parley. Draw the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Then, add Alma Hill to the victory display.
flavor: Miss Hill has been preventing other members of the Historical Society from researching similar disappearances. What is she afraid of?

name: The Labyrinths of Lunacy
text:
Standard
[skull]: -1. Reveal another token.
[cultist]: -3. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[tablet]: -4. If you fail, lose 2 resources.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, discard a random card from your hand.

name: Awakening
text: Forced - At the end of the round, if there is at least 1 doom on this agenda and no group has yet triggered this ability: The lead investigator of Group A chooses a random set-aside [[Act 1]] story card and draws it. Announce the chosen card's title to all three groups. Each other lead investigator draws that story card.
flavor: You and two other groups been kidnapped and trapped for some kind of terrible experiment. The note for your group has further instructions.

name: Awakening
flavor: You and two other groups been kidnapped and trapped for some kind of terrible experiment. The note for your group has further instructions.

name: Agony and Despair
text: Forced - At the end of the round, if there is at least 1 doom on this agenda and no group has yet triggered this ability: The lead investigator of Group A chooses a random set-aside [[Act 2]] story card and draws it. Announce the chosen card's title to all three groups. Each other lead investigator draws that story card.
flavor:
As you escape from the first chamber, glowing words flicker into existence on your group's note:
"Have you made it out of the first chamber? Good. Perhaps you are not as useless as I suspected."

name: Agony and Despair
flavor:
As you escape from the first chamber, glowing words flicker into existence on your group's note:
"Have you made it out of the first chamber? Good. Perhaps you are not as useless as I suspected."

name: The Mastermind
text: Each [[Distortion]] location gains: "[action] [survivor]4+1< T %2[cultist]+: <+@2 H <@6@~+ [willpower]9 EIXODOLON. (Group limit once per game.)" Objective - If each investigator is defeated, advance this agenda.
flavor: You rush into the next chamber, hoping to find an exit to this nightmare. The locked steel gate before you crushes that hope. Cryptic symbols are etched into the walls, and a sigil on the floor ebbs with power. Just then, a figure exits from the shadows.

name: Sealed In (Group A)
text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. By the time the agenda advances, investigators must possess the Key of Mysteries and the requisite number of clues. (Beware - If the agenda advances and you do not meet this condition, each investigator in this group will be killed.)
flavor: "You have one hour to discover the way out," your note reads, "or you will breathe in death."

name: Watery Grave (Group B)
text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. By the time the agenda advances, investigators at the same location must possess the requisite number of clues. (Beware - If the agenda advances and you do not meet this condition, the investigator in the Chamber of Rain will be killed.)
flavor: One member of your group is trapped inside one of this chamber's many tanks. A mechanism above the tank springs to life, and water pours into the tank from above. "You have one hour to find the means to free your companion," your note reads, "or their fate is sealed."

name: The Levers (Group C)
text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. Before the agenda advances, one investigator must activate the [action] ability on the Chamber of Regret. (Beware - If you pull the wrong lever, you will be killed.)
flavor: "Only one of you can make the choice," your note reads. "Choose the correct lever, or die." An iron gate nearby opens with a deafening crash and reveals a small room that contains three unmarked levers.

name: The Levers (Group C)
text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. Before the agenda advances, one investigator must activate the [action] ability on the Chamber of Regret. Beware - If you pull the wrong lever, you will be killed
flavor: "Only one of you can make the choice," your note reads. "Choose the correct lever, or die." An iron gate nearby opens with a deafening crash and reveals a small room that contains three unmarked levers.

name: Distortions in Time (Group A)
text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. When the agenda advances, there must be at least 11 doom in play. (Beware - If the agenda advances and you do not meet this condition, each investigator in this group will be killed.)
flavor: Glowing words continue to appear on your note. "Time flows differently in the next chamber," it reads. "If you do not act quickly, you will decay into ash."

name: Seeping Death (Group B)
text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. Before the agenda advances, one investigator must activate the [action] ability on the Chamber of Poison.
flavor: Glowing words continue to appear on your note. "The Chamber of Poison awaits," it reads. "One of you must open the way," your note reads. "A sacrifice, for the greater good."

name: The Pet (Group C)
text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. Find a way to deal with Eixodolon's Pet before the agenda advances. (Beware - If the creature is still "locked away" when the agenda advances, it will break free.)
flavor: Glowing words continue to appear on your note. "In the chamber ahead lives my precious pet," it reads. "He is very hungry. Perhaps you should open his gate and allow him to feed."

name: The Escape
text: Objective - At the end of the round, if Eixodolon has no remaining health, you may move any damage on him in excess of his health to another group's copy of Eixodolon. Then, advance.
flavor: "You are close to freedom," the figure's distorted voice crackles. "Do you still have hope in your voice? Do you still have light in your eyes?"

name: The Escape
text: Objective - If Eixodolon has no remaining health, advance.
flavor: "You are close to freedom," the figure's distorted voice crackles. "Do you still have hope in your voice? Do you still have light in your eyes?"

name: Chamber of Secrets
text: [action]: You pound your fists on the wall of the chamber. Nobody responds.
flavor:
Scrawled across the wall, a crude note reads: "RIGHT"
Perhaps it is a clue… but for what?

name: Chamber of Secrets
text: [action]: You pound your fists on the wall of the chamber. Nobody responds.
flavor:
Scrawled across the wall, a crude note reads: "MIDDLE"
Perhaps it is a clue… but for what?

name: Chamber of Secrets
text: [action]: You pound your fists on the wall of the chamber. Nobody responds.
flavor:
Scrawled across the wall, a crude note reads: "LEFT"
Perhaps it is a clue… but for what?

name: Chamber of Rain
text: The Chamber of Rain is sealed shut while the water flows. While it is Act 1, this location gains: "Investigators cannot move into or out of this location. Forced - When an investigator here draws an enemy card: Discard it and draw a new card to replace it."

name: Chamber of Sorrows
text: [action]: Test [combat] (1) to try to break down the door to the flooding terrarium. Regardless of whether you succeed or fail, it does not budge. Remember that you "tried your best."

name: Chamber of Sorrows
text: [action]: Test [willpower] (2) to interpret the diagram inscribed on the glass. If you succeed, take control of 1 clue on an investigator in either Chamber of Sorrows or Chamber of Rain (or from that location if you are the only investigator in the game). Any investigator in either Chamber of Sorrows or Chamber of Rain may perform this action.

name: Chamber of Night
text: [action]: You call out for help as loud as you can. Nobody responds.
flavor: The wooden shelves in this dark chamber are so rotten, you're surprised they can hold anything without falling apart.

name: Chamber of Night
text: [action]: Test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, you notice strange writing inscribed along the wall; look at the revealed side of the location underneath the scenario reference card. When you are satisfied, place it back underneath the scenario reference card.

name: Chamber of Regret
text:
No more than one investigator may be in the Chamber of Regret at a time.
[action] The investigators spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: You pull one of the 3 levers (choose one): left, middle, or right. As soon as you do, the gate slams shut behind you. You cannot leave the Chamber of Regret for the remainder of the current act.

name: Labyrinthine Halls
text: [fast] Choose and discard 2 cards from your hand: You find an old lockbox in a pile of refuse, and decide to leave something behind. At the end of the round, choose another investigator in any group. That investigator draws 2 cards. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: As you travel further down these halls, you are assaulted by a putrid stench.

name: Labyrinthine Halls
text: [fast] Spend 4 resources: You find the corpse of someone you think you once knew, and wish you could have saved them. At the end of the round, choose another investigator in any group. That investigator gains 4 resources. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: The corpses of gaunt creatures fill this section of the complex - some natural, others uncanny.

name: Labyrinthine Halls
text: [action] [action]: You peer through an overgrown mirror and see an unfamiliar reflection. At the end of the round, choose another investigator in any group. That investigator may take 2 additional actions during his or her next turn. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: As you continue through the halls, you find moss, mold and ivy creeping along the walls and floor.

name: Chamber of Hunger
text: [fast] If there are no clues on Chamber of Hunger: There is something strange drawn on the glass. Take control of the set-aside Hunger Diagram.
flavor: It's like a zoo for a sadist.

name: Chamber of Decay
text: [fast] If there are no clues on Chamber of Decay: There's a journal here with some strange scribblings. Take control of the set-aside Decay Diagram.
flavor: The air is thick and humid. It stings your eyes and causes you to cough uncontrollably.

name: Chamber of Rot
text: [fast] If there are no clues on Chamber of Rot: There is something strange etched on the walls. Take control of the set-aside Rot Diagram.
flavor: A trap door along the floor leads down into a separate chamber.

name: Chamber of Poison
text: [action]: You cross the noxious pit and turn the valve at the end. (Beware - activating this ability without the antidote may be deadly.)
flavor: The yellow-green sludge bubbles and froths dreadfully. Across the pit, you see a control panel with a lone copper valve.

name: Abandoned Warehouse
flavor: Two other heavy vault doors lead into the Abandoned Warehouse, sealed tightly shut. You can hear voices from the other side and all around you, as though stretching across multiple dimensions.

name: Arcane Runes
text:
In your chamber, you see a set of arcane runes etched upon the wall. If you can decode them and set them in the correct order, perhaps it will change something...
Revelation - Attach Arcane Runes to a [[Distortion]] location. [fast] If there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on this card: Flip it over and follow the instructions on its other side. [action]: sTte[intellect])3(. fI uoy ucdee,cs ceapl 1 cesueorr no tsih cr.ad If an investigator in this group has successfully resolved the above ability, this card gains: "[action]: es)3T[intellect](t. oYu ancnto mctmio rdcsa ot htsi klisl e.tts fI uyo duec,esc ealcp 1 srcrouee no nhotera ugpro's coyp fo raeAnc nRues."

name: The Rift
text:
With a sudden flash of light, a rift begins to open in the wall nearby, energy slowly coalescing into the shape of a portal. It is too small to enter now, but soon it will be large enough for a person to step through...
Revelation - Attach The Rift to the current act. If it is act 1, Groups B and C put the set-aside Key of Mysteries into play at a [[Distortion]] location. Forced - At the end of the round, if there is at least 3 doom on each group's agenda: The rift opens wide enough for an investigator to step through. Choose an investigator at any location to enter the rift. Then, that investigator flips this card over and follows the instructions on its other side.

name: The Vent
text:
You find a ventilation shaft through which you can fit some important items...
Revelation - Place The Vent in a [[Distortion]] location. If it is act 1, Groups B and C put the set-aside Key of Mysteries into play at that location. [fast]: Place any number of your resource tokens or clues on this card, and/or place any number of [[Item]] assets you control underneath this card. You may also place a written note underneath this card. [action]: Take control of any number of tokens, cards, or notes on/underneath this card. [reaction] At the end of the round: You send all of the tokens and cards gathered here through the ventilation shaft. Flip this card over and follow the instructions on the other side.

name: The Dilemma
text:
Glowing words appear on your group's note as though written by an unseen entity. It reads: "Worry not. I shall give your friends a chance to escape. All you have to do is perish at their expense, and they will be given the means to escape. Just write 'I choose death' on this note here, and the deed will be done."
Revelation - Put The Dilemma into play, next to the act deck. The current act gains: "[reaction] At the end of the round: Desperate, you are willing to sacrifice yourself for the benefit of the other groups. Flip The Dilemma over and follow the instructions on the other side."

name: The Gate
text:
You notice a doorway in your chamber that wasn't there before. On the other side, the hall is pitch black. Where does it lead?
Revelation - Attach The Gate to a [[Distortion]] location. [action] Spend 1 clue: You enter the doorway. Flip this story card over and follow the instructions on its other side.

name: Encrypted Glyphs
text:
In your chamber, you see three lines of strange glyphs etched upon the wall. One line seems brighter than the others.
Revelation - Attach Encrypted Glyphs to a [[Distortion]] location. Forced - If there is at least 1 horror and 1 [per_investigator] damage on this card: Flip it over and follow the instructions on its other side. [action]: Test [intellect] (2) to attempt to decipher the glyphs. If you succeed, place 1 damage on this card. [action]: Test [willpower] (4) to move the glyphs to their proper order. If you succeed, place 1 horror on each group's copy of Encrypted Glyphs.

name: Eixodolon's Note
text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Eixolodon's Note to another investigator.
flavor: A@ B# C% D< E+ F= G~ H> I\ J3 K7 L2 M6 N1 O9 P4 Q8 R5 S[survivor] T[willpower] U[cultist] V[elder_thing] W[intellect] X[tablet] Y[auto_fail] Z[elder_sign] 1T 2R 3H 4D 5U 6P 7Q 8Z 9B [action] [action]

name: Key of Mysteries
text: Forced - When you are defeated: Place Key of Mysteries at your location. While the Key of Mysteries is uncontrolled, it gains: "[action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, take control of the Key of Mysteries."
flavor: Emblazoned across the handle is the letter A.

name: Mysterious Syringe
text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Mysterious Syringe to another investigator. [action]: Choose an investigator at your location and remove Mysterious Syringe from the game. Remember that the chosen investigator has "been injected"
flavor: Emblazoned across the handle is the letter B.

name: Rot Diagram
text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Rot Diagram to another investigator. While you are in the Chamber of Decay, it gains: "[action]: Place 1 doom here. Flip any number of your clues to their doom side and place them here."
flavor: Perhaps one of the groups can make sense of this?

name: Rot Diagram
text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Rot Diagram to another investigator. While you are in the Chamber of Rot, it gains: "[action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, take control of the set-aside Mysterious Syringe."

name: Hunger Diagram
text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Hunger Diagram to another investigator. While you are in the Chamber of Rot, it gains: "[action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, take control of the set-aside Mysterious Syringe."
flavor: Perhaps one of the groups can make sense of this?

name: Hunger Diagram
text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Hunger Diagram to another investigator. While you are in the Chamber of Hunger, it gains: "[action] If Eixodolon's Pet is 'locked away,' spend 1 clue: Deal 4 damage to Eixodolon's Pet."

name: Decay Diagram
text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Decay Diagram to another investigator. While you are in the Chamber of Hunger, it gains: "[action] If Eixodolon's Pet is 'locked away,' spend 1 clue: Deal 4 damage to Eixodolon's Pet."
flavor: Perhaps one of the groups can make sense of this?

name: Decay Diagram
text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Decay Diagram to another investigator. While you are in the Chamber of Decay, it gains: "[action]: Place 1 doom here. Flip any number of your clues to their doom side and place them here."

name: Eixodolon
text: Hunter. Retaliate. Eixodolon gets +6 [per_investigator] health and cannot be defeated by damage. Forced - When the enemy phase begins, if there is a copy of Harvested Pain in the victory display: Ready Eixodolon.

name: Eixodolon's Pet
subname: You Are Not Its First Victim, Or Its Last
text:
Hunter. Retaliate.
While Eixodolon's Pet is "locked away," it is immune to player card effects and Chamber of Hunger gains: "[action] Investigators at Chamber of Hunger spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Set Eixodolon's Pet aside, out of play. Remember that you "sent Eixodolon's Pet to another group."

name: Eixodolon's Pet
subname: You Are Not Its First Victim, Or Its Last
text:
Hunter. Retaliate.
While Eixodolon's Pet is "locked away," it is immune to player card effects.

name: The Jailor
text: Spawn - Nearest Labyrinthine Halls. Hunter. Eixodolon's Note gains: "[action] Fight. Use only on The Jailor. Use either [willpower] or [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, set The Jailor aside, out of play. At the end of the round, move The Jailor to another group's Labyrinthine Halls (it keeps all tokens and attachments)."

name: Faceless Abductor
text: Spawn - Nearest [[Prison]] location. Hunter. Forced - After Faceless Abductor attacks an investigator: Move that investigator to a [[Prison]] location.

name: Tortured Victim
text: Revelation - You must either discard a random card from your hand, or Tortured Victim makes an immediate attack against you.

name: Mi-Go Guard
text: Prey - Most remaining health. For each [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] token revealed during an attack against Mi-Go Guard, that attack deals 1 fewer damage.

name: Unnatural Weariness
text: Peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must choose a different option: - Lose 3 resources. - Lose 1 action. - Discard a random card from your hand.

name: Poisonous Gas
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail, lose 1 action (2 actions instead if you fail by 2 or more). When this skill test begins, an investigator at your location may place 1 of his or her clues on your location to reduce the difficulty of this test by 2.

name: Dreadful Mechanism
text: Revelation - Put Dreadful Mechanism into play in your threat area. Forced - After you perform an action other than the [action] ability below: Take 1 damage, discard an asset taking up at least 1 hand slot, and discard Dreadful Mechanism. [action]: Test [combat] (2). If you succeed, discard Dreadful Mechanism.

name: Blood and Rust
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail, take 1 damage (2 damage instead if you fail by 2 or more). When this skill test begins, an investigator at your location may place 1 of his or her clues on your location to reduce the difficulty of this test by 2.

name: Paradox Effect
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror. If you succeed, put Paradox Effect into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Paradox Effect and choose an investigator in another group. You and that investigator may talk in private and may exchange resources, story assets, and cards in hand.

name: Paradox Effect
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror.
flavor:
Reality wavers.
Reality splits.
Reality reforms, and the paradox collapses.

name: Harvested Pain
text: Peril. Revelation - If you have 3 or fewer remaining health or sanity, add Harvested Pain to the victory display. Otherwise, take 1 damage and 1 horror. While Harvested Pain is in the victory display, Eixodolon gets +1 fight.

name: Custom Ammunition
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to a [[Firearm]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location. Place 2 ammo on that asset. Limit 1 per asset.
Attacks performed by attached asset deal +1 damage against [[Monster]] enemies.
flavor: "You want me to bless - what?"

name: The Boundary Beyond
text: Easy / Standard [skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you are at an [[Ancient]] location). [cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 doom on a [[Cultist]] enemy. [tablet]: Reveal another token. If you fail and there is a [[Serpent]] enemy at your location, it attacks you. [elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, place 1 clue (from the token pool) on the nearest [[Ancient]] location.

name: The Boundary, Broken
flavor:
Ichtaca is already up and about when you awaken, donning her traditional armor, her bow on her back and a long blade at her side. "Something is wrong," she states cryptically. "I only meant to peer through the boundary…"
Her eyes are bloodshot, her face pale as a ghost. You suspect she hasn’t slept all night. "It matters not. It is time you witnessed the fate that will befall humanity if we fail."

name: The Barrier Is Thin
flavor: Ichtaca’s strength continues to wane as you journey through the strange vision. You’ve never seen her this troubled. She is often distracted, peering about as though any moment the answer will appear before her. From time to time, she mutters strange phrases to herself: "…How could this have happened?…The answer will be with the ancients…Someone else is here, I know it…"

name: Time Collapsing
flavor: Alejandro’s former critic stands atop the steps of the main temple, her true self revealed to you. Silver streaks of lightning wind through her open arms. Coiled about her feet is an army of hissing cobras. "Only the chosen can find the Nexus! Only I am worthy!"

name: Crossing the Threshold
text: Objective - After the first [[Tenochtitlán]] location enters play by exploring successfully, advance.
flavor:
As you depart the hotel, you realize that the landscape of the city has been altered. Silver lightning crackles in the sky overhead, and the earth rumbles deep below your feet. Monstrous, polypous entities float just below the clouds. "What is going on?" you yell to Ichtaca over the whistling wind. "What is this place?"
"One future," she replies enigmatically.

name: Past and Present
text: Objective - Find paths to the Nexus by discovering all of the clues from as many different [[Tenochtitlán]] locations as you can before time runs out. If there are 6 [[Tenochtitlán]] locations in play with no clues on them, advance.
flavor: Is this real, or a vision? Either way, the secrets of the ancients may hold the key to finding the Nexus of N’kai…

name: The Return Trip
text: Objective - If Padma Amrita is defeated, advance. Objective - If investigators in Templo Mayor spend the requisite number of clues, advance.
flavor: Ichtaca points to the temple in the distance, shouting over the raging storm. "It was her! She is the one trapping us here; she’s known all along!" One way or another, if you want to get back home, you’ll have to slip through the rift Padma entered from.

name: Temple Ruins
text: [action] [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.

name: Metropolitan Cathedral
text: [action] Take 1 horror: Draw 2 cards. [action] If you have 6 or more cards in your hand: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.

name: Chapultepec Park
text: Forced - After you fail a [willpower] test while at Chapultepec Park: Take 1 horror. [action]: Explore. Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.

name: Zócalo
text: [action] Discard cards with a total combined cost of at least 5 from your hand: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.

name: Xochimilco
text: While you are at Xochimilco, you cannot gain resources. [action] Spend 3 resources: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.

name: Coyoacán
text: [action] Take 1 damage or 1 horror: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.

name: Templo Mayor
text: Forced - After Templo Mayor enters play: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Serpent]] enemy is discarded. Spawn that enemy here. [reaction] After you defeat or evade a [[Serpent]] enemy at this location: Discover 1 clue at this location. (Group limit once per phase.)

name: Templo Mayor
text: Forced - After Templo Mayor enters play: Shuffle your discard pile into your deck. Discard cards from the top of your deck until a weakness is discarded. Draw that weakness. [action] Shuffle a weakness from your discard pile into your deck: Discover 2 clues at this location. (Group limit once per round.)

name: Temples of Tenochtitlán
text: Forced - After Temples of Tenochtitlán enters play: Each investigator at this location takes 1 direct damage. While you are investigating Temples of Tenochtitlán, if you have 3 or fewer remaining health, Temples of Tenochtitlán gets -2 shroud.

name: Temples of Tenochtitlán
text: Forced - After Temples of Tenochtitlán enters play: Place 1 doom on the nearest enemy. [action] Place 1 doom on an enemy: Discover 2 clues at this location. (Group limit once per round.)

name: Chapultepec Hill
text: Forced - After Chapultepec Hill enters play: Each investigator at this location discards 2 random cards from his or her hand. [action] Discard your hand of at least 3 cards: Discover 2 clues at this location. (Group limit once per round.)

name: Chapultepec Hill
text:
Each investigator at Chapultepec Hill gets -2 [willpower].
[reaction] After you draw a [[Hex]] card: Discover 1 clue at this location. (Group limit once per phase.)

name: Canals of Tenochtitlán
text:
Each enemy at Canals of Tenochtitlán gets +2 evade.
While there is an exhausted enemy at Canals of Tenochtitlán, it gets -3 shroud.

name: Canals of Tenochtitlán
text: Forced - After Canals of Tenochtitlán enters play: Place 4 resources on it. Canals of Tenochtitlán gets +1 shroud for each resource on it. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 resource from Canals of Tenochtitlán.

name: Lake Xochimilco
text: Forced - After Lake Xochimilco enters play: Each investigator at this location loses all of his or her remaining actions. While you are investigating Lake Xochimilco, it gets +2 shroud for each action you have remaining.

name: Lake Xochimilco
text: Forced - After Lake Xochimilco enters play: Each investigator at this location takes 1 direct horror. While you are investigating Lake Xochimilco, if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity, Lake Xochimilco gets -2 shroud.

name: Sacred Woods
text: Forced - After Sacred Woods enters play: Each investigator at this location discards the top 10 cards of his or her deck. [action] If you have no cards remaining in your deck: Discover all of the clues at Sacred Woods.

name: Sacred Woods
text:
While you are at Sacred Woods, increase the cost of each card you play by 2.
While you are investigating Sacred Woods, it gets -1 shroud for each asset you control.

name: Padma Amrita
text: Alert. Retaliate. Hunter. While Padma Amrita is ready, clues cannot be discovered from each [[Ancient]] location. Forced - After Padma Amrita attacks you: If you have at least 1 clue, flip 1 of your clues to its doom side. Otherwise, take 3 horror.

name: Serpent of Tenochtitlán
text: While Serpent of Tenochtitlán is at an [[Ancient]] location with clues on it, it gains retaliate and alert. Otherwise, it gains hunter. Forced - After Serpent of Tenochtitlán deals you damage from its attack: If you are not poisoned, put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area.

name: Hand of the Brotherhood
text: Spawn - Any empty location. Forced - After the last clue is discovered from an [[Ancient]] location, if Hand of the Brotherhood is ready: Place 1 doom on Hand of the Brotherhood. While Hand of the Brotherhood is ready, [action] and [reaction] abilities on its location and connecting locations cannot be triggered.

name: Window to Another Time
text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Choose and shuffle an [[Ancient]] location back into the exploration deck (the [[Present-Day]] location underneath it takes its place). - Place 1 doom on the current agenda (this effect can cause the current agenda to advance).

name: Timeline Destabilization
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (1). This test gets +1 difficulty for each [[Ancient]] location in play. If you fail, take 1 damage and 1 horror, and shuffle Timeline Destabilization into the exploration deck.
flavor: As the threads pull, the weave unravels

name: Relic of Ages
text: [fast] Exhaust Relic of Ages: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (4). If you succeed, remove 1 doom from the current agenda. If you fail, add 1 doom to Relic of Ages. (Max one success per game.)
flavor: The device throbs with power in your hands, and the air shimmers around its frame. Can such a device really alter the flow of time?

name: Vantage Point
text:
Fast. Play after a location enters play or is revealed during an investigator's turn.
Until the end of the active investigator's turn, that location gets -1 shroud. You may move 1 clue to that location from any other location.

name: Borrowed Time
text: Exceptional. [action]: Place 1 resource on Borrowed Time, as a click (to a maximum of 3 clicks on Borrowed Time). Does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Forced - When your turn begins: Remove all clicks from Borrowed Time. You may take that many additional actions this turn.

name: Alter Fate
text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] player window.
Choose and discard from play a non-weakness treachery that is not attached to an [[Elite]] enemy.
flavor: We make our own fate.

name: Intrepid
text: If this skill test is successful, add Intrepid to your play area as an asset with the text: "You get +1 [intellect], +1 [combat], and +1 [agility]. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Intrepid."

name: Otherworldly Compass
text: [action] Exhaust Otherworldly Compass: Investigate. Your location gets -X shroud for this investigation. X is the number of revealed locations connected to your location.
flavor: It always points where you don't want to go.

name: Expose Weakness
text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] player window.
Choose an enemy at your location. Test [intellect] (X), where X is that enemy's fight value. If you succeed, treat that enemy's fight value as if it were 0 for the next attack performed against it this phase. Draw 1 card.

name: Defiance
text: Ignore the effects of all [skull], [cultist], [tablet], and [elder_thing] symbols during this test (including their modifiers).
flavor: "No."

name: Premonition
text: Fast. Play during any [fast] player window. Put Premonition into play, reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag, and seal it on Premonition. Forced - When a chaos token would be revealed from the chaos bag: Resolve the token sealed here as if it were just revealed from the chaos bag, instead. Then, discard Premonition.

name: Live and Learn
text: Fast. Play after a skill test you failed ends (after resolving all effects from the failed test). Attempt that test again. You get +2 skill value for this test.

name: Take Heart
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
You may commit Take Heart to any type of test.
If this test fails, the performing investigator draws 2 cards and gains 2 resources.

name: Trench Coat
text: You get +1 [agility] during evasion attempts.
flavor:
Roland loosened his tie, tilted his hat, and turned up his coat collar, and when he was sure he looked respectably disreputable, he approached the door.
- Graeme Davis, <u>The Dirge of Reason</u>

name: Ornate Bow
text: Uses (1 ammo). Limit 1 ammo on Ornate Bow. [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. This attack uses [agility] instead of [combat]. You get +2 [agility] and deal +2 damage for this attack. [action]: You nock another arrow. Place 1 ammo on Ornate Bow.

name: M1918 BAR
text: Uses (8 ammo). [action] Spend 1-5 ammo: Fight. You get +X [combat] for this attack. Instead of its standard damage, this attack deals X damage. X is the amount of ammo spent as part of this ability's cost.

name: Ancient Stone
text:
Researched. Uses (X secrets). X is the number in parentheses next to "you have identified the stone."
[reaction] When you draw any number of cards, spend that many secrets: Deal that much damage to an enemy at your location.

name: Ancient Stone
text:
Researched. Uses (X secrets). X is the number in parentheses next to "you have identified the stone."
[reaction] When you draw any number of cards, spend that many secrets: Heal that much horror from a card at your location.

name: Pay Day
text: Gain 1 resource for each action you performed this turn (including this one). If it is your turn, end your turn.

name: Sacrifice
text: Discard a [mystic] asset you control. Then, draw 3 cards or gain 3 resources, or any combination thereof.
flavor: The first step is the hardest.

name: On Your Own
text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
Discard On Your Own if you control an asset that takes up an ally slot.
[reaction] When you play a [survivor] event, exhaust On Your Own: Reduce that event's cost by 2.

name: Heart of the Elders
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you are in a [[Cave]] location).
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, place 1 doom on your location.
[tablet]: -2. If you are poisoned, this test automatically fails instead.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, take 1 horror.

name: Mouth of K'n-yan
text: [action]: Resign. "Let's make camp and solve this puzzle tomorrow." [action]: Check your supplies. If you have a compass, look at the top 3 cards of the exploration deck. Place 1 on the bottom and the other 2 on top, in any order.

name: Mouth of K'n-yan
text: [action]: Check your supplies. If you have a map, look at the top 2 cards of the exploration deck. Discard each treachery looked at by this effect. Shuffle the exploration deck.
flavor: Even the enormous size of the cavern entrance pales in comparison with the vastness of the depths below.

name: The Jungle's Heart
text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
flavor: You are deep in the jungle now, surrounded on all sides by the uncharted wilderness. All around you, the rainforest sings, its lyrics found in every chirping insect, every serpent’s hiss, every snapping tree branch.

name: Setting Sun
text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
flavor: The day advances quickly. Through the thick canopy of trees, you can tell that the sun is starting to sink closer to the horizon. To the east, the sky grows dim. Soon the jungle will be covered in darkness, and you will have to stop and make camp for the night.

name: Search for the Pattern
flavor: Six stone pillars surround the entrance to the cavern, each carved with a series of uncanny grooves and hieroglyphs that form an intricate pattern. Touching them causes the grooves to glow brightly, and twisting them causes the patterns to shift and change. Perhaps these patterns match the glyphs found in other regions of the jungle?

name: The Winged Serpent
text: Spawn - Mouth of K'n-yan. Alert. Hunter. Massive. Cannot be defeated. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Forced - After a pillar token is placed on the Mouth of K'n-yan: Exhaust The Winged Serpent. It does not ready during the upkeep phase this round.

name: Opening the Maw
text: [action] Investigators at the Mouth of K'n-yan spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: You solve one piece of the puzzle. Add 1 resource to the Mouth of K'n-yan, as a pillar token. Objective - Solve the puzzle of the six pillars in order to enter K'n-yan. If there are 6 pillar tokens on the Mouth of K'n-yan, advance to act 2b.
flavor: You have discovered that the ruins within the jungle each bear a distinct pattern of glyphs, which match those found on the six pillars. As you turn the pillars to match these patterns, a serpentine creature descends from the clouds…

name: The Lonely Caverns
text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Forced - When this agenda advances: Do not remove doom from each location in play.
flavor: Though much of this cavern system is natural and untouched by humans, you are stunned to find signs of an ancient civilization that once inhabited the area.

name: Eyes in the Dark
text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold.
flavor: Bright-yellow eyes peer at you from all sides as you continue delving deeper into the cavern. The glowing orbs vanish as light is cast on them, reappearing as soon as the darkness returns.

name: Cavern of the Forgotten Age
flavor: The vast underground caverns of K’n-yan are cold and all too quiet. Scattered, forsaken ruins lie undisturbed along your path to the Nexus of N’kai. What happened in this ancient and forgotten place? Were these ruins once occupied by humans? Or by a species far, far older?

name: Descent into Dark
text: Objective - If each surviving investigator is at the Descent to Yoth and there is no doom on it, you may advance.
flavor: The deeper you descend into the cold darkness, the more you feel the crushing weight of the world above, and the dizzying reality of the world further below. You suddenly long for the surface and wonder if you will ever see the sky again.

name: Pitfall
text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Test [agility] (3) to attempt to jump the gap. For each point you fail by, take 1 damage. - Shuffle Pitfall into the exploration deck. You cannot choose this option if Pitfall was drawn from the exploration deck.

name: Poisonous Spores
text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - At the end of the round: Each investigator at the attached location who is poisoned takes 2 horror. Each investigator at the attached location who is not poisoned must put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in his or her threat area, instead. Discard Poisonous Spores.

name: Time-Wracked Woods
text: [action] [action]: Choose a non-[[Elite]] card worth vengeance points in the victory display. Place that card in the encounter discard pile. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: The flora along this path are wildly distorted. Some of the flowers are withered and some are vibrant, but all are alien to you.

name: Stone Altar
text: Forced - After you enter Stone Altar: Reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [elder_sign], [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, lose 1 action. If you cannot, take 1 horror instead.
flavor: Once a ceremonial site, now overgrown and forgotten.

name: Apex Strangleweed
text: Alert. Retaliate. Forced - After Apex Strangleweed makes an attack of opportunity against you: Check your supplies. If you do not have a pocket knife, lose all remaining actions and end your turn.

name: Basilisk
text: Prey - Nearest to the Mouth of K'n-yan. Hunter. Forced - After a pillar token is placed on the Mouth of K'n-yan: Shuffle one copy of Basilisk into the encounter deck. (Max once per round.) Vengeance 2.

name: Ants!
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). For each point you fail by, discard a random card from your hand or choose and discard a card from your play area.
flavor: One ant is a nuisance. A colony is another matter.

name: Vast Passages
text: As an additional cost for you to explore while at Vast Passages, check your supplies. If no investigator at this location has binoculars, you must spend 1 additional action.
flavor:
The scale of these caverns is dizzying.
It is truly a world of its own.

name: Hall of Idolatry
text: Forced - After you put Hall of Idolatry into play by successfully exploring: Check Campaign Log. If there are 5 or more tally marks under "Yig's Fury", draw the top card of the encounter deck (top 2 cards instead if there are 10 or more tally marks).

name: Dark Hollow
text: Forced - After Dark Hollow enters play, check your supplies. If no investigator has a map: Place 1 [per_investigator] additional clues on Dark Hollow.
flavor: The throat of the cavern extends for miles, and you cannot help but feel as though you are descending into the belly of a great beast.

name: Perilous Gulch
text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Perilous Gulch: Check your supplies. If no investigator at this location has rope, place 1 doom on Perilous Gulch.
flavor: Along a dark chasm, the path winds and twists. Serpent statues with rearing heads are poised to strike as you pass.

name: Crystal Pillars
text: Forced - After you enter Crystal Pillars: Test [willpower] (1). This test gets +1 difficulty for each vengeance point in the victory display. If you fail, take 1 damage and 1 horror.
flavor: Enormous white crystals pierce through the tunnel, sending reflections of light across the walls and ceiling.

name: Descent to Yoth
text: Forced - After Descent to Yoth enters play: Each investigator must either place 1 doom on Descent to Yoth or draw the top 2 cards of the encounter deck. [reaction] After you successfully investigate Descent to Yoth: Instead of discovering clues, you may flip 1 doom on Descent to Yoth to its clue side. Vengeance 2.

name: No Turning Back
text: Revelation - Attach No Turning Back to your location or a connecting location. Limit 1 per location. Investigators cannot enter or leave attached location. [action]: Test [combat] (3) or check your supplies. If you succeed, or if you have a pickaxe, discard No Turning Back. Any investigator at a connecting location may activate this ability.

name: The City of Archives
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you have 5 or more cards in your hand).
[cultist] or [elder_thing]: -2. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, discard 1 random card from your hand.

name: City of the Great Race
text: Investigators cannot put [[Item]] assets into play (including [[Item]] weaknesses).
flavor: Somehow you have awoken in a futuristic city, inhabited by odd alien creatures beyond your imagining. You must explore this strange place if you are to find a way out, but your new body is difficult to get used to.

name: Lost Memories
text: Each investigator's maximum hand size is reduced by 2.
flavor: Little by little, the memories of your former life are starting to fade. The most recent events are the first to disappear, but soon you begin to lose your grip on your human identity.

name: Humanity Fading
text: Each investigator's maximum hand size is reduced by 4.
flavor:
How long has it been? Days? Weeks?

…Years?

name: Exploring Pnakotus
text: Each copy of Yithian Observer gains aloof.
flavor: Getting out of this strange city might be harder than you thought. Its halls are endless and filled with all manner of complex, futuristic machinery.

name: Restricted Access
text: Objective - If three of the following are true, you must advance: - An investigator "found the process." - An investigator "dissected an organ." - An investigator "interviewed a subject." - An investigator "realized what year it is." - An investigator "activated the device." - An investigator controls The Custodian.
flavor: You have to find a way back home. Surely if the Yithians can bring you to this place, there must be a way to return…

name: Repossession
text: Each Yithian Observer gains hunter. [action] Spend 1 clue: Draw. Draw 2 cards instead of 1. If your hand exceeds your maximum hand size, draw 1 additional card. Objective - If each surviving investigator has 10 or more cards in his or her hand, immediately advance. (Beware - remember to complete as many of the tasks listed on act 2b as you can.)
flavor: You have gathered the knowledge necessary to repossess your body, but before you can initiate the process, you must expand your mind.

name: Body of a Yithian
text:
Each of your [[Ally]] assets gains the [[Yithian]] trait.
[reaction] After you commit a card to a skill test you are performing: Double the skill icons on that card. (Limit once per test.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Draw 1 card.

name: Interview Room
text: [reaction] After you begin your turn in this location, if there is a [[Yithian]] enemy in this location: Draw 1 card.
flavor: There were colossal round windows and high arched doors, and pedestals or tables each as tall as the height of an ordinary room. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>

name: Interview Room
text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (4) or [combat] (4) to interrogate the captive mind restrained here. If you succeed, remember that you "interviewed a subject." If you fail, take 2 horror.

name: Interview Room
text: Forced - After you enter this location: Test [willpower] (3). Take 1 horror for each point you fail by.
flavor: An unidentifiable ooze covers the large table near the center of the chamber. The remains of a failed experiment? Or something far worse?

name: Halls of Pnakotus
text: [fast] During your turn, choose and discard a card from your hand: Move to another copy of Halls of Pnakotus. (Limit once per turn.)
flavor: Later I had visions of sweeping through Cyclopean corridors of stone, and up and down gigantic inclined planes of the same monstrous masonry. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>

name: Halls of Pnakotus
text: [fast] During your turn, choose and discard a card from your hand: Move to another copy of Halls of Pnakotus. (Limit once per turn.)
flavor: Later I had visions of sweeping through Cyclopean corridors of stone, and up and down gigantic inclined planes of the same monstrous masonry. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>

name: Halls of Pnakotus
text: [fast] During your turn, choose and discard a card from your hand: Move to another copy of Halls of Pnakotus. (Limit once per turn.)
flavor: Later I had visions of sweeping through Cyclopean corridors of stone, and up and down gigantic inclined planes of the same monstrous masonry. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>

name: Great Library
text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Test [intellect] (3) to decipher the information you've found. If you succeed, remember that you have "found the process." Forced - At the end of the round, if there are fewer than 4 clues on Great Library: Add clues to Great Library until there are 4 clues on it.

name: Yithian Orrery
text:
[action] [action] If there are no clues on Yithian Orrery: Remember that you "realized what year it is."
While you are in the Yithian Orrery, increase your maximum hand size by 2.

name: Laboratory of the Great Race
text: [action] If there are no clues on Laboratory of the Great Race: Test [agility] (3) to manipulate the controls on the technological device nearby. If you succeed, remember that you "activated the device." If you fail, place 1 clue on Laboratory of the Great Race (from the token pool).

name: Deconstruction Room
text: [action]: Test [combat] (4) to attempt to retrieve a valuable organ from one of the alien cadavers. This test gets +1 difficulty for each clue on Deconstruction Room. If you succeed, remember that you "dissected an organ."

name: Towers of Pnakotus
text: [action]: Discard any number of cards from your hand. Shuffle your discard pile into your deck and draw cards equal to 1 more than the number of cards you discarded. (Limit once per turn.)
flavor: The great sandy desert beyond is no escape for you. If you leave, you will never repossess your body.

name: The Custodian
text: [reaction] When the investigation phase begins, if you control The Custodian: Each investigator at its location draws 1 card. [action] If The Custodian is not controlled by a player: Parley. Test [intellect] (3) to converse with the library custodian. If you succeed, something about its mannerisms seems familiar to you; place 1 of your clues on it. Then, if there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on it, take control of The Custodian.

name: Keeper of the Great Library
text: Spawn - Great Library. Alert. Aloof. If an investigator has "found the process" or "realized what year it is," Keeper of the Great Library loses aloof and gains hunter.

name: Scientist of Yith
text: Spawn - Laboratory of the Great Race. Aloof. If an investigator has "activated the device" or "dissected an organ," Scientist of Yith loses aloof and gains hunter.

name: Scholar from Yith
text: Prey - Most cards in hand. Forced - When Scholar from Yith attacks you: Discard 2 random cards from your hand. [action] If Scholar from Yith is ready and engaged with you: Parley. Test [intellect] (3) to attempt to pass as a member of the creature's race. If you succeed, draw 1 card and evade Scholar from Yith. If you fail, Scholar from Yith attacks you.

name: Yithian Presence
text: Revelation - Put Yithian Presence into play in your threat area. If there is a [[Yithian]] enemy at your location, you cannot investigate that location or trigger [action] abilities on encounter cards (including this card). [action] Choose and discard 2 cards from your hand: Discard Yithian Presence.

name: Cruel Interrogations
text: Revelation - Put Cruel Interrogations into play in your threat area. If any investigator has "interviewed a subject," take 1 horror and Cruel Interrogations gains surge. You cannot take draw actions. [action]: Test [willpower] (2). If you succeed, discard Cruel Interrogations.

name: Lost Humanity
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). For each point you fail by, remove the top card of your deck from the game. If there are less than 10 total cards in your hand, deck and discard pile, you are driven insane.
flavor: All memories that could be eradicated were eradicated, so that in most cases only a dream-shadowed blank stretched back to the time of the first exchange. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>

name: Captive Mind
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (0). Regardless of whether this skill test succeeds or fails, choose and discard all but X cards from your hand. X is your modified skill value for this test.
flavor: It was not a kidnapping, but an exchange.

name: Out of Body Experience
text: Revelation - Shuffle each card from your hand into your deck and draw an equal number of cards. Shuffle Out of Body Experience into your deck.
flavor: My head was aching, and I had a singular feeling - altogether new to me - that someone else was trying to get possession of my thoughts. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow Out of Time</u>

name: Handcuffs
text: [action] If Handcuffs is not attached to an enemy: Evade. Use only on a [[Humanoid]] enemy. This evasion attempt uses [combat] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, attach Handcuffs to the just-evaded enemy. If the attached enemy is non-[[Elite]], it cannot ready and doom cannot be placed on it.

name: Blood Eclipse
text: As an additional cost to play Blood Eclipse, take up to 3 damage. Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. You get +1 [willpower] and deal +1 damage for this attack for each damage taken as part of this card's cost.

name: Feed the Mind
text:
Uses (3 secrets).
[action] Exhaust Feed the Mind and spend 1 secret: Test [intellect] (0). For each point you succeed by, draw 1 card. Then, take 1 horror for each card in your hand in excess of your maximum hand size.

name: Colt Vest Pocket
text: Uses (5 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Colt Vest Pocket.

name: Coup de Grâce
text: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. If this effect defeats that enemy, draw 1 card. If it is your turn, end your turn. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
flavor:
Two bullets cracked open the creature’s skull.
Then another. Then another. Then another.

name: Winging It
text: You may play Winging It from your discard pile. If you do, shuffle it into your deck after resolving its effects. Investigate. Your location gets -1 shroud for this investigation. (If you played Winging It from your discard pile, discover 1 additional clue if you succeed.)

name: Old Hunting Rifle
text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +3 [combat] and deal +2 damage for this attack. If a [skull] or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this attack, the rifle jams. (This attack automatically fails. Before you can activate this ability again, you must perform the following ability: "[action]: You clear the jam.")

name: Thermos
text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply, exhaust Thermos: Heal 1 damage from an investigator at your location (2 damage instead if he or she has 2 or more physical trauma).
[action] Spend 1 supply, exhaust Thermos: Heal 1 horror from an investigator at your location (2 horror instead if he or she has 2 or more mental trauma).

name: Hemispheric Map
text:
While your current location is connected to at least 2 other locations, you get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
While your current location is connected to at least 4 other locations, you get an additional +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].

name: Timeworn Brand
text: [action] If Timeworn Brand is ready: Fight. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. [action] Exhaust Timeworn Brand: Fight. Add your [willpower] to your skill value for this attack. This attack deals +3 damage. If this attack defeats an [[Elite]] enemy, draw 3 cards. (Max once per game.)

name: The Depths of Yoth
text: Easy / Standard [skull]: -X. X is the current depth level. [cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, each [[Serpent]] enemy at your location or a connecting location heals 2 damage. [tablet]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 clue on your location (from the token pool). [elder_thing]: -2. If there are 3 or more vengeance points in the victory display, you automatically fail this test, instead.

name: The Descent Begins
flavor: Slowly and cautiously, you begin your descent into the red-litten caverns of Yoth. It is quiet, and only the crumbling of stone and your echoing footfalls can be heard in the tunnels surrounding you.

name: Horrific Descent
flavor: Hisses begin to emanate from the tunnels all around you. Snake eyes glare at you from the dark as you attempt to avoid encountering the creatures that remain in this realm. You weave in and out of narrow tunnels and hide behind broken‑down walls and crumbling pillars.

name: Endless Caverns
flavor: You are convinced of it now: these caverns are without end. They must span the entirety of the subterranean layer of the Earth. Will you ever reach the Nexus? Will you ever make it home?

name: City of Blood
flavor: The caverns are no longer quiet. The angry cries and rattling of serpent creatures is all around you now, urging you onward. The cavern’s unnatural red glow becomes more intense. In this red light, the cities of Yoth take on another guise - no longer a source of hidden knowledge, but a place of animosity that resents your mere presence.

name: Fury That Shakes the Earth
text: Forced - After the third doom is placed on this agenda: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
flavor: The serpents have stirred up something much larger and more deadly than anything you have faced on this journey. Pale, sweaty, and terrified, you scurry for an exit - any exit.

name: The Red Depths
text: Forced - After any amount of doom is placed on this agenda: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
flavor: The deeper your descent, the brighter and more pervasive the red glow of the caverns becomes. If you didn’t know any better, you would think you were descending into the very depths of hell itself.

name: VENGEANCE
text: Forced - At the end of the 'check doom threshold' step of the mythos phase: The investigators must draw 1 additional encounter card for each doom in play, in player order. Objective - If each investigator is defeated, advance this agenda.
flavor: You never should have come here.

name: Journey to the Nexus
text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - At the end of the round, if investigators at Steps of Yoth possess the requisite number of clues, they may advance. (Beware - any investigator who is not at Steps of Yoth will be defeated.)
flavor: Doubt and horror grew upon me as I wound still farther down the seemingly endless staircase. Would the thing never stop?- H. P. Lovecraft and Zealia Bishop, <u>The Mound</u>

name: Steps of Yoth
text: [reaction] When adding to the current depth level, if investigators at Steps of Yoth possess 5 [per_investigator] clues as a group, an investigator at Steps of Yoth crosses rope off from his or her supplies: Add 1 additional resource to the current depth level. (Max once per game.)
flavor: A twisting passage over the chasm leads to a set of narrow, steep steps bathed in the red glow of the depths farther below.

name: City of the Serpents
text: While City of the Serpents has no clues on it, it is considered to be in the victory display (for the purposes of counting vengeance).
flavor: This much was known from the very few manuscripts and carvings found in the vaults of Zin, beneath the largest ruined city of Yoth.- H. P. Lovecraft and Zealia Bishop, <u>The Mound</u>

name: Hall of Heresy
text: While an investigator is in Hall of Heresy, it is considered to be in the victory display (for the purposes of counting vengeance).
flavor: It had been built in imitation of certain temples depicted in the vaults of Zin, to house a very terrible black toad-idol… - H. P. Lovecraft and Zealia Bishop, <u>The Mound</u>

name: Crumbling Precipice
text: Forced - When you attempt to explore while at Crumbling Precipice: Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, test [agility] (3). If you fail, test [combat] (2). If you fail, you fall to your death and are killed. (If you succeed at any of these tests, you explore as usual.)
flavor: One false step…

name: Caverns of Yoth
text: Forced - After Caverns of Yoth enters play: Place clues on it equal to the current depth level.
flavor: They - or their principal ancestral element - had first been found in a wild state amidst the Cyclopean ruins of the deserted red-litten world of Yoth which lay below the blue-litten world of K’n-yan. - H. P. Lovecraft and Zealia Bishop, <u>The Mound</u>

name: Forked Path
text: Forced - When you explore while at Forked Path, check your supplies. If you have a map: Continue drawing cards from the exploration deck until you have drawn 2 connecting locations, if able. Put both of those locations into play and choose 1 to move to.

name: Bridge over N'kai
text: Bridge over N'kai gets +1 shroud for each vengeance point in the victory display.
flavor: One other thing which endangered Zamacona’s status in Tsath was his persistent curiosity regarding the ultimate abyss of N’kai, beneath red-litten Yoth… - H. P. Lovecraft and Zealia Bishop, <u>The Mound</u>

name: Broken Passage
text: Forced - When you explore while at Broken Passage, check your supplies. If you do not have a pickaxe: Place 1 doom on Broken Passage.
flavor: The subterraneous approaches to K’n-yan, or such as could be remembered, were either blocked up or carefully guarded; and all encroachers were treated as dangerous spies and enemies. - H. P. Lovecraft and Zealia Bishop, <u>The Mound</u>

name: Abandoned Site
text: X is the current depth level.
flavor: Formerly several races of them had inhabited the entire underground world, which stretched down to unfathomable abysses and which included besides the blue-litten region a red-litten region called Yoth, where relics of a still older and non-human race were found by archaeologists. - H. P. Lovecraft and Zealia Bishop, <u>The Mound</u>

name: Bright Canyon
text: Forced - After you enter Bright Canyon, if you are poisoned: Take 1 damage. [action]: Check your supplies. If you have binoculars, discover 2 clues on Bright Canyon. (Group limit once each depth level.)

name: Yig
text:
Hunter. Massive.
Yig gets +6 [per_investigator] health.
Yig cannot be damaged while there is another ready [[Serpent]] enemy at its location.
Each other [[Serpent]] enemy at Yig's location gains alert and retaliate.

name: Pit Warden
text: Spawn - If Yig is in play, spawn Pit Warden at Yig's location. Otherwise, place Pit Warden in the pursuit area. Hunter.

name: Eater of the Depths
text: Spawn - Put a random set-aside location into play and spawn Eater of the Depths there. Hunter. Massive. X is the current depth level.

name: Children of Valusia
text: Revelation - Put Children of Valusia into play next to the agenda deck. Each [[Serpent]] enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Children of Valusia from play. (Max once per round.)

name: Lightless Shadow
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (1). This test gets +X difficulty, where X is the current depth level. If you fail, take 2 damage.
flavor: There is something in the black realm below. Something sealed away. Something worse than everything you have seen thus far, something that fills even the serpent creatures with unbridled terror.

name: Bathophobia
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (1). This test gets +X difficulty, where X is the current depth level. If you fail, take 2 horror.
