text: Forced - After you move to Narrow Ridge from a location below it: Take 1 horror.
flavor: "...before noon we all felt a thrill of excitement at beholding a vast, lofty, and snow-clad mountain chain which opened out and covered the whole vista ahead." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

name: Rocky Ledge
text: Forced - After you move to Rocky Ledge from a location below it: Shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it.
flavor: "They had crossed the icy peaks on whose templed slopes they had once worshipped and roamed among the tree-ferns." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

name: Snow-Covered Crag
text: Forced - After you move to Snow-Covered Crag from a location below it: Exhaust each asset you control.
flavor: "The distribution of cryptical cave-mouths on the black snow-denuded summits seemed roughly even...." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

name: Windswept Path
text: Forced - After Windswept Path is revealed: If it is at level 0, place 1 [per_investigator] clues on it (from the token pool). Forced - After you move to Windswept Path from a location below it: Place 1 clue on it (from the token pool).

name: The Summit
text: Clues on The Summit can only be discovered by investigating. Forced - When The Summit is revealed: Add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag. [action]: Resign. Add each [[Expedition]] asset you control to the victory display. Return all of your clues to the token pool.

name: Terror of the Stars
text: Hunter. Massive. Terror of the Stars gets +3 [per_investigator] health. X is the level of your location (to a minimum of 1). Forced - At the end of the round: Move all investigators at Terror of the Stars's location to the location directly below it.

name: Constricting Elder Thing
text:
Hunter.
X is the level of your location (to a minimum of 1).
While Constricting Elder Thing is engaged with you, you cannot move to locations above your location.

name: Snowfall
text: Revelation - Place 2 clues on your location (from the token pool).
flavor: "...the still lower horizon-grazing southern sun of midnight poured its hazy reddish rays over the white snow, bluish ice and water lanes, and black bits of exposed granite slope." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

name: Avalanche
text: Revelation - If the level of your location is 1-4, move to the location directly below you. Then test [willpower] (X). X is the level of your location. If you fail, repeat this process. If you did not move by this effect, Avalanche gains surge.

name: Hanging on the Edge
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, take 2 damage, lose control of each [[Expedition]] asset you control (placing it at your location), and move to the location directly below you.

name: Hypothermia
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If the level of your location is 4 or 5, reveal 1 additional chaos token for this skill test. If you fail, either add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag, or take 1 horror for each point you failed by.

name: City of the Elder Things
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of keys you control.
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, place a key you control on your location.
[tablet]: -3. If a [frost] token was revealed during this test, you automatically fail, instead.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, the nearest enemy moves once toward you. If it is engaged with you, it attacks.

name: Lurking Horrors
text:
[fast] During your turn, spend 1 clue: Look at the revealed side of a City Landscape in your column or row. (Limit once per round.)
[fast] During your turn, spend 3 clues: Move to any location in your column or row. (Limit once per round.)
flavor: The hidden alien city looms before you, ancient and enigmatic. What secrets - and terrors - lie in wait within?

name: Doom from Below
text:
[fast] During your turn, spend 1 clue: Look at the revealed side of a City Landscape in your column or row. (Limit once per round.)
[fast] During your turn, spend 3 clues: Move to any location in your column or row. (Limit once per round.)
flavor: Below the darkened ice, more of the city lies trapped, encased and frozen in time. This is but the tip of the iceberg...

name: Sprawling City (v. I)
text: [action] Spend two [elder_thing] keys: Remember that the team "studied the history of the Elder Things." [action] Spend two [tablet] keys: Remember that the team "discerned the origin of the Shoggoths." Objective - If the team has "studied the history of the Elder Things" and "discerned the origin of the Shoggoths," advance.
flavor: This is the discovery of a lifetime. Dyer's report was true - all of it. You must explore this alien civilization in order to learn more...

name: Sprawling City (v. II)
text: [action] Spend two [elder_thing] keys: Remember that the team "studied the history of the Elder Things." [action] Spend two [cultist] keys: Remember that the team "discovered a hidden power." Objective - If the team has "studied the history of the Elder Things" and "discovered a hidden power," advance.
flavor: This is the discovery of a lifetime. Dyer's report was true - all of it. You must explore this alien civilization in order to learn more...

name: Sprawling City (v. III)
text: [action] Spend two [tablet] keys: Remember that the team "discerned the origin of the Shoggoths." [action] Spend two [cultist] keys: Remember that the team "discovered a hidden power." Objective - If the team has "discerned the origin of the Shoggoths" and "discovered a hidden power," advance.
flavor: This is the discovery of a lifetime. Dyer's report was true - all of it. You must explore this alien civilization in order to learn more...

name: Pursuit of the Unknown (v. I)
text: [action] Spend two [cultist] keys: Each investigator may heal 1 damage, 1 horror, and 1 trauma. Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at the Hidden Tunnel and it has no clues, advance.
flavor: Somewhere in this sprawling web of icy streets and cyclopean structures lies an ancient gateway leading to the undercity beneath the great mountain. You'll have to find it if you wish to learn more...

name: Pursuit of the Unknown (v. II)
text: [action] Spend two [tablet] keys: Each investigator searches their deck for each Tekeli-li weakness, shuffles each of them into the Tekeli-li deck, then shuffles their deck. Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at the Hidden Tunnel and it has no clues, advance.
flavor: Somewhere in this sprawling web of icy streets and cyclopean structures lies an ancient gateway leading to the undercity beneath the great mountain. You'll have to find it if you wish to learn more...

name: Pursuit of the Unknown (v. III)
text: Forced - When a [[Shoggoth]] or [[Elite]] enemy enters a location: Defeat each [[Elder Thing]] enemy at that location. [action] Spend two [elder_thing] keys: Remove each [elder_thing] token from the chaos bag. Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at the Hidden Tunnel and it has no clues, advance.
flavor: Somewhere in this sprawling web of icy streets and cyclopean structures lies an ancient gateway leading to the undercity beneath the great mountain. You'll have to find it if you wish to learn more...

name: Hidden Tunnel
text:
Clues on Hidden Tunnel cannot be discovered or moved to other locations.
[action]: Test a skill of your choice (4). You may spend a [skull] key to get +5 skill value for this test. If you succeed, return 1 clue on Hidden Tunnel to the token pool (2 clues instead if you spent a [skull] key).

name: Ancient Planetarium
text: [action] Spend two "0" keys: Add one of the spent "0" keys to the chaos bag (as a chaos token) for the remainder of the campaign. Record in the Campaign Log the team photographed the astronomical charts.

name: Stone Bridge
text:
[action]: Test [combat] (4) or [agility] (4). If you succeed, discover 1 clue from Stone Bridge.
[action]: Move to another Stone Bridge location.
flavor: "All of these febrile structures seemed knit together by tubular bridges crossing from one to the other at various dizzy heights..." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

name: Cylindrical Tower
text: [action] Spend two "-2" keys: Draw 2 cards, gain 2 resources, and remove 2 [frost] tokens from the chaos bag. Record in the Campaign Log the team studied the mural carvings.

name: Labyrinthine Chamber
text: Each time a chaos token is revealed during a skill test at this location, double its modifier if a key matching that chaos token is on this location or under the control of an investigator at this location.

name: Map Room
text: [action] Spend two "-3" keys: Choose 3 locations other than Hidden Tunnel and reveal them. Discover 1 clue from each of these locations. Record in the Campaign Log the team read the map.

name: Roofless Rampart
text: [action] Spend two "-1" keys: Either remove 1 doom from the agenda, or choose and discard from play 1 non-[[Elite]] enemy or treachery. Record in the Campaign Log the team discovered an ancient vault.
flavor: "...farther on there was a huge roofless rampart still complete in its gigantic five-pointed outline..." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

name: Ruinous Streets
text: Forced - After you reveal 1 or more [frost] tokens during a skill test at Ruinous Streets: Take 1 damage. [reaction] After you discover the last clue from Ruinous Streets: Discover 1 clue on a connecting location.

name: Cyclopean Spires
text: [action]: Move 1 key on another location in this row to Cyclopean Spires. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: "There were composite cones and pyramids either alone or surmounting cylinders or cubes or flatter truncated cones and pyramids, and occasional needle-like spires in curious clusters..." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

name: Submerged Passageway
text: [action]: Move 1 clue from this location to an unrevealed location in this column or row.
flavor: "Had the coming of the ice been foreseen, and had a nameless population left en masse to seek a less doomed abode?" - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

name: Temple of the Elder Things
text: Forced - After you reveal 1 or more [frost] tokens during a skill test at this location: Take 1 horror. [action] If there are no clues on Temple of the Elder Things: Choose 2 locations with keys on them. Swap each key on those locations. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Terror of the Stars
text:
Hunter. Massive.
Terror of the Stars gets +3 [per_investigator] health.
While Terror of the Stars is ready, investigators at its location cannot spend or take control of keys.

name: Benign Elder Thing
text: Spawn - Any empty location. Benign Elder Thing enters play with 1 doom on it. Forced - When Benign Elder Thing is defeated: Place 1 doom on the agenda. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, remove Benign Elder Thing from the game.

name: Reawakened Elder Thing
text: Hunter. Forced - When this enemy engages you: Place a key you control on it. When it leaves play, place that key on its location. Forced - When an investigator at this enemy's location takes control of a key: This enemy readies, engages, and attacks them.

name: Dawning of the Truth
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). Increase the difficulty of this test by 1 for each key on your location or under your control. If you fail, take 2 horror (3 horror instead if you fail by 3 or more).

name: Crumbling Ruins
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). During this test, if you reveal a chaos token that matches a key on your location or under the control of an investigator at your location, you automatically fail. For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.

name: The Heart of Madness
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if there is an [[Ancient One]] enemy at your location).
[cultist]: -1. If there is a seal at your location, or if your location is a Mist-Pylon, treat this token as a [frost] token, instead.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, draw the top card of the Tekeli-li deck.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail by 3 or more, place 1 doom on the current agenda. This can cause the current agenda to advance.

name: The Gate of Y'quaa
text: [action]: Place an activated seal you control on The Gate of Y'quaa. [action]: Resign. You retreat, hoping you've done enough to seal away whatever lies beyond the gate. (If you control 1 or more seals, you retain control of them.)

name: Geothermal Vent
text: [action] If you control the [seal_a] seal: Test [combat] (3). If you succeed, investigators at Geothermal Vent spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to activate the [seal_a] seal. Then, remove 1 [frost] token from the chaos bag.

name: Forsaken Temple
text: [action] If you control the [seal_c] seal: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, investigators at Forsaken Temple spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to activate the [seal_c] seal. Then, look at the revealed side of each unrevealed location on the same spoke as Forsaken Temple.

name: Library of Kós
text: [action] If you control the [seal_b] seal: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, investigators at Library of Kós spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to activate the [seal_b] seal. Then, look at the revealed side of each unrevealed location on the same ring as Library of Kós.

name: Protoplasmic Pool
text: [action] If you control the [seal_d] seal: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, investigators at Protoplasmic Pool spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to activate the [seal_d] seal. Then, deal 2 damage to each enemy in play.

name: Hall of the Sunless Sea
text: [action] If you control the [seal_e] seal, investigators at Hall of the Sunless Sea spend 1 [per_investigator] clues and discard 2 [per_investigator] cards from their hands, as a group: Activate the [seal_e] seal.

name: Subnautical Sprawl
text: Treat the modifier of the first [frost] token revealed during each skill test at Subnautical Sprawl as -3 instead of -1. (Limit once per round.)

name: Vaulted Corridor
text: [fast]: Choose another Vaulted Corridor and test [agility] (X). X is the number of locations away that Vaulted Corridor is from this one. If you succeed, move there. (Limit once per round.)

name: Primeval Terror
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each location away from The Gate of Y'quaa you are. If you fail, take 2 horror.
flavor: "The sheer appalling antiquity and lethal desolation of the place were enough to overwhelm almost any sensitive person..." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

name: Roots of the Earth
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each location away from The Gate of Y'quaa you are. If you fail, take 2 damage.
flavor: "The things once rearing and dwelling in this frightful masonry in the age of dinosaurs were not indeed dinosaurs, but far worse." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

name: The Beating Heart
text: Forced - If two or more activated seals are controlled by investigators at the same location: The latent energy stored within the seals fuses together, and the ensuing chain reaction sets off an electrostatic detonation that destroys all life on Earth. (→R3)
flavor: Five darkened paths lead away from the gateway, through icy caverns and down vaulted corridors of smooth black stone. Quiet dread fills the ancient, dormant structure.

name: The Miasma Beckons
text: Forced - If two or more activated seals are controlled by investigators at the same location: The latent energy stored within the seals fuses together, and the ensuing chain reaction sets off an electrostatic detonation that destroys all life on Earth. (→R3)
flavor: Eldritch whispers and the dribbling of inky miasma permeates the once-silent ruins. Something is reaching out to you from within its walls. Calling to you.

name: Call of Madness
text: Forced - If two or more activated seals are controlled by investigators at the same location: The latent energy stored within the seals fuses together, and the ensuing chain reaction sets off an electrostatic detonation that destroys all life on Earth. (→R3)
flavor: The gateway stirs. Whatever is calling to you from within these walls, it hears your every word, your every footstep. It knows of your presence, of your hopes, of your fears. And it yearns to be free.

name: Dormancy
text: Objective - If an activated seal is placed on The Gate of Y'quaa, advance.
flavor: You have decided to explore the rest of this antediluvian complex in order to find the devices that fit this strange doorway.

name: The Great Seal
text: Objective - Place as many activated seals as you can on The Gate of Y'quaa before whatever is inside escapes. If all five seals have been placed, advance.
flavor: Placing the first of the five seals has awoken a strange power within the facility. You believe if you can find and activate the remaining seals, they will aid in containing the thing that dwells on the other side of this gate...

name: Glacial Grotto
text: Forced - After Glacial Grotto is revealed: Place the dormant [seal_a] seal on it. [action]: Test [combat] (2) to shatter the ice. If you succeed, investigators at Glacial Grotto may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, for you to take control of the seal on it.

name: Sculptured Crypt
text: Forced - After Sculptured Crypt is revealed: Place the dormant [seal_b] seal on it. [action]: Test [intellect] (2) to decipher the alien script. If you succeed, investigators at Sculptured Crypt may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, for you to take control of the seal on it.

name: Undercity Altar
text: Forced - After Undercity Altar is revealed: Place the dormant [seal_c] seal on it. [action]: Test [willpower] (2) to break the ancient ward. If you succeed, investigators at Undercity Altar may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, for you to take control of the seal on it.

name: Ichor-Laden Tunnels
text: Forced - After Ichor-Laden Tunnels is revealed: Place the dormant [seal_d] seal on it. [action]: Test [agility] (2) to traverse the ichor. If you succeed, investigators at Ichor-Laden Tunnels may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, for you to take control of the seal on it.

name: Limestone Caverns
text: Forced - After Limestone Caverns is revealed: Place the dormant [seal_e] seal on it. [action] Investigators at Limestone Caverns spend 1 [per_investigator] clues and 3 [per_investigator] resources, as a group: Take control of the seal on Limestone Caverns.

name: Protoplasmic Mass
text: Hunter. Spawn - Location farthest from you on the outer ring. Prey - Nearest investigator with a seal only. Forced - When the enemy phase ends, if an investigator controls an activated seal: Protoplasmic Mass readies and resolves the enemy phase again (it resolves its hunter keyword and attacks a second time). (Limit once per phase.)

name: Electrostatic Discharge
text: Surge. Revelation - Each investigator at the same location as a seal takes 1 horror, and 1 damage if that seal is activated

name: The Seal Weakens
flavor: Miasma has completely consumed this part of the facility. The walls and ceiling drip with polychromatic ooze, polar mist swirls through the halls, and the air shimmers with the insubstantial quality of a mirage. What manner of power is this? And how can you possibly hope to destroy it?

name: That Which Has No Name
text: Forced - When 1 or more doom would be put into play, if there are any copies of The Nameless Madness still set aside: Instead, spawn 1 set-aside copy of The Nameless Madness at the location nearest to an investigator without a copy of that enemy that is connected to a location with a copy of that enemy. Objective - At the end of the round, if all 15 copies of The Nameless Madness are in play and not every Mist-Pylon is collapsed, advance this agenda.
flavor: Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li!

name: Collapse the Pylons
text: Each revealed Mist-Pylon can be attacked as if it were an enemy. Its fight value is equal to its shroud value and its health is equal to its clue value. While it has no health remaining, it is collapsed (it remains in play). [reaction] When you discover 1 or more clues at a Mist-Pylon, spend those clues: Deal that much damage to that Mist-Pylon. Objective - At the end of the round, if each Mist-Pylon is collapsed, advance this act.
flavor: Five pylons hold this facility together. Your only hope is to destroy them - and everything else.

name: Mist-Pylon
text: [fast] If you control the [seal_a] seal, and it is activated: You unleash the seal's power. Place the [seal_a] seal on this Mist-Pylon. For the remainder of the game, each time you deal damage to a Mist-Pylon, deal 1 additional damage.

name: Mist-Pylon
text: [fast] If you control the [seal_b] seal, and it is activated: You unleash the seal's power. Place the [seal_b] seal on this Mist-Pylon. For the remainder of the game, reduce the shroud value of each Mist-Pylon by 2.

name: Mist-Pylon
text: [fast] If you control the [seal_c] seal, and it is activated: You unleash the seal's power. Place the [seal_c] seal on this Mist-Pylon. For the remainder of the game, each investigator gets +1 to each of their skills while they are at a Mist-Pylon.

name: Mist-Pylon
text: [fast] If you control the [seal_d] seal, and it is activated: You unleash the seal's power. Place the [seal_d] seal on this Mist-Pylon. For the remainder of the game, whenever an investigator at a Mist-Pylon would be dealt 1 or more damage and/or horror, cancel 1 of that damage or horror.

name: Mist-Pylon
text: [fast] If you control the [seal_e] seal, and it is activated: You unleash the seal's power. Place the [seal_e] seal on this Mist-Pylon. For the remainder of the game, each enemy gets -2 fight and -2 evade while it is at a Mist-Pylon.

name: The Nameless Madness
text: Alert. Massive. Retaliate. The Nameless Madness cannot take damage. Forced - After you successfully evade or attack The Nameless Madness: For each point you succeeded by, exhaust the nearest ready copy of The Nameless Madness.

name: Unsealed Phantasm
text: Spawn - The nearest Mist-Pylon that is not collapsed (or your location, if there are none in play). While Unsealed Phantasm is ready and at a Mist-Pylon, damage cannot be dealt to that Mist-Pylon. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Unsealed Phantasm is ready: Move it once toward the Mist-Pylon nearest to it that is not collapsed.

name: The Final Mirage
text: The Nameless Madness gains hunter. Forced - When 1 or more doom would be put into play: Instead, spawn 1 set-aside copy of The Nameless Madness at the leftmost investigator's location. Objective - Run.

name: Titanic Ramp
text:
Titanic Ramp is connected to the locations to its left and right.
As an additional cost for you to leave Titanic Ramp, test [agility] (4). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move. Any investigator at your location or a connecting location may spend 1 clue to have you automatically succeed at this test.

name: Titanic Ramp
text:
Titanic Ramp is connected to the locations to its left and right.
As an additional cost for you to leave Titanic Ramp, test [agility] (3). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move. Any investigator at your location or a connecting location may spend 1 clue to have you automatically succeed at this test.

name: Titanic Ramp
text:
Titanic Ramp is connected to the locations to its left and right.
As an additional cost for you to leave Titanic Ramp, test [agility] (2). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move. Any investigator at your location or a connecting location may spend 1 clue to have you automatically succeed at this test.

name: Titanic Ramp
text:
Titanic Ramp is connected to the locations to its left and right.
As an additional cost for you to leave Titanic Ramp, test [agility] (1). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move. Any investigator at your location or a connecting location may spend 1 clue to have you automatically succeed at this test.

name: Hidden Tunnel
text: Hidden Tunnel is connected to the location to its left. Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at the Hidden Tunnel, advance the act.
flavor: "...not even the fear of collapse could make us pause before reaching the normal outer realm of sun and sky." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

name: Primordial Evil
text: Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - When you deal any amount of damage to Primordial Evil: Shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it (if you cannot, Primordial Evil attacks you).

name: The Madness Within
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). For each point you fail by, shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it (for each card you cannot shuffle, take 1 horror).

name: Manifestation of Madness
text: Hunter. Forced - When Manifestation of Madness attacks you: Shuffle the top 2 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at them (for each card you cannot shuffle, Manifestation of Madness deals +1 damage and +1 horror for this attack).

name: Glacial Phantasm
text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Glacial Phantasm is ready: Move it once toward the location with the most investigators. In player order, each investigator at Glacial Phantasm's location or a connecting location shuffles the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck without looking at it (each investigator who cannot takes 1 horror).

name: Kindred Mist
text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location without a copy of Kindred Mist attached. Forced - When 1 or more cards from the Tekeli-li deck would be shuffled into your deck while you are at attached location: Draw them instead, placing them on the bottom of your deck instead of the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck. Discard Kindred Mist at the end of this round.

name: Antarctic Wind
text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location without a copy of Antarctic Wind attached. Investigators at attached location cannot play cards or draw cards from their deck. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Antarctic Wind.

name: Whiteout
text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Each investigator at attached location gets -1 [willpower], -1 [intellect], -1 [combat], and -1 [agility]. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Whiteout.

name: Polar Vortex
text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - When you end your turn at attached location: Each card you control with health (including your investigator) takes 1 direct damage. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Polar Vortex.

name: Elder Thing Scavenger
text: Hunter. Forced - After Elder Thing Scavenger attacks you: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. Draw each weakness discarded this way.
flavor: "Of the life of the Old Ones, both under the sea and after part of them migrated to land, volumes could be written." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

name: Guardian Elder Thing
text: Hunter. Forced - When you deal damage to Guardian Elder Thing: For each point of damage dealt, discard the top card of your deck. Draw each weakness discarded this way.

name: Rise of the Elder Things
text: Revelation - Find the topmost [[Elder Thing]] enemy in the encounter discard pile and spawn it engaged with you. Each [[Elder Thing]] enemy currently engaged with you gets +1 fight and +1 evade until the end of the round. If Rise of the Elder Things put no enemies into play, it gains surge.

name: Ice Shaft
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each [frost] token revealed during this test, take 1 damage. If you fail, take 2 damage.
flavor: One false step...

name: Through the Ice
text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location without a copy of Through the Ice attached. As an additional cost for you to enter or leave attached location (except by a scenario card effect), test [agility] (2). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move, take 1 damage and 1 horror, and discard Through the Ice.

name: Lost Researcher
text: Spawn - Any location (empty, if able). Lost Researcher enters play with 1 doom on it. Forced - When Lost Researcher is defeated: Move each doom on it to its location. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, take control of 1 doom on Lost Researcher and flip it to its clue side. Then, if there is no doom on Lost Researcher, discard it.

name: Frenzied Explorer
text: Frenzied Explorer enters play with 1 doom on it. Forced - When Frenzied Explorer is defeated: Move each doom on it to its location. [reaction] After you successfully evade Frenzied Explorer by 2 or more: Take control of 1 doom on Frenzied Explorer and flip it to its clue side. Then, if there is no doom on Frenzied Explorer, discard it.

name: Abandoned to Madness
text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest [[Possessed]] enemy and place 1 doom on that enemy. If there are no [[Possessed]] enemies in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Possessed]] enemy, draw it, and attach Abandoned to Madness to it (shuffle the encounter deck). Increase the difficulty to fight, evade, or parley with attached enemy by 1.

name: Blasphemous Visions
text: Revelation - Shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it. Then, put Blasphemous Visions into play in your threat area. Resolve the effects of each Tekeli-li weakness you draw an additional time. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Blasphemous Visions.

name: Glimpse the Unspeakable
text: Peril. Revelation - Draw the top card of the Tekeli-li deck (and resolve its effects). Shuffle it into any investigator's deck instead of placing it on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck. If no Tekeli-li weakness is drawn by this effect, Glimpse the Unspeakable gains surge.

name: Nightmarish Vapors
text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Lose 2 actions. - Shuffle the top 2 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at them.

name: Miasmatic Torment
text: Revelation - If you control a partner asset, exhaust them and attach Miasmatic Torment to them. Otherwise, Miasmatic Torment gains surge. Attached asset cannot ready. Forced - At the end of your turn: Attached asset takes 1 damage or 1 horror. [action]: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, discard Miasmatic Torment.

name: Nebulous Miasma
text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - When you end your turn at attached location: Each card you control with sanity (including your investigator) takes 1 direct horror. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Nebulous Miasma.

name: Giant Albino Penguin
text:
Aloof.
As an additional cost for you to enter or leave this enemy's location, you must spend 1 action.
flavor: "...it was only a penguin - albeit of a huge, unknown species larger than the greatest of the known king penguins, and monstrous in its combined albinism and virtual eyelessness." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

name: Wuk! Wuk! Wuk!
text: Revelation - Find the Giant Albino Penguin enemy farthest from you. You must either move it to your location or place 1 doom on it. If there are no Giant Albino Penguins in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Giant Albino Penguin, draw it, and shuffle the encounter deck.

name: Forgotten Shoggoth
text: Hunter. Forced - After Forgotten Shoggoth engages you: Draw the top card of the Tekeli-li deck (if you cannot, Forgotten Shoggoth attacks you).
flavor: "...shoggoths and their work ought not to be seen by human beings or portrayed by any beings." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

name: Rampaging Shoggoth
text: Hunter. Massive. Rampaging Shoggoth gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Deal 2 damage to each investigator and non-[[Shoggoth]] enemy at Rampaging Shoggoth's location. Each of those investigators draws the top card of the Tekeli-li deck.

name: Polar Mirage
text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location with at least 1 clue, and without a copy of Polar Mirage attached. Forced - After you discover or take control of 1 or more clues at attached location: Discard each non-weakness card in your hand. Discard Polar Mirage.

name: Dark Aurora
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each [frost] token revealed during this test, take 1 horror. If you fail, take 2 horror.
flavor: "The phosphorescent organisms supplied light with vast effectiveness, and doubtless atoned for the loss of the familiar polar auroras of the outer-world night." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

name: Charlie Kane
text:
You have 3 additional ally slots.
[fast] During a skill test you are performing, exhaust an [[Ally]] asset you control: For this test, you get +1 skill value, plus an additional +1 for each skill icon that [[Ally]] asset has that matches this test's type.
[elder_sign] effect: +3. Ready an [[Ally]] asset at your location.
flavor: "It can be arranged. It's just a matter of acceptable terms."

name: Bonnie Walsh
text:
Charlie Kane deck only.
[reaction] After you exhaust Bonnie Walsh: Ready another [[Ally]] asset you control. (Limit once per round.)
flavor: "Don't forget you have a 9 p.m. appointment with Mr. Sanford. Shall I book your usual table at La Bella Luna? Also, you bought me a wristwatch for my birthday. Thank you very much."

name: Burden of Leadership
text: Revelation - If you control no [[Ally]] assets, shuffle Burden of Leadership back into your deck. Otherwise, for each [[Ally]] asset you control, you must either exhaust it or deal it 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror.
flavor: "I tell myself it was for the greater good. Was it, Bonnie?"

name: Roland Banks
text:
[reaction] After you defeat an enemy: Discover 1 clue at your location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each clue on your location.
flavor: Everything by the book: every "i" dotted, every "t" crossed. It had worked, until now.

name: Daisy Walker
text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used on [[Tome]] [action] abilities.
[elder_sign] effect: +0. If you succeed, draw 1 card for each [[Tome]] you control.
flavor: "I know of books so powerful, they can rewrite reality."

name: "Skids" O'Toole
text:
[fast] During your turn, spend 2 resources: You may take an additional action this turn. (Limit once per turn.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. If you succeed, gain 2 resources.
flavor: "I didn't get out of the joint just to watch the world end."

name: Agnes Baker
text:
[reaction] After 1 or more horror is placed on Agnes Baker: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. (Limit once per phase.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each horror on Agnes Baker.
flavor: "I remember another life, one of sorcery and conquest."

name: Wendy Adams
text:
[reaction] When you reveal a chaos token, choose and discard 1 card from your hand: Cancel that chaos token and return it to the bag. Reveal a new chaos token. (Limit once per test/ability.)
[elder_sign] effect: +0. If Wendy's Amulet is in play, you automatically succeed instead.

name: Roland's .38 Special
text: Roland Banks deck only. Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack (if there are 1 or more clues on your location, you get +3 [combat], instead). This attack deals +1 damage.

name: Cover Up
text: Revelation - Put Cover Up into play in your threat area, with 3 clues on it. [reaction] When you would discover 1 or more clues at your location: Discard that many clues from Cover Up instead. Forced - When the game ends, if there are any clues on Cover Up: You suffer 1 mental trauma.

name: Daisy's Tote Bag
text:
Daisy Walker deck only.
You have 2 additional hand slots, which can only be used to hold [[Tome]] assets.

name: The Necronomicon
text: Revelation - Put The Necronomicon into play in your threat area, with 3 horror on it. It cannot leave play while it has 1 or more horror on it. Treat each [elder_sign] you reveal on a chaos token as a [auto_fail]. [action]: Move 1 horror from The Necronomicon to Daisy Walker. Then, if The Necronomicon has no horror on it, discard it.

name: On the Lam
text:
"Skids" O'Toole deck only.
Fast. Play after your turn begins.
Until the end of the round, non-[[Elite]] enemies cannot attack you.
flavor: I ain't going to the pen a second time.

name: Hospital Debts
text: Revelation - Put Hospital Debts into play in your threat area. [fast]: Move 1 resource from your resource pool to Hospital Debts. (Limit twice per round.) Forced - When the game ends, if Hospital Debts has fewer than 6 resources on it: You earn 2 fewer experience for this scenario.

name: Heirloom of Hyperborea
text:
Agnes Baker deck only.
[reaction] After you play a [[Spell]] card: Draw 1 card.
flavor: The etchings on its surface change from day to day, shifting and moving whenever I'm not looking.

name: Dark Memory
text: Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance. Forced - If Dark Memory is in your hand at the end of your turn, reveal it and take 2 horror.
flavor: No... not again!

name: Wendy's Amulet
text: Wendy Adams deck only. You may play the topmost event in your discard pile as if it were in your hand. Forced - After you play an event or discard an event from play: Place it on the bottom of your deck instead of in your discard pile.

name: Abandoned and Alone
text: Revelation - Take 2 direct horror and remove all cards in your discard pile from the game.
flavor: I don't need them. I don't need anyone.

name: "As you wish"
text:
Carson Sinclair deck only.
Commit only to a skill test being performed by another investigator.
If this test succeeds, the performing investigator draws 1 card. If this test fails, you draw 1 card.

name: Selfless to a Fault
text: Revelation - Put Selfless to a Fault into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn, if you did not commit at least 1 card to a skill test performed by another investigator this turn: Take 1 horror and shuffle Selfless to a Fault into your deck.

name: Kymani Jones
text:
[fast]: Engage an exhausted enemy at your location.
[reaction] When you attempt to evade an exhausted non-[[Elite]] enemy: Add your [intellect] to your skill value for this attempt. If you succeed by at least X, discard that enemy. X is that enemy's remaining health.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If there is an exhausted enemy at your location, you automatically succeed instead.
flavor: "This doesn't belong to you."

name: Grappling Hook
text:
Kymani Jones deck only.
Actions performed using Grappling Hook do not provoke attacks of opportunity.
[action][action] Exhaust Grappling Hook: Take up to 3 different basic actions from the following list, in any order (engage, evade, investigate, or move). If you investigate, use your [agility] instead of your [intellect].

name: Agent Fletcher
text: Alert. Hunter. Prey - Kymani Jones only. While Kymani Jones is evading Agent Fletcher, reduce their [intellect] value to 0.
flavor: "I know who you really are, Jones."

name: Word of Woe
text: Amina Zidane deck only. Fast. Play only during your turn. Place 1 doom on an asset you control to resolve an [action] ability on it, ignoring all costs (including its [action] cost). Then, if Word of Weal is in your discard pile, you may shuffle it into your deck.

name: Word of Weal
text:
Amina Zidane deck only.
Fast. Play when you perform a skill test on an asset with 1 or more doom on it.
Add your [willpower] to your skill value for this test. Then, if Word of Woe is in your discard pile, you may shuffle it into your deck.

name: Deafening Silence
text: Revelation - Move 1 doom from an asset you control to the current agenda. This may cause the current agenda to advance. If no doom is moved in this way, shuffle Deafening Silence back into your deck.
flavor: I can hear you too, Amina.

name: Darrell Simmons
text:
You begin the game with Darrell's Kodak in play.
[fast] During a skill test at your location, spend 1 evidence from an asset you control: Reduce the difficulty of this test by 2. (Limit once per test.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Place 1 evidence on an asset you control.
flavor: "The truth is darker than any of us know."

name: Darrell's Kodak
text: Darrell Simmons deck only. [reaction] After an enemy or treachery enters play, exhaust Darrell's Kodak: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on that enemy or treachery, as evidence. [reaction] After you discover any number of clues: Move that many evidence on enemies or treacheries at that location (or not at any location) to Darrell's Kodak.

name: Ruined Film
text: Revelation - Remove 4 evidence from cards you control. For each evidence you cannot remove in this way, take 1 horror.
flavor: Irrefutable proof, reduced to nothing by the light of day.

name: Grievous Wound
text: Fast. Play after you successfully attack a non-[[Elite]] enemy using a [[Melee]] asset. Attach Grievous Wound to the attacked enemy. Forced - At the end of the round: Deal 1 damage to attached enemy.
flavor: This is gonna hurt.

name: Motivational Speech
text: Parley. Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator may play an [[Ally]] asset from their hand, reducing its cost by 3.
flavor:
"Think they bought it?"
"They certainly do not suspect the world is ending, Mr. Kane."

name: One in the Chamber
text:
Fast. Play at the end of an attack or effect that spends the last ammo from a [[Firearm]] asset you control.
Add 1 ammo to that asset. You get +3 skill value for your next attack with that asset this round.

name: Fighting Lessons
text:
Commit only to a skill test during an attack or evasion attempt.
You can commit this skill to an investigator's test at any location.
flavor: "Aim and pull the damned trigger. It ain't hard, kid."

name: Helping Hand
text:
You may commit Helping Hand to any type of test. Max 1 committed per test.
While Helping Hand is committed to a skill test, double the skill icons of each other card committed to that test.

name: Field Agent
text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[fast] Exhaust Field Agent and deal 1 horror to it: Discover 1 clue at your location.
flavor: Day 15. The entities appear to be feeding. On what, I cannot imagine. I dare not approach further.

name: Captivating Discovery
text: Search the top 6 cards of your deck. You may place up to 3 of your clues on your location. For each clue placed in this way, choose and add 2 of the searched cards to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
flavor:
"Don't you realize what this means?"
"Why don't you calm down and tell me very slowly?"

name: Existential Riddle
text: Parley. Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location and test [willpower] or [intellect] (8). This test gets -1 difficulty for each other card in your hand. If you succeed, automatically evade the chosen enemy and attach Existential Riddle to it. Attached enemy gains aloof.

name: Thieves' Kit
text: Uses (6 supplies). [action] Spend 1 supply: Investigate. You may use [agility] instead of [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, gain 1 resource.
flavor: "Why do I keep these on me? Why, to be better informed regarding the unsavory methods of art thieves, of course."

name: Hit and Run
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Put an [[Ally]] asset from your hand into play. At the end of your turn, if that asset is still in play, return it to your hand.
flavor: "Impeccable timing, Mr. Fergus."

name: "I'll take that!"
text:
Fast. Play when you successfully evade a [[Humanoid]] enemy or successfully investigate.
Play an [[Item]] asset from your hand, reducing its cost by X, where X is the amount you succeeded by. Attach "I'll take that!" to that asset. Attached asset gains [[Illicit]].

name: Quick Getaway
text: Fast. Play when an enemy attacks you. Evade. Attempt to evade the attacking enemy. If you succeed, cancel that enemy's attack.
flavor: It's out of sight, but never out of mind.

name: Calculated Risk
text: Max 1 committed per skill test. Commit only to a test you are performing of any type, and only if it is your turn. Calculated Risk gains [wild] for each action you performed this turn (including this one). After this test ends, end your turn.

name: Thieves' Kit
text: Uses (6 supplies). [action] Spend 1 supply: Investigate. For this investigation, you may use [agility] instead of [intellect], and you get +1 skill value. If you succeed, gain 1 resource (2 resources instead if you succeed by 2 or more).
flavor: "...okay, fine, they're mine."

name: Ceremonial Sickle
text: [action]: Fight. Either use your [willpower] or get +1 [combat] for this attack. When you initiate this ability, choose one - - Exhaust Ceremonial Sickle and place 1 doom on it to get +1 skill value and deal +1 damage for this attack. - If this attack defeats an enemy, remove 1 doom from Ceremonial Sickle.

name: Dowsing Rod
text: [action]: Investigate. Either use your [willpower] or get +1 [intellect] for this investigation. When you initiate this ability, choose one - - Exhaust Dowsing Rod and place 1 doom on it to move to a connecting location. - If this investigation discovers the last clue at a location, remove 1 doom from Dowsing Rod.

name: Hallowed Chalice
text:
[action]: Choose an investigator at your location and either (choose one) -
- Exhaust Hallowed Chalice and place 1 doom on it to heal 2 damage or 2 horror from that investigator.
- Heal 1 damage or 1 horror from that investigator. If you heal the last damage or horror from that investigator, remove 1 doom from Hallowed Chalice.

name: String of Curses
text: Parley. Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location and either (choose one): - Automatically evade that enemy and place 1 doom on it. It cannot take damage for the remainder of the round. Discover 1 clue at your location. - If that enemy has 1 or more doom on it, defeat it. Gain 1 resource for each doom that was on it.

name: Ghastly Possession
text:
After you commit Ghastly Possession to a skill test on an asset, choose one:
- Place 1 doom on that asset. Ghastly Possession gains [wild][wild].
- If this test is successful, either remove 1 doom from this asset, or replenish half of its uses (rounded down).

name: Elle Rubash
text:
You get +1 skill value while resolving a skill test on an attached asset.
1 doom on each attached asset does not count towards the agenda's doom threshold.
[fast] Exhaust Elle Rubash: Choose an asset in your play area with 1 or more doom on it. Attach it to Elle Rubash, or switch it with an attached asset. (Limit 2 attached assets).

name: Sin-Eater
text:
Permanent. Exceptional.
[fast] Exhaust Sin-Eater: Move 1 doom from an asset you control to Sin-Eater. Then, either ready that asset or place 1 charge on it.
[action]: Remove all doom from Sin-Eater.

name: Improvised Shield
text: Improvised Shield can only be played from your discard pile. Forced - When Improvised Shield is defeated: Shuffle it into your deck instead of discarding it.

name: Predator or Prey
text: Max 2 [[Dilemma]] per round. Revelation - If there are no enemies in play, draw 1 card. Otherwise, you must decide (choose one): - Each unengaged non-[[Elite]] enemy moves once toward the nearest investigator. - Each investigator disengages from each enemy engaged with them and moves once away from the nearest enemy.

name: Salvage
text: Choose an [[Item]] asset in your discard pile. Either (choose one): - Remove that asset from the game and gain resources equal to its cost. - Play that asset (paying its cost).
flavor: You feel a bit discarded, too.

name: Tool Belt
text:
Each attached asset takes up no slots and its text box is treated as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]).
[fast] Exhaust Tool Belt: Choose one - attach a [[Tool]] asset in your play area to Tool Belt, switch a [[Tool]] asset in your play area with an attached asset, or detach an attached asset.

name: Ectoplasmic Horror
text:
[mystic] investigator only.
Hunter.
The first time you reveal a chaos token while attacking or attempting to evade Ectoplasmic Horror, reveal an additional token for each empty arcane slot you have.

name: Vincent Lee
text:
[reaction] After one of your card effects heals damage from an investigator or an investigator's [[Ally]] asset: Add one of your set-aside On the Mend skills to that investigator's hand.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may heal 1 damage from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.
flavor: "I will find the answers, even if it kills me."

name: Bonesaw
text: Vincent Lee deck only. [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If this attack is successful, you may take 1 damage to deal +1 damage for this attack. [action]: Heal 5 damage from an investigator at your location. Test [intellect] (4). If you fail, that investigator suffers 1 physical trauma. (Max once per game.)

name: On the Mend
text: Limit 1 On the Mend in your hand. Commit only to a test you are performing. Forced - When On the Mend would be discarded from anywhere: Set it aside, out of play, instead.

name: Wounded Bystander
text: Revelation - Put Wounded Bystander into play in your play area with 3 damage on it. It cannot leave play while it has damage (unless it is defeated). If it has no damage, discard it. Forced - When you take non-direct damage: At least 1 of it must be assigned to Wounded Bystander, if able. Forced - If Wounded Bystander is defeated: You suffer 1 mental trauma.

name: Girish Kadakia
text:
Girish Kadakia may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
[fast] During a skill test being performed by an investigator at your location, exhaust Girish Kadakia: That investigator gets +2 skill value for this test. If this test is successful, heal 1 damage or horror from Girish Kadakia.

name: Research Notes
text:
[reaction] After a player card ability places 1 or more of your clues on your location: Place that many resources on Research Notes, as evidence.
[action]: Test [intellect] (0). For each point you succeed by, you may spend 1 evidence to discover 1 clue at your location.

name: Map the Area
text: Investigate. Add your [willpower] or [agility] to your skill value for this investigation. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues at this location, attach Map the Area to it. Limit 1 per location. Reduce the difficulty of all skill tests at attached location by 1.

name: Orphic Theory
text:
Uses (4 secrets).
[fast] Spend 1 secret: Choose any non-weakness treachery not attached to an [[Elite]] enemy. Until the end of the round, treat that card's printed text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]).

name: Hidden Pocket
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to a [[Clothing]] or [[Armor]] asset you control.
Attached asset gains: "You have 1 additional hand or accessory slot (your choice), which can only be used to hold an [[Illicit]] asset."
flavor: "Thanks! It has pockets!"

name: Breaking and Entering
text: Investigate. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this investigation. If you succeed by 1 or more, you may automatically evade an enemy at this location. If you succeed by 3 or more, return Breaking and Entering to your hand at the end of your turn. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
flavor: If you're careful, it's just "entering."

name: Eldritch Initiation
text: For each arcane slot you have, draw 1 card (max 5). For each filled arcane slot you have, choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
flavor:
By both light and shadow /
may dusk beget dawn;
May the turning of the world /
lead to power everlasting.

name: Astral Mirror
text:
For each of your arcane slots that are empty, you have one additional hand slot.
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to play an asset into one of your hand slots.

name: Ceremonial Sickle
text: [action]: Fight. Either use your [willpower] or get +1 [combat] for this attack. When you initiate this ability, choose one - - Exhaust Ceremonial Sickle and place 1 doom on it to get +3 skill value and deal +1 damage for this attack. - If this attack defeats an enemy, ready Ceremonial Sickle and remove all doom from it.

name: Idol of Xanatos
text: [reaction] When you are dealt damage and/or horror, exhaust Idol of Xanatos and discard up to 3 cards from your hand: Cancel that much damage/horror.
flavor: The weight of it was reassuring, the metal warm against her skin.

name: Exploit Weakness
text:
Fast. Play before revealing a chaos token during an attack or evasion attempt you are performing, and only if the difficulty of this test is currently 0.
This test automatically succeeds. Instead of this test's normal effects, discard the attacked or evaded enemy (if it is [[Elite]], automatically evade it and deal it 3 damage instead).

name: Making Preparations
text: Max 2 [[Dilemma]] per round. Revelation - Choose two skills ([willpower], [intellect], [combat], or [agility]). Until the end of the investigation phase, each investigator gets +1 to each of the chosen skills, and -1 to each other skill.
flavor: There is a certain clarity in the grim mathematics of survival.

name: At a Crossroads
text: Max 2 [[Dilemma]] per round. Revelation - Choose an investigator and decide (choose one): - The chosen investigator must immediately take an action as if it were their turn, then discards 1 card at random from their hand. - The chosen investigator loses 1 action during their next turn, then draws 3 cards.

name: Nature of the Beast
text: Max 2 [[Dilemma]] per round. Revelation - Reveal the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Choose an investigator to draw 1 of the revealed cards and discard the rest. Then, choose an investigator to discover 1 clue at any revealed location.

name: Heed the Dream
text: Max 2 [[Dilemma]] per round. Revelation - Reveal the top card from each investigator's deck and place them in a pile. Repeat this two more times. Choose one of the three piles. Each investigator draws each of their cards from that pile. Shuffle each weakness in each other pile into its owner's deck. Remove each other revealed card from the game.

name: Soul Sanctification
text:
Permanent. Exceptional.
For every point of damage and/or horror you heal in excess of an investigator's current damage/horror, place 1 resource on Soul Sanctification, as an offering. This still counts as healing.
[fast] Spend 1 offering: You get +2 skill value for this test. (Limit twice per test.)

name: Quantum Paradox
text: [seeker] investigator only. As an additional cost to play Quantum Paradox, you must choose and discard 4 other cards from your hand. Forced - If Quantum Paradox is in your hand at the end of your turn: Reveal it and take 1 horror.

name: Underprepared
text:
[survivor] investigator only.
Play only if Underprepared is the only card in your hand and you have exactly 1 resource in your resource pool.
While Underprepared is in your hand, each card you commit to skill tests is considered to have 1 fewer matching skill icon.

name: Hunter's Armor
text: Customizable.
flavor: You cobbled this suit together yourself from the remnants of ancient armor, mixed with more modern "bulletproof" plating used in the Great War. It's not much, yet. But with some improvements, maybe it'll be enough.

name: Runic Axe
text: Customizable. Uses (4 charges). Replenish 1 of these charges at the start of each round. [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. Before this attack, you may spend any number of charges to imbue the axe with that many different inscriptions - - Accuracy - You get an additional +2 [combat] for this attack. - Power - This attack deals +1 damage.

name: Martyr's Vambrace
text:
You get +1 skill value while resolving revelation abilities on encounter cards.
[reaction] After another investigator at your location draws a non-peril encounter card, before resolving that card's effects, exhaust Martyr's Vambrace: You are considered to have drawn that encounter card, instead.

name: Alchemical Distillation
text:
Customizable. Uses (3 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply: Choose an investigator at your location and test [intellect] (1). If you succeed, that investigator performs one of the following options -
- Draw 2 cards.
- Gain 2 resources.

name: Empirical Hypothesis
text: Customizable. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - At the start of the round: Choose one of the following criteria for this round - You fail a test by 2 or more. - You succeed at a test by 3 or more. When the chosen criteria is met, you may exhaust Empirical Hypothesis to add 1 evidence to it. [fast] Spend 1 evidence: Draw 1 card.

name: The Raven Quill
text:
Customizable. When you purchase The Raven Quill, name a [[Tome]] or [[Spell]] asset and record that name on its upgrade sheet.
Attach to a named asset you control.
[reaction] When you resign or the game ends: Either mark a checkbox on The Raven Quill's upgrade sheet, or reduce the experience cost to upgrade the attached asset before the next scenario by 1.

name: Surgical Kit
text:
Uses (4 supplies).
[reaction] When one of your card effects heals damage from an investigator, spend 1 supply: Either that effect heals 1 additional damage, or you draw 1 card and heal 1 horror.
[action] [action]: Heal 3 damage from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.

name: Gray's Anatomy
text:
[action]: Choose a card at your location and test [intellect] (1). For each point you succeed by, choose one -
- The next time that card would be healed this round, heal +1 damage/horror (to a maximum of +3).
- The next time that card would be dealt damage this round, deal +1 damage (to a maximum of +3).

name: Damning Testimony
text: Customizable. Uses (3 evidence). [action] Exhaust Damning Testimony and choose an enemy at any location: Investigate (your location). If you succeed, you may spend 1 evidence to discover 1 additional clue at the chosen enemy's location.

name: Friends in Low Places
text:
Customizable. When you purchase Friends in Low Places, choose and record a [[Trait]] on its upgrade sheet.
Look at the top 6 cards of your deck. For each looked-at card with the chosen [[Trait]](s), you may spend 1 resource to add that card to your hand. Shuffle the remaining cards into your deck.
flavor: "Pleasure doing business with you, Ms. O'Bannion."

name: Disguise
text: Uses (4 supplies). [action] Spend 1 supply: Evade. You get +2 [agility] for this evasion attempt. If you succeed and the evaded enemy is non-[[Elite]], it does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

name: Embezzled Treasure
text: [fast] Exhaust Embezzled Treasure: Move up to 2 resources from your resource pool to Embezzled Treasure (to a maximum of 10 resources on it). Forced - When you resign or the game ends: For every 2 resources on Embezzled Treasure, an investigator of your choice begins the next scenario of the campaign with 1 additional resource in their resource pool.

name: Underworld Market
text:
Permanent. Exceptional. You get +10 deck size.
[reaction] Before drawing your opening hand, choose 10 [[Illicit]] cards from your deck: Shuffle them together and place them next to Underworld Market, as your market deck.
[reaction] At the start of your turn: Reveal the top 2 cards of your market deck. You may spend 1 resource to draw 1 of them. Place the rest on the bottom, in any order.

name: Summoned Servitor
text:
Customizable. As an additional cost to play Summoned Servitor, you must discard another asset you control.
Summoned Servitor enters play at your location. It can take 1 action during each of your turns, which can only be used to take the following action:
- Move Summoned Servitor to a connecting revealed location.

name: Power Word
text: Customizable. Fast. Play only during your turn. Attach to a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. [action] If attached enemy is at your location: Parley. Give it a command (limit once per round per command) - - "Go." This enemy moves once in a direction of your choice. - "Cower." This enemy exhausts.

name: Pocket Multi Tool
text:
Customizable. Limit 1 per investigator.
[fast] During a skill test you are performing, exhaust Pocket Multi Tool: You get +1 skill value for this test.
flavor: But wait - there's more!

name: Grizzled
text: Customizable. When you purchase Grizzled, choose and record two [[Traits]] on its upgrade sheet. If this is a skill test on or against an encounter card (including fighting, evading, or parleying), Grizzled gains [wild][wild] for each of the chosen traits that encounter card possesses.

name: Pay Your Due
text: [rogue] investigator only. As an additional cost to play Pay Your Due, you may spend any number of additional actions. Reduce its cost by 5 for each additional action spent. Forced - If Pay Your Due is in your hand at the end of your turn: Reveal it and take 1 damage.

name: Carson Sinclair
text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used on the below [action] ability.
[action]: Choose another investigator at your location. They immediately take an action as if it were their turn. (Limit once per round for each investigator.)
[elder_sign] effect: +0. Draw 1 card. You may resolve this effect anytime another investigator at your location resolves their [elder_sign] effect.

name: Amina Zidane
text:
[reaction] When you play an asset: Reduce its resource cost by 3. It enters play with 1 doom on it. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may move all doom from a card at your location to another card at your location.
flavor: "What is it trying to tell me?"

name: Custom Modifications
text:
Customizable.
Attach to a [[Firearm]] asset you control. Limit 1 per asset.
[reaction] When you reveal a non-[auto_fail] chaos token attacking with attached asset, exhaust Custom Modifications: Cancel that chaos token, return it to the chaos bag, and reveal a new one.
flavor: It's like an old friend in your grip.

name: Obsidian Bracelet
text:
Obsidian Bracelet may only be assigned damage and/or horror dealt by treachery effects.
Obsidian Bracelet may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
flavor: You're not about to question why it works. All you know is that you're never taking it off again.

name: Bolas
text: Evade. Attempt to evade using [combat] instead of [agility]. If you succeed and the enemy is non-[[Elite]], attach Bolas to it. Attached enemy gets -1 evade value. Forced - After attached enemy moves: Exhaust it.

name: Breach the Door
text:
Test [combat] (1). If you succeed, attach Breach the Door to your location with 1 resource on it for each point you succeeded by, as leads.
Reduce attached location's shroud by 1 for each lead on Breach the Door.
flavor: "Let's see those hands!"

name: Bestow Resolve
text:
Uses (4 charges).
[fast] During a skill test performed by an investigator at your location or a connecting location, spend 1 charge: Commit a non-weakness card from your hand to that skill test, treating all of its skill icons as [wild].

name: Guard Dog
text: [fast] Exhaust Guard Dog: Engage an enemy at your location. That enemy attacks you. [reaction] When an enemy attack deals damage and/or horror to Guard Dog: Deal 1 damage to the attacking enemy. Card design by the Council-in-Exile at Arkham Nights 2020.

name: Handcuffs
text: Fast. [action] If Handcuffs is not attached to an enemy: Evade. Use only on a [[Humanoid]] enemy. This evasion attempt uses [combat] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, remove all doom from the just-evaded enemy and attach Handcuffs to it. If the attached enemy is non-[[Elite]], it cannot ready and doom cannot be placed on it.

name: Prepared for the Worst
text: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator search the top 9 cards of their deck for a [[Weapon]] asset, adds it to their hand or plays it (paying its resource cost), and shuffles their deck.

name: Ever Vigilant
text: One at a time, investigators at your location, as a group, may play up to 4 assets in total from their hands, reducing the resource cost of each by 1.
flavor:
He had to give Logan credit:
the man knew how to gear up for Armageddon.

name: Dissection Tools
text: [reaction] After an enemy at your location is defeated: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on this card, as evidence. While Dissection Tools has... - ... 1 or more evidence, you get +1 [agility]. - ... 2 or more evidence, you get +1 [combat]. - ... 3 or more evidence, you get +1 sanity.

name: Grim Memoir
text: Uses (4 secrets). [action] Spend 1 secret: Investigate. You get +2 [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed by 2 or more, you may draw 1 card.
flavor: What follows is a true account. Would that it were not so.

name: Bizarre Diagnosis
text: Place 1 of your clues on your location. Then, heal 3 damage from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.
flavor: Unconventional ailments require unconventional treatments.

name: Analysis
text: After revealing a chaos token for this skill test, you may place 1 of your clues on your location to cancel that chaos token, return it to the chaos bag, and reveal a new one. (You may do this any number of times.)

name: Lab Coat
text: [reaction] When you would fail a skill test on a [seeker] card by 1 or less, exhaust Lab Coat: You succeed by 0, instead.
flavor: It makes you feel like you know what you're doing, even when you're in way over your head.

name: Guidance
text: Choose another investigator at your location who has yet to take their turn this round. During their turn this round, the chosen investigator gets +1 to each of their skills, and may take an additional action. Playing Guidance does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Dr. William T. Maleson
text: [reaction] When any investigator draws an encounter card from the encounter deck, exhaust Dr. William T. Maleson and place 1 of your clues on your location: That investigator draws another card from the top of the encounter deck, chooses one of those 2 cards to resolve, and cancels and discards the other.

name: Press Pass
text: [reaction] After you spend 1 or more clues or place 1 or more clues on your location, exhaust Press Pass: You may take an additional action during this turn (or your next turn if it is not currently your turn).
flavor: It's amazing how differently everyone treats you while you're wearing one.

name: Fingerprint Kit
text: Uses (3 supplies). [action] Exhaust Fingerprint Kit and spend 1 supply: Investigate. You get +2 [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, you discover 2 additional clues at your location.

name: Honed Instinct
text:
Customizable. Fast. Play this card only after one of the following conditions is met:
- The agenda or act advances.
- You succeed at a skill test by 3 or more.
Immediately take an action as if it were your turn. (Max once per round.)

name: Kicking the Hornet's Nest
text: Search the top 9 cards of the encounter deck for a non-[[Elite]] enemy and spawn it engaged with you (instead of its normal spawn location). Then, discover 1 clue at your location and gain X resources, where X is that enemy's health value. Shuffle the encounter deck.

name: Stylish Coat
text: [reaction] When you gain 1 or more resources during your turn via another player card effect, exhaust Stylish Coat: Gain 1 additional resource.
flavor: "Dress for the job you want, you say. What if the job I want is yours?"

name: Chuck Fergus
text:
[reaction] When you play a [[Tactic]] or [[Trick]] event, exhaust Chuck Fergus: Choose one -
- That event gains fast.
- That event costs 2 fewer resources to play.
- You get +2 skill value while performing a skill test during the resolution of that event.

name: Dirty Fighting
text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
While attacking, parleying, or attempting to evade an exhausted enemy, you get +2 skill value.
[reaction] After you evade an enemy, exhaust Dirty Fighting: Take a fight action against that enemy. Ignore the aloof keyword for this attack.

name: Trigger Man
text: [reaction] After Trigger Man enters play: Attach an [[Illicit]] asset from your hand to Trigger Man (it is considered to be in play and under your control). [fast] Exhaust Trigger Man and spend 1 resource: Resolve an [action] ability on attached asset, without paying its [action] cost. Resolve that ability with a base skill value of 4.

name: Clean Sneak
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
For each exhausted non-swarm enemy at your location, choose a different option:
- Gain 2 resources.
- Deal 2 damage to that enemy.
- Discover 1 clue at your location.
- Draw 1 card.

name: Living Ink
text:
Customizable. When you purchase Living Ink, choose a skill and circle it on its upgrade sheet.
Uses (3 charges).
Remove 1 charge from Living Ink at the start of each of your turns. If Living Ink has no charges, discard it.
You get +1 to the chosen skill(s).

name: Onyx Pentacle
text: [action]: Evade. Either use your [willpower] or get +1 [agility] for this evasion attempt. When you initiate this ability, choose one - - Exhaust Onyx Pentacle and place 1 doom on it to target any enemy at your location or a connecting location, and get +1 skill value for this evasion attempt. - If you succeed by 2 or more, remove 1 doom from Onyx Pentacle.

name: Explosive Ward
text:
Before you play Explosive Ward, you may discard any number of cards from your arcane slots.
Deal X damage to a non-[[Elite]] enemy engaged with you. X cannot be greater than the number of empty arcane slots you have. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Binder's Jar
text:
You get +1 arcane slot for each enemy beneath Binder's Jar.
[reaction] After a non-[[Elite]] enemy is defeated at your location: Place that enemy facedown beneath Binder's Jar (limit 2 enemies beneath it).
[reaction] When an enemy attacks you, discard an enemy beneath Binder's Jar that shares a [[Trait]] with the attacking enemy: Cancel that attack.

name: Moonlight Ritual
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Remove all doom from a non-[[Elite]] card at your location.
flavor: "In the name of the moon..."

name: Uncage the Soul
text: You may discard a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset you control. Play a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] card from your hand or discard pile, reducing its resource cost by 3.
flavor:
The power seized her, made her shudder and spasm.
Its energy united with hers, and then,
she opened her eyes…

name: Dowsing Rod
text: [action]: Investigate. Either use your [willpower] or get +1 [intellect] for this investigation. When you initiate this ability, choose one - - Exhaust Dowsing Rod and place 1 doom on it to move to a connecting location and get +2 skill value for this investigation. - If this investigation discovers the last clue at a location, ready Dowsing Rod and remove all doom from it.

name: Onyx Pentacle
text: [action]: Evade. Either use your [willpower] or get +1 [agility] for this evasion attempt. When you initiate this ability, choose one - - Exhaust Onyx Pentacle and place 1 doom on it to target any enemy at your location or a connecting location, and get +3 skill value for this evasion attempt. - If you succeed by 2 or more, ready Onyx Pentacle and remove all doom from it.

name: Makeshift Trap
text: Customizable. Uses (2 time). If Makeshift Trap has no time, discard it. Attach to your location. Each non-[[Elite]] enemy at attached location get -1 fight and -1 evade. Forced - At the end of the round: Remove 1 time from Makeshift Trap.

name: End of the Road
text:
Fast. Play during your turn only if the final agenda is in play.
Draw 1 card, gain 1 resource, and gain 1 additional action. Remove End of the Road from the game.
flavor: "So... should we turn around?"

name: Shed a Light
text:
Fast. Play before revealing a chaos token during an investigation you are performing, and only if the difficulty of this test is currently 0.
This test automatically succeeds. You discover 1 additional clue at this location and 1 additional clue at any location.

name: Lifeline
text:
Max 1 per turn.
Fast. Play when an investigator's turn would end.
That investigator may take X additional actions during their turn. X is the number of skill tests they failed during their turn. Exile Lifeline.

name: Gumption
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
You may commit Gumption to any type of skill test.
While Gumption is committed to a skill test, that test gets -2 difficulty.
flavor: "Now you listen here, mister!"

name: Baseball Bat
text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. If a [skull] or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this attack, either (choose one): - Return Baseball Bat to your hand after this attack. - This attack deals an additional +1 damage. Discard Baseball Bat after this attack.

name: Katja Eastbank
text:
[reaction] When you draw a non-weakness card from the top of your deck, before resolving any of its effects, exhaust Katja Eastbank: Place that card facedown beneath her (limit 5 cards beneath her). Draw a new card to replace it.
[action]: Draw any card beneath Katja Eastbank.
flavor: "Let's bookmark that for later."

name: Old Keyring
text: Uses (3 keys). If there are no keys on Old Keyring, discard it. [action]: Investigate. Your location gets -2 shroud for this investigation. If you succeed, remove 1 key from Old Keyring, and if this test's difficulty is 0, you discover 1 additional clue.

name: Fickle Fortune
text: Max 2 [[Dilemma]] per round. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. Each investigator heals 3 damage and 3 horror. - Remove 1 doom from the current agenda. Each investigator takes 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror. Remove Fickle Fortune from the game.

name: Hyperphysical Shotcaster
text: Customizable. Uses (4 aether). If Hyperphysical Shotcaster has no aether, discard it. [action] Spend 1 aether: Resolve the Manifest ability of the Hyperphysical Shotcaster's current form. [fast] Exhaust Hyperphysical Shotcaster: Change its form (to one you have unlocked on its upgrade sheet).

name: Refine
text:
As an additional cost to play Refine, spend an action.
Immediately mark a checkbox on an upgrade sheet for a customizable card you own, even if it is not in play.
Max once per game for each investigator.

name: Flashlight
text: Uses (4 supplies). [reaction] When you perform a skill test while investigating or attempting to evade, spend 1 supply: This test gets -2 difficulty. Card design by the Council-in-Exile at Arkham Nights 2020.

name: Lurker in the Dark
text: [guardian] investigator only. Hunter. Spawn - Any connecting location. Lurker in the Dark can only be attacked or damaged using [[Weapon]] assets or [[Tactic]] events, and takes 1 fewer damage from each source.

name: Inspector Flint
text: [reaction] When you expose a decoy, exhaust Inspector Flint: Cancel the exposing of that decoy, flip it facedown and either draw 1 card or choose a different concealed mini-card at that location to expose.
flavor: If you know both yourself and your enemy, you can win a hundred battles without a single loss. - Sun Tzu

name: Agent Ari Quinn
text:
While there is a concealed mini-card at your location, you get +1 [intellect], +1 [combat], and +1 [agility].
[reaction] After you expose a card in the shadows, exhaust Agent Ari Quinn: Draw 1 card.
flavor: "The truth is out there."

name: Dr. Dewi Irawan
text:
You get +1 [willpower].
[fast] Exhaust Dr. Dewi Irawan: Either reveal a card from your hand to shuffle each copy of that card that is set-aside as a hollow into its owner's deck, or discard a card from your hand to shuffle any set-aside hollow into its owner's deck. In either case, gain 1 resource for each card shuffled in this way.

name: Expedited Ticket
text: Permanent. While embarking to a new destination on the map, you may exile Expedited Ticket and mark 1 time in your Campaign Log to travel anywhere on the map.

name: Foundation Intel
text: Foundation Intel cannot leave your hand.
flavor: This dossier, while filled with important findings, isn't related to your situation in the slightest. You should probably drop it off at the sanctum Taylor indicated at your earliest convenience.

name: Paradimensional Understanding
text: Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Immediately shift an [[Unstable]] key you control. - Flip each [[Stable]] key you control to its [[Unstable]] side.

name: Fortune and Folly
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half your alarm level (rounded up).
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, the nearest enemy moves once toward you.
[elder_thing]: -5. You may raise your alarm level by 1 to automatically succeed, instead.

name: Abarran Arrigorriagakoa
subname: The Man with the Ruby Ring
text: Aloof. Patrol (clockwise). Forced - When you engage Abarran Arrigorriagakoa: Immediately advance the agenda. [action]: Test [agility](3). If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1. If you succeed, discard the top card of the encounter deck and check its game icon. If its color is red, remember that you "stole Abarran's keys." ♦A

name: Abarran Arrigorriagakoa
text: While an investigator's alarm level is 5 or higher, Abarran Arrigorriagakoa gains hunter. Forced - When you deal 1 or more damage to Abarran Arrigorriagakoa, if he is ready: Discard the top card of the encounter deck and check its game icon. If its suit is ♦, Abarran attacks you. ♦A

name: Deck of Possibilities
text:
Permanent.
[action]: Draw the top card of the possibilities deck. Flip this card over and consult the list on its other side to resolve its effect. Remove the drawn card from the possibilities deck for the remainder of the campaign. (Limit once per game.)

name: Deck of Possibilities
text: - J♠: The Prayer. Nothing happens. - J♥: The Wind. You may take an additional 3 actions this turn. - J♦: The Chest. Gain 10 resources. - J♣: The Tome. Choose 2 different skills. You get +1 to each of those skills for the remainder of the game. - Q♦: The Champion. Select an [[Ally]] asset from among your collection and put it into play (for the remainder of the game). - Q♠: The Sword. Select an [[Item]] asset from among your collection and put it into play (for the remainder of the game). - K♥: The Lifeblood. Heal all damage and horror on your investigator. - K♣: The Lamp. Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy or treachery in play. That card ceases to exist (remove it from the game). - A♠: The Evil Eye. For the remainder of the game, treat each [elder_sign] you reveal on a chaos token as an [auto_fail].

name: Isamara Ordoñez
text:
You get +1 [willpower].
During the upkeep phase, you may choose to not ready Isamara Ordoñez.
[fast] Exhaust Isamara Ordoñez and deal 1 horror to her: Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location or a connecting location. That enemy cannot move until Isamara Ordoñez readies or leaves play.

name: Riddles and Rain
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you have 2 or more clues).
[tablet]: -1. If there is a concealed mini-card at your location, reveal another chaos token.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, you must either spend 1 clue or place 1 doom on an enemy in the shadows.

name: When It Rains...
text: Forced - When this agenda advances: Move all doom on it to the next agenda.
flavor: Arriving in London, you patiently await your contact... but none arrives. Inspector Flint - or one of his proxies - was supposed to meet you at a quiet teahouse tucked away in a narrow storefront just outside Trafalgar Square. Wondering what could have gone wrong, and suspecting the worst, you set off to investigate.

name: Figures in the Fog
text: Forced - When this agenda advances: Move all doom on it to the next agenda.
