name: Rex's Curse
text: Advanced. Revelation - Put Rex's Curse into play in your threat area. Forced - When you would succeed at a skill test: Reveal an additional chaos token. If this effect causes you to fail the test, shuffle Rex's Curse into your deck. (Limit once per test.)

name: The House Always Watches
text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.
flavor: You have arrived at Défis de la Roulette. If you are to recover the Wellspring, you must learn all that you can about this casino and the cult that operates it.

name: Opening Hand
text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.
flavor: Défis de la Roulette is bustling on this busy night — the perfect cover for you and your crew. You hope that your long days of planning will pay off.

name: The Turn
text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.
flavor: The heist has become more complicated than you could have ever imagined. Terrifying monsters have appeared on the casino floor. The patrons, however, seem to be in a daze, while the staff continue to watch for suspicious activity. Can they not see the danger they are all in?

name: All Bets Down
text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.
flavor: The cult is against you. Creatures from beyond time and space are against you. Now fortune itself is against you. No one said this would be easy.

name: Casing the Joint
text: [reaction] After you trigger the [action] ability on a [[Game]] location: Remove 1 clue from The Wellspring of Fortune (2 clues instead if you gained resources from the [[Game]] location's ability). Objective - Accomplish as many tasks as you can and get out before you are noticed! If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
flavor: You must tread carefully, as arousing suspicion may ruin your plans before they have even begun.

name: The Take
text: [reaction] After you trigger the [action] ability on a [[Game]] location: Remove 1 clue from The Wellspring of Fortune (2 clues instead if you gained resources from the [[Game]] location's ability). Objective - If an investigator controls The Wellspring of Fortune, advance.
flavor: The heist begins. You must open the vault door, locate the Wellspring, make it past the mystical defenses, and find a way to open the container that holds it.

name: The Exit
text: Each [[Casino]] enemy loses aloof and patrol. Each [[Casino]] enemy gains hunter and "Prey - Investigator that controls The Wellspring of Fortune." Objective - If the investigator with The Wellspring of Fortune has resigned, advance. (Beware - any investigator who has not resigned will be left behind!)
flavor: Getting in was one thing, but now you must make it out with your prize. It feels as if the whole casino stands between you and the world outside.

name: Casino Floor
text: [action]: Resign. It's time to get out of here! [action]: Place an asset from your hand or play area facedown beneath Casino Floor, as part of your crew's "stash for the heist." (Limit once per turn.)
flavor: Standing in the center of the casino floor is overwhelming, with its dazzling interior and the clamor of well-to-do patrons.

name: Casino Floor
text: [action]: Resign. It's time to get out of here! [action] If an investigator "impersonated a high roller" and your alarm level is 6 or lower, spend 2 resources: You set up a delivery to the vault. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Casino]] enemy, spawn it here, and attach the set-aside Package Delivery story card to it. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Poker Table
text: [action] Spend 2 resources: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have a sequential rank, or if 3 or more of the cards have the same rank, gain 5 resources.
flavor: Omaha 8-or-better, nothing's wild, sky's the limit.

name: Roulette Wheel
text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Name a color and a rank. Then, discard the top card of the encounter deck and check its game icon. If it matches the named color and rank, gain 5 resources.
flavor: Red or black, what tickles your fancy?

name: Baccarat Table
text: [action] Spend 2 resources: Name "player," "banker," or "tie." Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. If the combined value of their ranks is higher than 18, the "player" wins. If the combined value is lower than 18, the "banker" wins. If the combined value is equal to 18, it is a "tie." If this result matches the result you named, gain 4 resources.

name: Slot Machines
text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. If all 3 cards have the same suit or same rank, gain 3 resources.
flavor: "Jackpot!"

name: High Roller's Table
text: [action] If there are no clues here, spend 4 resources: Remember that you "impersonated a high roller." Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have the same suit or a sequential rank, or if 4 of the cards have the same rank, gain 8 resources.

name: High Roller's Table
text: [action] Spend 4 resources: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have the same suit or a sequential rank, or if 4 cards have the same rank, gain 8 resources and remember that you "won a cultist medallion."

name: Casino Lounge
text: [action] If there are no clues on Casino Lounge: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, remember that you "found a vent."
flavor: The sumptuous lounge area boasts culinary delights, a stage suitable for all manner of entertainment, and countless tables for conducting business - both legal and illicit.

name: Casino Lounge
text: [action] If you "found a vent," investigators at Casino Lounge spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Move. Move to Guard Room. Then, reveal Staff Access Hallway if it has not already been revealed. Remember that "the vent is open." (Group limit once per game.) While "the vent is open," investigators may move from Casino Lounge to Guard Room as if they were connected, and vice versa.

name: Staff Access Hallway

flavor: "Is this the way to the bathroom?"

name: Security Office
text: [action]: Choose 1, 2, or 3. Discard that many cards from the top of the encounter deck and check their game icons. If an icon matches the rank of an enemy in play, remember that you "observed the staff." If the combined value of the discarded cards is 19 or higher, draw the top card in the encounter discard pile.

name: Guard Room
text:
[action] If all of the following are true, remember that you "impersonated a guard:"
- There are no enemies at Guard Room.
- There are no clues remaining on Guard Room.
- An investigator "obtained an employee uniform."

name: Owner's Office
text:
X is equal to the highest alarm level among investigators at Owner's Office.
[action] If there are no clues on Owner's Office: Remember that you "found Abarran's sigil."
flavor: Abarran's safe and desk drawers are locked. The far side of the office peers into the main hall of the casino through a false wall.

name: Counting Room
text:
[action] Investigators at Counting Room spend 10 [per_investigator] resources, as a group (5 [per_investigator] instead if you "found a vent"): Remember that you "obtained a schematic."
[reaction] After you successfully investigate Counting Room by 2 or more: Gain 2 resources. (Limit once per turn.)

name: Vault Door

name: Relic Room
text: Forced - After Relic Room is revealed: Move all clues from The Wellspring of Fortune to Relic Room. [action] If there are no clues on Relic Room: Take control of The Wellspring of Fortune and attach it to your investigator card.

name: The Stakeout
text:
Each of the following is a task that can be completed in Fortune and Folly, Part I: □ An investigator "found a vent." □ An investigator "impersonated a high roller." □ An investigator "convinced Isamara to participate in the heist." □ An investigator "obtained an employee uniform." □ An investigator "stole Abarran's keys." □ An investigator "cleaned out the house."
Forced - When an investigator is eliminated (by defeat or resignation): Place each of that investigator's clues on this story card, instead of placing them at their location.

name: If the Uniform Fits…
text:
This casino employee looks like they are wearing a uniform in your size.
[action]: Fight. Perform this attack only on the attached enemy. Test [combat] (3). If you succeed, attached enemy has been knocked out (read the section below). If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1. If attached enemy leaves play, remove this story card from the game.
If attached enemy is knocked out: Remember that you "obtained an employee uniform." Raise your alarm level by 1 if another enemy is at your location or a connecting location. Discard the attached enemy. Remove this story card from the game.

name: Fortune's Disfavor
text:
Isamara warned you that the relic you seek possesses strange abilities that bring misfortune upon those who are not favored by its bearer. Perhaps, then, you should have factored a sudden turn of fortune into your plans. For, at this moment, in the midst of your high-stakes heist, everything is about to be turned upside-down...

flavor: ... pertains to no known civilization or currency.

text: Patrol (clockwise). Retaliate. Forced - When you would deal 1 or more damage to Fortune's Shield: Discard the top card of the encounter deck and check its game icon. If its suit is ♥, cancel 1 of that damage. ♥K

text: Patrol (counterclockwise). Retaliate. Forced - When Fortune's Dagger attacks you: Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. For each card that has the ♣ suit, this attack deals +1 damage. ♣K

name: Fortune's Dagger
text: Patrol (clockwise). Retaliate. Forced - When Fortune's Dagger attacks you: Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. For each card that has the ♣ suit, this attack deals +1 damage. ♦K

text: Hunter. Forced - After any investigator performs the same type of action twice in a row during the same phase, if Dimensional Shambler is ready and unengaged: Move it once toward that investigator. (Limit once per turn.) ♠A

Treat this card as an [[Extradimensional]] enemy with 1 fight, 1 health, 1 evade, 1 damage, and 1 horror. If that enemy disengages from you, discard it. ♠6

Treat this card as an [[Extradimensional]] enemy with 1 fight, 1 health, 1 evade, 1 damage, and 1 horror. If that enemy disengages from you, discard it. ♣6

name: Dimensional Displacer
text: Hunter. Retaliate. Spawn - Discard the nearest non-unique [[Casino]] enemy without an encounter card attached to it. Spawn Dimensional Displacer at that location. (If there are no such enemies in play, instead discard Dimensional Displacer and it gains surge.) ♥6

If you fail, cancel the effects of the move, move the nearest [[Extradimensional]] enemy once toward you, and discard Dimensional Hypnosis. ♠5

If you fail, cancel the effects of the move, move the nearest [[Extradimensional]] enemy once toward you, and discard Dimensional Hypnosis. ♣5

If you fail, cancel the effects of the move, move the nearest [[Extradimensional]] enemy once toward you, and discard Dimensional Hypnosis. ♠4

text: Revelation - Put Grip of the Beyond into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn: Take 2 damage. Reduce this damage by 1 for each time you moved this turn. Discard Grip of the Beyond. ♦4

name: Hunter's Hunger
text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Discard an [[Ally]] asset you control. Each other investigator takes 1 horror. - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror. ♣4

name: Hunter's Hunger
text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Discard an [[Ally]] asset you control. Each other investigator takes 1 horror. - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror. ♥4

name: Machinations Through Time
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is 1 plus the number of story cards in the victory display.
[cultist]: -1. If you are at Tindalos, you automatically fail.
[tablet]: -2 (-4 instead if a [[Scientist]] asset is at your location).
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, deal 1 damage or 1 horror to an [[Ally]] asset at your location.

name: Into the Void
text: Forced - When a [[Scientist]] asset would be defeated: It is abducted instead (set it aside, out of play).
flavor: In order to mend time, you must traverse the maze of winding pathways to rescue those trapped within Tindalos, then reconstruct the significant events of Thomas and Mary's journey.

name: Time Marches On
text: Forced - When a [[Scientist]] asset would be defeated: It is abducted instead (set it aside, out of play).
flavor: The more you travel through Tindalos, the more likely its minions are to take notice and pursue you. If you don't complete your mission in time, you might become permanent guests of Tindalos.

name: Walking Through Time
text: Abilities on [[Scientist]] assets can be triggered by any investigator at that asset's location. [reaction] When you move to a location, if one or more [[Scientist]] assets are at your location: Move any number of them with you. Objective - Restore the timeline by completing the objective on each story card. If Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski are at non-Tindalos locations in all 3 eras, and each era has no story cards in play, advance.
flavor: Nervously, you step through a portal and enter the realm of angular time and infinite depths.

name: Tindalos
text:
Tindalos is connected to each [[Portal]] location, and vice versa.
[fast] If it is your turn: Move to a [[Portal]] location.
[action]: Test [combat] (2) or [agility] (2). If you succeed, rescue an abducted [[Scientist]] asset and put it into play at Tindalos, exhausted.

name: Tindalos
text:
Tindalos is connected to each [[Portal]] location, and vice versa.
[fast]: Place 1 of your clues on Tindalos, or take control of 1 clue on a Tindalos location in any era.
[action]: Test [combat] (3) or [agility] (3). If you succeed, rescue an abducted [[Scientist]] asset and put it into play at Tindalos, exhausted.

name: A Noble Legacy (Past)
text: Setup: Place the Nikola Tesla asset at the [[Past]] River Docks. Flip this story card over.
flavor:
Thomas and Mary met as promising undergraduate students attending Miskatonic University. It is paramount that these two gifted minds meet and form an everlasting friendship.
Famed inventor Nikola Tesla is touring America and has arrived in Arkham by sea. You know Thomas and Mary witnessed Tesla's electrifying demonstration and regarded it as highly inspirational in their pursuit of science.
In its devotion to the sciences, the Universtiy is looking to upgrade and expand its campus. High on the wish list is an observatory, but a lack of funding makes such an exorbitant facility unlikely. A sizable donation would surely get the momentum started on such a notable project.

name: Arkham Gazette
text: [action]: Test any skill (4). If you succeed, gain 1 clue (from the token pool). [fast] Remove 1 newspaper from this location: Place 1 [per_investigator] clues (from the token pool) on this location. Look at the top 5 cards of the encounter deck, add 1 to the victory display, and put the rest on the top and/or bottom of that deck in any order.

name: O'Malley's Watch Shop
text: [action] Remove 1 time from this location: Remove 1 doom from an agenda in any era. If Thomas Corrigan is at this location, you may exhaust him to place 1 resource (from the token pool) on the [[Present]] Tick-Tock Club, as time.

name: River Docks
text: [action] Spend 2 resources or exhaust a [[Scientist]] asset at this location: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on the [[Present]] or [[Future]] River Docks, as a shipment. (Limit once per turn.)

name: Miskatonic University
text: [action] [action] Remove 1 seed from this location: Announce "a tree seed has been planted." Gain 1 resource for each [[Scientist]] asset at this location.
flavor: The brilliant minds of Miskatonic's College of Sciences motivate one another to ever-ascending heights.

name: Childhood Home
text: [action] If "Thomas and Mary have met" and Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski are at this location: Announce "Thomas and Mary have married." [action] [action] If "Corrigan Industries has been founded:" Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on Corrigan Industries, as a time capsule. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Thomas Corrigan
text: [reaction] When you initiate a skill test, exhaust Thomas Corrigan: If you succeed, draw 1 card.
flavor: Ever since he was a toddler exploring the woods and creek near his home, Thomas has had an abundance of curiosity and the drive to satiate it.

name: Mary Zielinski
text: [action] Exhaust Mary Zielinski: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering a clue at your location, gain 1 clue (from the token pool).
flavor: Born in Warsaw, Poland, Mary's intense passion for the Sciences led her across the world to Miskatonic University.

name: A Noble Legacy (Present)
text: Setup: Place the Ezra Graves asset at the [[Present]] Arkham Advertiser. Flip this story card over.
flavor:
When funding is reached and construction is completed, Miskatonic University's newest building, the Gerald Warren Astronomical Observatory, will sit high atop Crane Hill. The facility will feature state-of-the-art equipment, such as a high-powered telescope, that will be able to explore the depths of the universe. The new data it provides could be invaluable to the research of Thomas and Mary.
While brief, the fortuitous collaboration with a professor of the arcane, Ezra Graves, was vital in steering Thomas and Mary down the right path. You'll have to ensure this chance encounter occurs.

name: Arkham Advertiser
text: [fast] Spend 1 resource: Ready a [[Scientist]] asset at this location. (Limit once per round.) [action] Remove 1 newspaper from this location: Place 1 [per_investigator] clues (from the token pool) on this location. Take 4 additional actions this turn.

name: Tick-Tock Club
text: [action] Remove 1 time from this location: Remove 1 doom from an agenda in any era. If Thomas Corrigan is at this location, you may exhaust him to place 1 resource (from the token pool) on the [[Future]] Tick-Tock Club, as time.

name: River Docks
text: [fast] Remove 1 shipment from this location: Gain 4 resources or 1 clue (from the token pool). [action] Spend 3 resources or exhaust 2 [[Scientist]] assets at this location: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on the [[Future]] River Docks, as a shipment.

name: Miskatonic University
text: [action] If "a tree seed has been planted:" Gain 1 clue (from the token pool) for each [[Scientist]] asset at this location. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: The new facilities on campus have attracted additional prominent researchers to Miskatonic University.

name: Ye Olde Magick Shoppe
text: [fast] If Ezra Graves is at this location, exhaust him and spend 1 clue: Defeat a non-[[Elite]] enemy in any era. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Thomas Corrigan
text:
[fast] Exhaust Thomas Corrigan: You get +2 [willpower] for this skill test.
[reaction] When you initiate a skill test, exhaust Thomas Corrigan: If you succeed, draw 1 card.

name: Mary Zielinski
text: [fast] Exhaust Mary Zielinski: You get +2 [intellect] for this skill test. [action] Exhaust Mary Zielinski: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering a clue at your location, gain 1 clue (from the token pool).

name: A Noble Legacy (Future)
text: Setup: Set the Dimensional Beam Machine asset aside, out of play. Flip this story card over.
flavor: Once all of the necessary pieces are in place, it could take countless years of researching - if it is possible at all - to make a significant breakthrough on one of the greatest mysteries of the universe: teleportation - the moving of matter from one point to another without traversing the physical space between them. Thomas and Mary believe they are on the verge of sending a human through spacetime. Such a momentous discovery should have occurred - Thomas and Mary's Nobel Prize, their worldwide acclaim, the event at the Arkham Advertiser, the two of them holding up the newspaper celebrating their accomplishments - and yet, there is no trace of such events happening. Unless you intervene...

name: Arkham Advertiser
text: [action]: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on the Arkham Gazette or on an Arkham Advertiser in any era, as a newspaper. (Group limit twice per game.) [fast] Remove 1 newspaper from this location: Place 1 [per_investigator] clues (from the token pool) on this location. Remove 1 [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] token from the chaos bag for the remainder of the game.

name: Tick-Tock Club
text: [action] If Thomas Corrigan is at this location, exhaust him and spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on O'Malley's Watch Shop, as time. (Group limit once per game.) [action] Remove 1 time from this location: Remove 1 doom from an agenda in any era.

name: River Docks
text: [fast] Remove 1 shipment from this location: Gain 4 resources or 1 clue (from the token pool). [fast] Spend 3 resources or exhaust 2 [[Scientist]] assets at this location: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on the [[Present]] River Docks, as a shipment. (Limit once per round.)

name: Miskatonic University
text: [action] If Mary Zielinski is at this location: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on the [[Past]] Miskatonic University, as a seed. (Group limit once per game.) [fast]: If "a tree seed has been planted:" Gain 1 clue (from the token pool) for each [[Scientist]] asset at this location. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Corrigan Industries
text:
[action] Remove 1 time capsule from this location: Choose up to 4 cards in your discard pile and add them to your hand.
[action] [action] If "Thomas and Mary have married:" Their children inherit Corrigan Industries. Gain 10 resources. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Thomas Corrigan
text:
Each investigator at Thomas Corrigan's location gets +1 [willpower].
[reaction] When you initiate a skill test, exhaust Thomas Corrigan: If you succeed, draw 1 card.

name: Mary Zielinski
text: Each investigator at Mary Zielinski's location gets +1 [intellect]. [action] Exhaust Mary Zielinski: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering a clue at your location, gain 1 clue (from the token pool).

name: A Bitter Rivalry
text:
Setup: Follow the instructions for your relevant era(s), below.
Past: Set Thoman Corrigan aside, out of play; he has been abducted. Place Mary Zielinski at Arkham Gazette. Set the Edwin Bennet enemy aside, out of play.
Present and Future: Set Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski aside, out of play; they have been abducted. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, set the Edwin Bennet enemy aside, out of play.
flavor: There's no sign of Edwin Bennet but you know he could appear anywhere at any moment. Deranged and obsessed, he swears revenge on those who "betrayed" him. The fame and glory will be his alone. Nothing will convince him otherwise.

name: Redeem a Former Colleague
text:
Setup: Follow the instructions for your relevant era(s), below. Then, flip this story card over.
Past: Set Mary Zielinski aside, out of play; she has been abducted. Place Thomas Corrigan at Childhood Home. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, set the Edwin Bennet enemy aside, out of play.
Present: Set Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinsky aside, out of play: they have been abducted. Spawn the Edwin Bennet enemy at Miskatonic University.
Future: Set Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski aside, out of play; they have been abducted. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, set the Edwin Bennet enemy aside, out of play.
flavor: Edwin Bennet's grudge for his former colleagues has spiraled out of control and he must be swiftly subdued. Undaunted, you're determined to restore his sanity and dissolve his vendetta.

name: Uneasy Alliance
text:
Setup: Follow the instructions for your relevant era(s), below. Then, flip this story card over.
Past: Place Thomas Corrigan at Childhood Home. Place Mary Zielinski at O'Malley's Watch Shop. Place the Edwin Bennet asset at Arkham Gazette with 12 clues on him, then remove 3 [per_investigator] clues from him.
Present and Future: Set Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinsky aside, out of play: they have been abducted. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, set the Edwin Bennet asset aside, out of play.
flavor: Nothing in the past appears to be out of the ordinary. You wonder if Edwin Bennet is trustworthy. Surely his vast knowledge could prove extremely useful in aiding you. Reluctantly, you convince yourself the payoff is worth the risk, but it will take a great deal of persuasion to keep Edwin from betraying you.

name: Edwin Bennet
text: Patrol (nearest location with a [[Scientist]] asset). Edwin Bennet cannot be damaged. Clues cannot be discovered from Edwin Bennet's location. Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Deal 1 damage to a [[Scientist]] asset at Edwin Bennet's location.

name: Edwin Bennet
text: [fast] If it is your turn and you are at a [[Portal]] location, exhaust Edwin Bennet and spend 2 resources: Move to Tindalos.
flavor: A truly brilliant, yet unstable, mastermind.

name: Edwin Bennet
text: Patrol (nearest location with a [[Scientist]] asset). Edwin Bennet cannot be damaged. Clues cannot be discovered from Edwin Bennet's location. Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Deal 1 damage to each [[Scientist]] asset at Edwin Bennet's location. Then, choose an investigator to draw the top card of the encounter deck.

name: Edwin Bennet
text: Forced - After Edwin Bennet exhausts: Choose an investigator to draw the top card of the encounter deck. [reaction] When you draw an encounter card, exhaust Edwin Bennet: Cancel all of that card's effects and discard it.

name: Anomalies in Spacetime
text: Setup: Place 1 [per_investigator] horror on each Miskatonic University location, as anomalies. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, also place 1 [per_investigator] horror on the following locations, as anomalies: Arkham Gazette, Arkham Advertiser, O'Malley's Watch Shop, and Tick-Tock Club. Remove the following enemies from the game: Tyr'thrha, Old Sadie Sheldon, and all 3 copies of Sheldon Gang. Flip this story card over.
flavor: Seemingly random peculiarities are affecting spacetime. Strange hotspots in Arkham disrupt day-to-day life and terrify residents. Apparently, these aberrations began at Miskatonic University, and some blame the distortions on taboo experiments in the Science Building's laboratories.

name: Mob Troubles
text: Setup: Set the Old Sadie Sheldon enemy and all 3 copies of the Sheldon Gang enemy aside, out of play. Remove the Tyr'thrha enemy from the game. You make a deal with Old Sadie Sheldon: each investigator playing the present era gains 2 resources.
flavor: Desperate times call for desperate measures. Out of options, you go to the infamous crime boss, Old Sadie Sheldon. Notorious for bottlegging large quantities of Canadian whiskey, Sheldon and his gang maintain a vast reserve of cash for those in need of an urgent loan. Just be sure you reimburse the short-tempered kingpin in a timely fashion...

name: Old Sadie Sheldon
text: Aloof. Each Sheldon Gang enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, spend 3 [per_investigator] resources, as a group, to add Old Sadie Sheldon to the victory display and announce "the debt has been paid."

name: Sheldon Gang
text: Surge. Hunter. Massive. Sheldon Gang gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After an investigator at Sheldon Gang's location plays a card: Ready Sheldon Gang and discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Put each [[Criminal]] enemy discarded this way into play at that location.

name: Unspeakable Abomination
text: Setup: Set the Tyr'thrha enemy aside, out of play. Remove the Old Sadie Sheldon enemy and all 3 copies of the Sheldon Gang enemy from the game.
flavor:
The extreme warping of spacetime in Tindalos has affected everything within. The satyrs and Hounds of Tindalos aren't the only beings to stalk about the realm of angular time - a being exponentially larger and more powerful twists spacetime itself.
Those who continually walk the paths of this vast maze are bound to draw the ire of those who call it home, andnothing compares to the wrath of the Arch-Lord of Tindalos.

name: Tyr'thrha
text: Massive. Retaliate. Patrol (nearest location with a [[Scientist]] asset). *Tyr'thrha has a global health pool of 6 [per_investigator]. Forced - When Tyr'thrha enters a location: Each [[Scientist]] asset at that location is abducted.

name: Ghastly Satyr
text: Patrol (nearest location with a [[Scientist]] asset). Ghastly Satyr gets +1 fight while it is at a [[Past]] location and +2 fight while it is at a [[Present]] location. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Ghastly Satyr is ready: Deal 1 damage to each [[Scientist]] asset at its location.

name: Hound of Tindalos
text: Patrol (nearest location with a [[Scientist]] asset). Hound of Tindalos gets +1 health while it is at a [[Present]] location and +2 health while it is at a [[Future]] location. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Hound of Tindalos is ready: Deal 1 horror to each [[Scientist]] asset at its location, and move each [[Scientist]] asset and investigator at its location to Tindalos.

name: Many-Angled Thing
text: Spawn - Tindalos. Hunter. While Many-Angled Thing is at a... - ...[[Past]] location, it gets +1 evade and gains alert. - ...[[Present]] location, it gets +1 damage and +1 horror. - ...[[Future]] location, it gets +1 fight and gains retaliate.

name: Tindalos Alpha
text: Alert. Retaliate. Forced - After Tindalos Alpha attacks you: Shuffle a non-story asset you control into your deck, moving all damage and horror from that asset to your investigator. Discard Tindalos Alpha. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Discard Tindalos Alpha.

name: A Tear in Time
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either lose 1 action or take 1 horror.
flavor: We've been conceptualizing time as if it were a straight line, moving forward from one point to the next. The truth is quite different.

name: Abducted
text: Peril. Revelation - If there are no [[Ally]] assets at your location, Abducted gains surge. Otherwise, test [willpower] (5). If you fail, exhaust all [[Ally]] assets at your location and deal 5 horror to one of them.
flavor: One risks becoming hunted down when traveling into and out of the domain of the Hounds.

name: Broken Space
text: Revelation - If you are at a... - ...[[Past]] location, lose 3 resources. - ...[[Present]] location, place 2 of your clues on it. - ...[[Future]] location, lose 1 action.

name: Dimensional Breach
text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest [[Portal]] location. Place 1 doom on Dimensional Breach. Each enemy at attached location gets +1 fight, +1 evade, and +1 health. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Dimensional Breach.

name: From All Angles
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail and you are at a... - ...[[Past]] location, exhaust all assets at it. - ...[[Present]] location, take 1 direct damage. Deal 1 damage to each [[Ally]] asset at your location. - ...[[Future]] location, take 1 direct horror. Deal 1 horror to each [[Ally]] asset at your location.

name: Lost in Time
text: Revelation - Shuffle a non-story asset you control into your deck, moving all damage and horror from that asset to your investigator. If no asset is shuffled into your deck by this effect, choose and discard 3 cards from your hand.

name: Merging Timelines
text: Revelation - Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. For each card in your hand that matches one of the discarded cards (by title), discard that card from your hand and lose 1 action. Shuffle each weakness discarded by this effect into your deck.

name: Open Portal
text: Revelation - Take 1 damage. Test [agility] (3). If you fail, take 1 additional damage and move to Tindalos.
flavor: An alluring destination awaits on the other side... or the snarling jaws of a fearsome Hound.

name: Temporal Distortion
text: Revelation - Attach to the current agenda. Abilities on story cards cannot be triggered. [action]: If you are at a [[Past]] location, you may test [willpower] (2). If you are at a [[Present]] location, you may test [agility] (3). If you are at a [[Future]] location, you may test [combat] (4). If you succeed at 1 or more of these tests, discard Temporal Distortion.

name: Vanishing History
text: Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Discard a non-story [[Item]] asset you control. - Choose and discard 3 non-weakness cards from your hand.

name: Jenny Barnes
text:
[reaction] After your turn begins: Play a [[Talent]] asset, reducing its cost by 1.
[fast] Discard a [[Talent]] asset you control: Gain resources equal to that asset's printed cost. (Limit 5 resources per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +0. If you succeed, gain 3 resources.
flavor: "Oh honey, I'm making this up as I go along."

name: Jenny's Twin .45s
text: Jenny Barnes deck only. Advanced. Uses (X ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. [reaction] After you defeat an enemy using the above ability, exhaust Jenny's Twin .45s: Gain resources equal to that enemy's printed health.

name: Searching for Izzie
text: Advanced. Revelation - Attach Searching for Izzie to the location farthest from you. Attached location gets +2 shroud. [action] [action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, discard Searching for Izzie. Forced - When the game ends, if Searching for Izzie is in play: You suffer 1 mental trauma.

name: Father Mateo
text:
[fast] During your turn: Seal a [bless] token on an investigator at your location with no [bless] token sealed on them. (Limit once per round.)
[reaction] When an investigator would reveal a chaos token: Resolve the [bless] token sealed on them instead. Release that token.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Resolve Father Mateo's [fast] ability, ignoring its limit.

name: The Codex of Ages
text:
Father Mateo deck only. Advanced. Seal ([elder_sign] or up to 3 [bless]).
You get +1 to each of your skills while there is a token sealed here.
[reaction] When an investigator at your location would reveal a chaos token from the chaos bag: That investigator resolves a token sealed here instead, then releases that token. (Limit once per test.)

name: Serpents of Yig
text: Advanced. Prey - Father Mateo only. Hunter. Revelation - Search the chaos bag and all play areas for the [elder_sign] token and each [bless] token and seal them on Serpents of Yig.

name: Underground Survey
text: Forced - When this agenda advances: Move all doom on it to the next agenda. [action] Draw the top card of the encounter deck: Move 1 resource from your location to the scenario reference card, as a scrap. If the enconter card just drawn was a [[Power]] treachery, gain 5 resources.
flavor: The old mine is full of dilapidated machinery and an old rail track. What secrets are written in rock below?

name: Dangerous Ride
text:
Locations with a story asset on them cannot be slid or swapped.
Each enemy gains the hunter keyword and resolves its hunter keyword an additional time during the enemy phase.
When an enemy moves, each adjacent location is considered to be connected to its location.
flavor: You now know why North Point Mine was abandoned. Writhing abominations and frenzied miners prowl the tunnels, hungry for their next meal.

name: Descent into the Mines
text: Objective - At the end of the round, if each surviving investigator is at Control Station, advance. (Hint: Get to the Control Station before the agenda advances!)
flavor: You realize the eerie hum in the air comes from vibrating crystal formations. Something feels strange, though you cannot say what...

name: The Underground Maze
text: [fast] During your turn, spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Either slide a location into an empty adjacent space, or swap 2 adjacent locations. [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] resources: Slide a revealed location into an empty adjacent space. (Group limit once per round.) [action] If the Prismatic Shard story asset is at your location: Take control of it. Objective - Get to the Rail Exit! When the Mine Card enters Rail Exit, immediately advance.
flavor: The only way out of North Point Mine is through the maze of rail tunnels.

name: The Predatory House
text: Create a separate bag consisting of the following tokens: [cultist], [tablet], and [elder_thing]. (If you do not have a second bag, you can use a cup, bowl, or other opaque container.) This is the predation bag, and these are predation tokens. They are not chaos tokens. Then, add the following tokens to the predation bag based on the current day: - Day 1: Add [cultist], [cultist] to the predation bag. - Day 2: Add [cultist] to the predation bag. - Day 3: No change is made. Some abilities will instruct investigators to make a predation test. A predation test may cause the house to come alive and prey on the investigators. To resolve a predation test, reveal a random token from the predation bag and resolve the effects for that token as indicated on the other side of this card. Flip this card over and place it next to the scenario reference card.

name: Predation Test
text: Use these results only when revealing tokens from the predation bag. [cultist]: Set this token aside. [tablet]: Each enemy-location attacks each investigator at that location. If no attack was made by this effect, the lead investigator draws the top card of the encounter deck. Return this token and each set-aside token to the predation bag. [elder_thing]: Set this token aside. Find the unsealed, [[Dormant]] location nearest to the lead investigator. Flip that location to its enemy-location side.

name: Eerie Silence
flavor: Your first steps into the old manor come with a fetid odor and an intense feeling of being watched. The air is too still, and for an abandoned house, there is an unsettling lack of dust on the furniture and floors. If nobody has lived here for years, then why does it feel like everything has moved recently?

name: The House Stirs (v. I)
text: Forced - When the mythos phase ends: Make a predation test. [fast] Either place 1 [per_investigator] of your clues on your location or remove a seal from it: Ready it and flip it over.
flavor: It is no mere infestation of rats or woodland creatures that haunts this decrepit manor. Something vile lives in Hemlock House. It burrows through the floor, writhes within its walls, and watches you with invisible, hungry eyes.

name: The House Stirs (v.II)
text: Forced - When the mythos phase ends: Make a predation test. [fast] Either place 1 [per_investigator] of your clues on your location or remove a seal from it: Ready it and flip it over.
flavor: It is no mere infestation of rats or woodland creatures that haunts this decrepit manor. Something vile lives in Hemlock House. It burrows through the floor, writhes within its walls, and watches you with invisible, hungry eyes.

name: Strange Infestation
text: Clues cannot be discovered from locations with no investigators. [action] If your location is unsealed and [[Dormant]], investigators at that location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 resource on it, as a seal. Objective - At the end of the round, if a total of 7 locations are sealed and/or in the victory display, advance.

name: Against the House
text: Clues cannot be discovered from locations with no investigators. Objective - Bring this house down! If no locations are in play, immediately advance (this occurs before investigators would be defeated by not being at a location).
flavor: Sealing this creature away won't solve anything. Whatever sort of monster has taken over Hemlock House, it needs to be destroyed.

name: The Heart of the House
text: Clues cannot be discovered from locations with no investigators. [action] If your location is unsealed and [[Dormant]], investigators at that location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 resource on it, as a seal. Forced - After an enemy-location attacks you: Move (one location at a time) to Shapeless Cellar. Objective - When the Shapeless Cellar is in the victory display, advance.
flavor: If you want to seal the house for good, you must delve into the loathsome sepulchre below.

name: Bedroom
text:
X is 1 more than this location's floor number.
[reaction] After you place a seal on this location: Draw 1 card or gain 2 resources.
flavor: The room stirs with gentle movement, the window curtains and bedsheets swaying in a breeze you cannot feel.

name: Living Bedroom
text: Massive. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Living Bedroom gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When this enemy-location is revealed: Place 1 doom on it.
flavor: This time, there really is a monster under the bed.

name: Bedroom
text:
X is 1 more than this location's floor number.
[reaction] After you place a seal on this location: Draw 1 card or gain 2 resources.
flavor: The room stirs with gentle movement, the window curtains and bedsheets swaying in a breeze you cannot feel.

name: Living Bedroom
text: Massive. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Living Bedroom gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When this enemy-location is revealed: It attacks each investigator at this location.
flavor: This time, there really is a monster under the bed.

X is 1 more than this location's floor number.

flavor: The room stirs with gentle movement, the window curtains and bedsheets swaying in a breeze you cannot feel.

flavor: This time, there really is a monster under the bed.

[reaction] After you place a seal on this location: Draw 1 card or gain 2 resources.

text: Massive. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Living Bedroom gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When this enemy-location is revealed: It attacks each investigator at this location.
flavor: This time, there really is a monster under the bed.

name: Washroom
text: [fast]: Move 1 clue on this location to the location directly below it. (Limit once per turn.)
flavor: The faucet leaks a viscous brown fluid with a steady drip. The pipes croak unnaturally in the stillness.

name: Living Washroom
text: Massive. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Forced - When this enemy-location is revealed, if there are 1 or more clues on it: It attacks each investigator at this location.

name: Washroom
text: [fast]: Move 1 clue on this location to the location directly below it. (Limit once per turn.)
flavor: The faucet leaks a viscous brown fluid with a steady drip. The pipes croak unnaturally in the stillness.

name: Living Washroom
text: Massive. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Forced - When this enemy-location is revealed, if there are 1 or more clues on it: It attacks each investigator at this location.

name: Washroom
text: [fast]: Move 1 clue on this location to the location directly below it. (Limit once per turn.)
flavor: The faucet leaks a viscous brown fluid with a steady drip. The pipes croak unnaturally in the stillness.

name: Living Washroom
text: Massive. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Forced - When this enemy-location is revealed: Each investigator at this location discards cards at random from their hand equal to the number of clues on this location.

name: Library
text: [reaction] After you discover the last clue from Library: You find a secret passage. Choose any location and place 1 horror token on it, as a secret passage. For the remainder of this scenario, each copy of Library is connected to the location with a secret passage, and vice versa. (Max once per game.)

name: Living Library
text: Massive. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Living Library gets +1 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When this enemy-location is revealed: Each investigator at this location and each connecting location loses 2 resources.

name: Library
text: [reaction] After you discover the last clue from Library: You find a secret passage. Choose any location and place 1 horror token on it, as a secret passage. For the remainder of this scenario, each copy of Library is connected to the location with a secret passage, and vice versa. (Max once per game.)

name: Living Library
text: Massive. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Living Library gets +1 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When this enemy-location is revealed: Each investigator at this location and each connecting location takes 1 horror.

name: Parlor
text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Deal 2 damage to an enemy at a connecting location. You may test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, deal 1 additional damage to that enemy. (Limit once per round.)
flavor: If there are creatures within the house's walls, maybe you can use the fireplace to smoke or burn them out?

name: Living Parlor
text: Massive. Retaliate. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Living Parlor gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When this enemy-location is revealed: It attacks each investigator at this location.

name: Dining Room
text: Forced - After you discover the last clue at this location: Discard 1 card at random from your hand.
flavor: The hutch is filled with all manner of chipped plates and tarnished silverware. With each step you take, plates and glasses rattle precariously.

name: Living Dining Room
text: Massive. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Living Dining Room gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When this enemy-location is revealed: Make a predation test.

name: Foyer
text: [fast] During your turn: Move (to a connecting location). (Limit once per turn.) [action]: Resign. You flee the house.
flavor: The grandfather clock is stopped at 11:13.

name: Living Foyer
text: Massive. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Forced - When this enemy-location is revealed: It attacks each investigator at this location. [action]: Resign. You flee the house.

name: Grappling Spawn
text: Hunter. (Night [night]) Retaliate. Grappling Spawn gets +X health, where X is its current floor (to a minimum of +1 health).
flavor: "It's got me!"

name: Out of the Walls
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail and... - ...your location is an enemy, take 1 damage and 1 horror. - ...your location is unsealed and [[Dormant]], flip it over. - ...your location is sealed, discard 1 card at random from your hand.

name: Pulled In
text: Revelation - If there are no enemy-locations in play, Pulled In gains surge. Otherwise, test [combat] (4). If you fail, choose the nearest enemy-location and move (one location at a time) to it. If you failed by 4 or more, the chosen enemy-location attacks you.
flavor: You should really watch where you step.

name: Shapeless Cellar
text: Massive. Retaliate. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Shapeless Cellar cannot be sealed or flipped. Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Shapeless Cellar: Shapeless Cellar attacks you. Forced - If there are no clues on Shapeless Cellar: Add it to the victory display.

name: Unsettling Silence
text: Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda, if the Brood Queen enemy is set aside: Reveal tokens from the chaos bag equal to the number of [[Insect]] enemies in the victory display. If a [skull] or [auto_fail] token is revealed, spawn the set-aside Brood Queen enemy.
flavor: The dry landscape is perfectly still. A beguiling glow hangs over everything.

name: Desolation (v.I)
text: Each [[Insect]] enemy loses aloof. Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda, if the Brood Queen enemy is set aside: Reveal tokens from the chaos bag equal to the number of [[Insect]] enemies in the victory display. If a token with a symbol is revealed, spawn the set-aside Brood Queen enemy.
flavor: The insects scurry to and fro, alarmed by your presence.

name: Desolation (v.II)
text: Each [[Insect]] enemy loses aloof and patrol and gains hunter. Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda, if the Brood Queen enemy is set aside: Reveal tokens from the chaos bag equal to the number of [[Insect]] enemies in the victory display. If a token with a symbol is revealed, spawn the set-aside Brood Queen enemy.
flavor: The insects scurry to and fro, alarmed by your presence.

name: A Lost Legacy
text: Objective - When the round ends, investigators at the Pearl Estate Ruins may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: The legacy of Pearl Ridge is a story of note amongst the locals. The Pearls were a prominent family like the Hemlocks and Atwoods, but the family vanished in a curious incident back in 1906. What could have happened here?

name: Searching the Heath
text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Draw the top card beneath your location. [fast] Investigators at your location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Look at the top card beneath your location. You may place that card on the bottom of its stack. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned and there are 1 or more Crystal Remains in the victory display, advance.
flavor: The Warrens are likely the final resting place of the Pearl family. Studying their remains may shed light on what really happened here.

name: Crystal Grove
text: [action] Investigators at Crystal Grove spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Add a Crystal Remains you control to the victory display.
flavor: The world is changing around us. I think, truly, for the better. - from the personal diary of Susan Pearl

name: Pearl Estate Ruins
text: [action]: Resign. You leave the heath behind. Add all Crystal Remains you control to the victory display.
flavor: The former orchard and farm has turned to powder from years of neglect. Nearly two decades have passed, yet nature has not reclaimed the opulent estate.

name: Ashen Slope
text: Forced - When you reveal Ashen Slope: Test [agility] (4). If you fail, take 2 damage.
flavor: The soft ash makes navigating the steep terrain especially treacherous.

name: Salt Chamber
text: Revelation - Put Salt Chamber into play adjacent to the location from which it was drawn ([codex] Ω) (page 21). [action] Investigators at Salt Chamber spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Draw the top card of the stack beneath Salt Chamber. (Group limit once per round.)

name: Larval Tunnel
text: Revelation - Put Larval Tunnel into play adjacent to the location from which it was drawn. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Colorless Larva and spawn it at this location ([codex] Ψ) (page 21). [reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy at Larval Tunnel: Draw the top card of the stack beneath this location. (Group limit once per round.)

name: Crystal Nursery
text: Revelation - Put Crystal Nursery into play adjacent to the location from which it was drawn ([codex] Ф) (page 21). [reaction] After you end your turn in Crystal Nursery, take 1 direct horror: Draw the top card of the stack beneath Crystal Nursery. (Group limit once per round.)

name: Commanding Resonance
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, choose a different option from the following, if able: - Take 1 damage. - Discard 1 card at random from your hand. - The nearest [[Insect]] enemy readies, moves (one location at a time) until it reaches your location, engages you, and makes an immediate attack.

name: Defend the Nest
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (2). Increase the difficulty of this test by 1 for each [[Lair]] location in play. If you fail, place 1 doom on the nearest [[Insect]] enemy. (If you cannot, take 2 horror instead.)
flavor: These ants can literally make mountains out of molehills.

name: Colorless Larva
text: Aloof. Forced - After Colorless Larva attacks: Defeat it.
flavor: The pale fluid dripping from the larva's eyes almost resemble tears.

name: Brood Soldier
text:
Aloof. Patrol ([[Cave]] location with clues).
While Brood Soldier is ready, its location gets +2 shroud.
flavor: "The creatures were 8-12 feet long. Vestigial wings. Completely blind. Their venom burned like fire." - Dr. Rosa Marquez, Miskatonic Survey, 1926

name: Brood Queen
text: Spawn - ([codex] Σ) (page 21). Massive. Alert. [[Insect]] enemies at Brood Queen's location lose aloof. Brood Queen gets +1 fight for each other [[Insect]] enemy in play and +X [per_investigator] health, where X is the current day number.

name: Crystal Remains
text: Revelation - Put Crystal Remains into play in your play area. If Crystal Remains is defeated, shuffle it with the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and place them facedown in a stack beneath the nearest [[Lair]] location. Forced - When your turn begins: Take 1 damage or horror.

name: Crystal Remains
text: Revelation - Put Crystal Remains into play in your play area. If Crystal Remains is defeated, shuffle it with the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and place them facedown in a stack beneath the nearest [[Lair]] location. Forced - When your turn begins: Take 1 horror.

name: Crystal Remains
text: Revelation - Put Crystal Remains into play in your play area. If Crystal Remains is defeated, shuffle it with the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and place them facedown in a stack beneath the nearest [[Lair]] location. Forced - When your turn begins: Take 1 damage.

name: The Lost Sister
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half the number of revealed [[Cave]] locations in play (rounded up).
[cultist]: -1. If you succeed, heal 1 horror.
[tablet]: -2. If you are at a [[Cave]] location, treat this token's modifier as -4 instead.
[elder_thing]: -2. If an [[Abomination]] enemy is at your location, reveal another token.

name: Into the Caves
text: Cards at [[Dark]] locations use (Night [night]) effects. Cards at all other locations use (Day [day]) effects.
flavor: Waves crash on the shoreline, threatening to wipe out a set of footprints that lead into the tidal caverns. You catch the faintest glimpse of a dim, blue glow deep within the tunnels.

name: Darkness Closes In
text: Cards at [[Dark]] locations use (Night [night]) effects. Cards at all other locations use (Day [day]) effects.
flavor: The cavern walls are alive with churning, shifting fungal growths. And they seem to be following you.

name: The Missing Sibling
text: Forced - After the last clue is discovered from a [[Cave]] location: Put the top card of the Caverns deck into play adjacent to that location. Objective - Find Elizabeth Peters! If the investigators "found a torn dog leash" and "found a set of footprints," immediately advance.
flavor: Elizabeth Peters has gone missing in these coastal caves, chasing after the family dog. Helen is determined to get her back.

name: On the Trail
text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues and choose an enemy at a connecting [[Dark]] location: Move that enemy to your location. Objective - When an investigator enters Fungal Cave, immediately advance.
flavor: Lizzie's glowing footprints lead to an unexplored chamber deep in the caverns. Through your exploration, you now know how to lure the ravenous creatures with glowing moss out of the darkness and into the light.

name: Face to Carapace
text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues and choose an enemy at a connecting [[Dark]] location: Move that enemy to your location. Objective - If Limulus Hybrid is defeated, immediately advance.
flavor: The abomination from the depths of the caves stalks you through the tunnels. You can only hope you can buy Helen and her sister enough time to escape.

name: Akwan
text: [action]: Resign. You give up the search. If it is Day 1 or Day 2, Akwan gains: "[action]: Parley. You ask around the village about the coastal caves. Look at the top 3 cards of the Caverns deck. Return them to the top of the Caverns deck in any order."

name: Suspended Graveyard
text: [action] Take 1 horror: You dig through the bone-strewn moss covering the walls. Put the top card of the Caverns deck into play adjacent to this location. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: Dozens of grinning skulls and reaching skeletal arms hang down from the walls and ceiling.

name: Hidden Cove
text: [action] Investigators at Hidden Cove spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that the investigators "found a torn dog leash." Forced - After you fail a skill test while fighting at Hidden Cove: Take 1 damage.

name: Weed-Choked Beach
text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while attempting to evade at Weed-Choked Beach: Lose 1 action. Forced - When you would leave Weed-Choked Beach: Reveal a chaos token. If a [skull], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] is revealed, you must either cancel the effects of the move or discard an [[Item]] asset you control.

name: Rocky Shoreline
text: Forced - After you reveal Rocky Shoreline: Spawn a set-aside Crustacean Hybrid enemy at this location, (In the Light) side faceup.
flavor: Worse things than seaweed and jellyfish have washed up on this beach.

name: Underground Pools
text: [action] Investigators at Underground Pools spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that the investigators "found a set of footprints." Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Underground Pools: Take 1 horror.

name: Open Cave
text: [fast] During your turn: Test [agility] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each ready enemy at this location. If you succeed, Open Cave loses the [[Dark]] trait until the beginning of the next investigation phase (all cards at this location to use (Day [day]) effects). (Group limit once per round.)

name: Fungal Cave
text: [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues from Fungal Cave: Heal 1 damage. (Group limit once per round.) Forced - At the end of the round: Each enemy at Fungal Cave heals 2 damage.

name: Limulus Hybrid [day]
text: Elusive. Massive. Limulus Hybrid gets +3 [per_investigator] health and cannot make attacks of opportunity. Forced - After Limulus Hybrid flips to this side: Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to it.

name: Limulus Hybrid [night]
text: Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Limulus Hybrid gets +3 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After you successfully attack Limulus Hybrid with a [[Melee]] card: Take 1 damage.

name: Crustacean Hybrid [day]
text: Elusive. Hunter. Crustacean Hybrid gets +X health, where X is the current day number. Forced - When Crustacean Hybrid would take damage from an attack: Reduce that damage to 1.

name: Crustacean Hybrid [night]
text: Hunter. Crustacean Hybrid gets +X health, where X is the current day number. Forced - After Crustacean Hybrid flips to this side: Crustacean Hybrid deals 1 damage to each investigator at its location.

name: Cavern Moss
text: Aloof. Hunter. While Cavern Moss is attached to an asset, it may be attacked as if it were an enemy engaged with you. Forced - After you succeed at a skill test while fighting or investigating at Cavern Moss's location, if it is ready: Attach Cavern Moss to an [[Item]] asset you control. Treat attached asset's text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]).

name: Reclaimed by Nature
text: (Day [day]) Revelation - Test [combat] (3). If you fail, you must either take 2 damage or choose the nearest enemy. That enemy attacks you. (Night [night]) Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, you must either take 2 horror, or each enemy at your location and each connecting location heals 1 damage.

name: Luminous Growth
text: Revelation - Attach Luminous Growth to the nearest revealed [[Dark]] location without Luminous Growth attached, if able. Attached location loses the [[Dark]] trait. Enemies at attached location get +1 fight and +1 damage. [action]: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, discard Luminous Growth.

name: Deepening Dark
text: Forced - After a location is revealed: Put locations from the top of the Woods deck into play above, below, to the left, and to the right of that location. Forced - When the investigation phase ends: Each investigator at a [[Dark]] location must either draw an enemy in pursuit with the highest evade or take 1 horror (cannot be canceled).
flavor: The silent woods thrum with the sounds of hungry creatures and stalking shadows.

name: Desperate Search
text: Each enemy without spawn instructions gains "Spawn - When this enemy is drawn from the encounter deck: Put this enemy in the pursuit area." Objective - At the end of the round, if each investigator is at the same [[Lair]] location, they may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: There must be some trace or clue of Bertie in these woods. You only hope you aren't already too late.

name: Ursine Hybrid
text: Spawn - ([codex] Σ) (page 37). Hunter. Retaliate. Ursine Hybrid gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When Ursine Hybrid would be defeated, if it is act 2: Heal all damage from it and put it in the pursuit area instead of the victory display.

name: Where's Bertie?
text: [fast] Spend 1 clue: Look at the revealed side of an adjacent location. Objective - Find Bertie Musgrave. He is lost deep in the forest! (Do not advance until you are instructed.)
flavor: The trees close in as you follow Bertie's trail deeper into the forest.

name: Back to the Vale!
text: [fast] Either exhaust the Vale Lantern or spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Look at the revealed side of an adjacent location. You may move to that location. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, (→R1) (page 38).
flavor: With Bertie in tow, you must find your way back to Hemlock Vale.

name: Vale Lantern
text: Vale Lantern's location and each connecting location lose the [[Dark]] trait. [reaction] When an investigator at your location moves into and reveals a [[Forest]] location, exhaust Vale Lantern: They ignore that location's forced effect(s). Forced - When Vale Lantern would leave play: Flip it over and place it at the nearest location, instead.

name: Vale Lantern
text: [action]: Take control of Vale Lantern, then flip it over. Any investigator at Vale Lantern's location may trigger this ability. Forced - When Vale Lantern would leave play: Place it at the nearest location, instead.

name: Vale Lantern
text: Vale Lantern's location loses the [[Dark]] trait. [action] Exhaust Vale Lantern: Look at the revealed side of a connecting location. You may move to that location, ignoring its forced effect(s). Forced - When Vale Lantern would leave play: Flip it over and place it at the nearest location, instead.

name: Vale Lantern
text: [fast]: Take control of Vale Lantern, then flip it over. Any investigator at Vale Lantern's location may trigger this ability. Forced - When Vale Lantern would leave play: Place it at the nearest location, instead.

name: Glimmering Woods
text: [action]: Resign. "I'm sure Bertie's fine!" [action]: Heal 1 horror. (Limit once per round.)
flavor:
A dim though distinct luminosity seemed to inhere in all the vegetation, grass, leaves, and blossoms alike...
 - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Colour Out of Space"

name: Blighted Glade
text: Forced - After you reveal Blighted Glade: Choose the enemy in pursuit with the lowest fight and spawn it at this location.
flavor:
The boughs surely moved, and there was no wind.
 - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Colour Out of Space"

name: Poisoned Marsh
text: Forced - After you reveal Poisoned Marsh: You must either take 1 direct damage, or deal 1 damage to each [[Ally]] asset you control.
flavor:
"Observed an intricate mycelium network with an animal-like digestive system. Fungus has reduced the wood to pulp."
 - Dr. Rosa Marquez, <u>Miskatonic Survey, 1926</u>

name: Fecund Thicket
text: Fecund Thicket gets -X shroud, where X is the current darkness level. Forced - After you reveal Fecund Thicket: Test [agility] (X), where X is the current darkness level. If you fail, find the enemy in pursuit with the highest printed health and spawn it at this location.

name: Mushroom Grove
text: Mushroom Grove gets +2 shroud while it is not [[Dark]]. Forced - After you reveal Mushroom Grove: Test [intellect] (X), where X is the current darkness level. If you fail, the enemy in pursuit with the highest evade attacks you.

name: Moonlit Clearing
text: While an enemy is moving, its location is considered to be connected to Moonlit Clearing. Forced - After you reveal Moonlit Clearing: Test [willpower] (X), where X is the current darkness level. If you fail, find the enemy in pursuit with the highest fight and spawn it at this location.

name: Crooked Path
text:
X is the current darkness level.
[reaction] After you discover a clue at this location: Look at the revealed side of a connecting location. You may move to that location.
flavor: The winding paths loop back on themselves.

name: Corpse Grove
text: Forced - After you reveal Corpse Grove: Take 1 horror. Forced - After you successfully investigate Corpse Grove: Take 1 horror.

name: Bear Den
text: Forced - After you reveal Bear Den: Find the enemy in pursuit with the highest fight and spawn it engaged with you. If you cannot, draw the top card of the encounter deck.
flavor: Whatever lives here is clearly starved to the point of eating its own kind.

name: The Twisted Hollow
text: Objective - At the end of the round, if each surviving investigator is at The Twisted Hollow, investigators may spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to advance to act 2b.
flavor: The knotted old tree has seen far more than you ever will.

name: Deep Shadows
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). This test gets +2 difficulty if your location is [[Dark]]. If you fail, you must either (choose one): - Take 2 horror. - The investigator who controls the Vale Lantern flips it to its [[Unlit]] side and places it at a connecting location.

name: Lurking Fear
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). This test gets +2 difficulty if your location is [[Dark]]. If you fail, you must either (choose one): - Take 2 damage. - Find the enemy in pursuit with the highest fight and spawn it engaged with you.

name: Stolen Light
text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the agenda to advance. - Flip the Vale Lantern to its [[Unlit]] side. Place the Vale Lantern at the empty location farthest from all investigators.

name: Stalking Hybrid
text: Hunter. Alert. X is the current darkness level. Prey - Investigator with the Vale Lantern only. Forced - After Stalking Hybrid attacks you, if you control the Vale Lantern: Flip the Vale Lantern to its [[Unlit]] side and place it at your location.

name: Barriers, Decoys, and Traps
text: Token Effects Enemies that ignore a token's effects do not trigger its Forced abilities. Resource Forced - When an enemy would move via a keyword and 1 or more barriers are between its location and the location it is moving to: Remove one of those barriers. Cancel the effects of the move. Horror Forced - When an enemy enters a location with a decoy: Remove the decoy. Deal 1 damage to that enemy, disengage it from each investigator, and exhaust it. That enemy cannot ready for the remainder of the round. Damage Forced - When an enemy enters a location with a trap: Remove the trap. Deal 2 damage to that enemy.

name: The Onslaught
text: When checking the doom threshold, doom on cards other than this agenda subtract from the total doom in play instead of adding to it. Forced - When a card effect would place doom on the agenda: Place it on The Captives story asset instead. Forced - After doom is placed on this agenda: In player order, each investigator draws the top card of the Enemy deck.
flavor: Your only hope is to last until dawn.

name: The Longest Night
text: [fast] During your turn, spend 1 clue: Place 1 barrier, decoy, or trap at your location. [action]: Resign. Then, if each undefeated investigator has resigned, (→R3) (page 50). Objective - Survive the night and protect as many captives as you can. (Do not advance until you are instructed.)
flavor: You must protect the captives!

name: The Farmhouse
text: The Farmhouse cannot have player card attachments, traps, or decoys. [fast] During your turn, spend 1 [per_investigator] resources: Move (to a connecting location). [action]: Gain 1 clue (from the token pool). (Group limit once per round.)

name: Milkhouse
text:
[reaction] When you would place a decoy or a trap at Milkhouse: Place it at an adjacent location instead.
[action]: Draw 1 set-aside Fire! treachery. Shuffle 1 copy of a set-aside Fire! treachery into the encounter deck. (Limit once per round.)

name: Vineyard
text: [fast] During your turn: Engage an enemy at Vineyard. (Limit once per turn.) Forced - When an enemy enters Vineyard: Heal 1 damage from it.
flavor: The grapes are all skin and pop like puffballs when touched.

name: Coop
text:
While there is a decoy on Coop, this location gets -2 shroud.
Each enemy at Coop gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
[action]: Draw 1 set-aside Fire! treachery. Shuffle 1 copy of a set-aside Fire! treachery into the encounter deck. (Limit once per round.)

name: Barn
text: Enemies at Barn get +1 damage value. Forced - When Barn is revealed: Place the set-aside Ajax story asset at this location ([codex] Ω).
flavor: The barn looks like it could collapse at any moment.

name: Pasture
text: [fast] During your turn, if Pasture has a trap on it: Move (to a connecting location). Forced - After a ready, unengaged enemy moves into Pasture via a keyword, if there are no barriers at Pasture: Resolve that keyword again.

name: Outer Fields
text:
[action]: Move an enemy to a connecting location. (Group limit once per game.)
[reaction] After you discover the last clue from this location: Heal 2 damage from The Captives. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Outer Fields
text: [fast] During your turn: Look at the top 1 [per_investigator] cards of the Enemy deck. Discard any number of them and put the rest back on top in any order. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Outer Fields
text:
[reaction] After you discover the last clue from this location: Place 1 barrier at this location.
[fast] During your turn: Choose a barrier at any location and move it to any other location. (Limit once per turn.)

name: Outer Fields
text:
[reaction] After you discover the last clue from this location: Place 1 trap at this location.
[fast] During your turn: Choose a trap at any location and move it to any other location. (Limit once per turn.)

name: Outer Fields
text:
[reaction] After you discover the last clue from this location: Place 1 decoy at this location.
[fast] During your turn: Choose a decoy at any location and move it to any other location. (Limit once per turn.)

name: The Captives
text: During the enemy phase, each ready, unengaged enemy at The Farmhouse attacks as though it were engaged with The Captives. Horror dealt to The Captives in this way is dealt as damage instead. Forced - When The Captives story asset is defeated: (→R3) (page 50).

name: Ursine Hybrid
text: Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Prey - Lead investigator. Ursine Hybrid gets +3 [per_investigator] health and ignores barriers and decoys. While this enemy is moving, each [[Field]] location is considered connected to one another.

name: Molting Hybrid
text: Spawn - Outer Fields (east). Aloof. Patrol (The Farmhouse). Molting Hybrid ignores barriers. Forced - When Molting Hybrid would take any amount of damage: Reduce that amount to 1.

name: Molting Hybrid
text: Spawn - Outer Fields (south). Aloof. Patrol (The Farmhouse). Molting Hybrid ignores barriers. Forced - When Molting Hybrid would take any amount of damage: Reduce that amount to 1.

name: Molting Hybrid
text: Spawn - Outer Fields (west). Aloof. Patrol (The Farmhouse). Molting Hybrid ignores barriers. Forced - When Molting Hybrid would take any amount of damage: Reduce that amount to 1.

name: Lupine Hybrid
text: Spawn - Outer Fields (north). Retaliate. Patrol (The Farmhouse). Forced - After Lupine Hybrid attacks: Heal 1 damage from it.
flavor:
...strangely, they didn't howl. They laughed.
 - Dr. Rosa Marquez, <u>Miskatonic Survey, 1926</u>

name: Lupine Hybrid
text: Spawn - Outer Fields (east). Retaliate. Patrol (The Farmhouse). Forced - After Lupine Hybrid attacks: Heal 1 damage from it.
flavor:
...strangely, they didn't howl. They laughed.
 - Dr. Rosa Marquez, <u>Miskatonic Survey, 1926</u>

name: Lupine Hybrid
text: Spawn - Outer Fields (south). Retaliate. Patrol (The Farmhouse). Forced - After Lupine Hybrid attacks: Heal 1 damage from it.
flavor:
...strangely, they didn't howl. They laughed.
 - Dr. Rosa Marquez, <u>Miskatonic Survey, 1926</u>

name: Capra Hybrid
text: Spawn - Outer Fields location with the fewest enemies. Alert. Patrol (The Farmhouse). Capra Hybrid ignores decoys.
flavor:
I suppose that, like any goat, it eats everything.
 - Dr. Rosa Marquez, <u>Miskatonic Survey, 1926</u>

name: Equine Hybrid
text: Spawn - Outer Fields (north). Patrol (The Farmhouse). Equine Hybrid ignores traps. Forced - When Equine Hybrid would take any amount of damage: Reduce that amount to 1.

name: Equine Hybrid
text: Spawn - Outer Fields (east). Patrol (The Farmhouse). Equine Hybrid ignores traps. Forced - When Equine Hybrid would take any amount of damage: Reduce that amount to 1.

name: Equine Hybrid
text: Spawn - Outer Fields (west). Patrol (The Farmhouse). Equine Hybrid ignores traps. Forced - When Equine Hybrid would take any amount of damage: Reduce that amount to 1.

name: Slithering Hybrid
text: Spawn - Outer Fields location with the most enemies. Aloof. Patrol (The Farmhouse). Slithering Hybrid ignores barriers, decoys, traps, and damage from Fire! treacheries.

name: Endless Night
text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Remove 1 doom from the agenda. - Deal 2 damage to The Captives story asset. - Take 3 direct damage and 3 direct horror.

name: Incursion
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (X). X is half the number of doom in play (rounded up). For each point you fail by, choose a different [[Mutated]] enemy nearest to The Farmhouse and ready it. Each chosen enemy moves, engages, and attacks as if it were the enemy phase.

name: The Silence
text: If you look at the Cosmic Emissary enemy for more than 15 seconds at a time, you are driven insane. Forced - When you would draw 1 or more cards from the encounter deck: Instead, reveal cards from the bottom of The Abyss until a card with an encounter card back is revealed and draw it (all other revealed cards are placed on top of The Abyss).
flavor: A hoary shape flickers in spiraling gas.

name: The Miasma
text: If you look at the Cosmic Emissary enemy for more than 15 seconds at a time, you are driven insane. Forced - When you would draw 1 or more cards from the encounter deck: Instead, reveal cards from the bottom of The Abyss until a card with an encounter card back is revealed and draw it (all other revealed cards are placed on top of The Abyss).
flavor: Nightmarish shapes coalesce in the mist.

name: The Spiral
text: If you look at the Cosmic Emissary enemy for more than 15 seconds at a time, you are driven insane. Forced - When you would draw 1 or more cards from the encounter deck: Instead, reveal cards from the bottom of The Abyss until a card with an encounter card back is revealed and draw it (all other revealed cards are placed on top of The Abyss).
flavor: Your vision refracts like broken glass.

name: Shattered Memories
text: [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test at a [[Lair]] location during your turn: Reveal cards from the bottom of The Abyss for each point you succeed by. Draw 1 of them, shuffle the rest, and place them on top of The Abyss. [fast] Spend 1 clue: You get +2 skill value for this skill test. Objective - If each player has their "true" investigator card, advance.
flavor: Why Ii sii Tso Obr ig htT aml drEa Min G?

name: Lost Self
text: [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test at a [[Lair]] location during your turn: Reveal cards from the bottom of The Abyss for each point you succeed by. Draw 1 of them, shuffle the rest, and place them on top of The Abyss. [fast] Spend 1 clue: You get +2 skill value for this skill test. Objective - At the end of the round, if there are 3 or more revealed [[Cave]] locations in play with no clues on them, advance.
flavor: You must find a way back to the Vale!

name: Fate of the Vale (v.I)
text: [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test at a [[Lair]] location during your turn: Reveal cards from the bottom of The Abyss for each point you succeed by. Draw each single-sided enemy card revealed by this effect. Remove each other revealed card from the game. [fast] Spend 1 clue: You get +2 skill value for this skill test. Objective - At the end of the round, if each surviving investigator is at The Abyss, investigators may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: Dr. Marquez needs your help to save the Vale!

name: Fate of the Vale (v.II)
text: [action] Choose and discard 1 card from your hand: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, draw the [[Resident]] card beneath your location, enemy side faceup. You may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues to put it into play exhausted. Objective - If no [[Resident]] enemies are beneath locations or in play, you may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: You'll have to either talk sense into the frenzied residents... or knock it out of them.

name: Fate of the Vale (v.III)
text: [action] Spend X [per_investigator] clues: Place X resources on your location, as kindling (you may spend 5 resources or discard an [[Item]] asset you control to place 1 additional kindling). [action] If your location has kindling on it equal to or greater than its shroud value, remove all kindling from it: Draw 1 set-aside Fire! treachery. (Group limit once per location.) Objective - When the round ends, if there are 5 copies of Fire! in play, immediately advance.
flavor: Your only hope of stopping this thing is to burn this accursed island. All of it.

name: Fate of the Vale (v.IV)
text: [action] If at least 5 of the following are true (the investigators found gas, the investigators found Theo's truck, the road is clear, the survey notes were recovered, Bertie is fleeing, the samples were found): Resign. You flee the Vale. Objective - Escape with your lives! If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
flavor: You must escape with your lives!

name: Shattered Self
text:
Your maximum hand size is reduced by 3.
X is the number of cards in your hand (max 5).
[reaction] After you commit a card to a skill test you are performing: Double the skill icons on that card until the end of this test. (Limit once per test.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may draw 1 card.
flavor: I art thou uoht ma I

name: Old Memory
