text: [reaction] When a card is revealed or drawn from The Abyss, spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, and remove Old Memory from the game: Either choose an investigator to draw that card, or cancel that card's revelation effect and remove it from the game.

name: Cosmic Emissary
text: Massive. Cosmic Emissary gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Each investigator tests [willpower] (100). Each investigator who fails is devoured (they are killed).

name: Cosmic Emissary
text: Aloof. Hunter. Retaliate. Prey - Highest [combat]. Forced - After you reveal an [elder_thing] token during a skill test at this location: Either this test automatically fails, or this enemy attacks you.

name: Cosmic Emissary
text: Aloof. Hunter. Alert. Prey - Highest [agility]. Forced - After you reveal a [cultist] token during a skill test at this location: Either this test automatically fails, or this enemy attacks you.

name: Cosmic Emissary
text: Aloof. Elusive. Hunter. Prey - Highest [willpower]. Forced - After you reveal a [tablet] token during a skill test at this location: Either this test automatically fails, or this enemy attacks you.

name: Mirror Nest
text: Mirror Nest is connected to the location in the clockwise and counter-clockwise directions. Forced - When you end your turn at this location, if you did not successfully fight this round: You must either place 1 of your clues on this location, or discard 1 card at random from your hand.

name: Mirror Nest
text: Mirror Nest is connected to the location in the clockwise and counter-clockwise directions. Forced - When you end your turn at this location, if you did not successfully evade this round: You must either place 1 of your clues on this location, or discard 1 card at random from your hand.

name: Mirror Nest
text: Mirror Nest is connected to the location in the clockwise and counter-clockwise directions. Forced - When you end your turn at this location, if you did not successfully investigate this round: You must either place 1 of your clues on this location, or discard 1 card at random from your hand.

name: Mirror Nest
text: Mirror Nest is connected to the location in the clockwise and counter-clockwise directions. Forced - When you end your turn at this location: Discard 1 card at random from your hand. [action] Spend 7 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Search The Abyss for a card and draw it. (Group limit once per act.)

name: The Abyss
text: Forced - When you enter The Abyss, if there are cards in The Abyss: You are killed. During the enemy phase, each [[Shattered]] enemy at The Abyss loses aloof. The Abyss always covers the top of The Abyss deck.

name: The Abyss
text: This card must always cover the top of The Abyss. Cards are always drawn and revealed from the bottom of The Abyss. When a non-weakness encounter card is discarded, it is always placed on top of The Abyss. Forced - When you draw a card from The Abyss, if that card is ... - ...a treachery or an enemy: Draw it. - ...a [[Resident]] card: Flip it to its enemy side. It gains "Revelation - This enemy attacks you (without engaging you). Discard this enemy." - ...a player card: Add it to its owner's hand. - ...a location: Put it into play, unrevealed, adjacent to the nearest Mirror Nest (that is not already connected to a [[Cave]] location, if able). For the remainder of this scenario, the two locations are connected to one another. - ...any investigator's "true" investigator card: Its owner heals all damage and horror and takes control of it. Then, they flip their Shattered Self investigator card to its Old Memory side and put it into play under their control.

name: Crystal Mimic
text: Elusive. Hunter. While you are fighting or evading this enemy, X is the number of cards in your hand. Otherwise, X is 6. Forced - After Crystal Mimic attacks you: Discard 1 card at random from your hand.

name: Sublimation
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, you must decide (choose one): - For each point you fail by, choose 1 card in your hand to place on top of The Abyss. - The nearest Cosmic Emissary enemy attacks you (even if it is not at your location).

name: Fragmentation
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail, you must decide (choose one): - Choose the asset in your play area with the highest printed cost and place it on top of The Abyss. - The nearest Cosmic Emissary enemy attacks you (even if it is not at your location).

name: Euphoria
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (4). You must either take 2 horror, or place a non-story asset you control on top of The Abyss. If you fail, do both.
flavor:
"There is a heart / Within the blight /
We'll all go down / To purest light."
 - "The Lands Beyond", Songs of Bliss no. 235

name: Swarm
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either lose 1 resource or take 1 damage.
flavor:
"Most of the creatures seemed not quite usual in their aspects and motions..."
 - H.P. Lovecraft, "The Colour Out of Space"

name: Downpour
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either lose 1 action or place 1 of your clues on your location.
flavor:
"...there descended such a blinding sheet of torrential rain that shelter became imperative."
 - H.P. Lovecraft, "The Lurking Fear"

name: Otherworldly Visions
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). This test gets +2 difficulty if there is a [[Colour]] enemy at your location. For each point you fail by, you must either take 1 horror or discard 1 card at random from your hand.
flavor: I am the eyes I am all eyes that see

name: Welcome to Hemlock Vale!
text: Forced - When you draw a weakness: cancel its revelation effect and discard it.
flavor: The Miskatonic Survey is staying in Hemlock Vale and making preparations for today's expedition. The more the locals trust you, the better you will understand the nature of Hemlock Isle.

name: Dawn of the First Day
text: Investigators cannot take damage/horror or be defeated. Objective - Befriend the locals and prepare for the first survey! (Refer to the rules on page 6 for more information on preludes)
flavor: The village brims with excitement! Children play along the roadside wearing animal masks, while others hang gaudy flowers on eaves and along fences.

name: Dark Clouds
text: Forced - When you draw a weakness: cancel its revelation effect and discard it.
flavor: Dreary clouds threaten rain as thunder rumbles overhead. Locals bustle about making preparations.

name: Dawn of the Second Day
text: Investigators cannot take damage/horror or be defeated. Objective - Talk to the locals and learn more about Hemlock Isle!
flavor: The village continues preparations with cheery resolve, despite the dour weather.

name: All is Full of Love
text: Forced - When you draw a weakness: Cancel its revelation effect and discard it.
flavor: The people of the Vale dance with an almost manic energy. Riotous music and a sweet perfume scent hang in the air.

name: Dawn of the Final Day
text: Objective - Talk to the locals and prepare yourself for the Feast.
flavor: A beautiful sheen hangs over everything, shimmering in the air around you.

name: Around the Table
text: Objective - Confront Mother Rachel! If Mother Rachel is defeated: (→R1).
flavor: Revelers dance to raucous music while others gorge themselves on rank platters of oily food. Visitors and locals alike collapse in fits of laughter while others claw at their eyes. Each of them wear a wild, gleeful smile.

name: Lambs to the Slaughter
text: You cannot trigger [codex] codex entries. [reaction] After you evade a [[Resident]] enemy by 2 or more: Add them to the victory display. Objective - If 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] [[Resident]] cards are in the victory display, (→R3) (page 60).
flavor: You must gather Mother Rachel's flock, willing or not, to their place at the table.

name: The Crossroads
text: [action]: You ask the locals about the Vale ([codex] 10). [fast] If there are exactly 1 or 2 investigators in the game, during your turn: Move (to a connecting location). (Group limit once per round.)
flavor: Dozens of visitors gather around the base of the effigy.

name: The Crossroads
text: [action]: Parley. You exhort the locals for help. Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, move 1 damage from your investigator to a [[Resident]] enemy at The Crossroads.
flavor: A crowd of revelers dance around a roaring bonfire. Mother Rachel stands before it, smiling broadly.

name: The Old Mill
text: [action] [action]: Discover 1 clue at The Old Mill.
flavor: The mill appears to have been overtaken by sharp, knotted vines and fecund vegetation.

name: The Old Mill
text: [action]: You investigate the sounds of something rustling in the undergrowth ([codex] 12).
flavor: The daylight gives way to long, sinister shadows.

name: Frenzied Reveler
text: Forced - When Frenzied Reveler is defeated: Place 1 doom on the agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance. [action]: Parley. Test [agility] (4). If you succeed, remove Frenzied Reveler from the game.

name: Boarding House
text: [action]: You ask around about the Vale ([codex] 9). [action]: Heal 1 damage or 1 horror. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: They say Ms. Olmstead runs a very tight ship.

name: Boarding House
text:
The first encounter card drawn at this location each round gains surge.
[action]: Test [willpower] (3), then [agility] (2), then [combat] (1). If you succeed at each of these tests, draw 3 cards. Then, if the current act is Fate of the Vale (v.IV), remember that "the investigators found gas."

name: The Crossroads
text: [action]: You ask the locals about the Vale ([codex] 10). [fast] If there are exactly 1 or 2 investigators in the game, during your turn: Move (to a connecting location). (Group limit once per round.)
flavor: The elaborate effigy is the tallest structure in the Vale.

name: The Crossroads
text:
During the enemy phase, each [[Shattered]] enemy at The Crossroads loses aloof.
[reaction] After you successfully evade a [[Shattered]] enemy at The Crossroads by 3 or more, if the current act is Fate of the Vale (v.IV): Remember that "the road is clear."

name: Hemlock Chapel
text: [action]: You approach the overgrown chapel at the top of the hill ([codex] 11). [action]: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Spell]] card and draw it. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: The chapel looks like something out of a storybook.

name: Hemlock Chapel
text: Forced - After the last clue is discovered from Hemlock Chapel: Place 1 clue on each location in play. (Max once per game.) [action]: Heal 1 horror. Return a [[Spell]] card from your discard pile to your hand. (Limit once per game.)

name: The Old Mill
text: [reaction] After you discover a clue at The Old Mill: ([codex] 12).
flavor: The morning breeze carries the fresh scent of lupines, asters, yarrow, and meadowsweet into the Vale.

name: The Old Mill
text: [action]: Test [agility] (8). If you succeed, heal 2 damage (if you fail you may spend 2 [per_investigator] clues to automatically succeed instead). Then, if the current act is Fate of the Vale (v.IV), remember that "the samples were found."

name: The Atwood House
text: [action]: You approach the old homestead ([codex] 13).
flavor: The dour façade of the old house carries a hint of its former glory. The locals seem to avoid the property.

name: The Atwood House
text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating The Atwood House: Take 1 horror. [action]: Test [willpower] (8). If you succeed, heal 2 horror (if you fail, you may spend 2 [per_investigator] clues to automatically succeed instead). Then, if the current act is Fate of the Vale (v.IV), remember that "the survey notes were recovered."

name: Tad's General Store
text: [action]: Parley. You haggle for goods and chat with the locals ([codex] 14).
flavor: The general store is abustle with locals and visitors buying up supplies for the coming Feast.

name: Tad's General Store
text:
Enemies at Tad's General Store get +1 fight.
[reaction] After a kindling is placed on this location: Place 1 additional kindling. (Group limit once per round.)
flavor: A putrid stench wafts out of the emporium.

name: Vale Schoolhouse
text: [action]: You peruse the school library ([codex] 15). [action]: Search your deck for a [[Tome]] asset and draw it. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: Several roads lead past the schoolhouse toward Hemlock Isle's southern point.

name: Vale Schoolhouse
text:
Enemies at Vale Schoolhouse get +1 evade.
[action]: Test [willpower] or [agility] (3). If you succeed, heal 1 damage or 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at this location. (Limit once per round.)
flavor: Fireflies dance in the air around the schoolhouse.

name: The Commons
text: [action]: You inspect the communal hall and check out the local delivery service ([codex] 16).
flavor: The long barn-sized building is host to many dinners, dances, and community events in the Vale.

name: The Commons
text:
While an enemy is moving, its location is considered to be connected to The Commons.
[action]: Test [intellect] (3), then [combat] (2), then [agility] (1). If you succeed at each of these tests, gain 5 resources. Then, if the current act is Fate of the Vale (v.IV), remember that "the investigators found Theo's truck."

name: Dry Burrow
text: (Day [day]) [fast] : Move (to a connecting location). (Group limit once per round.) (Night [night]) Forced - After you end your turn in Dry Burrow: Take 1 horror.
flavor: The open paths seem safe enough... but are they?

name: Alkaline Forest
text: Forced - After you reveal Alkaline Forest: You must either take 1 direct horror, or discard 2 cards at random from your hand.
flavor: The rock formations resemble a jagged grove, wreathed in poisonous red gas.

name: Iridescent Passage
text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Iridescent Passage: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
flavor: The mirror-like walls reflect your fractured face.

name: Overgrown Tunnel
text: While Overgrown Tunnel has clues on it, you must spend 1 additional action to move out of Overgrown Tunnel.
flavor: Thick sinewy roots choke the surrounding tunnels.

name: Mineral Tunnel
text: While you are investigating Mineral Tunnel, it gets +1 shroud for each card in your hand (max +6 shroud on Easy/Standard difficulty).
flavor: The formations resemble a shark's many-rowed teeth, and are just as sharp.

name: Crystal Parasite
text: Hunter. Retaliate. (Day [day]) Forced - After Crystal Parasite attacks: Heal 2 damage from it. (Night [night]) Crystal Parasite gets +2 fight and +1 damage value for every 2 damage on it.

name: Chroma Blight
text: Revelation - Put Chroma Blight into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - After you draw 1 or more cards from your deck: Place 1 resource on Chroma Blight, as brilliance. Forced - If there is a total of 6 brilliance on Chroma Blight: Put a set-aside copy of Crystal Parasite into play at your location. Remove Chroma Blight from the game.

name: Calcification
text: Revelation - Put Calcification into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - The first time you move each round: Take 1 direct damage. [action]: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, discard Calcification. (You may take 1 direct damage for this test to automatically succeed.)

name: Miasmatic Shadow
text: Aloof. Hunter. (Night [night]) Elusive. Cannot be damaged except by [[Spell]], [[Relic]], [[Science]], or encounter cards. Forced - When you discard 1 or more cards from hand at Miasmatic Shadow's location, if it is ready: It engages you and makes an immediate attack.

name: Alien Whispers
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must (choose one): - Take 1 damage, which can only be assigned to an asset you control. - Take 1 horror, which can only be assigned to an asset you control. - Discard 1 card at random from your hand.

name: Strange Mutations
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each horror on you. If you fail, you must either take 2 horror, or discard 2 cards at random from your hand.
flavor: Knotty, scaly growths erupt on the skin, resembling scales or vestigial fingernails.

name: Fungal Rot
text: Revelation - Attach Fungal Rot to an [[Item]] asset you control without Fungal Rot attached. If you cannot, Fungal Rot gains surge. Treat attached asset's text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]). [action]: Test [combat] (3). If you succeed, discard Fungal Rot. Otherwise, take 1 damage.

name: Enervation
text: Revelation - Test [combat] (5). Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each damage on you. If you fail, you must either take 2 damage, or choose the card with the highest printed cost in your hand and discard it.
flavor: The sores won't heal on their own, and emit a sharp chemical scent.

name: Desiccation
text: Revelation - Put Desiccation into play next to the agenda deck. As an additional cost for an investigator to play a card, they must take 1 damage. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Desiccation from play. (Max once per round.)

name: Empyrean Brilliance
text: (Day [day]) Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). Increase the difficulty of this test by 2 if you have 5 or more cards in hand. If you fail, choose and discard 2 cards from your hand. (Night [night]) Revelation - Discard 1 card at random from your hand. Test [willpower] (X). X is that card's printed cost. If you fail, take 2 horror.

name: Captivating Gleam
text: Surge. Revelation - Put Captivating Gleam into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - If you have no cards in hand: Take 5 horror and discard Captivating Gleam.
flavor: Who do you see beyond the veil?

name: Poisonblossom
text: Retaliate. (Day [day]) Poisonblossom gets +1 health and +1 damage value for each overgrowth on it. (Night [night]) Poisonblossom gets +1 fight and +1 damage value for each overgrowth on it. Forced - At the end of the round: Place 1 resource on Poisonblossom, as overgrowth.

name: Forest Watcher
text: Aloof. (Night [night]) Elusive. Spawn - Any location (empty, if able). Forced - After Forest Watcher enters play: Place 1 doom on it.
flavor: Don't even try to pet it.

name: Cochleal Stag
text: Elusive. (Night [night]) Hunter. Each investigator at Cochleal Stag's location and each connecting location gets -2 to all skills during the mythos phase.
flavor: Half the majestic creature's flesh has been replaced with vascular, bark-like tissue.

name: Bloom
text: Revelation - Choose the nearest [[Flora]] enemy and heal all damage from it (if that enemy is [[Elite]], heal 2 [per_investigator] damage from it instead). If no damage was healed by this effect, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Flora]] card is discarded and draw it.

name: Wall of Thorns
text: Revelation - Attach Wall of Thorns to the nearest location without Wall of Thorns attached. (Day [day]) Forced - When you move into attached location: Take 2 damage. Discard Wall of Thorns. (Night [night]) Forced - When you move into or out of attached location: Take 1 damage.

name: Call of the Wild
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, choose the nearest enemy. That enemy attacks you. If you failed and no enemy was chosen, take 2 damage instead.
flavor:
"...even the herbivores seem to have developed an unusual ability to plan, coordinate, and hunt."
 - Dr. Rosa Marquez, <u>Miskatonic Survey, 1926</u>

name: Black Amanita
text: (Day [day]) Aloof. (Night [night]) Massive. Forced - After you discover a clue at Black Amanita's location or a connecting location, if it is ready: Take 1 direct horror.
flavor:
"...and their spores smell of rotting meat."
 - Dr. Rosa Marquez, Miskatonic Survey, 1926

name: Corpse Lichen
text: (Day [day]) Corpse Lichen cannot move. (Night [night]) Hunter. Alert. Forced - After Corpse Lichen attacks: Heal 1 damage from it.
flavor: The lichens animate the fleshless bones.

name: Psychotropic Spores
text: Revelation - Put Psychotropic Spores into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - The first time you draw 1 or more cards from your deck each round: Take 1 direct horror. [action]: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, discard Psychotropic Spores. (You may take 1 direct horror for this test to automatically succeed.)

name: Sudden Mutation
text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest non-[[Elite]] enemy. If you cannot, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Mutated]] enemy and draw it. Forced - When attached enemy is defeated: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded and spawn it at this location.

name: Unnatural Growth
text: Revelation - Place 1 doom on the nearest enemy with no doom on it. If no doom was placed by this effect, discard 2 cards at random from your hand.
flavor:
"It is not the strongest of the species that survives, not the most intelligent that survives. It is the one that is most adaptable to change"
 - Charles Darwin

name: Fire!
text: Revelation - Attach Fire! to the nearest location with no copy of Fire! attached (connected to a location with Fire! attached, if able). [action]: Test [agility] (4). If you succeed, discard Fire! Forced - At the end of the round: Each card with health at this location takes 1 direct damage.

name: Something Else Stirs...
text: *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold. Forced - When this agenda advances: Do not remove doom from locations in play. Forced - When an investigator is defeated: That investigator shuffles each [[Ancient]] story asset they control into the exploration deck.
flavor: You've made your way to the Eztli ruins in search of ancient artifacts.

name: Dweller in the Pit
text: Hunter. Retaliate. Spawn - Engaged with Monterey Jack. Dweller in the Pit gets +1 [per_investigator] health and +1 fight for each vengeance point in the victory display (max +3 fight). Forced - After Dweller in the Pit deals damage to you, check your supplies: If you do not have the satchel, shuffle each [[Ancient]] asset you control into the exploration deck.

name: Guardian of the Relics
text: *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold. Forced - When an investigator is defeated: That investigator shuffles each [[Ancient]] story asset they control into the exploration deck.
flavor: From the darkness of the tunnel before you, the creature lumbers forward with a reptilian hiss.

name: Crumbling Ruin
text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - When each surviving investigator is at Inner Chamber, they may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: As you traverse the tight corridors of the ruin, you feel a deep rumbling beneath your feet.

name: Find the Way Out!
text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - Get out with as many [[Ancient]] relics as you can! If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.

name: Secret Passage
text: Revelation - If Secret Passage is connected to your location, put it and the set-aside Inner Chamber into play. Otherwise, shuffle it into the exploration deck. Forced - After you enter Secret Passage: Check your supplies. If you have the compass, discover 1 clue from Secret Passage.

name: Inner Chamber
text: [action] Spend X clues: Reveal the top X cards of the exploration deck. Draw 1 non-location card revealed in this way and check your supplies. If you have chalk, you may choose 1 additional non-location card revealed and draw it. Shuffle the remaining cards into the exploration deck.

name: Ancient Hall
text: Forced - After doom is placed on Ancient Hall: Shuffle the top card of the encounter deck into the exploration deck. Any investigator at Ancient Hall may spend 3 resources to cancel this effect.
flavor: The crumbling hall dares you to venture deeper.

name: Jade Crocodile
text: Revelation - Put Jade Crocodile into play under your control. You must either place 1 doom on your location, or take 2 damage. Forced - When you resign: Add Jade Crocodile to the victory display.

name: Obsidian Jaguar
text: Revelation - Put Obsidian Jaguar into play under your control. You must either place 1 doom on your location, or the nearest enemy attacks you. Forced - When you resign: Add Obsidian Jaguar to the victory display.

name: Citrine Snake
text: Revelation - Put Citrine Snake into play under your control. If you are poisoned, take 1 direct damage. If you are not poisoned, put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area. Forced - When you resign: Add Citrine Snake to the victory display.

name: Turquoise Eagle
text: Revelation - Put Turquoise Eagle into play under your control. You must either place 1 doom on your location, or take 2 horror. Forced - When you resign: Add Turquoise Eagle to the victory display.

name: Vengeant Past
text: Peril. Revelation - For each [[Ancient]] story asset controlled by an investigator, you must either (choose one): - Deal 1 damage or horror to that asset's controller. - Shuffle that asset into the exploration deck. After this effect resolves, shuffle Vengeant Past into the exploration deck.

name: The Midwinter Gala
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the current agenda number.
[cultist]: -X. X is the number of [[Guest]] assets at your location (to a maximum of 5).
[tablet]: -2. (-4 instead if you are at a [[Private]] location).
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail or if The Bloodless Man is at your location, take 1 horror.

name: Masked Revelers
text: Each [[Lantern Club]] enemy cannot be dealt damage. Doom cannot be removed from this agenda by card effects. Forced - When a single-sided [[Guest]] asset would leave play: It becomes spellbound instead (flip it facedown, lose control of it, and heal all damage and horror from it).
flavor: Promising to be a night of intrigue and wonder, the gala is expected to be filled with secrets and whispers that are as much a part of the entertainment as the drinks and music.

name: Unexpected Guests
text: Parley abilities on each [[Lantern Club]] enemy cannot be triggered. Doom cannot be removed from this agenda by card effects. Forced - When a single-sided [[Guest]] asset would leave play: It becomes spellbound instead (flip it facedown, lose control of it, and heal all damage and horror from it).
flavor: Commotion stirs deeper within the manor as various guests ask the attendants to be let out. Other guests shuffle through the manor with dead eyes and blank stares.

name: A Killer Party
text: Parley abilities on each [[Lantern Club]] enemy cannot be triggered. Doom cannot be removed from this agenda by card effects. Forced - When a single-sided [[Guest]] asset would leave play: It becomes spellbound instead (flip it facedown, lose control of it, and heal all damage and horror from it).
flavor: The party descends into utter mayhem, with guests throwing themselves out of glass doors and windows to escape the otherworldly monstrosities.

name: Meet and Greet
text: [[Guest]] assets do not take up ally slots. [action] Choose a [[Guest]] asset and a skill icon on it at your location: Parley. Test that skill (3). If you succeed, take control of that asset. [action] If you control a [[Guest]] asset: Give control of it to another investigator at your location. Objective - If each undefeated investigator controls a [[Guest]] asset and the current agenda is 2a or 3a, they may spend the requisite amount of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: You notice the Jewel is no longer in the ballroom. Maybe a guest saw someone move it?

name: Finding the Jewel
text: [[Guest]] assets do not take up ally slots. [action] Choose a [[Guest]] asset and a skill icon on it at your location: Parley. Test that skill (3). If you succeed, take control of that asset. Objective - Complete the objective on your faction story card, and try to accomplish as many tasks as you can (see page 24 of the rulebook).
flavor: You must help your contact and their associates, no matter the cost.

name: Lobby
text: [fast] If the current agenda is 2a or 3a, spend 1 [per_investigator] resources: Someone is fashionably late. Reveal the top card of the Guest deck and put it into play at this location. (Group limit once per round.)
flavor: The winter chill lingers in your bones. Something feels wrong.

name: Lantern Chamber
text:
[fast] During your turn, name a card: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. If it is the named card, cancel its effects and discard it. Discover 1 clue at this location. (Limit once per turn.)
[action] If this location has no clues: Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, flip over any spellbound card.

name: Art Gallery
text: [action]: There's more to be discovered in this room full of strange works of art. Place up to 2 clues (from the token pool) on this location. Gain 2 resources. (Group limit once per round.)
flavor: There's nothing quite like the pieces on display here.

name: Ballroom
text: [action]: Parley. You persuade two of the guests to have a dance. Exhaust 2 [[Guest]] assets at this location. Then, heal 1 horror from each of them.
flavor: They're playing "Sogno e Follia in D Minor" by a little known composer named E. Zann.

name: Barroom
text: [fast] Spend 1 resource: Buy a drink! Heal 1 damage or 1 horror from an investigator or [[Guest]] asset at this location. (Group limit once per round.)
flavor: "This jag juice has a nice kick!"

name: Bedroom
text: [action] Choose an enemy at any [[Second Floor]] location: Fight. You may use [agility] instead of [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, you may spend 1 clue for this attack to deal +2 damage. (Limit once per turn.)

name: Library
text:
You get +1 skill value while parleying at this location.
[fast] If the Jewel of Sarnath is at this location: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, either place 1 damage on the Jewel of Sarnath or remove 1 token from it. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Parlor
text:
This location gets -1 shroud for each [[Guest]] asset at it (to a minimum of 1 shroud).
[fast] If you control the Jewel of Sarnath: Exhaust an enemy at any location. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: A moon-beast in a bottle? How bizarre.

name: The Foundation [guardian]
text: Forced - When The Bloodless Man (Unleashed) is defeated: If the Jewel of Sarnath is attached to him, attach it to his location. [action] If the Jewel of Sarnath is at your location and The Bloodless Man is not in play: Take control of the Jewel of Sarnath and place 1 damage on it. Objective - At the end of the round, if the investigators control the Jewel of Sarnath, they may spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to advance the act. End of game scoring: 4 points if no non-weakness enemies are in play (2 points instead if exactly one non-weakness enemy is in play).
flavor: The 'authorities' seem to want you to acquire the Jewel by force. Good luck taking it from the Bloodless Man.

name: The Foundation [guardian]
text: Setup: Shuffle the set-aside Rookie Cop enemy into the encounter deck. Put the set-aside Valeriya Antonova card into play at the lead investigator's location, enemy side faceup. [action] If Valeriya Antonova is at your location: Parley. Test [combat] (3). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues on this story card. Forced - When there are 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] clues on this story card: Add it and Valeriya Antonova to the victory display. Search the encounter deck, encounter discard pile, and all play areas for Rookie Cop and remove it from the game. If the encounter deck was searched, shuffle it.
flavor: The Foundation doesn't take kindly to your interest in the Jewel. If you make a show of force, you might convince them to back down.

name: Valeriya Antonova
text: You get +1 [combat]. [action] Exhaust Valeriya Antonova: Ready another [[Guest]] asset at your location. You get +1 to your next skill test this round for each [[Guest]] asset at your location. Forced - When Valeriya Antonova leaves play: Remove her from the game.

name: Valeriya Antonova
text: Aloof. Hunter. Valeriya Antonova cannot be damaged. Each investigator at this location gets -1 to each of their skills if they control an exhausted [[Guest]] asset. Forced - When the round ends: Exhaust each [[Guest]] asset at this location.

name: Archibald Hudson
text:
[fast] During your turn, exhaust Archibald Hudson: Search the top 9 cards of the encounter deck for an enemy, draw it, and shuffle the encounter deck. Then, exhaust that enemy and gain 3 resources.
[action] Spend 1 resource: Move 1 damage from an asset at your location to a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location.

name: Special Agent Callahan
text: [action]: Fight. Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1. [reaction] After you trigger an [action] ability on an [[Ally]] or [[Weapon]] asset, exhaust Special Agent Callahan: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
flavor: "Say hello to my lil' boy, Tommy!"

name: Horacio Martinez
text: While you control Horacio Martinez, he may be assigned damage dealt to other investigators at your location. [reaction] After a non-[[Elite]] enemy attacks you, exhaust Horacio Martinez: Exhaust that enemy and it cannot ready this round (do not disengage from it).

name: Rookie Cop
text: Surge. Aloof. Hunter. Forced - After an investigator at this location attacks another enemy: Deal 1 damage to that investigator.

name: Miskatonic University [seeker]
text: Declan Pearce cannot be damaged or leave play while the Jewel of Sarnath is attached to him. [action] If Declan Pearce is at your location: Parley. Place up to 2 of your clues on Declan Pearce. Then, if 3 [per_investigator] or more clues are on him, take control of the Jewel of Sarnath and add Declan Pearce to the victory display. Objective - At the end of the round, if the investigators control the Jewel of Sarnath, they may advance the act. End of game scoring: 1 point per 2 [per_investigator] total cards in hand among all investigators (to a maximum of 4 points).
flavor: You are assisting Dean Caldwell with "acquiring" the Jewel, but first you will have to persuade Declan Pearce to give it up.

name: Miskatonic University [seeker]
text: Setup: Shuffle the set-aside Confusion treachery into the encounter deck. Put the set-aside Caldwell Philips card into play at the lead investigator's location, enemy side faceup. [action] If Caldwell Philips is at your location: Parley. Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues on this story card. Forced - When there are 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] clues on this story card: Add it and Caldwell Philips to the victory display. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for Confusion and remove it from the game. Shuffle the encounter deck.
flavor: The eggheads at Miskatonic University seem to think this Jewel belongs in their museum. Perhaps you can help them see reason.

name: Caldwell Philips
text: You get +1 [intellect]. [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues, exhaust Caldwell Philips: Draw that number of cards (to a maximum of 3). Forced - When Caldwell Philips leaves play: Remove him from the game.

name: Caldwell Philips
text: Aloof. Hunter. Caldwell Philips cannot be damaged. Forced - When you end your turn at this location: Choose and discard a non-weakness card from your hand.

name: Dr. Mya Badry
text: Your maximum hand size is increased by 2. [action] Exhaust Dr. Mya Badry: Investigate. Your base [intellect] value for this investigation is equal to the number of cards in your hand.
flavor: "Disturbingly lifelike, isn't it?"

name: Lucas Tetlow
text: [reaction] After the last clue is discovered at your location, exhaust Lucas Tetlow: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for an [[Item]] asset and draw it. If it is a [[Relic]], gain 2 resources. If it is a [[Tome]], you may play it (paying its cost). If it is a [[Tool]], discover 1 clue at a connecting location. Shuffle your deck.

name: Elizabeth Conrad
text: [reaction] After you draw a card during your turn, exhaust Elizabeth Conrad: Choose an investigator at your location to move to a connecting location.
flavor: "Has anyone else tried the giggle juice? It's fantastic!"

name: Confusion
text: Surge. Confusion cannot be canceled. Revelation - Place 2 of your clues on your location. For each clue you cannot place, take 1 horror.
flavor: What is this???

name: The Syndicate [rogue]
text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Look at a mystery (a facedown card) beneath your location. [fast] During your turn, if there are 1 [per_investigator] or fewer clues on a location with a mystery: Draw that mystery. Objective - Find the Jewel of Sarnath and escape. At the end of the round, if an investigator at the Lobby controls the Jewel of Sarnath, the investigators may spend 4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to advance the act. End of game scoring: 1 point per 3 [per_investigator] resources among all investigators (to a maximum of 4 points).
flavor: It's a job, and nothing more. If you can abscond with the Jewel, you know you'll be handsomely rewarded.

name: The Syndicate [rogue]
text: Setup: Shuffle the set-aside Cold Streak treachery into the encounter deck. Put the set-aside Johnny Valone card into play at the lead investigator's location, enemy side faceup. [action] If Johnny Valone is at your location: Parley. Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues on this story card. Forced - When there are 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] clues on this story card: Add it and Johnny Valone to the victory display. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for Cold Streak and remove it from the game. Shuffle the encounter deck.
flavor: The mob are easily angered, but you might be able to convince Johnny Valone that giving up the Jewel is in his best interest...

name: Johnny Valone
text: You get +1 [agility]. [reaction] After you gain 1 or more resources via a card effect, exhaust Johnny Valone: Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource. Forced - When Johnny Valone leaves play: Remove him from the game.
flavor: "Fifty clams when the job's done."

name: Johnny Valone
text: Aloof. Hunter. Johnny Valone cannot be damaged. Forced - When you end your turn at Johnny Valone's location: Lose 2 resources.
flavor: "The debt must be paid!"

name: Miranda Keeper
text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] Spend 1 supply: Place 1 resource on your location, as an antiquity. You get +2 to your next skill test this round.
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more, remove an antiquity from your location: Gain 2 resources.
flavor: "You slay me."

name: Arsène Renard
text:
[fast]: Place 1 resource on each location, as an antiquity. (Group limit once per game.)
[fast]: If there is an exhausted enemy at your location, remove an antiquity from your location: Either draw 1 card or gain 2 resources.

name: Nova Malone
text: [action] Exhaust Nova Malone: Fight. Your base [combat] value for this fight is equal to the number of resources in your resource pool (to a maximum of 7). This attack deals +1 damage. [reaction] After you defeat an enemy: Gain 1 resource. (Limit once per round.)

name: Cold Streak
text: Surge. Cold Streak cannot be canceled. Revelation - Lose 4 resources. For each resource you cannot lose, take either 1 damage or 1 horror.
flavor: It's just not your night.

name: Silver Twilight Lodge [mystic]
text: [action]: You try to sense the Jewel's presence. Discard the top card of the encounter deck. You may draw that card. (Group limit twice per round.) Objective - Find the Jewel of Sarnath. At the end of the round, if the investigators control the Jewel of Sarnath, they may spend 5 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to advance the act. End of game scoring: 1 point for each treachery with no victory points in the victory display (to a maximum of 4 points).
flavor: Carl Sanford has promised you a lavish reward for acquiring the Jewel. But can you really trust him?

name: Silver Twilight Lodge [mystic]
text: Setup: Shuffle the set-aside Ward of Preservation treachery into the encounter deck. Put the set-aside Carl Sanford card into play at the lead investigator's location, enemy side faceup. [action] If Carl Sanford is at your location: Parley. Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues on this story card. Forced - When there are 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] clues on this story card: Add it and Carl Sanford to the victory display. Search the encounter deck, encounter discard pile, and all play areas for Ward of Preservation and remove it from the game. Shuffle the encounter deck.
flavor: Perhaps you can gently convince Sanford and the Lodge to leave well enough alone.

name: Carl Sanford
text: You get +1 [willpower]. You have one additional arcane slot. [reaction] After a revelation effect on a non-weakness treachery is canceled, exhaust Carl Sanford: Add that treachery to the victory display. Draw 1 card. Forced - When Carl Sanford leaves play: Remove him from the game.

name: Carl Sanford
text:
Aloof. Hunter.
Carl Sanford cannot be damaged.
Each investigator at this location gets -1 [willpower].
flavor: "The Jewel is mine."

name: Prudence Douglas
text:
Uses (3 portents).
[fast] During your turn, spend 1 portent and exhaust Prudence Douglas: Look at the top 4 cards of the encounter deck. Discard up to 2 non-[[Elite]] cards from among them and put the rest back on top in any order.

name: Sarah Van Shaw
text: [action] Spend up to 2 resources and exhaust Sarah Van Shaw: Fight. Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this attack. For each resource spent, this attack deals +1 damage.
flavor: "Ares, Hades, heel. Good boys!"

name: Raymond Loggins
text:
Uses (4 truths).
[reaction] When you draw a non-weakness treachery, spend 1 truth: Cancel that card's revelation effect and discard it. Then, take 1 horror.

name: Ward of Preservation
text: Surge. Ward of Preservation cannot be canceled. Revelation - Put Ward of Preservation into play in your threat area. Forced - When you play an event: Cancel its effects and take 1 horror. Then, discard Ward of Preservation.

name: Locals of Kingsport [survivor]
text: Forced - When Declan Pearce is defeated: Attach the Jewel of Sarnath to his location. [action] If the Jewel of Sarnath is attached to your location: You attempt to purge the corruption from the Jewel. Test [combat] or [agility] (3). If you succeed, remove 1 token from it. You may take control of it. Objective - At the end of the round, if the investigators control the Jewel of Sarnath and it has no tokens on it, they may spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to advance the act. End of game scoring: 4 points, minus 1 point for each card in the guest deck (to a minimum of 0 points).
flavor: Bain has hinted at the dangerous power of the Jewel. Perhaps if you can wrest control of it from Declan Pearce, this nightmare will end.

name: Locals of Kingsport [survivor]
text: Setup: Shuffle the set-aside Unlucky treachery into the encounter deck. Put the set-aside William Bain card into play at the lead investigator's location, enemy side faceup. [action] If William Bain is at your location: Parley. Test any skill (4). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues on this story card. Forced - When there are 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] clues on this story card: Add it and William Bain to the victory display. Search the encounter deck, encounter discard pile, and all play areas for Unlucky and remove it from the game. Shuffle the encounter deck.
flavor: The locals don't seem to have taken kindly to your involvement. Perhaps you can show them you don't mean any harm.

name: William Bain
text: While there are 1 or more cards committed to a skill test you are performing, you get +1 to each of your skills. [reaction] After you commit 1 or more cards to a skill test, spend 1 [per_investigator] resources and exhaust William Bain: Reveal the top card of the Guest deck and put it into play at the Lobby. Forced - When William Bain leaves play: Remove him from the game.

name: William Bain
text:
Aloof. Hunter.
William Bain cannot be damaged.
Each investigator at this location cannot commit cards to skill tests.
flavor: "Phonus balonus; I know you're with them."

name: Delores Gadling
text:
While investigating and parleying, you get +1 [intellect] for each [[Humanoid]] enemy at your location.
You may ignore each attack of opportunity made by [[Humanoid]], non-[[Elite]] enemies against you.
flavor: "That club made me do terrible things. We must stop them."

name: Thomas Olney
text:
[fast] Name a [[Trait]] and exhaust Thomas Olney: Discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that card has the named [[Trait]], gain 2 resources.
[fast] During a skill test at your location, exhaust Thomas Olney: Discard the top card of your deck. You may commit that card to this skill test, if able.

name: Claire Wilson
text: [reaction] After you commit 1 or more cards to a skill test you are performing, exhaust Claire Wilson: You get +1 skill value for this test.
flavor: "I should've stayed home."

name: Unlucky
text: Surge. Unlucky cannot be canceled. Revelation - Put Unlucky into play in your threat area. You get -2 to each of your skills. Forced - When the round ends: Discard Unlucky.

name: The Bloodless Man
text: Aloof. Patrol (nearest location with a [[Guest]]). Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Instead flip him over, exhaust him, and heal all but 3 [per_investigator] damage from him. Forced - When the investigation phase ends, if this enemy is ready: Deal 1 horror to each investigator and [[Guest]] asset at this location. If The Pale Lantern is attached to this enemy, each [[Guest]] asset at this location becomes spellbound.

name: The Bloodless Man
text: Hunter. Massive. Forced - After this enemy attacks you: Remove a [[Guest]] asset you control from the game, ignoring the agenda's Forced effect.

name: The Pale Lantern
text: [action] If The Bloodless Man has 1 or more damage on him or is in the victory display: Test [combat] or [agility] (3). If you succeed, take control of The Pale Lantern and flip it over. Any investigator at this location may trigger this ability. Forced - When The Pale Lantern would leave play: Attach it to its location instead.

name: The Pale Lantern
text: [action]: Flip over a spellbound card at your location. [action] Exhaust The Pale Lantern: Test [combat] or [agility] (2). If you succeed, place 1 damage on it. Then, if there is 4 damage on it, you break it; add it to the victory display (ignoring its Forced effect) and flip over each spellbound card. Forced - When The Pale Lantern would leave play: Flip it over and attach it to its location instead.

name: Enraged Gug
text:
Alert. Hunter.
Horror dealt by this enemy must be assigned to [[Guest]] assets you control, if able.
flavor: "I wasn't expecting this kind of entertainment!" - Elizabeth Conrad

name: Abhorrent Moon-Beast
text:
Hunter. Retaliate.
Damage dealt by this enemy must be assigned to [[Guest]] assets you control, if able.
flavor: "Life imitates Art far more than Art imitates Life." - Oscar Wilde

name: Savage Shantak
text:
Hunter.
Savage Shantak gets +1 fight and +1 evade for each [[Guest]] asset at its location.
flavor: And they whispered also that the rumoured Shantak-birds are no wholesome things... - H.P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>

name: Vicious Ambush
text: Revelation - If no [[Monster]] enemies are in play, Vicious Ambush gains surge. Otherwise, the nearest [[Monster]] enemy readies, moves (one location at a time) until it reaches your location, engages you, and makes an immediate attack.

name: Declan Pearce
text: Hunter. Declan Pearce gets +2 [per_investigator] health. While Declan Pearce is engaged with you, you get 1 fewer action during your turn. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Declan Pearce is ready: Heal 1 damage from each enemy in play.

name: Jewel of Sarnath
text: Revelation - Put Jewel of Sarnath into play under your control with 3 damage and 1 doom on it. Forced - When Jewel of Sarnath leaves play: Shuffle it into the encounter deck. [fast] Exhaust Jewel of Sarnath: Test [willpower] or [agility] (1). If you succeed, move 1 token on it to an enemy at your location.

name: Lantern Club Member
text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Parley. Automatically evade this enemy (you may spend 2 additional resources to discard it instead).
flavor: "I hear Nomarch Pearce has quite the evening in store."

name: Bleeding Walls
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X). X is the shroud value of your location. If you fail, lose 1 action and take 1 horror.
flavor: They needed redecorating anyway.

name: Entrap
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail and... - ...The Bloodless Man is at your location, a [[Guest]] asset you control becomes spellbound. - ...The Bloodless Man is at another location, he readies, moves (one location at a time) until he reaches your location, and engages you. - ...The Bloodless Man is not in play, Entrap gains surge.

name: Inexplicable Cold
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). For each point you fail by, you must choose one: - Choose and discard 1 card from your play area. - Choose and discard 1 card from your hand. - Take 1 damage.

name: Mind Extraction
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X). X is 1 plus the current agenda number. If you fail, take 2 horror. Then, if The Bloodless Man is in play and an investigator controls The Pale Lantern, flip it over and attach it to The Bloodless Man (leaving all tokens on it).

name: Noxious Fumes
text: Revelation - In player order, each investigator at your location must choose: - Test [agility] (3) to attempt to flee before the gas fills the room. If you succeed, move to a connecting location. If you fail, take 2 damage. - Test [combat] (3) to attempt to hold your breath. For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.

name: Pushed into the Beyond
text: Revelation - Choose and shuffle a non-story asset you control into its owner's deck. Discard the top 3 cards of that deck. If a copy of that asset is discarded, take 2 horror.
flavor: Push it.

name: Secret Door
text: Revelation - Attach to the location with the most investigators, and without a Secret Door attached. Investigators cannot leave this location. [action]: Test [willpower] (3) to search for the passage or [intellect] (3) to discern the way out. If you succeed, discard Secret Door.

name: Terror Gate
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +2 difficulty if a [[Rival]] enemy is in play. If you fail and you allied with... - ...the [guardian] faction, take 2 damage. - ...the [seeker] faction, discard 2 cards from your hand. - ...the [rogue] faction, lose 3 resources. - ...the [mystic] faction, take 2 horror. - ...the [survivor] faction, lose 1 action.

name: Violent Commands
text: Revelation - Put Violent Commands into play in your threat area. [action]: Deal 2 damage to an investigator at your location and discard Violent Commands. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror.

name: Sinking Ground
text: [action]: Resign. You flee the bog. Forced – When your turn ends, if you are at a [[Bog]] location: Place 1 damage on your location, as a sinkhole (2 sinkholes instead if there are 1 or 2 investigators in the game). Forced – If a location has 3 or more sinkholes on it: Remove all sinkholes from it and flip it over.
flavor: Light tremors ripple through the floating landscape. The bog is a fecund jungle of bright flowers and glassy, oily reflections.

name: The Thing in the Bog
text: Forced – When your turn ends, if you are at a [[Bog]] location: Place 1 damage on your location, as a sinkhole (2 sinkholes instead if there are 1 or 2 investigators in the game). Forced – If a location has 3 or more sinkholes on it: Remove all sinkholes from it and flip it over. Objective – If the Thing in the Depths is defeated, (→R4).
flavor: The bog rocks with towering waves!

name: A Botanical Survey
text: Objective – At the end of the round, investigators at the North Shore location may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. (See the Location Placement diagram on page 28 of the campaign guide for the North Short location.)
flavor: The bog is supposedly the origin of the sample that drew Dr. Marquez to the island in the first place. You have your work cut out for you.

name: Discovery of a Lifetime
text: [fast] Investigators at a single location adjacent to Chelydran Hybrid's location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: For the remainder of the round, change Chelydran Hybrid's patrol location to that location. Forced – At the end of the enemy phase: Chelydran Hybrid takes 1 damage for each ready [[Abomination]] enemy at its location. Objective – At the end of the round, if the Chelydran Hybrid is at the Starting Location, immediately advance.
flavor: The large flowering turtle-like creature is on the move. Perhaps you can herd it to safety.

name: Muddy Fen
flavor:
For some unknown reason I dreaded the thought of disturbing the ancient bog and its sunless secrets.
 – H. P. Lovecraft, "The Moon-Bog"

name: Open Water
text: Forced - After you move into this location: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.
flavor: The calm ripples hide something sinister deep below.

name: Tangled Thicket
text: As an additional cost to move out of Tangled Thicket, you must spend an action.
flavor:
It was very dark, for the trees were grotesquely huge and luxuriant, and incredibly numerous.
 – H. P. Lovecraft and Winifred V. Jackson, "The Green Meadow"

name: Open Water
text: Forced - After you move into this location: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.
flavor: The calm ripples hide something sinister deep below.

name: Fetid Pool
text: This location gets +1 shroud for each sinkhole on it.
flavor:
The stagnant waters, lately quite devoid of animal life, now teemed with a horde of slimy enormous frogs which piped shrilly and incessantly...
 – H. P. Lovecraft, "The Moon-Bog"

name: Open Water
text: Forced - After you move into this location: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.
flavor: The calm ripples hide something sinister deep below.

name: Flooded Path
text: [fast] During your turn, place 1 damage on this location, as a sinkhole: Move (to a connecting location).
flavor: Stepping between the sunken boards allows you to navigate the flooded pathway.

name: Open Water
text: Forced - After you move into this location: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.
flavor: The calm ripples hide something sinister deep below.

name: Abandoned Shack
text: [fast] Spend 1 clue: Move 1 sinkhole from Abandoned Shack to an enemy at this location, as damage. (Limit once per round.)
flavor: The ruined homestead floats on the surface of the water.

name: Open Water
text: Forced - After you move into this location: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.
flavor: The calm ripples hide something sinister deep below.

name: Rotten Dock
text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at Rotten Dock: Test [agility] (3). If you fail, place 1 damage on Rotten Dock, as a sinkhole.
flavor: You ought to know better.

name: Open Water
text: Forced - After you move into this location: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.
flavor: The calm ripples hide something sinister deep below.

name: Covered Bridge
text: Forced - After you reveal a token with a symbol while investigating Covered Bridge: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.
flavor: The pungent flowers small like honey and musk.

name: Open Water
text: Forced - After you move into this location: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.
flavor: The calm ripples hide something sinister deep below.

name: Thing in the Depths
text: Elusive. Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Thing in the Depths gets +5 [per_investigator] health and cannot make attacks of opportunity. While Thing in the Depths is moving, its location is considered to be connected to each [[Sunken]] location. Forced – After Thing in the Depths attacks at a [[Bog]] location: Heal 2 damage from it.

name: Chelydran Hybrid
text: Aloof. Elusive. Patrol (nearest empty location). Chelydran Hybrid cannot move if a ready [[Abomination]] enemy is at its location, or if it is engaged with an investigator. Forced – If this enemy is defeated, (→R3).

name: Grasping Tendril
text: Surge. (Night [night]) Aloof. Spawn - Chelydran Hybrid's location. X is the current day number.
flavor: Truthfully, 'Thing' was the best thing we could come up with to describe whatever was down there. – Dr. Rosa Marquez, Miskatonic Survey, 1926

name: Ground Disturbance
text: Revelation – Test [intellect] or [agility] (4). For each point you fail by, you must either take 1 damage or place 1 damage on the nearest [[Bog]] location, as a sinkhole.
flavor: The awful tremors are followed by a stampede of terrified forest creatures.

name: Sinking Sludge
text: Revelation – If you are at a... - ...[[Sunken]] location, take 1 direct damage and deal 1 direct damage to each [[Ally]] asset you control. - ...[[Bog]] location, place 1 damage on your location, as a sinkhole.

name: Day One
text: In which we welcome new friends to Hemlock Vale.

name: Day Two
text: In which we prepare for the Feast under a blanket of rain.

name: Day Three
text: In which we celebrate the joy of transfiguration.

name: George Barnaby
text:
Your max hand size is equal to the number of facedown cards beneath George Barnaby. (Limit 5 cards.)
You may commit facedown cards beneath George Barnaby to skill tests as if they were in your hand.
[reaction] After you discard a card from your hand: Place it facedown beneath George Barnaby, then draw 1 card. (Limit once per phase.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Draw 1 card.

name: Grim Resolve
text:
George Barnaby deck only.
After this skill test resolves, you may swap any number of cards beneath George Barnaby with the same number of non-weakness cards in your hand.

name: Cast Adrift
text: Revelation - If there are no cards beneath George Barnaby, shuffle Cast Adrift into your deck. Otherwise, discard each card beneath George Barnaby.

name: Mine Cart
text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Move Mine Cart once. If it moves off the rail line, each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma. [reaction] When Mine Cart moves, spend 1 switch: Either cancel the move, or move an additional time. (Group limit twice per phase.)

name: Control Station
text: [fast] During your turn: Swap 2 adjacent [[Rail]] locations. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: The back of the station is filled with crates of very old dynamite and stocks of gunpowder.

name: Rail Exit
text: Rail Exit cannot be slid or swapped.
flavor: Scratch marks score the walls and beams nearby. You shudder to think of the frenzied creatures who have excaped North Point Mine to hunt for their next meal.

name: Left Turn
text: [action] [action]: Swap 2 adjacent [[Rail]] locations. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: The crystals emanate a strange light.

name: Left Turn
text: [action] Spend 2 resources: Slide a location into an empty space adjacent to it. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: The crystals emanate a strange light.

name: Right Turn
text: [action] [action]: Swap 2 adjacent [[Rail]] locations. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: A strange light emanates from the crystals.

name: Right Turn
text: [action] Spend 2 resources: Slide a location into an empty space adjacent to it. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: A strange light emanates from the crystals.

name: Alkaline Rail
text: Forced - At the end of the round: Deal 1 horror to each investigator and [[Resident]] asset at Alkaline Rail.
flavor: The tunnel is choked with a blood-red mist. Every breath induces a painful fit of coughing.

name: Warped Rail
text: Forced - After the Mine Cart enters Warped Rail: Move the Mine Cart once.
flavor: Looking down the spiraling tunnel makes your head swim.

name: Sunken Rail
text: Forced - After Sunken Rail is revealed: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded. The lead investigator draws that enemy.
flavor: What really lurks underwater?

name: Forked Rail
text: Forced - At the end of the round, if the Mine Cart is at Forked Rail: Discard 1 switch from the scenario reference card.
flavor: The air smells less foul down two passages. But should you really follow your nose?

name: Rail Bridge
text:
X is Rail Bridge's column number.
[action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] resources: Place 1 resource on the scenario reference card, as a switch. (Group limit once per round.)
flavor: The minerals in the rock glimmer like stars.

name: Subterranean Beast
text:
Hunter. Massive.
Subterranean Beast gets +3 [per_investigator] health.
If Subterranean Beast is ready and at the Mine Cart's location, the Mine Cart cannot move.
[action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Exhaust Subterranean Beast. It cannot ready this round.

name: Burrowing Hybrid
text: Hunter. Forced - After Burrowning Hybrid enters play, if the Mine Cart is facing a connecting location: Slide that location into an adjacent empty space. If you cannot, swap it with a location adjacent to it.
flavor: It definitely doesn't just eat worms.

name: Frenzied Miner
text: Hunter. X is Frenzied Miner's column number. Forced - After Frenzied Miner attacks you: Deal 1 damage to each other investigator and [[Resident]] asset at this location.

name: Cave-In
text: Revelation - Attach Cave-In to the location the Mine Cart is facing. If you cannot, Cave-In gains surge. Forced - When the Mine Cart would move into attached location: Cancel the move and deal 2 damage to each investigator and [[Resident]] asset in the Mine Cart. [action]: Test [combat] or [agility] (2). If you succeed, discard Cave-In. An investigator at an adjacent location may trigger this ability.

name: Wild Ride
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (5). If you fail, put Wild Ride into play in your threat area. Forced - When the Mine Cart moves: Either move it 2 additional times, or deal 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror to each investigator, [[Ally]] asset, and [[Resident]] card they control. Discard Wild Ride.

name: Mother Rachel
text: Aloof. Retaliate. Mother Rachel gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After you deal 1 or more damage to Mother Rachel: Choose a different [[Resident]] enemy at her location. That enemy attacks you.

name: Leah Atwood
text: Retaliate. [action]: Parley. Test [combat] (5). If you succeed, set Leah Atwood aside, out of play.
flavor: "Just get out of here. Nobody wants you here."

name: Simeon Atwood
text: Elusive. Hunter. [action]: Parley. Test [agility] (5). If you succeed, set Simeon Atwood aside, out of play.
flavor: "Wanna see a magic trick? I can make this grass disappear. All of it."

name: William Hemlock
text: Elusive. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (5). If you succeed, set William Hemlock aside, out of play.
flavor: "I will do what I must to protect my family's legacy."

name: River Hawthorne
text: Aloof. Hunter. The first treachery drawn at River Hawthorne's location each round gains surge. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (5). If you succeed, set River Hawthorne aside, out of play.

name: Gideon Mizrah
text: Retaliate. Forced - After Gideon Mizrah attacks you: Discard 1 card at random from your hand. [action] [action] [action]: Parley. Set Gideon Mizrah aside, out of play.

name: Judith Park
text: Hunter. Retaliate. [action] Spend 5 resources: Parley. Set Judith Park aside, out of play.
flavor: "Don't make me do this."

name: Theo Peters
text: Elusive. Alert. [action] Discard 3 cards at random from your hand: Parley. Set Theo Peters aside, out of play.
flavor: "We're all family here. Except for you!"

name: Bertie Musgrave
text: Aloof. Patrol (Mother Rachel's location). Forced - When damage would be assigned to a [[Resident]] enemy at Bertie Musgrave's location and he is ready: It is assigned to Bertie Musgrave, instead. Forced - After Bertie Musgrave is defeated: ([codex] Ω).

name: Main Street
text:
While an investigator is moving, Main Street is connected to each Slimy Streets location, and vice versa.
[action]: You and an investigator in another group who is at another copy of Main Street disengage from each engaged enemy and swap groups. Both investigators must activate this ability simultaneously. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Old Burial Hill
text: Forced - After a [[Manifold]] enemy spawns at Old Burial Hill: Exhaust that enemy. For the remainder of the round, if that enemy is defeated, discover clues at Old Burial Hill equal to the value of its Blob X keyword, instead of dealing X damage to Subject 8L-08.

name: Abandoned Windmill
text: [action]: Investigate. Abandoned Windmill gets -4 shroud for this investigation. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, move each clue you would discover to a Research Site or Temporary HQ in any group.

name: Abbatoir
text: [action] If there are no clues on Abbatoir: Test [agility] (3) to bait the creatures here. If you succeed, move each [[Ooze]] enemy twice toward Abbatoir. For the remainder of the round, increase the Blob X value of each enemy moved by this effect by 2. (Max one success per game.)

name: Replicating Aberration
text: Replicate - If you spot a [[Manifold]] enemy with exactly 1 remaining health, discard it and spawn this enemy exhausted in its place (unless the investigators spend a countermeasure). Hunter. Forced - When Replicating Aberration leaves play: Return it to the event organizer. Blob 3.

name: Replicating Aberration
text: Replicate - If you spot an Oozeling failing to spawn because its spawn location does not exist, discard it and spawn this enemy exhausted at any location instead (unless the investigators spend a countermeasure). Hunter. Forced - When Replicating Aberration leaves play: Return it to the event organizer. Blob 3.

name: Replicating Aberration
text: Replicate - When you spot a [[Manifold]] enemy being defeated with excess damage, spawn this enemy exhausted in its place (unless the investigators spend a countermeasure). Hunter. Forced - When Replicating Aberration leaves play: Return it to the event organizer. Blob 3.

name: Replicating Aberration
text: Replicate - After you spot the last clue being discovered from an [[Oozified]] location, spawn this enemy exhausted at that location (unless the investigators spend a countermeasure). Hunter. Forced - When Replicating Aberration leaves play: Return it to the event organizer. Blob 3.

name: Replicating Aberration
text: Replicate - If you spot an investigator 3 or more locations away from the nearest other investigator, spawn this enemy exhausted and engaged with the investigator (unless the investigators spend a countermeasure). Hunter. Forced - When Replicating Aberration leaves play: Return it to the event organizer. Blob 3.

name: Replicating Aberration
text: Replicate - After you spot an asset being defeated by an [[Ooze]] enemy’s attack, discard that enemy and spawn this enemy exhausted in its place (unless the investigators spend a countermeasure). Hunter. Forced - When Replicating Aberration leaves play: Return it to the event organizer. Blob 3.

name: Replicating Aberration
text: Replicate - If you spot a copy of "It’s got me!" in an investigator’s threat area with 3 or more resources on it, spawn this enemy exhausted and engaged with them (unless the investigators spend a countermeasure). Hunter. Forced - When Replicating Aberration leaves play: Return it to the event organizer. Blob 3.

name: Replicating Aberration
text: Replicate - If you spot an enemy with a copy of Alien Food Chain attached, spawn this enemy exhausted at any location and attach that copy of Alien Food Chain to it (unless the investigators spend a countermeasure). Hunter. Forced - When Replicating Aberration leaves play: Return it to the event organizer. Blob 3.

name: Replicating Aberration
text: Replicate - If you spot an investigator at a location with a copy of Sticky Feet attached to it, spawn this enemy exhausted at that location (unless the investigators spend a countermeasure). Hunter. Forced - When Replicating Aberration leaves play: Return it to the event organizer. Blob 3.

name: Escort the Car
text: Revelation - Put the set-aside Armored Car into play at the location farthest from the Fungus Mound. Spawn the set-aside Mi-Go Destroyer enemy at the Fungus Mound. Put this card into play next to the act deck. Forced - After Armored Car enters the Fungus Mound: Remember that "the car reached its target." Flip this card over. Forced - If Armored Car is defeated or devoured: Remember that "the escort failed." Flip this card over.
flavor: You’ve heard from some of the civilians fleeing to the perimeter of the quarantine zone that the military is sending in armor to secure Blackwater. You’re not sure a bigger gun is the answer, but it might help deter the creatures that have been wreaking havoc across the town. If you can clear the path and prevent it from getting devoured like the rest of the vehicles they’ve sent in, maybe it can make a real difference.

name: Armored Car
text:
During the enemy phase, each ready enemy at Armored Car’s location attacks it, instead of any other target.
During the investigation phase, investigators at this location may spend 1 [per_investigator] actions, as a group, to move Armored Car to a connecting location.

name: Mi-Go Destroyer
text: While Mi-Go Destroyer is ready, it gains: "Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Move Mi-Go Destroyer once toward Armored Car." While attacking Armored Car, Mi-Go Destroyer deals +2 damage.

name: Reclaim the Brain
text: Revelation - Spawn the set-aside Mi-Go Scientist enemy at the location farthest from the Fungus Mound. Attach the set-aside Brain Case asset to Mi-Go Scientist. Put this card into play next to the act deck. Forced - If Brain Case is at Research Site and under an investigator’s control: Remember that "the brain was recovered." Flip this card over. Forced - If Brain Case is at Fungus Mound and attached to Mi-Go Scientist: Remember that "the brain was taken." Flip this card over.
flavor: You thought you’d seen everything, but when you spot one of the creatures flying overhead with a human brain in its grasp, you realize you’re sorely mistaken. Even more surprising, it seemed to be cradling the brain safely inside a glass cylinder, as if it were a scientific sample. Are these monsters collecting human brains? The irony isn’t lost on you - the creatures are likely doing the same kind of research as the scientists at the research site - but even still, you have to find this creature and stop this sick experiment!

name: Mi-Go Scientist
text: While Mi-Go Scientist is ready, it gains: "Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: If Brain Case is attached to Mi-Go Scientist, move Mi-Go Scientist once toward the Fungus Mound. Otherwise, move Mi‑Go Scientist once toward Brain Case’s location, and if it is at Brain Case’s location, attach Brain Case to it (if it is under an investigator’s control, they lose control of it)."

name: Brain Case
text:
If uncontrolled and unattached, attach Brain Case to its location.
While attached to a location or an exhausted enemy, Brain Case gains: "[action]: Test [intellect] or [agility] (6). If you succeed, detach Brain Case and take control of it."

name: Prevent Their Research
text: Revelation - Spawn both set-aside Mi-Go Researcher enemies, one at the Fungus Mound, and the other at the location farthest from the Fungus Mound. Put this card into play next to the act deck. Forced - If there are no Mi-Go Researcher enemies in play: Remember that "the Mi-Go research was stopped." Flip this card over. Forced - If there are 6 resources on this story card: Remember that "the Mi-Go completed their research." Flip this card over.
flavor: Flitting about the night sky, the alien entities descend, searching. Observing. But for what purpose? Did they bring the ooze-thing here, or are they in the dark, too? One thing is for sure: They’re terrifying the quarantined citizens of Blackwater and causing pandemonium. If they’re not going to help contain the subject, they’re just stirring up trouble. Perhaps you can "discourage" them from performing their research so you can focus your efforts on the real threat.

name: Mi-Go Researcher
text: Aloof. While Mi-Go Researcher is ready, it gains: "Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Move Mi-Go Researcher once toward the nearest [[Ooze]] enemy that has not been researched. For each such enemy at its location, place 1 resource on Prevent Their Research and 1 resource on that enemy; that enemy is 'researched.'"

name: Marion Tavares
text:
You have 1 fewer hand slots.
[reaction] After you play an event during your turn: Draw 1 card. Then, you may play a different event. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Search the top 3 cards of your deck for an event and draw it. Shuffle your deck.
flavor: "People rely on me to do my job. A few odd fish in the water don't change that."

name: Determined
text:
Marion Tavares deck only.
If this skill test is successful and it is on an event you played, you may return Determined to your hand instead of discarding it.

name: "I'll do it myself"
text: Revelation - Put "I'll do it myself" into play in your threat area. As an additional cost for you to play an event, take 1 horror. [fast] Discard 3 events from your hand: Discard "I'll do it myself."

name: Lucius Galloway
text:
[reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy by 2 or more: Discover 1 clue at your location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each enemy at your location.
flavor: "I'm just glad all my dreams have stayed in my head."

name: Book of Verse
text:
Lucius Galloway deck only.
Uses (1 inspiration). Replenish this inspiration the first time you discover a clue each round.
[reaction] After revealing chaos tokens during a skill test, spend 1 inspiration: You get +1 skill value for this skill test. If you succeed by exactly 0, draw 1 card.

name: Dreams of the Flood
text: Revelation - Put Dreams of the Flood into play in your threat area. Forced - The first time you discover 1 or more clues during your turn: Take 1 horror and shuffle Dreams of the Flood into your deck.

name: Agatha Crane
text:
[reaction] When your turn ends, if you sealed, canceled, or ignored 1 or more chaos tokens this round: Play a [[Spell]] or [[Insight]] event from your discard pile. After that event resolves, remove it from the game.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may cancel this token and draw another in its place. If you do, draw 1 card.

name: Agatha Crane
text:
[reaction] When your turn ends, if you sealed, canceled, or ignored 1 or more chaos tokens this round: Play a [[Spell]] or [[Insight]] event from your discard pile. After that event resolves, remove it from the game.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may cancel this token and draw another in its place. If you do, draw 1 card.

name: Ocula Obscura
text: Agatha Crane deck only. [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test, if no tokens are sealed here and you did not release a token from Ocula Obscura during this skill test: Seal a non-symbol token revealed during this skill test on Ocula Obscura. (Limit once per phase.) Forced - When you would reveal a token from the chaos bag: Resolve the token sealed here instead, then release that token.

name: Glimpse the Void
text: Revelation - Put Glimpse the Void into play in your threat area. The first time you reveal 1 or more chaos tokens during each skill test, you must reveal 1 additional chaos token (and resolve its effects). [action]: Shuffle Glimpse the Void into your deck.

name: Michael McGlen
text:
[reaction] After you spend 1 or more ammo from a [[Firearm]] asset: Gain 1 resource. (Limit once per [[Firearm]] asset per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may place 1 ammo on a [[Firearm]] asset you control.
flavor: "Don't care if it's a god. If it crosses me, it's gonna regret it."

name: "Viola" Case
text:
Michael McGlen deck only.
You have 2 additional hand slots, which can only be used to hold [[Firearm]] assets.
[reaction] After you play "Viola" Case: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Firearm]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

name: Confiscation
text: Revelation - Shuffle each [[Firearm]] asset in your play area into your deck. If no asset was shuffled into your deck by this effect, take 1 damage and shuffle Confiscation back into your deck.
flavor: "You, uh... going hunting, Mr. McGlen?"

name: Gloria Goldberg
text:
You choose the investigator order during the mythos phase.
[reaction] When you look at 1 or more cards from the encounter deck: Look at 1 additional card and choose 1 non-[[Elite]] card among them. Either discard it, put it on top of the encounter deck, or place it facedown beneath Gloria Goldberg (max 3 cards beneath her).
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Look at the top card of the encounter deck.

name: Psychic Sensitivity
text:
Gloria Goldberg deck only.

text: *This act gets +1 [per_investigator] clue threshold. [fast] Spend X clues: Parley. Discard an engaged [[Criminal]] enemy with X remaining health at your location. Place 1 clue (from the token pool) on this act. Objective - At the end of the round, if the number of clues on this act equals or exceeds its clue threshold, advance.
flavor: You need to find out what happened to Tillinghast's shipment. With the increased gang activity all over Rivertown, you think that checking in with the Sheldons and the O'Bannions is the best place to start.

name: Hibb's Roadhouse
text: Easttown is connected to Hibb's Roadhouse. Revelation - Put Hibb's Roadhouse into play. Spawn the set-aside Sadie Sheldon enemy at Hibb's Roadhouse. Add the set-aside act 2a - "The Sheldon Gang" and act 3a - "Face the Music" to the act deck, then advance to act 2a.

name: The Sheldon Gang
text: Sadie Sheldon gains: "[action] Spend up to 4 resources: Parley. Test [willpower] or [combat] (5). This test gets -1 difficulty for each resource spent as part of this action's cost. For each point you succeed by, place 1 of your clues on Sadie Sheldon." Objective - When damage is placed on Sadie Sheldon, advance. Objective - If there are 3 clues on Sadie Sheldon, advance.
flavor: The Sheldons wound up with the shipment. It's up to you to either talk Sadie into a deal, or "convince" her it's not worth the trouble.

name: The O'Bannion Gang
text: Naomi O'Bannion gains: "[action] Spend up to 4 resources: Parley. Test [intellect] or [agility] (5). This test gets -1 difficulty for each resource spent as part of this action's cost. For each point you succeed by, place 1 of your clues on Naomi O'Bannion." Objective - When damage is placed on Naomi O'Bannion, advance. Objective - If there are 3 clues on Naomi O'Bannion, advance.
