Objective - When the round ends, if there is at least 1 [[Elite]] enemy in the victory display, advance.
flavor: You've found yourself squarely in the center of a gang war!

name: Tillinghast Esoterica
text: Tillinghast Esoterica is connected to the location to the right of it, and vice versa. [action] Investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: In your Campaign Log, record the investigators discovered an alien language. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Sadie Sheldon
text:
Retaliate.
Sadie Sheldon cannot move and gets +1 [per_investigator] health.
Sadie Sheldon gets +1 fight for each damage on her (to a maximum of +3 fight).

name: Naomi O'Bannion
text: Alert. Naomi O'Bannion cannot move and gets +1 [per_investigator] health. Forced - The first time Naomi O'Bannion is evaded each round: Ready her. Any investigator at her location may take 1 damage to prevent this.

name: Gang Soldier
flavor: "Don't go stickin' your nose where it don't belong, pal!"

name: Gang Enforcer

name: Gang Informant
text: Aloof. Spawn - Nearest [[Arkham]] location with clues. Forced - After an investigator at Gang Informant's location discovers 1 or more clues while this enemy is ready: That investigator must either spend 3 resources or place 1 doom on the current agenda.

name: Caught in the Crossfire
text: Revelation - Put Caught in the Crossfire into play in your threat area. Forced - When damage is dealt to a [[Criminal]] enemy at your location: Test [intellect] or [agility] (3). If you fail, reduce the damage dealt to that enemy by 1 and take 1 direct damage. Discard Caught in the Crossfire.

name: End of Negotiations
text: Revelation - Attach End of Negotiations to the nearest [[Criminal]] enemy. Limit 1 per enemy. If you cannot, End of Negotiations gains surge. Forced - After an investigator parleys at this location: Attached enemy attacks that investigator. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard this card.

name: Flooded Paths
text: Each location is connected to each other location on the rows above and below it. Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location or decrease the flood level of your current location, take 5 direct damage.
flavor: You can navigate a path through the crumbling ruins via small pockets of air.

name: Descend into the Abyss
text: [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Decrease your location's flood level. Objective – Make your way to the sea floor! If each surviving investigator is at Obsidian Foundations, you may advance.
flavor: A softly pulsing light at the base of the ancient foundations beckons you to the sea floor. You must proceed carefully.

name: Ascend the Wall
text: [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Decrease your location's flood level. Objective – Make your way to the surface! If each surviving investigator is at Western Wall, you may advance.
flavor: It is a steep climb up the crumbling wall, but if you step carefully, you should reach the surface in one piece.

name: Treacherous Path
text: X is this location's level. Forced - After you enter Treacherous Path from a location above it: Take 1 damage. Forced - After you enter Treacherous Path from a location below it: Take 1 horror.

name: Treacherous Path
text: X is this location's level. Forced - After you enter Treacherous Path: Test [agility] (X). If you fail, take 1 damage and increase this location's flood level.

name: Treacherous Path

name: Seafloor Frieze [tdc_rune_w]
text:
Below the frieze is a triptych of three distinct scenes. The first panel depicts a comet falling from the sky. The center panel, while highly abstract, shows legions of nightmarish alien shapes pouring out of fallen rocks. Their faces are covered in thick, ropy appendages. The frieze depicts the alien creatures trampling a forest of what looks like thick, boxy flowering trees. The final frieze depicts a wave of sinewy, wormlike creatures spilling out from the celestial rocks like a flood.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_w] In your Campaign Log, record "Parasite" under [tdc_rune_w] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

name: Undersea Vault [tdc_rune_z]
text: [action]: Test [intellect] (X), where X is this location's level. If you succeed, flip this card and resolve its text.
flavor: [tdc_rune_j][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_b][tdc_rune_x][tdc_rune_p][tdc_rune_z] · [tdc_rune_c][tdc_rune_b][tdc_rune_k] · [tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_f][tdc_rune_u][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_f][tdc_rune_c] · [tdc_rune_u][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_c][tdc_rune_h] · [tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_f][tdc_rune_z] · [tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_c][tdc_rune_l] · [tdc_rune_q][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_s][tdc_rune_a][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_u][tdc_rune_c] · [tdc_rune_l][tdc_rune_h][tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_c][tdc_rune_s][tdc_rune_h]

name: The Undersea Vault [tdc_rune_z]
text:
You press three small hidden nodes inset into the vault door and it slides open with a satisfying hiss. Inside is a desiccated corpse of an alien creature, its octopoid face and leathery wings reduced to dust. It holds an obsidian slate in one bony hand; you identify it as a kind of city map, likely of R'lyeh itself.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_z] In your Campaign Log, record "City" under [tdc_rune_z] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Flip this card back to its location side. It cannot be flipped over again.

name: Deep One Matron
text: Hunter. Spawn - Any revealed location (Drowned Shanty, if able). Forced - When Deep One Matron enters play: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Deep One]] enemy and spawn it at this location.

name: "Look Out!"
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (3). If you fail, put "Look Out!" into play in your threat area. Forced - The first time you enter a flooded location each round: Take 1 horror. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, discard "Look Out!"

name: The Sunken Ruins
text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location or decrease the flood level of your current location, take 5 direct damage.
flavor: Chunks of R'lyeh's foundation continue to fall, threatening the seafloor dome.

name: Seafloor Leviathan
text: Massive. Patrol (nearest unflooded or partially flooded location). Spawn - Barrier Core. Seafloor Leviathan gets +3 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When the enemy phase begins, if this enemy is ready: Increase the flood level of its location.

name: Collapsing Dome
text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location or decrease the flood level of your current location, take 5 direct damage.
flavor: The dome won't hold up much longer against the barrage of falling rock.

name: Reactivate the Core
text: Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it. [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Decrease your location's flood level. Objective – At the end of the round, if each surviving investigator is at Barrier Core (Active), you may advance. (Hint: Reactivate the Barrier Core by revealing and draining locations!)
flavor: You can't open the barrier core until the undersea dome is at least partially drained.

name: Barrier Core
text: Forced - If 6 or more [[Seafloor]] locations are revealed and not flooded: Flip Barrier Core. [action] Decrease the flood level of Barrier Core and choose an adjacent eligible location: Increase the flood level of the chosen location. Then, place 3 [per_investigator] clues on it. (Group limit once per round.)

name: Barrier Core
text: Forced - If there are 5 or fewer unflooded [[Seafloor]] locations: Flip Barrier Core. [action] Spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Put the set-aside Barrier Node story asset into play under your control.

name: Abyssal Trench
text:
X is equal to half of the number of revealed [[Seafloor]] locations (rounded down).
[reaction] After you successfully fight or evade an enemy at Abyssal Trench: Decrease its flood level. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: The seafloor trench feels as alien as another dimension.

name: Drowned Acropolis
text: Forced - After you end your turn at Drowned Acropolis: You must either increase its flood level or take 1 horror. [action] Increase the flood level of Drowned Acropolis: Choose any location and decrease its flood level. (Group limit twice per game.)

name: Drowned Acropolis
text: Forced - After you end your turn at Drowned Acropolis: You must either increase the flood level of an adjacent location or take 1 damage. [action] Increase the flood level of Drowned Acropolis: Choose any location and decrease its flood level. (Group limit twice per game.)

name: Blasted Ruins
text: Forced - After you end your turn at Blasted Ruins: Increase its flood level. [action] Investigators at Blasted Ruins spend 5 resources, as a group: Decrease the flood level of this location or an adjacent location. (Group limit once per round.)

name: Blasted Ruins
text: Forced - After you end your turn at Blasted Ruins: Increase its flood level. [action] Investigators at Blasted Ruins discard a total of 1 [per_investigator] cards from hand, as a group: Decrease the flood level of this location or an adjacent location. (Group limit once per round.)

name: Coral Reef
text: [action] [action]: Draw 2 cards and gain 2 resources. Spawn the set-aside Undersea Parasite [tdc_rune_x] enemy at this location. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Coral Reef
text: Forced - After Coral Reef is revealed: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded and spawn it at this location. [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at Coral Reef: Spawn the set-aside Undersea Parasite [tdc_rune_x] enemy at this location.

name: Ancient Gallery
text: [action] Choose and discard 2 cards from your hand: Put the set-aside Obsidian Relic [tdc_rune_y] asset into play under your control. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Undersea Parasite [tdc_rune_x]
text: Aloof. Retaliate. Forced - After Undersea Parasite [tdc_rune_x] attacks you: Flip this card and resolve its text. Forced - When Undersea Parasite [tdc_rune_x] would leave play: Flip this card and resolve its text.

name: Undersea Parasite [tdc_rune_x]
text:
If this card flipped because Undersea Parasite [tdc_rune_x] attacked you, read the following:
The creature's bite burns like fire. Before you can react, it has vanished into a maze of coral.
Flip this card and move it to a connecting location (with no investigators, if able). Otherwise:
After crushing the loathsome creature's carapace, you catch a glint of something. An alien symbol?
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_x] In your Campaign Log, record "Sum" under [tdc_rune_x] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

name: Obsidian Relic [tdc_rune_y]
text:
Pressing a small inset in the relic's base opens the statue's center with a strange hiss, unfolding like an obsidian blossom. A light projection extends over the relic's open core, showing hazy scenes of a crashing alien shoreline and nameless horrors silhouetted against the sky. A cnidarian creature looms over a crowd of squamous larvae, grasping a glowing tablet in a tangle of viscous tentacles. Was this some kind of otherworldly sage? An alien leader, perhaps?
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_y] In your Campaign Log, record "Knowledge" under [tdc_rune_y] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

name: Medusa
text: Aloof. Patrol (nearest unflooded or partially flooded location). Forced - When the enemy phase begins, if Medusa is ready: Increase the flood level of its location. If you cannot, place 1 doom on Medusa.
flavor: Not your average jellyfish.

name: Stirring in the Dark
flavor: You can hear the sound of slithering and gnashing teeth in the darkness. Something awful stirs in the bowels of R'lyeh. You would rather not stick around to find out what it actually is...

name: Loathsome Parasites
text: Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda, if there are no non-[[Elite]] enemies in play: Reveal cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is revealed and spawn it (at an empty location, if able). Shuffle each other revealed card and place them on top of the encounter deck.
flavor: Loathsome creatures emerge from every nook and cranny. If you don't escape soon, you have a feeling you'll become a permanent resident.

name: Unsettling Signs
text: [action] Spend 1 or more clues, as a group: For each clue spent, discard the top 5 cards (10 cards instead if there is 1 investigator) of the encounter deck and draw each location discarded by this effect. Objective - If each surviving investigator is at a [[Sanctum]] location, investigators may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.(Hint: you may not be able to explore further after you advance.)
flavor: The fleshy tunnels excrete a foul, waxy substance that burns the skin. Your destination lies deeper within the disgusting labyrinth.

name: Lost Pilgrims
text: Each [[Cultist]] enemy gains victory 0 and aloof. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2) or [combat] (2). For each point you succeed by, move a different [[Cultist]] enemy at your location once in any direction. Forced - When the enemy phase ends: Each [[Cultist]] enemy takes 1 damage for each [[Stowaway]] enemy at its location. Objective - When the round ends, if there is a combined total of 5 or more [[Cultist]] cards in the victory display and/or under this act, you must advance.
flavor: The campsite is under attack by alien parasites!

name: The Hive Mind
text: [fast] During your turn, place X clues on your location: Deal X damage to a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. Forced - When the round ends: Flip a coin. On heads, rotate Central Chamber once clockwise. On tails, rotate Central Chamber once counter-clockwise. Objective - If Mother is defeated, immediately advance.
flavor: It doesn't live in the walls! It is the walls!

name: Apiary Entrance
text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Shuffle each location in the encounter discard pile into the bottom 10 cards of the encounter deck. [fast]: Choose the farthest location from Apiary Entrance. Place clues on the chosen location up to its clue value. (Limit once per round.) [action]: Resign. You make your exit.

name: Apiary Entrance
text: When a [[Stowaway]] enemy is drawn, spawn it at Apiary Entrance instead of its normal spawn location. [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place a [[Cultist]] asset or enemy at this location underneath the act. [action]: Resign. You make your exit.

name: Fleshy Paths
text: Revelation - Put Fleshy Paths into play. [action]: Test [intellect] (2) to search the flesh-like walls. If you succeed, put the set-aside Ancient Relic [tdc_rune_s] asset into play under your control.

name: Fleshy Paths [tdc_rune_r]
text: Revelation - Put Fleshy Paths [tdc_rune_r] into play. [action] You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_r] In your Campaign Log, record "Time" under [tdc_rune_r] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated.

name: Growing Fields
text: Revelation - Put Growing Fields into play along with the set-aside Hidden Vault [tdc_rune_u] location. [action]: Test [willpower] (8). Double the skill icons of each card committed to this test. If you succeed, take control of the set-aside Grisly "Mask" story asset.

name: Churning Chasm
text: Revelation - Put Churning Chasm into play and spawn the set-aside Squamous Parasite [tdc_rune_t] enemy at it. [reaction] When you begin your turn in Churning Chasm: Move to any revealed location.

name: Corrupted Vault [tdc_rune_q]
text: Revelation - Put Corrupted Vault [tdc_rune_q] into play. [action][action]: You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_q] In your Campaign Log, record "Hand" under [tdc_rune_q] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated.

name: Luminous Tunnels
text: Revelation - Put Luminous Tunnels into play. Shuffle the set-aside Pilgrims encounter set into the encounter deck along with the encounter discard pile. Find the set-aside Spawning Grounds and Corrupted Vault [tdc_rune_q] and shuffle them into the bottom 10 cards of the encounter deck. [action] Take 1 damage: Place clues on the location farthest from Apiary Entrance up to its clue value.

name: Spawning Grounds
text: Revelation - Put Spawning Grounds into play. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Find the set-aside Lost Campsite and Churning Chasm and shuffle them into the bottom 10 cards of the encounter deck.

name: Lost Campsite
text: Revelation - Put Lost Campsite into play. [action]: Draw the topmost card beneath Lost Campsite.
flavor: The camp is seemingly abandoned, strewn with dishware and tattered tents. Perhaps there are survivors hiding nearby.

name: Maria Rivera
text: When damage would be placed on a [[Cultist]] enemy at your location, place it on Maria Rivera instead. [reaction] When doom would be placed on a [[Cultist]] enemy, exhaust Maria Rivera: Place it on Maria Rivera instead, as damage. Forced - If Maria Rivera is defeated: Add her to the victory display.

name: Grasping Corridor
text: Revelation - Put Grasping Corridor into play. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Find the set-aside Starving Corridor and Corrupted Vault [tdc_rune_q] and shuffle them into the bottom 10 cards of the encounter deck. [action] Take 1 horror: Place clues on the location farthest from Apiary Entrance up to its clue value.

name: Starving Corridor
text: Revelation - Put Starving Corridor into play. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Find the set-aside Acidic Coelom and Churning Chasm and shuffle them into the bottom 10 cards of the encounter deck.

name: Acidic Coelom
text: Revelation - Put Acidic Coelom into play. As an additional cost to move from Acidic Coelom to Apiary Entrance, you must take 1 damage.
flavor: The acidic vapors digest anything inside the chamber, including flesh and metal.

name: Central Chamber
text: Central Chamber is connected to the location below it (bordering its bottom edge) and vice versa. Forced - When your turn ends, if you are at this location: Test [agility] (1). If you fail, you must either move to a connecting location or Mother attacks you.

name: Mother
text: Massive. Relentless. Forced - When another [[Stowaway]] enemy is defeated: Move all damage on that enemy to Mother. (If that enemy had doom on it, shuffle that enemy into the encounter deck as well.)

name: Grotesque Amalgam
text: Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - After you fight this enemy using a [[Weapon]] asset: Place 1 doom on that asset.

name: Apiary Tender
text: Aloof. Hunter. Prey - Lowest [agility]. Forced - When doom is placed on a card at this location: Ready Apiary Tender. It loses aloof until the end of the round. If it is engaged with an investigator, it makes an immediate attack.

name: Hungry Walls
text: Revelation - Attach this card to your location. Forced - When you leave attached location: Test [agility] (4) or [combat] (4). If you fail and you tested... - ...[agility], discard an asset you control and take 1 damage. Discard Hungry Walls. - ...[combat], take 2 direct damage. Discard Hungry Walls.

name: Dangerous Curiosity
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is your location's shroud value. If you fail, take 1 damage and discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Stowaway]] enemy is discarded and draw it. Shuffle each location discarded by this effect back into the encounter deck.

name: Alien Eggs
text: Surge. Revelation - Place 1 doom on the nearest non-[[Elite]] enemy with no doom on it.
flavor: What is that moving inside?

name: Hidden Vault [tdc_rune_u]
text: Forced - After Hidden Vault [tdc_rune_u] enters play: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for an enemy and spawn it at this location. [reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy at Hidden Vault [tdc_rune_u] by 2 or more: Flip this card and resolve its text.

name: Hidden Vault [tdc_rune_u]
text:
You find an alien panel hidden behind a fold of fleshy wall. Grimacing, you press it and reveal a round alcove untouched by the alien growths. Sharp glowing symbols connected by curling lines appear on a black slate in the center of the alcove. After some study, you recognize it as some kind of ancestral tree. There are hundreds upon hundreds of names: how many creatures lived in this city aeons ago?
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_u] In your Campaign Log, record "Daughters" under [tdc_rune_u] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Flip this card back to its location side. It cannot be flipped over again.

name: Squamous Parasite [tdc_rune_t]
text: Retaliate. If Squamous Parasite [tdc_rune_t] would leave play, set it aside, out of play. Forced - When you defeat Squamous Parasite [tdc_rune_t]: Flip this enemy and resolve its text.

name: Squamous Parasite [tdc_rune_t]
text:
The alien creature's hard carapace crumbles to reveal a shining black sigil. It must have devoured this piece of technology... or was it assembled from it? Pressing the sigil projects an image of a cloudy golden sky. Somewhere not of this world. A series of glyphs and descending lines overlay the scene. Eventually, their meaning becomes clear.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_t] In your Campaign Log, record "Air" under [tdc_rune_t] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

name: Ancient Relic [tdc_rune_s]
text:
Twisting portions of the relic unlocks a small cylinder in the center. Inside the cylinder is an even smaller version of the same relic, and within the smaller relic is a glittering gem. Holding it up to the light projects a series of small dots that form some kind of code. One of the expedition members identifies it as a blueprint of sorts: the symbols appear to be instructions for repairing some kind of machine.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_s] In your Campaign Log, record "Machine" under [tdc_rune_s] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

name: Bowels of the City
text: Forced - When your turn begins, if your location is fully flooded, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter a partially flooded or unflooded location during your turn, or decrease your location's flood level, take 5 direct damage.
flavor: The oppressive darkness is filled with the sound of crushing, gnashing machinery.

name: Devil in the Machine
text: The Inescapable gets +1 [per_investigator] health. When The Inescapable moves via its hunter keyword, each location is considered to be connected to each adjacent location. Forced - When your turn begins, if your location is fully flooded, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter a partially flooded or unflooded location during your turn, or decrease your location's flood level, take 5 direct damage.
flavor: This thing won't stop unless you find a way to put it down for good.

name: Ever-Shifting Walls
text: The Inescapable gets +2 [per_investigator] health. When The Inescapable moves via its hunter keyword, each location is considered to be connected to each adjacent location. Forced - When your turn begins, if your location is fully flooded, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter a partially flooded or unflooded location during your turn, or decrease your location's flood level, take 5 direct damage.
flavor: With great effort and no small amount of luck, you may still be able to escape.

name: Careful Navigation
text: [reaction] After the investigators have translated any 3 of the following glyphs ([tdc_rune_l], [tdc_rune_m], [tdc_rune_n], [tdc_rune_p], [tdc_rune_o]): Reveal the Sealed Chamber location. (Hint: Each of these glyphs are found in this scenario.). Objective - When the round ends, if an investigator controls the Tidal Tablet story asset, advance.
flavor: The machinery that serves as the beating heart of R'lyeh is alien in design, but not inscrutable. Thanks to all you've learned up to this point, you may be able to find your way through.

name: Back Through the Machine
text: Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.
flavor: There is only one way in and one way out of the ancient vault, but your route back is fraught with danger. Frothing water continues to pour in, carried by the great waterworks from the rest of the city.

name: The Great Stair
text: The Great Stair cannot be flooded. [action]: Resign. You venture into darkness, leaving the churning machinery behind.

name: Moving Platform
text:
Moving Platform cannot be flooded.
Moving Platform is connected to each adjacent location, and vice versa.
[fast] Investigators at Moving Platform spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Swap Moving Platform with an adjacent [[Vault]] location.

name: Core of the Vault
text: Core of the Vault cannot be flooded. Forced - If The Inescapable is defeated at this location: Search all in- and out-of-play areas for each copy of Still Behind You and remove them from the game. In your Campaign Log, record the creature was defeated. [action] [action] Spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: You study the machine. Proceed to Scenario Interlude: The Vault Core (page 26).

name: Shrouded Cistern
text: This location's flood level cannot be decreased. Forced - After Shrouded Cistern is revealed: Increase its flood level. [action]: You open up a new passageway. Activate this location. Then, increase the flood level of any eligible [[Vault]] location.

name: Chamber of Records [tdc_rune_l]
text:
[action]: Activate this location.
[reaction] After the last clue is discovered from this location, you discover this glyph:
[tdc_rune_l]
In your Campaign Log, record "Arm" under [tdc_rune_l] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated.

name: Chamber of Records [tdc_rune_m]
text:
[action]: Activate this location.
[reaction] After the last clue is discovered from this location, you discover this glyph:
[tdc_rune_m]
In your Campaign Log, record "Earth" under [tdc_rune_m] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated.

name: Otherworldly Mechanisms
text: Forced - When you reveal Otherworldly Mechanisms: Draw 1 random set-aside [[Glyph]] treachery, if able. [action] Choose and discard 3 cards from your hand: Activate this location.

name: Otherworldly Mechanisms
text: Forced - When you reveal Otherworldly Mechanisms: Draw 1 random set-aside [[Glyph]] treachery, if able. [action] Take 1 damage and 1 horror: Activate this location.

name: Otherworldly Mechanisms
text: Forced - When you reveal Otherworldly Mechanisms: Draw 1 random set-aside [[Glyph]] treachery, if able. [action] Spend 5 resources: Activate this location.

name: Otherworldly Mechanisms
text: Forced - When you reveal Otherworldly Mechanisms: Draw 1 random set-aside [[Glyph]] treachery, if able. [action] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck: Draw each revealed weakness and remove the rest from the game. Activate this location.

name: Chamber of the Tablet
text:
Chamber of the Tablet cannot be flooded.
Chamber of the Tablet is connected to the location to the left of it, and vice versa.
[reaction] After the last clue is discovered from Chamber of the Tablet: Choose an investigator at this location to take control of the set-aside Tidal Tablet story asset.

name: Slitherer in Darkness
text: Spawn - Nearest flooded location. Slitherer in Darkness cannot enter unflooded locations. Forced - When the enemy phase begins, if there are no investigators at this enemy's location: This enemy attacks the investigator with the lowest [combat] at a connecting location. If no attack was made, Slitherer in Darkness moves directly to the flooded location nearest the Moving Platform.

name: Vault Attendant
text: Hunter. Spawn - Engaged with prey. Prey - Most clues. When Vault Attendant moves via its hunter keyword, its location is considered to be connected to each activated location.

name: Deadly Mechanisms
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, you must decide (choose one; choose two instead if it is act 2): - Deactivate the nearest activated [[Vault]] location. - Draw 1 of the set-aside Vault Attendant enemies. - Move to an adjacent location (flooded if able).

name: Ancient Vault [tdc_rune_o]
text: Revelation - Attach Ancient Vault [tdc_rune_o] to your location. Cannot be canceled. [action] Choose and discard assets from your play area with a total printed resource cost of at least X, where X is the shroud value of attached location: Flip this card over and resolve its text.

name: Ancient Vault [tdc_rune_o]
text:
A small switch at the base of the wall opens into a cramped musty room. As you enter, a small glyph in the floor begins to glow a dim green. The light intensifies until it is blindingly bright, and the air in the room begins to crackle with energy. The glyph flares even brighter, then goes dark. The symbol's meaning will forever be burned into your memory.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_o] In your Campaign Log, record "Power" under [tdc_rune_o] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

name: Ancient Vault [tdc_rune_n]
text: Revelation - Attach Ancient Vault [tdc_rune_n] to your location. Cannot be canceled. [action] Take a combined total of X damage and/or horror, where X is attached location's shroud: Flip this card over.

name: Ancient Vault [tdc_rune_n]
text:
Within the ancient vault is a large octagonal room that resembles a kind of laboratory. A central console resembles a clawed hand, with two of its "fingers" raised. Nodes in the console project a glowing translucent letter. Curious, you press one hand to a central node. A vision overwhelmes your mind: a torrential wave, a sundered mountain, burning forests and atmosphere. You pull one hand away, uncertain of what you just experienced. A record? A vision?
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_n] In your Campaign Log, record "Doom" under [tdc_rune_n] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

name: Ancient Vault [tdc_rune_p]
text: Revelation - Attach Ancient Vault [tdc_rune_p] to your location. Cannot be canceled. [action] Choose and discard X cards from your hand, where X is attached location's shroud: Flip this card over.

name: Ancient Vault [tdc_rune_p]
text:
The room within the vault is dark and featureless, save for an incandescent, smoky orb suspended in the center. Inspecting it closer, you find a full-scale model of an alien planet. Small storm systems move along the surface at an accelerated rate, swirling and dissipating in seconds. When you touch it, your senses are assailed by invisible gales, torrential rain, and a crack of thunder. Lines of swirling alien writing appear on the globe, conveying a record of an ancient storm.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_p] In your Campaign Log, record "Weather" under [tdc_rune_p] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

name: Ruined Archives
flavor: The massive tower rises above you, promising enticing knowledge and forbidden truths. However, the imminent peril of navigating the ancient, crumbling structure comes into sharp focus as a chunk of obsidian crashes down nearby. For all its grandeur, you are not safe here.

name: Flooded Archives
text: Forced - When your turn begins, if your location is fully flooded, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
flavor: The massive tower promises enticing knowledge and forbidden truths. However, the imminent peril of navigating the ancient, crumbling structure comes into sharp focus as a chunk of obsidian crashes down to the flooded depths below. For all its grandeur, you are not safe here.

name: Unstable Foundations
text: During the enemy phase, each location is considered to be connected to the location above and below it. Forced - After the Great Lift moves: Each investigator at the Great Lift must test [agility] (2). Each investigator who fails takes 1 damage.
flavor: The tower groans as R'lyeh continues its slow ascent from the depths of the ocean.

name: Steps of Giants
text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck (8 cards instead if there is only 1 investigator). Draw 1 [[Glyph]] card discarded by this effect. Then, one at a time, draw each [[Omen]] card discarded by this effect. Objective - After the Great Lift flips to its (Active) side, immediately advance.
flavor: The halls and tall ceilings are divided into massive stacks, like the shelves of a library. There is so much you could learn here.

name: Escape the Tower (v.I)
text: [action] If you are at Twisting Catwalks: Resign. [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck (8 cards instead if there is only 1 investigator). Draw 1 [[Glyph]] card discarded by this effect. Then, one at a time, draw each [[Omen]] card discarded by this effect. Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.
flavor: Your only hope is to find the relic, if you can, and get out before the entire tower crumbles around you!

name: Escape the Tower (v.II)
text: [action] If you are at East Antechamber: Resign. [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck (8 cards instead if there is only 1 investigator). Draw 1 [[Glyph]] card discarded by this effect. Then, one at a time, draw each [[Omen]] card discarded by this effect. Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.
flavor: Your only hope is to find the relic, if you can, and get out before the entire tower crumbles around you!

name: West Antechamber
text: [fast] During your turn, investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group (2 [per_investigator] clues instead if this location is flooded): Slide the Great Lift down once.

name: East Antechamber
text: [fast] During your turn, investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group (2 [per_investigator] clues instead if this location is flooded): Slide the Great Lift down once.

name: Twisting Catwalks
text: Forced - After an enemy at Twisting Catwalks deals damage and/or horror to you: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand. [reaction] After you defeat an enemy at this location: Discard the top X cards of the encounter deck, where X is that enemy's printed health. Draw 1 [[Glyph]] card discarded by this effect.

name: Great Lift
text: Great Lift cannot move and is connected to the locations to the right and left of it, and vice versa. Forced - When the last clue is discovered from this location: Flip Great Lift (keeping all tokens and attachments).

name: Great Lift
text:
Great Lift is connected to the locations to the right and left of it, and vice versa.
[reaction]When you successfully investigate this location, instead of discovering clues: Slide Great Lift up or down once. You may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues to slide Great Lift up or down one additional time.

name: Ancient Altar
text: [action]: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (5) to break the seal. This test gets -1 difficulty for every 5 glyphs the investigators have translated (to a max of -4). If you succeed, take control of the set-aside Shard of Y'ch'lecht story asset.

name: Ring Library
text: [reaction] When you discard 1 or more cards from the top of the encounter deck, choose and discard 1 card from your hand: Discard 2 additional cards from the top of the encounter deck. [action]: Move. Move to a revealed [[Passageway]] location.

name: Ring Library
text: [reaction] When you discard 1 or more cards from the top of the encounter deck, take 1 direct horror: Discard 3 additional cards from the top of the encounter deck.

name: Lofty Walkway
text: This location gets -1 shroud for each [[Glyph]] card in the victory display. Forced - When this location is revealed: Spawn the set-aside Star Spawn Observer at this location. [action]: Move. Move to a revealed [[Passageway]] location.

name: Lofty Walkway
text: Forced - After you discard 1 or more cards from the top of the encounter deck while at Lofty Walkway: The nearest ready, non-[[Elite]] enemy disengages from each investigator and moves to this location.

name: Luminous Archives
text: Luminous Archives gets +1 shroud for each [[Glyph]] card at or attached to it. [fast] Spend X actions (to a minimum of 1): Search the encounter discard pile for up to X [[Glyph]] cards and draw them, one at a time. [action]: Move. Move to a revealed [[Passageway]] location.

name: Luminous Archives
text: Forced - When the investigation phase ends, if there are clues on Luminous Archives: Shuffle each [[Glyph]] treachery attached to this location into the encounter deck. [action] [action]: Search the encounter discard pile for a [[Glyph]] card and draw it.

name: Court Keeper [tdc_rune_k]
text: If the investigators have translated 10 or more glyphs, this enemy gains relentless. Forced - When you defeat this enemy, discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_k] In your Campaign Log, record "Dreams" under [tdc_rune_k] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated.

name: Court Keeper [tdc_rune_j]
text: If the investigators have translated 10 or more glyphs, this enemy gains alert and retaliate. Forced - When you defeat this enemy, discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_j] In your Campaign Log, record "Sleep" under [tdc_rune_j] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated.

name: Ancient Vault [tdc_rune_g]
text: Revelation - If this treachery is drawn from the encounter discard pile, attach it to your location. Otherwise, discard it and it gains surge. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, record "Life" under [tdc_rune_g] on the glyph record in your Campaign Log. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

name: Ancient Vault [tdc_rune_i]
text: Revelation - If this treachery is drawn from the encounter discard pile, attach it to your location. Otherwise, discard it and it gains surge. [action]: Test [combat] (3). If you succeed, record "Cthulhu" under [tdc_rune_i] on the glyph record in your Campaign Log. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

name: Ruined Orrery [tdc_rune_h]
text: Revelation - If this treachery is drawn from the encounter discard pile, attach it to your location. Otherwise, discard it and it gains surge. [action]: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, record "Y'ch'lecht" under [tdc_rune_h] on the glyph record in your Campaign Log. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

name: Colossal Tyrant
text: Massive. Colossal Tyrant gets +3 [per_investigator] health and cannot move. Forced - When the enemy phase ends, if there are no investigators at Colossal Tyrant's location: Deal 1 direct horror to each card with sanity at each adjacent location.

name: Cosmic Omen
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If the investigators have translated 10 or more glyphs, this test gets +2 difficulty. If you fail, you must either shuffle one [[Glyph]] card in play into the encounter deck, or take 1 direct horror and discard 1 card at random from your hand.

name: Winged Keeper
text: Alert. Spawn - Highest level with no investigators. Prey - Lowest [agility]. Forced - When the enemy phase begins, if this enemy is ready and unengaged: It moves to its prey's location.

name: Western Winds
text: Forced - When the round ends, reveal tokens from the chaos bag equal to the storm intensity. If a non-[elder_sign] symbol token is revealed: - Shuffle the rightmost open sky/[[Summit]] locations in rows 2 and 4 and place them on top of the Summit deck (or place them in the victory display instead if they have Victory X and no clues on them). Each enemy, token, and attachment at those locations/open sky are discarded. - Slide each open sky and [[Summit]] location in rows 2 and 4 once to the right. - Place the bottom card of the Summit deck in each gap created. - Flip this card.
flavor: Western gales howl with the fury of the cosmos.

name: Eastern Winds
text: Forced - When the round ends, reveal tokens from the chaos bag equal to the storm intensity. If a non-[elder_sign] symbol token is revealed: - Shuffle the leftmost open sky/[[Summit]] locations in rows 1 and 3 and place them on top of the Summit deck (or place them in the victory display instead if they have Victory X and no clues on them). Each enemy, token, and attachment at those locations/open sky are discarded. - Slide each open sky and [[Summit]] location in rows 1 and 3 once to the left. - Place the bottom card of the Summit deck in each gap created. - Flip this card.
flavor: A necrous wind blows from the eastern skies.

name: Otherworldly Storms
text: Each non-weakness enemy may enter or leave open sky as if it were a location. Each location is connected to each location (and open sky) adjacent to it. Forced - When an investigator's location would leave play: Move that investigator to any [[Central]] location. They take 2 direct damage.
flavor: The clouds around R'lyeh crackle with alien energy as a storm picks up.

name: Encroaching Storms
text: Each non-weakness enemy may enter or leave open sky as if it were a location. Each location is connected to each location (and open sky) adjacent to it. Forced - When an investigator's location would leave play: Move that investigator to any [[Central]] location. They take 2 direct damage.
flavor: The clouds around R'lyeh crackle with alien energy as a storm picks up.

name: Searching the Spires
text: [action] Spend X clues: Reveal X cards from the bottom of the Summit deck. You may put 1 revealed location into play in an adjacent open sky and move to it. (Place that open sky card and each other revealed card on top of the Summit deck in any order.) Objective - If each surviving investigator is at Central Spire, advance.
flavor: The alien skyline calls to you, brimming with ancient secrets.

name: To the Ancient Dome!
text: [action] Spend X clues: Reveal X cards from the bottom of the Summit deck. You may put 1 revealed location into play in an adjacent open sky and move to it. (Place that open sky card and each other revealed card on top of the Summit deck in any order.) Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.
flavor: The alien skyline calls to you, brimming with ancient secrets.

name: Scouring the Spires
text: [action] Spend X clues: Reveal X cards from the bottom of the Summit deck. You may put 1 revealed location into play in an adjacent open sky and move to it. (Place that open sky card and each other revealed card on top of the Summit deck in any order.) Objective - If each surviving investigator is at Central Spire, advance.
flavor: The alien skyline calls to you, brimming with ancient secrets.

name: Deadly Skies
text: [action] Spend X clues: Reveal X cards from the bottom of the Summit deck. You may put 1 revealed location into play in an adjacent open sky and move to it. (Place that open sky card and each other revealed card on top of the Summit deck in any order.) Objective - If each surviving investigator is at Floating Spire, advance.
flavor: A distant waterfall and gravity-defying spire beckon you onward.

name: Return to the Shoreline
text: [action] Spend X clues: Reveal X cards from the bottom of the Summit deck. You may put 1 revealed location into play in an adjacent open sky and move to it. (Place that open sky card and each other revealed card on top of the Summit deck in any order.) Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.
flavor: You can recognize the western wall in the distance where you made landfall.

name: R'lyeh Streets
text: R'lyeh Streets cannot be moved or leave play. [action] Spend 1-3 resources: Place that many clues (from the token pool) on any revealed location (Limit once per round.)

name: Central Spire
text: Central Spire cannot be moved or leave play. [action] Spend 1-3 resources: Place that many clues (from the token pool) on any revealed location (Limit once per round.)

name: Floating Spire
text: Floating Spire cannot be moved or leave play. [action] Spend 1-3 resources: Place that many clues (from the token pool) on any revealed location (Limit once per round.)

name: Western Wall
text: Western Wall cannot be moved or leave play. Forced - After you reveal this location: Draw the set-aside Eroded Frieze [tdc_rune_e] treachery. [action]: Resign. You clamber down.

name: Ancient Dome
text: Ancient Dome cannot be moved or leave play. Forced - After you reveal this location: Draw the set-aside Eroded Frieze [tdc_rune_e] treachery. [action]: Resign. You clamber down.

name: Eastern Athenaeum [tdc_rune_b]
text:
[action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: You discover this glyph:
[tdc_rune_b]
In your Campaign Log, record "Plant" under [tdc_rune_b] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated.

name: Western Athenaeum [tdc_rune_c]
text:
[reaction] After you discover the last clue at this location: You discover this glyph:
[tdc_rune_c]
In your Campaign Log, record "Elder Thing" under [tdc_rune_c] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated.

name: Obsidian Cliffs
text: [action] Choose an adjacent open sky: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, put the set-aside Glyph Orrery [tdc_rune_d] into play in the chosen open sky (placing that open sky on top of the Summit deck).

name: Suspended Reef
text: Forced - After you end your turn at this location: You must either discard 1 card at random from your hand or take 1 damage. [fast] During your turn, spend 1 clue: Choose an enemy at a [[Summit]] location up to 3 connections away. Swap places with the chosen enemy, ignoring its location's Forced effect.

name: Hanging Ship
text: Forced - After you end your turn at this location: Test [agility] (X), where X is the number of investigators at this location. If you fail, discard Hanging Ship (to the top of the Summit deck). [action] Each investigator at this location spends 1 clue: Slide Hanging Ship once into an adjacent open sky.

name: Ancient Canyons
text: Forced - After you reveal this location: Test [agility] (1). If you fail, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Monster]] enemy and spawn it engaged with you. [action]: Put the set-aside Sky Relic [tdc_rune_f] asset into play under your control.

name: Dazzling Skyline
text: Forced - After you reveal Dazzling Skyline: Take 1 horror. [action] Spend 1-3 clues: For each clue spent, reveal the bottom 3 cards of the Summit deck. You may place those cards on either the top or bottom of the Summit deck, in any order.

name: Aerial Waterfall
text: [fast] During your turn, spend 1 clue: Choose any revealed [[Summit]] location and move to it. (Limit once per round.) [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Put the set-aside Obsidian Claw story asset into play under control of any investigator, (Speed) side faceup.

name: Magnetic Spires
text:
You cannot trigger abilities on [[Firearm]] assets while you are at Magnetic Spires.
[action] Each investigator at this location spends 1 clue: Choose an open sky up to 2 spaces away. Swap Magnetic Spires with the chosen open sky. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Glyph Orrery [tdc_rune_d]
text: If Glyph Orrery [tdc_rune_d] would leave play, set it aside, out of play (or in the victory display if it has no clues on it). Forced - When you would enter this location, if you do not control the Obsidian Claw: You must either spend 1 clue or test [agility] (2). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move. [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Flip this card.

name: Glyph Orrery [tdc_rune_d]
text:
You discover this glyph:
[tdc_rune_d]
In your Campaign Log, record "Wave" under [tdc_rune_d] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated.
Flip this card back over to its location side. It cannot be flipped over again.
flavor: A brilliant map of distant nebulae fills the room, bursting with color and light. A cerulean glob near the edge draws your attention. Staring at it fills your mind with a sharp, chittering alien language and the crash of waves. As you begin to mouth the strange language, a symbol glimmers in the cerulean sphere. Looking at it fills you with a deep yearning, an instinct to dive into deep underwater nests. Is this a word you learned, or an ancient, primordial memory recalled?

name: Sky Relic [tdc_rune_f]
text:
You discover the following glyph:
[tdc_rune_f]
In your Campaign Log, record "Stars" under [tdc_rune_f] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.
flavor: Twisting a hidden knob in the relic's base releases a shower of sparks. You nearly drop the relic from surprise, but the "sparks" are merely random pinpricks of light and thick clouds of fog that shift like oil on water. The more you look at them, the more they resemble constellations, patterns of distant stars. The projection looks nothing like the constellations you've seen before, however.

name: Eroded Frieze [tdc_rune_e]
text: Revelation - Attach Eroded Frieze [tdc_rune_e] to your location. Cannot be canceled. If Eroded Frieze [tdc_rune_e] would leave play, set it aside, out of play. [action]: Test [combat] or [intellect] (3). If you fail, take 1 damage. Otherwise, put 1 resource on this card. If there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on Eroded Frieze [tdc_rune_e], flip it and resolve its text.

name: Eroded Frieze [tdc_rune_e]
text:
You discover this glyph:
[tdc_rune_e]
In your Campaign Log, record "Darkness" under [tdc_rune_e] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.
flavor: Parts of the frieze are worn smooth by the passage of time, but you eventually identify the shapes of mountains, clouds, mist. Within the mist, nightmarish shapes appear to be locked in some kind of struggle. Frightened creatures look up from below. Underneath it all, a cyclopean eye gazes intensely at an underground city deep below the surface. Heavy accenting depicts a roiling mist that fills the streets of the city. Each of the citizens reclines in a look of terrifying repose.

name: St. Elmo's Fire
text: Revelation - Attach St. Elmo's Fire to the nearest location without St. Elmo's Fire attached. Forced - When the round ends: Each investigator at this location takes 1 damage. Attach St. Elmo's Fire to an adjacent location (with investigators, if able).

name: Acrophobia
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (1). This test gets +1 difficulty for each open sky adjacent to your location. For each point you fail by, you must either lose 1 action or take 1 horror.
flavor: You shouldn't have looked down.

name: Wings of Terror
text: Revelation - Put Wings of Terror into play in your threat area. Forced - After you fail a skill test: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded. Either draw that enemy, or that enemy attacks you (from the discard pile). Then, discard Wings of Terror.

name: Lost in the Clouds
text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance. - Each investigator takes 2 direct horror. - Resolve the Forced effect on the Eastern Winds/Western Winds story card as if you had drawn a non-[elder_sign] symbol token.

name: Primeval Terror
text:
Patrol (nearest empty [[Summit]] location).
Cannot make attacks of opportunity.
While engaged with this enemy, you may enter open sky as if it were a location. If you defeat or disengage from this enemy while at open sky, you are defeated and suffer 1 physical trauma.

name: Star Vampire
text: Hunter. Relentless. Prey - Most remaining health. Forced - After this enemy attacks: Heal 1 damage from it.

name: Beneath the City
text: Forced - When doom would be placed on a card other than a story asset: Place 1 resource on the scenario reference card, as Disturbance, instead. If the current Disturbance is 6 or more (8 or more instead of there are exactly 1 or 2 investigators in the game), immediately advance (do not remove doom from cards in play). Objective - Prepare your artifacts for the final showdown!

name: Cthulhu
text: Hunter. Massive. Relentless. Spawn - Dreamer's Rest. Forced - After Cthulhu is evaded: Either ready him, or each investigator at Cthulhu's location takes 1 direct damage.

name: Cthulhu Awakened
text: Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda: Each investigator takes 1 direct horror. [fast] During your turn, remove 1 doom from an [[Artifact]] asset you control: Cthulhu loses relentless and gets -1 fight and -1 evade until the end of the round. (Limit once per asset per round.) Objective - If you manage to defeat Cthulhu: (→R1) (page 39)

name: Dreamer's Rest
text: Forced - After an investigator fails a test at this location: Place 1 resource on the scenario reference card, as Disturbance.
flavor: There is something unsettling about the still black water.

name: Sigil-Carved Alcove
text: Forced - When Cthulhu enters this location: Each investigator discards 1 card at random from their hand. [action]: Test [willpower] (5). If you succeed, place 1 doom on Obsidian Claw. Investigators at this location may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to place 1 additional doom on Obsidian Claw.

name: Sigil-Carved Alcove
text: Forced - When Cthulhu enters this location: Each investigator takes 1 direct damage. [action]: Test [combat] (5). If you succeed, place 1 doom on Barrier Node. Investigators at this location may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to place 1 additional doom on Barrier Node.

name: Sigil-Carved Alcove
text: Forced - When Cthulhu enters this location: Each investigator takes 1 direct horror. [action]: Test [intellect] (5). If you succeed, place 1 doom on Tidal Tablet. Investigators at this location may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to place 1 additional doom on Tidal Tablet.

name: Sigil-Carved Alcove
text: Forced - When Cthulhu enters this location: Each investigator loses 2 resources. [action]: Test [agility] (5). If you succeed, place 1 doom on Grisly "Mask". Investigators at this location may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to place 1 additional doom on Grisly "Mask".

name: Sigil-Carved Alcove
text: Forced - When Cthulhu enters this location: Each investigator removes the top card of their deck from the game. [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Place 1 doom on Shard of Y'ch'lecht. Investigators at this location may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to place 1 additional doom on Shard of Y'ch'lecht.

name: The Coming Storm
text: [action]: Resign. You give up your search. Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda: Increase the flood level of the lead investigator's location.
flavor: The downpour worsens. As the streets begin to flood, terrifying creatures emerge from the shadows: creatures that could only have come from R'lyeh.

name: The Phantom Shop
text: [action] Investigators at your location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Draw the top card beneath your location. If it is an asset, take control of it. Objective - When the round ends, if an investigator at Tillinghast Esoterica controls at least 1 [[Artifact]] asset, the investigators may advance. (Hint: Recover as many artifacts as possible!)
flavor: Conflicting accounts place Tillinghast Esoterica in locations across Arkham.

name: Tillinghast Esoterica
text: Revelation - Put Tillinghast Esoterica into play adjacent to your location and spawn the set-aside Randall Tillinghast at it. Shuffle each set-aside [[Artifact]] asset and place them underneath it as a stack. Tillinghast Esoterica is connected to the location from which it was drawn, and vice versa. [fast]: Place clues on this location up to its clue value.

name: Randall Tillinghast
text:
Relentless. Retaliate. 
Randall Tillinghast cannot move and gets +1 fight and +1[per_investigator] health for each card beneath Tillinghast Esoterica.
flavor: "There is far more happening here than you could possibly comprehend."

name: The Doom of Arkham
text: Forced - When the enemy phase ends: Increase the flood level of Cthulhu's location and draw the top card of the Cthulhu deck. Forced - When the round ends: Each investigator at a fully flooded location takes 1 damage/horror.

name: Fight Back!
text: [fast] During an attack at your location, spend 1 clue: That attack deals +1 damage. (Max once per attack.) Objective - When the round ends, if there are 3 [[Cthulhu]] enemies in the victory display, advance.
flavor: With the others at your side, you must make a final stand to save Arkham!

name: Banish Him!
text: [fast] During an attack at your location, spend 1 clue: That attack deals +1 damage. (Max once per attack.) Objective - When the round ends, if there are 3 [[Cthulhu]] enemies in the victory display, advance.
flavor: By drawing Cthulhu's anger, you and your allies may be able to devise a way to seal the ancient one away!

name: The Final Seal
text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, and place an [[Artifact]] asset you control in the victory display: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on your location, as a sigil. Forced - When the enemy phase ends: Draw the top card of the Cthulhu deck. Objective - Banish the awakened dreamer! If each [[Cthulhu]] enemy is in the victory display and there are 5 locations with sigils on them, immediately advance.

name: Northside
text:
Northside cannot be fully flooded.
[action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, reveal the top 3 cards of the Cthulhu deck. You may discard 1 of them and place the rest back on top in any order. (Group limit once per round.)

name: Downtown
text: [reaction] When a [[Star Spawn]] enemy enters Downtown, spend 3 resources: Automatically evade that enemy.
flavor: A few socialites and club-goers stagger through the flooded streets, seemingly lost in dreams.

name: Easttown
text:
Easttown cannot be fully flooded.
[action] Discard an [[Ally]] asset you control: Decrease this location's flood level and draw 3 cards. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Miskatonic University
text:
Miskatonic University cannot be fully flooded.
[action] Choose and discard up to 3 cards with [intellect] icons from your hand: For each card discarded in this way, heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at Miskatonic University. (Limit once per game.)

name: Rivertown
text: [action]: Test [agility] (3) or [intellect] (3) to attempt to open the emergency drain. If you succeed, decrease the flood level of this or an adjacent location. (Group limit once per game.)

name: St. Mary's Hospital
text:
St. Mary's Hospital cannot be fully flooded.
[reaction] After Cthulhu enters St. Mary's Hospital: Place up to 3 of your clues on this location. For each clue placed in this way, deal 1 damage to an enemy at this location. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Southside
text: [action] Choose an [[Item]] asset in your discard pile and add it to your hand. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: The old family homes of Southside have been reduced to splinters.

name: Western Rooftops
text:
Western Rooftops cannot be flooded and sigils cannot be placed on it.
Northside, Miskatonic University, and St. Mary's Hospital are connected to Western Rooftops, and vice versa.
While you are at Western Rooftops, you may fight and evade enemies at connecting locations as if you were at their location.

name: Eastern Rooftops
text:
Eastern Rooftops cannot be flooded and sigils cannot be placed on it.
Easttown, Rivertown, and Southside are connected to Eastern Rooftops, and vice versa.
While you are at Eastern Rooftops, you may fight and evade enemies at connecting locations as if you were at their location.

name: Cthulhu
text:
Each [[Cthulhu]] enemy on the Cthulhu Board shares this enemy's [[Traits]], text box, and location.
Massive. Patrol (nearest location that can be flooded). Cannot make attacks of opportunity.

name: Cthulhu
text: Alert. Prey - Highest [agility]. X is Cthulhu's Rage. Cannot be damaged, defeated, or exhausted. [reaction] After you successfully fight or evade this enemy: Flip it to its [[Enraged]] side.

name: Cthulhu
text: Alert. Prey - Highest [agility]. X is Cthulhu's Rage. Cannot be exhausted. Forced - After you flip this enemy to this side: Draw the top card of the Cthulhu deck. [reaction] After you evade this enemy: Deal 1 damage to it.

name: Cthulhu
text: Alert. Retaliate. Prey - Highest [willpower]. X is Cthulhu's Rage. Cannot be damaged, defeated, or exhausted. [reaction] After you successfully fight or evade this enemy: Flip it to its [[Enraged]] side.

name: Cthulhu
text: Alert. Retaliate. Prey - Highest [willpower]. X is Cthulhu's Rage. Cannot be exhausted. Forced - After you flip this enemy to this side: Discard 1 card at random from your hand. [reaction] After you evade this enemy: Deal 1 damage to it.

name: Cthulhu
text: Retaliate. Prey - Highest [combat]. X is Cthulhu's Rage. Cannot be damaged, defeated, or exhausted. [reaction] After you successfully fight or evade this enemy: Flip it to its [[Enraged]] side.

name: Cthulhu
text: Retaliate. Prey - Highest [combat]. X is Cthulhu's Rage. Cannot be exhausted. Forced - After you flip this enemy to this side: Place 1 doom on it. [reaction] After you evade this enemy: Deal 1 damage to it.

name: Ruthless Charge
text: If Cthulhu (Hoary Wings) is in play: Each investigator at Cthulhu's location discards one card from hand at random. If Cthulhu (Fierce Visage) is in play: Cthulhu (Fierce Visage) attacks the investigator with the highest [willpower] at Chulhu's location. If no attack was made, the investigator with the highest [willpower] draws the top card of the encounter deck. That card's effects cannot be canceled and it loses surge. If Cthulhu (Wicked Claw) is in play: The investigator with the highest [combat] at Cthulhu's location must test [combat] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If they fail, Cthulhu (Wicked Claw) attacks them.

name: Hurricane Force
text: If Cthulhu (Hoary Wings) is in play: Resolve Cthulhu's patrol keyword an additional time. If Cthulhu (Fierce Visage) is in play: The nearest investigator to Cthulhu must test [willpower] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If that investigator fails, Cthulhu (Fierce Visage) attacks them. If Cthulhu (Wicked Claw) is in play: Choose an investigator at Cthulhu's location to test [agility] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If that investigator fails, they must either increase the flood level of Cthulhu's location, or take 1 damage or 1 horror.

name: Dire Gale
text: If Cthulhu (Hoary Wings) is in play: Each investigator at Cthulhu's location discards 1 card at random from hand. Resolve Cthulhu's patrol keyword an additional time. If Cthulhu (Fierce Visage) is in play: The investigator with the highest [willpower] tests [willpower] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If they fail, they must either take 1 horror, or choose and discard a non-story asset they control. If Cthulhu (Wicked Claw) is in play: If Cthulhu did not move via his patrol keyword this round, Cthulhu (Wicked Claw) attacks each investigator at its location.

name: Dreadsight
text: If Cthulhu (Hoary Wings) is in play: The investigator with the highest [agility] tests [agility] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If they fail, they take 1 damage or 1 horror. If Cthulhu (Fierce Visage) is in play: Each investigator at Cthulhu's location loses 2 resources. If Cthulhu (Wicked Claw) is in play: The investigators must decide, as a group: - Each investigator loses 1 action during their next turn. - Cthulhu (Wicked Claw) attacks each investigator at its location. - Each investigator takes 1 direct horror.

name: Demolition
text: Place 1 damage token on the [[Rooftop]] location nearest to Cthulhu, as a ruin token. If there are 2 or more ruin tokens on that location,each investigator is killed and each enemy at that location is discarded. Then, remove that location and this card from the game. Otherwise, shuffle this card into the Cthulhu deck along with the Cthulhu discard pile.

name: Fifth Eye
text: Put this card into play next to the agenda deck. Forced - When the investigation phase ends: Place 1 doom on an enemy on the Cthulhu Board with no doom on it and discard this card.

name: Seismic Stomp
text:
If there are no investigators at Cthulhu's location, discard this card and draw the top card of the Cthulhu deck.
Otherwise, each investigator at Cthulhu's location tests [agility] or [willpower] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If they fail, they must either take 1 damage/horror, or discard 1 card from their hand at random.

name: Eldritch Call
text:
If there are no investigators at Cthulhu's location, discard this card and draw the top card of the Cthulhu deck.
Otherwise, each investigator at Cthulhu's location tests [willpower] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If 1 or more investigators fail, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded and spawn it at Cthulhu's location.

name: Psychic Rebuke
text:
If there are no [[Cthulhu]] enemies in the victory display, discard this card and draw the top card of the Cthulhu deck.
Otherwise, choose an investigator to test [willpower] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If they fail, choose a [[Cthulhu]] enemy in the victory display and return it to the Cthulhu board, [[Enraged]] side faceup.

name: Rising Tides
text:
Decrease the flood level of Cthulhu's location and choose another location (with an investigator, if able) that can have its flood level increased. Increase the flood level of the chosen location.
Each investigator at a fully flooded location tests [agility] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If they fail, they must either take 1 damage or discard a non-story asset they control.

name: Hope Fades
text: Put this card into play next to the agenda deck. Search the chaos bag and all in- and out-of-play areas for the [elder_sign] token and seal it on this card. (If you cannot, search the chaos bag for the numbered token with the highest positive value and seal it on this card instead.) Forced - When the act advances: Discard this card (release the token sealed here).

name: Lay Waste
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If you fail, take 2 damage.
flavor: Arkham will never be the same. The ancient creature tosses trees, houses, and vehicles aside as if they were made of paper.

name: Eyes of Y'ch'lecht
text: Peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If you fail, take 1 direct horror and discard 1 card at random from your hand.
flavor: [tdc_rune_m] · [tdc_rune_l][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_k] · [tdc_rune_h][tdc_rune_x][tdc_rune_n] · [tdc_rune_g][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_c][tdc_rune_b] · [tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_h] · [tdc_rune_z][tdc_rune_s][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_f][tdc_rune_e] · [tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_h][tdc_rune_k]

name: Gross Plasticity
text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the agenda to advance. - Increase the flood level of your location. - Each investigator takes 1 damage or 1 horror.

name: Arkham Under Assault
text: Revelation - Each investigator tests [willpower] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If 1 or more investigators fail, draw the top card of the Cthulhu deck.
flavor: [tdc_rune_l][tdc_rune_n][tdc_rune_j][tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_c] · [tdc_rune_c][tdc_rune_x] · [tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_h] · [tdc_rune_g][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_p][tdc_rune_p] · [tdc_rune_c][tdc_rune_b][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_s][tdc_rune_k] · [tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_l] · [tdc_rune_f][tdc_rune_x] · [tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_l][tdc_rune_u][tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_q][tdc_rune_k]

name: Film Fatale
text:
Standard
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the current agenda number.
[cultist]: -3 (-5 instead if there is a [[Monster]] enemy at your location).
[tablet]: -3. If there is a [[Saturnite]] enemy at your location, reveal another token.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail and there is a [[Dinosaur]] enemy at your location, ready that enemy. That enemy attacks you.

name: Showbusiness As Usual
text: As you walk with André, he mentions the trouble around the lot all started when the producer, Erika Strand, found the "deal of the century" on three props for the films. Ever since then, people have been acting strange, things have been disappearing, and the world just doesn't seem right.

name: Colliding Realities
text: Forced - The first time each round an investigator draws a copy of Bleeding Reality: After resolving its effects, that investigators draws the top card of the Reel deck.
flavor: Reality continues to warp and bend. It isn't just one film coming to life: all three are blending together in pure chaos.

name: André's Request
text: Each Possessed Extra gains aloof. Objective - Investigate as many of the cursed props as you can. At the end of the round, if there are 2 or more [[Prop]] assets in the victory display, the investigators may advance.
flavor: The mishaps that have plagued Lot C all seem to stem from several strange props. By tracking them down, you may be able to put a stop to these unfortunate events.

name: Helios Telescope
text:
Uses (0 shards).
[action] Spend 1 shard: Discard an exhausted non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. Then, for each remaining shard on Helios Telescope, deal 1 damage to an [[Elite]] enemy at any location.

name: Staff of the Serpent
text: Damage cannot be assigned to Staff of the Serpent except by the ability below. [action] If it is act 3: Fight. Add your [willpower] to your skill value for this attack. If this attack defeats an enemy, deal 1 damage to Staff of the Serpent (2 damage instead of the defeated enemy is [[Elite]]).

name: Accursed Cape
text: Accursed Cape gets +2 [per_investigator] health. When damage would be placed on attached enemy, place 1 of that damage on Accursed Cape. Forced - When Accursed Cape is defeated: Place it in the victory display.

name: Central Lot
text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Add the topmost card beneath Central Lot to the victory display.

name: Central Lot
text: Forced - When the round ends, if there are no clues on Central Lot: Place clues on Central Lot up to its clue value.
flavor: Saturnites and werewolves and dinosaurs, oh my!

name: Space Set
text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, lose 1 action. [action]: Play an asset from your hand, reducing its cost by 2. (Limit once per game.)

name: Jungle Set
text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Test [agility] (2). If you fail, you must either take 1 damage or discard an asset you control. [action]: Reveal the top 6 cards of your deck. Choose a revealed [[Item]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per game.)

name: Gothic Set
text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Test [combat] (2). If you fail, ready the nearest enemy. It moves towards, engages, and attacks the nearest investigator. [reaction] After you defeat an enemy at Gothic Set: Heal 1 horror.

name: Flip the Script
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (0). Each matching skill icon committed to this test subtracts from your skill value instead of adding to it. For each point you succeed by, you must either take 1 horror or place 1 of your clues on your location (to a maximum of 3).

name: Found Footage
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is equal to your location's shroud value. If you fail, take 2 horror.

name: Action!
text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Lose 2 actions. - Each investigator at your location takes 1 damage and 1 horror.

name: "Break a Leg!"
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, you must either take 2 damage, or choose and discard a non-story [[Item]] asset you control.

name: Bleeding Reality
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (X), where X is 1 more than the current act number. For each point you fail by, discard 1 card at random from your hand (to a maximum of 3).

name: Last Looks
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +2 difficulty if there is 3 or more damage on you. If you fail, take 1 direct horror and discard 1 card at random from your hand.

name: Creature Feature
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] + [combat] (5). If you fail, draw the topmost [[Creature]] or [[Monster]] enemy in the encounter discard pile. If you failed and no enemy was drawn by this effect, take 1 horror and Creature Feature gains surge.

name: Possessed Extra
flavor: "There is only one longing! Back to Earth!" -Woman in the Moon

name: Possessed Extra
flavor: "Your record as a hunter of big game will add weight to your testimony- if we return!" -The Lost World

name: Possessed Extra
flavor: "Feast your eyes! Glut your soul on my accursed ugliness!" -The Phantom of the Opera

name: Erika Strand
text: Forced - When the enemy phase begins, if Erika Strand is ready: Reveal 1 random token from the chaos bag. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] token is revealed, ready each other [[Possessed]] enemy. Those enemies gain hunter and lose aloof until the end of the round.

name: Ghost Light
text:
Hunter.
Cannot be damaged except by [[Spell]], [[Relic]], [[Charm]], or encounter cards.
[reaction] After Ghost Light is successfully evaded: Deal 1 damage to it.

name: André Patel
text:
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test in which 2 or more cards were committed, exhaust André Patel: Immediately take an action as if it were your turn (this action does not count toward the number of actions you can take each turn).

name: A Cosmic Journey
text: Each Possessed Extra gets +2 health. Objective - Rebuild the telescope. When the round ends, if there are 3 shards on Helios Telescope, advance. (Hint: Explore the cosmos to rebuild the telescope.)
flavor: As you float noiselessly through space, André mentions that the Telescope must have caused this madness. With nothing but Saturn and its moons in front of you, you have no other choice but to explore these celestial bodies.

name: From Whence They Came
text: Each Possessed Extra gets +2 health, +1 fight, +1 evade, and gains elusive and the [[Saturnite]] trait. [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 shard on Helios Telescope. Forced - If Helios Telescope has no shards on it, advance. Objective - Dethrone the monarch. If the Saturnite Monarch is defeated, advance.
flavor: The telescope's transporting beam may be able to send the Saturnites home, but the monarch is hellbent upon taking it.

name: High Ruler's Bastion
text: Forced - At the end of the round, if there are no clues on High Ruler's Bastion: Place clues on this location up to its clue value. [fast] If the Saturnite Monarch is in the victory display: Place 1 shard on Helios Telescope. (Max once per game.)

name: Teetawn Passage
text:
Teetawn Passage gets -X shroud, where X is the combined cost of each asset beneath Teetawn Passage.
[fast] If there are no clues on Teetawn Passage: Place 1 shard on Helios Telescope. (Max once per game.)

name: Ritual Site Teetawn
text: [action]: Make a sacrifice. Test [willpower] + [agility] (5). If you succeed, you may place up to two non-story assets from your hand or play area under Teetawn Passage. Then, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If it is an enemy, draw it.

name: Tothis Barrens
text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if there are any ready enemies at Tothis Barrens: Discard 1 shard on Tothis Barrens. [action] If there are no clues on Tothis Barrens: Move 1 shard on Tothis Barrens to Helios Telescope (Max once per game.)

name: Ritual Site Tothis
text: [fast] If there is no shard on Tothis Barrens: Disturb the ritual site. Discard the top 1 [per_investigator] cards from the encounter deck. Spawn each enemy discarded by this effect at Tothis Barrens. Place 1 resource token (from the token pool) on Tothis Barrens, as a shard.

name: Saturnite Monarch
text: Aloof. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, place 1 resource (from the token pool) on Saturnite Monarch. If there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on Saturnite Monarch, add it to the victory display.

name: Saturnite Monarch
text: Alert. Hunter. Massive. Saturnite Monarch gets +1 fight for each other enemy in play (to a max of +3). Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Saturnite Monarch is at the same location as Helios Telescope, remove 1 shard from Helios Telescope.

name: Saturnite Drudge Militia
text: Elusive. Retaliate. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (3) to make loud noises. For each point you succeed by, deal 1 damage to Saturnite Drudge Militia. If you succeed by 2 or more, exhaust it.

name: Lost Asteroid
text: Revelation - Disengage from each enemy, put Lost Asteroid into play, and move to it. Investigators at Lost Asteroid get -1 to all skills during the mythos phase. [action]: Test [agility] (4). If you succeed, move to a revealed location and discard Lost Asteroid. (You may spend 4 resources to automatically succeed.)

name: Celestial Shower
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] + [agility] (6). If you fail, investigators at your location take a combined total of X damage, divided as you choose. X is the number of investigators at your location.

name: Rocket Ship
text:
Vehicle.
[fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Blast off! Move Rocket Ship to a [[Cosmos]] location. Reveal a token from the chaos bag. If a symbol token is revealed, each investigator leaves Rocket Ship. Then, flip this card over.
flavor: It seems bigger on the inside.

name: Curious Moon
text: Massive. Forced - If Curious Moon is successfully attacked or evaded, flip this card over.
flavor: Your reckless flight has attracted unwanted attention. You can't risk flying until this pesky planetoid is dealt with.

name: The Forgotten Island
text: Each Possessed Extra gets +1 health, +1 evade, and gains alert. [fast] Investigators at the same [[Jungle]] location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Move 1 seal from Ruins of the Serpent King to Allosaurus. Objective - When the round ends, if each surviving investigator and the Staff of the Serpent are at Jungle Set, advance.
flavor: You have found yourself in an actual tropical jungle. If the staff is behind these strange events, you should find it immediately.

name: Destroy the Source
text: Each Possessed Extra gets +2 health, +2 evade, and gains alert and the [[Dinosaur]] trait. [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Search the top 6 cards of the encounter deck for an enemy and spawn it at the location with the most investigators. Objective - Shatter the staff. If the Staff of the Serpent is defeated, advance.
flavor: Prehistoric terrors have begun to overrun Lot C. The staff's power is warping reality. To end this nightmare, you must destroy it!

name: Western Ridge
text: [reaction] When you attempt to evade an enemy at Western Ridge, choose and discard 2 cards from your hand: That enemy gets -2 evade for this evasion attempt. (Limit once per round.)

name: Tar Pit
