text: Forced - When you end your turn at this location: Test [combat] (2). If you fail, you must either take 1 direct horror or discard an [[Ally]] or [[Footwear]] asset you control.

name: Eastern Ridge
text: [reaction] When you attempt to fight an enemy at Eastern Ridge, spend 3 resources: That enemy gets -2 fight for this attack. (Limit once per round.)

name: Jungle River
text: Forced - When you leave this location: Test [agility] (2). If you fail, you must either take 1 direct damage or discard a [[Weapon]] or [[Clothing]] asset you control.

name: Ruins of the Serpent King
text:
[action] Choose an enemy at Ruins of the Serpent King and spend X clues, where X is that enemy's fight value: Exhaust that enemy.
[action]: You attempt to wrest the staff from the altar. Test [willpower] + [combat] (6). If you succeed, take control of the Staff of the Serpent.

name: Allosaurus
text: Alert. Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Allosaurus cannot be damaged or defeated. Forced - After a seal is placed on Allosaurus, if there are 4 seals on it: Remove each seal from Allosaurus and flip it over.

name: Allosaurus
text: Alert. Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Allosaurus gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After Allosaurus enters your location: You must either take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror, or Allosaurus defeats an [[Ally]] asset at your location.

name: Dromaeosaurus
text: Elusive. Hunter. Forced - After Dromaeosaurus engages you: You must either choose or discard 1 card from your hand, or Dromaeosaurus attacks you.
flavor: The creature moves rapidly and without a sound. This is no puppet from a film. This is a real predator.

name: Primordial Terror
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror. If you fail by 3 or more, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Dinosaur]] and spawn it engaged with you. If the encounter deck was searched, shuffle it.

name: Unexpected Transformation
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is the highest resource cost among non-story assets you control. If you fail, you must either discard that asset, or take 1 horror for each [willpower] and [intellect] skill icon on that asset and 1 damage for each [combat] and [agility] skill icon on that asset.

name: The Abominable Contessa
text: Each Possessed Extra gets +1 fight, +1 health, and gains elusive. Exhausted enemies cannot be damaged. Objective - When the round ends, if the Accursed Cape is in the victory display, advance.
flavor: You and André have found yourselves trapped in a horror film... and you are the victims. You have to find the Contessa and wrest her cursed cape from her!

name: Bloodbath
text: Each Possessed Extra gets +2 fight, +2 health, and gains patrol (The Contessa) and the [[Monster]] trait. [fast] Spend 1 clue: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. Objective - Finish her! If The Contessa is defeated, advance.
flavor: An unnatural darkness overtakes Lot C. The Contessa has reclaimed her cape! If you hope to survive, you will need to defeat her once and for all.

name: Castle Hallways
text: Haunted - Choose and discard 1 card with at least 1 [knowledge] skill icon from your hand. If you cannot, ready The Contessa and move her to this location. [fast] Spend 1 resource: Move to any revealed [[Castle]] location.

name: Catacombs
text: Haunted - Ready the nearest enemy. It moves and attacks as if it were the enemy phase. Forced - When an enemy would be defeated in the Catacombs: Instead, heal all damage from it, disengage it from each investigator, and exhaust it.

name: Clock Tower
text: Haunted - Choose and discard 1 card with at least 1 [agility] skill icon from your hand. If you cannot, take 2 damage. This location is investigated using [agility] instead of the skill indicated by the investigation attempt.

name: Moonlit Garden
text: Haunted - Heal 2 damage from the nearest enemy. If no damage was healed by this effect, ready The Contessa and move her to this location. [reaction] After you successfully evade a non-[[Elite]] enemy at Moonlit Garden by 2 or more: Move that enemy to a connecting location. (Group limit once per round.)

name: Throne of Blood
subname: Red as Blood, Black as Night
text: The Contessa cannot leave Throne of Blood. Forced - When you reveal this location: Search all in- and out-of-play areas for The Contessa and move her to Throne of Blood. Heal all damage from The Contessa and attach the set-aside Accursed Cape story asset to her. [fast] Spend 1 clue: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at Throne of Blood

name: The Contessa
text: Elusive. Prey - Most remaining health. Forced - After you evade The Contessa: Ready her. She cannot attack you for the rest of the round. Forced - When The Contessa moves via her elusive keyword: Move her to the Throne of Blood instead.

name: The Contessa
text:
Elusive.
While the Accursed Cape is attached to The Contessa, she gets +1 damage and gains hunter and retaliate.

name: Vampire Thrall
text: Elusive. Hunter. Prey - Least remaining health. Forced - After Vampire Thrall attacks: Heal 1 damage from it.
flavor: "You have such a beautiful neck..."

name: Werewolf
text: Elusive. Hunter. Retaliate Prey - Most remaining health. This enemy moves twice via its hunter keyword.
flavor: This actor seems to have gotten a little too into character.

name: Hellfire
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (1) three times. For each of these skill tests you fail, take 1 damage.
flavor: "Fools! You can never defeat me!"

name: Vampire's Kiss
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). This test gets +2 difficulty if you have 3 or fewer damage on you. If you fail, take 1 damage. For each point you fail by, heal 1 damage from the nearest eligible enemy.
flavor: They say that the bite of a vampire is the most exquisite kind of pain imaginable.

name: A Noble Legacy (Past)
text: [action] If you, Thomas Corrigan, and Mary Zielinski are all at the [[Past]] Miskatonic University: Announce "Thomas and Mary have met." [action] If Thomas Corrigan, Mary Zielinski, and Nikola Tesla are all at the same location, spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Announce "Thomas and Mary are inspired by Nikola Tesla." [fast] If you are at the [[Past]] Miskatonic University, spend 2 [per_investigator] resources: Announce "funding for an observatory has begun." Objective - If all 3 abilities on this story card have been triggered, add it to the victory display (Place a resource token over each ability when it is triggered).

name: A Noble Legacy (Present)
text: [action] If you are at the [[Present]] Miskatonic University and "funding for an observatory has begun:" Announce "the observatory is built." [action] If "the observatory is built," "Thomas and Mary are inspired by Nikola Tesla," and Thomas Corrigan, Mary Zielinski and Ezra Graves are at the [[Present]] Miskatonic University, spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group (4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, instead if you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode): Announce "teleportation research has begun." [fast] If "Thomas and Mary have met" and Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski are at Ye Olde Magick Shoppe, spend 1 [per_investigator] resources: Announce "Corrigan Industries has been founded" and put the set-aside Corrigan Industries location into play in the future era. Objective - If all 3 abilities on this story card have been triggered, add it to the victory display (place a resource token over each ability when it is triggered).

name: A Noble Legacy (Future)
text: [action] If Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski are at Corrigan Industries: Put the set-aside Dimensional Beam Machine asset into play under your control (if you are eliminated, set it aside, out of play). [action] If "teleportation research has begun" and Thomas Corrigan, Mary Zielinski, and the Dimensional Beam Machine are at the [[Future]] Miskatonic University: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group (8 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, instead if you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode) and announce "Thomas and Mary have made a historic discovery." [action] If "Thomas and Mary have made a historic discovery" and Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski are at the [[Future]] Arkham Advertiser: Announce "Thomas and Mary have won a Nobel Prize." Objective - If all 3 abilities on this story card have been triggered, add it to the victory display (place a resource token over each ability when it is triggered).

name: A Bitter Rivalry
text: [action] [action]: Ready and move Edwin Bennet to your location (even if he is in another era). [action] If Edwin Bennet is at your location: Fight/Evade. Either attack or attempt to evade Edwin Bennet. If you succeed, spend X clues as a group, where X is the global number of players. Then, place 1 resource on him, as a target. (Group limit once per round.) Objective - If Edwin Bennet has 3 targets on him and he is at Tindalos, the forces of Tindalos seize him. Remove Edwin Bennet from the game and add all copies of this story card in each era to the victory display.

name: Redeem a Former Colleague
text: [action] [action]: Ready and move Edwin Bennet to your location (even if he is in another era). [action] If Edwin Bennet is at your location: Parley. Test [willpower] (3) or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, spend X clues, as a group where X is the global number of players. Then, place 1 resource on him, as a redemption. Objective - If Edwin Bennet has 3 or more redemption on him and he is at any Miskatonic University with Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski, he is redeemed. Remove all redemption from him and flip him over. Add all copies of this story card in each era to the victory display.

name: Uneasy Alliance
text: [action] If Edwin Bennet is at your location and he is ready: Parley. Place 1 of your clues on him. You may test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, place 1 more of your clues on him. If you fail, exhaust him. [action]: Ready and move Edwin Bennet to your loaction (even if he is in another era). Forced - At the end of the round: Remove 1 clue from Edwin Bennet (2 clues instead if you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode). If you cannot, place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance. Forced - When Edwin Bennet would be abducted: Remove all damage and horror from him and place 2 doom on the current agenda instead. Objective - If "Thomas and Mary have won a Nobel Prize" and there is no [[Plot]] story card in play in any era, add this story card to the victory display.

name: Anomalies in Spacetime
text: Abilities on locations with an anomaly cannot be triggered. [action] Spend any number of clues: Test [willpower] (3) or [agility] (3). You get +3 skill value to this test for each clue spent this way. If you succeed, remove 1 anomaly from your location (2 anomalies instead if you succeed by 3 or more). Then, if you succeed by 4 or more and "Corrigan Industries has been founded," remove 1 anomaly from a location with the same title as your location, in any era. Objective - If it is agenda 2a and each location has no anomalies, add this story card to the victory display.

name: Mob Troubles
text: [action] If "the debt has been paid," spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Search the play area, encounter deck, or encounter discard pile for a Sheldon Gang enemy and add it to the victory display. If you searched the encounter deck, shuffle it. This action does not cause attacks of opportunity. Objective - If all 3 Sheldon Gang enemies are in the victory display, add this story card to the victory display.

name: Unspeakable Abomination
text: [action] If Tyr'thrha is at your location, spend 1 clue: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, deal 2 damage to Tyr'thrha (3 damage instead if you succeed by 3 or more). This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Objective - If Tyr'thrha is defeated, add this story card to the victory display.

name: Ethereal Entity
text: Warring. Spawn - Athenaeum of the Empty Sky. Forced - After Ethereal Entity engages you: You must decide (choose one) - - Place 1 doom on the blue agenda. - Place 1 of your clues on your location. - Take 2 horror.

name: Bringer of Paradise
text: Aloof. Retaliate. Warring. Spawn - Shrine of Magh'an Ark'at. Forced - At the end of the round: Place 1 resource on Bringer of Paradise, as a mutation. Then, if there are 3 or more mutations on it, remove 2 of them and place 2 doom on the green agenda.

name: Trylogog
text: Swarming 2. Warring. Spawn - Burning Pit. Forced - When Trylogog attacks: It deals either its damage or its horror, instead of both.
flavor: The irritating, incessant buzzing of the swarm can be heard from miles away.

name: Lola Hayes
text: You begin the game in the Neutral role. You can only play or commit Neutral cards or cards of your current role. Forced - When your turn begins: Switch your role ([guardian], [seeker], [rogue], [mystic], [survivor], or Neutral). [elder_sign] effect: +2. You may switch roles.

name: Leading Lady (Heroine)
text: Lola Hayes deck only. Replacement. Fast. Play only during your turn. Play a card from your hand, regardless of your current role (paying its cost). If that card was a Guardian ([guardian]) card, you may either draw 1 card or immediately take a fight action.
flavor: "I'm done waiting in the wings."

name: Leading Lady (Mentor)
text: Lola Hayes deck only. Replacement. Fast. Play only during your turn. Play a card from your hand, regardless of your current role (paying its cost). If that card was a Seeker ([seeker]) card, you may either draw 1 card or immediately take an investigate action.
flavor: "I've learned a thing or two on stage."

name: Leading Lady (Femme Fatale)
text: Lola Hayes deck only. Replacement. Fast. Play only during your turn. Play a card from your hand, regardless of your current role (paying its cost). If that card was a Rogue ([rogue]) card, you may either draw 1 card or immediately take an evade action.
flavor: "Trust me, honey, I'm lead material."

name: Leading Lady (Enchantress)
text: Lola Hayes deck only. Replacement. Fast. Play only during your turn. Play a card from your hand, regardless of your current role (paying its cost). If that card was a Mystic ([mystic]) card, you may either draw 1 card or remove 1 doom from a player card at your location.
flavor: "The trick is to only show them what you want them to see."

name: Leading Lady (Final Girl)
text: Lola Hayes deck only. Replacement. Fast. Play only during your turn. Play a card from your hand, regardless of your current role (paying its cost). If that card was a Survivor ([survivor]) card, you may either draw 1 card or heal 1 damage/horror.
flavor: "Come on, Lola, just make it to the final bow."

name: Samuel Blake
text:
Lola Hayes deck only. Replacement. Peril.
While Samuel Blake is in your hand, you cannot switch roles or play cards belonging to another role.
While Samuel Blake is in play, as an additional cost for you to switch your role, you must take 1 horror.

name: Enthralling Encore
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of measures.
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, you must either spend 1 clue or take 1 damage.
[tablet]: -3 (-5 instead if there are 3 or more classes among cards you control).
[elder_thing]: -2. If Sinister Soloist is at your location, reveal another token.

name: The Haunting of the Ward Theatre
text: [fast] While at Sinister Soloist's location, discard 1 card of each class from your hand ([guardian], [seeker], [rogue], [mystic], and [survivor]): Parley. Automatically evade Sinister Soloist. Treat Sinister Soloist's text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]) for the remainder of the round.
flavor: The theatre is closed and quiet, as it has been since those days during the phantom production of The King in Yellow. As you take in your surroundings, you hear it again - the haunting violin. Someone is here, and they are keeping the memory of that production alive.

name: Break Free from the Past
text: [fast] Investigators at the same [[Private]] location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Parley. Reveal the top 3 cards of the Props deck and choose an investigator to draw 1 of them. Shuffle the remaining cards together and place them on the bottom of the Props deck. Objective - When Sinister Soloist is in the victory display, advance.
flavor: The soloist stands on stage, their gangly arms moving with mechanical precision as they play the violin. Their face is shrouded in shadow, but their song follows you throughout the theatre.

name: Sinister Soloist
text: Alert. Aloof. Elusive. Hunter. As an additional cost to play a non-Neutral card at Sinister Soloist's location, you must take 1 horror. Forced - When the enemy phase ends, if Sinister Soloist is ready: Each investigator at Sinister Soloist's location and each connecting location takes 1 direct horror.

name: Reality Acid
text: - -6: ...all events from each investigator's hand. - -7: ...a non-story, non-weakness asset from each investigator's play area. - -8: ...a non-weakness siganture card in any player's deck, hand, discard pile, or play area. - [skull]: ...1 card beneath Ravenous, at random. - [cultist]: ...each card committed to each skill test at your location (after the test ends), until the end of the next investigation phase. - [tablet]: ...each event played by investigators at your location, until the end of the next investigation phase. - [elder_thing]: ...the player card at your location with the most evidence, supplies, ammo, charges, or secrets on it. - [auto_fail]: Reveal 3 more chaos tokens and resolve each of those devour effects.

name: Deep Within the Labyrinth...
text:
If you are in Group B:
Etched upon the glass of the capsule slowly filling with water, you can see a blueprint begin to glow.
Each investigator in this group may immediately trade clues among one another. Move any number of clues from Chamber of Rain to Chamber of Sorrows, or vice-versa. Flip this card back over.
If you are in Group A:
The runes glow, and a piece of the wall slides to reveal a secret compartment, filled with trinkets.
Put the Key of Mysteries into play at the Chamber of Secrets. Flip this card back over.
If you are in Group C:
The runes in your chamber shift to form a word.
The word you see is the same word inscribed upon the wall of the Chamber of Secrets in Group A's play area (you may examine Group A's play area) Flip this card back over.

name: Deep Within the Labyrinth...
text:
You find yourself in a hub, of sorts - a pathway within the aether. Other prisoners have found their way here. Perhaps you can collaborate with them to find a way to escape.
Each investigator that entered the rift takes this story card and meets in private, away from each group. Investigators within the rift can speak freely, and may exchange any number of clues, resources, cards in hand, or story assets controlled. Once the investigators are satisfied, each investigator returns to his or her original group. Flip this card back over.

name: Deep Within the Labyrinth...
text:
The objects tumble down through the shaft, making loud banging noises behind the walls and underneath the floor. Hopefully another group can find them...
Take the cards, tokens, and notes on or underneath this card and place them on or underneath another group's copy of The Vent. Flip this card back over.

name: Deep Within the Labyrinth...
text:
You write "I choose death" on the note. Words appear just below yours, spelling out a sentence in reply. "Did you really think I would let you die that easily?"
You must choose and discard all but X cards from your hand, and remove all but X resources from your resource pool. X is the amount of doom on the current agenda.
Read the following to each group aloud:
The words and letters on the note shift and change to form a strange diagram.
The lead investigator of Group A takes control of the set-aside Rot Diagram. The lead investigator of Group B takes control of the set-aside Hunger Diagram. The lead investigator of Group C takes control of the set-aside Decay Diagram. Remove each group's copy of The Dilemma from the game.

name: Deep Within the Labyrinth...
text:
As soon as you step through the gate, it vanishes behind you. You are on your own, for now...
Depending on which group you are in, put a different location into play, as follows: - If you are in Group A, put the Chamber of Rot into play. - If you are in Group B, put the Chamber of Hunger into play. - If you are in Group C, put the Chamber of Decay into play. Disengage from each enemy and move to the location just put into play. Until there is at least 5 doom on the current agenda, that location is not considered to be connected to any other location. Remove this card from the game.

name: Deep Within the Labyrinth...
text:
The runes in the chamber glow, and a strange message is spelled out across the wall.
If you are in Group A: Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Rot Diagram. Remove this card from the game.
If you are in Group B: Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Hunger Diagram. Remove this card from the game.
If you are in Group C: Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Decay Diagram. Remove this card from the game.

name: Daniela Reyes
text: [reaction] After an enemy attacks an investigator at your location: Fight that enemy (using either a basic fight action or a Fight ability on a card). (Limit once per round.) [elder_sign] effect: +1. Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
flavor: "Those creatures are definitely gonna know what hit 'em."

name: Daniela's Wrench
text: Daniela Reyes deck only. [fast] Exhaust Daniela's Wrench: Choose an enemy at your location. That enemy engages you and makes an immediate attack. [action]: Fight ([combat]). You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If this enemy attacked you this round, this attack deals +1 damage.

name: In Harm's Way
text: Revelation - Put In Harm's Way into play in your threat area. Forced - After you deal damage to an enemy: Take 1 damage and place 1 damage on In Harm's Way. If there is 3 or more damage on this card, discard it. Forced - When the game ends: Suffer 1 physical trauma.

name: Joe Diamond
text:
[reaction] After you successfully investigate: Draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If you succeed, draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.
flavor: "I can't stop now. Not when I'm so close to the truth."

name: Detective's Intuition
text:
Joe Diamond deck only.
Gain 2 resources and heal 1 damage or 1 horror.
[reaction] After you draw Detective's Intuition during your turn: Reveal it and draw 2 additional cards.
flavor: "I don't know how you do it, Mr. Diamond. Your insight never ceases to impress."

name: Dead Ends
text: Forced - When you search your deck and Dead Ends is among the searched cards: Draw it, cancel the effects of the search, and shuffle your deck. Forced - When the game ends or you are eliminated, if this card is in your hand: You earn 2 fewer experience.

name: Trish Scarborough
text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to evade.
[elder_sign] effect: +0. After this test resolves, you may disengage from each enemy and move to a connecting location.
flavor: "You're quite good, but nobody can catch me."

name: Covert Ops
text:
Trish Scarborough deck only.
[reaction] After you evade an enemy, exhaust Covert Ops: Either draw 1 card, or move to a connecting location.
flavor: There are alley cats more conspicuous than you.

name: Black Chamber Operative
text: Hunter. Prey (Trish Scarborough only). Forced - After you evade Black Chamber Operative: Place 1 of your clues on your location. If you cannot, this enemy readies, engages you, and makes an immediate attack.
flavor: "There is nowhere to run, Ms. Scarborough."

name: Dexter Drake
text: [reaction] After you play an asset: Either return another non-story asset you control to your hand, or play a different asset from your hand (paying its cost). (Limit once per round.) [elder_sign] effect: +1. You may return a non-story asset at your location to its owner's hand.
flavor: "I'll show you real magic."

name: "For my next trick..."
text: Dexter Drake deck only. Search your deck for a [[Spell]] or [[Item]] asset and play it, reducing its cost by 2 (shuffle your deck). This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: The Necronomicon
text: Revelation - Put The Necronomicon into play in your threat area. It cannot leave play except by the [action] ability below. You cannot play assets or trigger abilities on other assets you control. [action]: Test [willpower] (5). If you succeed, discard The Necronomicon. If you fail, shuffle it into your deck and take 1 horror.

name: Isabelle Barnes
text:
[fast] During a skill test you are performing, take 1 direct horror: Commit an eligible skill from your discard pile to this test. After this test resolves, shuffle that card into your deck. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If you succeed, heal 1 horror.
flavor: "My sister's sacrifice won't be in vain."

name: Isabelle's Twin .45s
text: Isabelle Barnes deck only. Uses (6 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. [reaction] After you resolve the above ability, spend 1 ammo and exhaust Isabelle's Twin .45s: Fight ([agility]). You get +1 [agility] and deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: Breaking Point
text: Revelation - Take 1 direct damage. Then, if you have 6 or fewer remaining sanity, take 1 direct damage. Then, if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity, take 1 direct damage.

name: Bodyguard
text:
Bodyguard may be assigned damage dealt to other investigators at your location.
[reaction] When Bodyguard is defeated: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
flavor: "I'm not here to help you shop; I'm here to keep you alive."

name: Endurance
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test (+2 [combat] instead if this is an attack or evasion).
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test (+2 [agility] instead if this is an attack or evasion).

name: Logan Hastings
text:
You get +1 [combat].
[reaction] After you defeat an enemy, exhaust Logan Hastings: Gain 1 resource.
flavor: "Preparing for Armageddon seems insane until it's the end of the world!"

name: M1911
text: Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: Resilience
flavor: Nothing's gonna keep you down.

name: Lesson Learned
text:
Fast. Play after an enemy attacks you.
Discover 1 clue at your location.

name: Right Tool for the Job
text: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Tool]] or [[Weapon]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
flavor: "Keep digging. You'll find something you need in there."

name: Counterattack
text: Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location (before resolving that attack). Cancel that attack. Deal 1 damage to that enemy.

name: Bodyguard
text:
Bodyguard may be assigned damage dealt to other investigators at your location.
[reaction] When Bodyguard is defeated: Deal 2 damage to an enemy at your location.
flavor: "I'm not here to help you shop; I'm here to keep you alive."

name: Sledgehammer
text: [action]: Fight ([combat]). This attack deals + 1 damage. [action][action]: Fight ([combat]). You get +3 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, you may exhaust Sledgehammer for this attack to deal +2 damage.
flavor: Twenty-two and a half pounds of steel vengeance.

name: Winchester Model 12
text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). You get +3 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, this attack deals +1 damage for each point you succeed by (to a maximum of +4). If you fail and would deal damage to another investigator, this attack deals 1 damage for each point you fail by (to a maximum of 5 damage).

name: Dorothy Simmons
text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After you successfully investigate by exactly 1 or 3, exhaust Dorothy Simmons: Gain 1 resource.
flavor: "I've taken every class that Dr. Christopher offers!"

name: Local Map
text: Uses (4 secrets). [action] Spend 1 secret: Investigate ([intellect]). Investigate a revealed connecting location. You get +1 [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, you may exhaust Local Map to move to that location.
flavor: "I could swear we've been here before..."

name: Sharp Rhetoric
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test (+2 [intellect] instead if this is an investigation or parley).
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test (+2 [willpower] instead if this is an investigation or parley).

name: Gather Intel
text:
Fast. Play when an enemy enters your location.
Draw 2 cards.
flavor: You learn so much more by getting up-close and personal.

name: Through the Cracks
text: Evade ([agility]). You get +1 [agility] for this evasion for each clue you control (to a maximum of +3). If you succeed, you may disengage from each enemy engaged with you and move to a revealed connecting location.

name: Mysterious Grimoire
text:
Uses (4 secrets).
[fast] During your turn, spend 1 or 2 secrets and exhaust Mysterious Grimoire: Search the top 3 cards (or 6 cards instead if you spent 2 secrets) of your deck for a card and draw it. If 1 or more weaknesses are among the searched cards, draw them as well. Shuffle your deck.

name: Through the Cracks
text: Evade ([agility]). You get +2 [agility] for this evasion for each clue you control (to a maximum of +6). If you succeed, you may disengage from each enemy engaged with you and move to a revealed connecting location.

name: Unbridled Knowledge
text: Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck (8 cards instead if you control 2 or more clues). Draw 3 of them and place the rest of those cards on the top and/or bottom of your deck in any order.

name: M1903 Hammerless
text: Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([agility]). If the targeted enemy is exhausted, this attack deals +1 damage.

name: Olivier Bishop
text:
You get +1 [agility].
[fast] During your turn, exhaust Olivier Bishop: Move to a connecting location.
flavor: "I suppose I'll help you... for now."

name: Silver Tongue
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test (+2 [intellect] instead if this is an evasion or parley).
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test (+2 [agility] instead if this is an evasion or parley).

name: Sticky Fingers
text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy, exhaust Sticky Fingers: Gain 1 resource.
flavor: Worse than a kid in a candy shop.

name: Paint the Town Red
text: Parley. Search the top 9 cards of the encounter deck for a non-[[Elite]] enemy, draw it, and gain resources equal to that enemy's printed health. Shuffle the encounter deck.
flavor:
You can't put a price on fame.
Or can you?

name: Prestidigitation
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Play an [[Item]] asset from your hand, reducing its cost by 2. When your turn ends, return an [[Item]] asset you control to your hand.
flavor: Now you see it. Now you don't.

name: Out of Sight
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful by 2 or more, the performing investigator may disengage from each enemy and move to a revealed connecting location.

name: Sticky Fingers
text:
Fast. Limit 1 per investigator.
[reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy, exhaust Sticky Fingers: Gain 1 resource.
flavor: Worse than a kid in a candy shop.

name: Decisive Strike
text: Fight ([combat]). You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If this attack defeats an enemy, gain 5 resources.
flavor: Don't forget to check the pockets.

name: Out of Sight
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful by 1 or more, the performing investigator may disengage from each enemy and move to a revealed location up to 2 connections away.

name: Cloak of Resonance
text: [reaction] When horror is placed on Cloak of Resonance, exhaust it: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
flavor: "To be createde of 3 partes aether, 2 cinnabar, and at least 3 pounds ophe rokket gatherede from ain hevenful mountain." -Alchemical Formula No VIII ca. 1660

name: Cosmic Flame
text: Uses (3 charges). [action]: Fight ([willpower]). If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to deal +1 damage for this attack. If you reveal a [skull] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Cosmic Flame (if you cannot, take 1 damage and discard this card).

name: Jim Culver
text:
You get +1 [willpower].
[reaction] After you take damage and/or horror, exhaust Jim Culver: Draw 1 card.
flavor: "You see these folks too? You never really get used to them."

name: Lucky Charm
text: Uses (4 charges). [fast] Spend 1 charge and exhaust Lucky Charm: Move 1 damage or 1 horror from a card at your location to a card you control (with a health or sanity value).

name: Second Sight
text: Uses (3 charges). [action]: Investigate ([willpower]). If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to discover 1 additional clue at your location. If you reveal a [cultist] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Second Sight (if you cannot, take 1 horror and discard this card).

name: Spiritual Intuition
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test (+2 [willpower] instead if this test is on a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] card).
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test (+2 [combat] instead if this test is on a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] card).

name: Will of the Cosmos
text: Place 1 doom on a player card you control. Then, discover 1 clue at your location and 1 clue at another revealed location.
flavor: In the cosmos, all are one. In the void, all is none.

name: Soul Link
text: As an additional cost to commit Soul Link, take 1 horror.
flavor: By the power of the ancients am I reborn anew.

name: Mask of Silenus
text:
Uses (3 charges).
[reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token, spend 1 charge: Reveal 1 additional token. Choose 1 of those tokens to resolve and ignore the other. If you resolved a token with a symbol, take 1 horror.

name: Augur of Elokoss
text: Investigate ([intellect]). Add your [willpower] to your [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at your location. If you succeed and a token with a symbol was revealed during this test, you may discard a [[Terror]] or [[Hex]] treachery from any investigator's threat area.

name: Cosmic Flame
text: Uses (4 charges). [action]: Fight ([willpower]). You get +2 [willpower] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. If you reveal a [skull] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Cosmic Flame (if you cannot, take 1 damage and discard this card).

name: Aleksey Saburov
text: [reaction] When your turn begins: Heal 1 damage or 1 horror from Aleksey Saburov.
flavor: "I've had way worse, pal."

name: Hunter's Instinct
text:
Limit 1 per investigator. Uses (3 supplies). If there are no supplies on Hunter's Instinct, discard it.
[reaction] After you engage an enemy, spend 1 supply and exhaust Hunter's Instinct: Add a level 0 event in your discard pile to your hand.

name: Jumpsuit
text: [fast] During your turn, discard Jumpsuit: Choose a [[Tool]] or [[Weapon]] asset in your discard pile and add it to your hand.
flavor: You keep finding things you thought you'd lost in those deep pockets.

name: Levelheaded
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test (+2 [willpower] instead if this test is on a scenario card).
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test (+2 [agility] instead if this test is on a scenario card).

name: "Shove off!"
text: Evade ([agility]). If you succeed, deal 1 damage to the evaded enemy. If you fail, return "Shove off!" to your hand at the end of your turn.

name: Slippery
text: If this skill test is successful while evading a non-[[Elite]] enemy, that enemy does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

name: Timely Intervention
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
You may commit Timely Intervention from your hand after revealing chaos tokens during a skill test you are performing.

name: Scrape By
text:
Fast. Play when you would fail a skill test during which a non-[auto_fail] token was revealed.
You succeed at that skill test instead. If a token with a symbol was revealed during that skill test, take 1 horror.

name: Old Compass
text: [action]: Investigate ([intellect]). Your location gets -1 shroud for this investigation. If you fail, you may exhaust Old Compass to attempt this test again. If you do, your location gets -2 shroud for this investigation, instead.

name: On the Brink
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test fails, return each other card committed to this test to its owner's hand and draw 1 card.
flavor: Nobody knows what you'll do if you're pushed past your limits.

name: Meat Cleaver
text: [action]: Fight ([combat]). You get +2 [combat] for this attack (+3 [combat] instead if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity). If this attack defeats an enemy, you may heal 1 horror. [reaction] When you trigger the above [action] ability, take 1 horror: This attack deals +1 damage.

name: Broken Bottle
text: [action]: Fight ([combat]). You get +1 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, you may discard Broken Bottle to deal +1 damage for this attack.
flavor: It was cheap whiskey, anyway.

name: Fedora
flavor: A little style goes a long way.

name: Hand-Crank Flashlight
text: [action]: Investigate ([intellect]). You get +1 [intellect] for this test. If you succeed, you may discard Hand-Crank Flashlight for your location to get -1 shroud until the end of the round.
flavor:
Works in any situation, and the batteries never run out!
- Schoffner's Catalogue, Spring 1927 ed.

name: The Gold Bug
text: Revelation - Put The Gold Bug into play in your threat area. It cannot leave play except by the [action] ability below. You get -1 health and -1 sanity. [action]: Shuffle the Gold Bug into your deck.

name: The Nameless Lurker
text: Aloof. Spawn - Farthest empty location. Forced - When the investigation phase ends, if The Nameless Lurker is ready and has no doom on it: Place 1 doom on it.

name: Pursued
text: Revelation - Put Pursued into play in your threat area. Forced - After an enemy enters (moves into or spawns at) your location: Take 1 horror. [action][action]: Discard Pursued.

name: Syndicate Obligations
text: Revelation - Put Syndicate Obligations into play in your threat area. Forced - After you spend 1 or more resources: Take 1 damage. [action][action]: Discard Syndicate Obligations.

name: Wounded
text: Revelation - Put Wounded into play in your threat area. Forced - The first time you move each turn: Take 1 damage. [action][action]: Discard Wounded.

name: Machete
text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. If the attacked enemy is the only enemy engaged with you, this attack deals +1 damage.
flavor: Cuts through vines, underbrush, and tentacles equally well.

name: Scene of the Crime
text:
Play only as your first action.
Discover 1 clue at your location (2 clues instead if there is an enemy at that location). This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Vicious Blow
text: If this skill test is successful during an attack, that attack deals +1 damage.
flavor: With a sickening smack, he struck the abomination over and over... until at last, it stopped moving.

name: Fingerprint Kit
text: Uses (3 supplies). [action] Exhaust Fingerprint Kit and spend 1 supply: Investigate. You get +1 [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, you discover 1 additional clue at your location.

name: Laboratory Assistant
text:
Your maximum hand size is increased by 2.
[reaction] After Laboratory Assistant enters play: Draw 2 cards.

name: Magnifying Glass
text:
Fast.
You get +1 [intellect] while investigating.
flavor: A lens into a world unseen can reveal things you wish it hadn't.

name: Working a Hunch
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Discover 1 clue at your location.

name: Deduction
text: If this skill test is successful while investigating a location, discover 1 additional clue at that location.
flavor: I knew I had seen this symbol before. I must warn the others before it is too late!

name: Studious
text:
Permanent.
You begin each game with 1 additional card in your opening hand.
flavor:
Possibly Gilman ought not to have studied so hard.
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dreams in the Witch House</u>

name: Lucky Cigarette Case
text: [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more, exhaust Lucky Cigarette Case: Draw 1 card.
flavor: "It’s not really all that lucky. Just in the mood for a smoke."

name: Thieves' Kit
text: Uses (6 supplies). [action] Spend 1 supply: Investigate. You may use [agility] instead of [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, gain 1 resource.
flavor: "Why do I keep these on me? Why, to be better informed regarding the unsavory methods of art thieves, of course."

name: Breaking and Entering
text: Investigate. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this investigation. If you succeed by 2 or more, you may automatically evade an enemy at this location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
flavor: If you're careful, it's just "entering."

name: Another Day, Another Dollar
text:
Permanent.
You begin each game with 2 additional resources.
flavor: Never lose sight of what’s really important.

name: Premonition
text: Fast. Play during any [fast] player window. Put Premonition into play, reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag, and seal it on Premonition. Forced - When a chaos token would be revealed from the chaos bag: Resolve the token sealed here as if it were just revealed from the chaos bag, instead. Then, discard Premonition.

name: Ward of Protection
text:
Fast. Play when you draw a non-weakness treachery card.
Cancel that card's revelation effect. Then, take 1 horror.

name: Fearless
text: If this skill test is successful, heal 1 horror (2 horror instead if it succeeds by 2 or more).
flavor: Only by standing firm against the darkness can we live to see the light of another day.

name: Bandages
text:
Uses (3 supplies). If Bandages has no supplies, discard it.
[reaction] After an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location takes 1 or more damage, spend 1 supply: Heal 1 damage from that card.

name: Meat Cleaver
text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack (+2 [combat] instead if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity). If this attack defeats an enemy, you may heal 1 horror. As an additional cost to initiate this ability, you may take 1 horror to have this attack deal +1 damage.

name: "Look what I found!"
text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 2 or less while investigating.
Discover 2 clues in your location.

name: Emergency Cache
text: Gain 3 resources.
flavor: You can never be too prepared.

name: Guts
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card.
flavor: Stay back! I'll handle this.

name: Manual Dexterity
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card.
flavor: Too easy.

name: Overpower
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card.
flavor: Die, you beast!

name: Perception
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card.
flavor: At last, I've found it!

name: Unexpected Courage
text: Max 1 committed per skill test.
flavor: Sometimes, the most selfless acts can come from the strangest places

name: Charisma
text:
Permanent.
You have 1 additional ally slot.
flavor: When you turn on the charm, it could light the entire town.

name: Relic Hunter
text:
Permanent.
You have 1 additional accessory slot.
flavor: No stone unturned, no ancient treasure left behind.

name: Amnesia
text: Revelation - Choose and discard all but 1 card from your hand.
flavor: Wait... where am I? What was I doing?

name: Overzealous
text: Revelation - Draw the top card of the encounter deck. That card gains surge.
flavor: "Don't worry, I have this completely under control!"

name: Paranoia
text: Revelation - Discard all your resources.
flavor: What was that noise?

name: Spreading Flames
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull] -X. X is the current act number.
[tablet] -1. Reveal another token. If you fail, take 1 damage.
[elder_thing] -3. If you fail by 2 or more, draw the topmost copy of Fire! in the encounter discard pile, if able.

name: Past Curfew
text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, discard a Bystander enemy at your location.
flavor: The campus is strangely quiet, and there is no sign of your friend. Hooded figures cross the quad as nervous students scurry under painfully bright streetlamps.

name: Lit Up
text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, discard a Bystander enemy at your location.
flavor: The sky glows a faint orange as the flames spread.

name: Wild Flames
text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, discard a Bystander enemy at your location. Forced - After doom is placed on the agenda: The lead investigator draws the topmost copy of Fire! in the encounter discard pile
flavor: The campus is ablaze!

name: Where There's Smoke...
text: Objective - At the end of the round, investigators may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: You are searching the dormitories for any sign of your friend.

name: Escape the Dorms
text: Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at Miskatonic Quad, advance. (Hint: Somcetimes it's better to run than to fight!)
flavor: A burning apparition stands between you and the exit. You must escape the dormitories!

name: Searching for Dr. Armitage
text: Objective - At the end of the round, investigators at Orne Library may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: Your friend had mentioned visiting the head librarian, Dr. Henry Armitage. With more and more strange figures arriving, you must scour the campus for his whereabouts.

name: Blaze of Glory
text: [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to an enemy at your location. [action]: Resign. You flee the burning campus. (This does not provoke attacks of opportunity.) Objective - If the Servant of Flame is defeated: Advance.
flavor: Your fiery nemesis can't be allowed to hurt more innocents! With Dr. Armitage's help, perhaps you can stop them.

name: Your Friend's Room
text: [action]: Engage. Choose an enemy at a connecting location. That enemy moves to this location and engages you. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
flavor: The dorm is quickly filling with smoke.

name: Servant of Flame
text: Hunter. Prey (lowest [agility]). Retaliate.

name: Dr. Henry Armitage
text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
The first action you perform each round does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
flavor: "I've seen more than my share of strange occurrences."

name: Miskatonic Quad
text: [fast] During your turn, if there are exactly 1 or 2 investigators in the game: Move to a connecting location. (Group limit once per round.)

name: Dormitories
text: [action]: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: There's never a dull moment in the university dorms.

name: Science Hall
text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at Science Hall: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
flavor: The students are never exactly sure what will be under the microscope each day.

name: Warren Observatory
text: [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.)
flavor: To date, Miskatonic astronomers have identified at least 15 separate stars that appear to have gone missing from the Northern Hemisphere.

name: Orne Library
text: [action][action]: Draw 3 cards. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: Students have reported strange sounds coming from the empty archives at night...

name: Cantor of Flame
text: Retaliate.
flavor:
"By flame and blade, in shade and blood
Our queen reborn after the flood."
-Edict of Ash, Vol XIX

name: Hellhound
text: Hunter. Forced - After Hellhound attacks you during the enemy phase: Choose and discard 1 asset you control.

name: Bystander
text: Doomed. (When this enemy is defeated, place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.)
flavor: They're always in the exact wrong place at the exact wrong time.

name: Cosmic Evils
text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the agenda to advance. - Take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror. Cosmic Evils gains surge.

name: Unspeakable Truths
text: Revelation - Put Unspeakable Truths into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues: Take 1 horror. [action][action]: Discard Unspeakable Truths.

name: Forbidden Secrets
text: Revelation - If you have no clues, Forbidden Secrets gains surge. Otherwise, test [intellect] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either place 1 of your clues on your location, or take 1 horror.
flavor: They say curiosity killed the cat. But will it kill you, too?

name: Extraplanar Visions
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] or [intellect] (X), where X is the number of cards in your hand. If you fail, take 1 damage and discard 1 card at random from your hand.

name: Wild Compulsion
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either discard 1 card at random from your hand, or lose 1 resource.
flavor: "God help the dreamer whose mad visions shew Those did eyes set in crystal gulfs below!" -H.P. Lovecraft, "Fungi from Yuggoth"

name: Fire!
text: Revelation - Attach Fire! to the nearest location without Fire! attached. Forced - When the investigation phase ends: Each non-[[Elite]] card with health at this location takes 1 direct damage. [action]: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, discard Fire!

name: Noxious Smoke
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] or [agility] (3). Take 1 damage for each point you fail by.
flavor: Where there's smoke, there's almost definitely fire.

name: Mutated!
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +2 difficulty if there is an enemy at your location. If you fail, you must either take 2 damage, or each investigator at your location takes 1 horror.

name: Mutated Experiment
text: Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Each investigator at its location takes 1 horror.

name: Smoke and Mirrors
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull] -X. X is the total number of [[Elite]] enemies in the victory display and under the act.
[cultist] -1. If this is a test targeting an [[Elite]] enemy, reveal another token.
[tablet] -3. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[elder_thing] -1 for each clue you control.

name: Arkham Alive
text: [action]: Resign. You return to compare notes with Dr. Armitage on your friend's whereabouts.
flavor: An unnatural haze fills the streets of Arkham. Some of the locals say the hills west of Arkham are burning. Despite the cool autumn weather, the city streets feel unnaturally warm as evening falls.

name: Emergent Evils
text: [action]: Resign. You return to compare notes with Dr. Armitage on your friend's whereabouts.
flavor: Steam rises off of the wet pavement, as though the ground beneath it were actually burning.

name: Augurs of Flame
text: [action] Spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Draw the facedown card beneath your location. Objective - If there are a total of 6 [[Elite]] enemies in the victory display and/or under the act, advance. (Hint: Either defeat the suspects by force or resolve their codex entries to generate leads for your investigation!)
flavor: You must find the whereabouts of the suspects on your friend's list.

name: Mark of Elokoss
text: Revelation - Put Mark of Elokoss into play in your threat area. Forced - When your turn ends: Take 1 damage. Assign that damage to an asset you control, if able. [action][action]: Discard Mark of Elokoss.

name: Servant of Flame
text: Elusive. Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - When Servant of Flame is defeated: ([codex] Ф)

name: David Renfield
text: Aloof. (This enemy does not automatically engage investigators at its location.) [reaction] After you successfully investigate David Renfield's location: ([codex] 1).

name: Cornelia Akely
text: Alert. (After you fail a skill test while evading this enemy, it attacks you.) [reaction] After you successfully evade Cornelia Akely: Ready her. ([codex] 2).

name: Naomi O'Bannion
text: Retaliate. (After you fail a skill test while fighting this enemy, it attacks you.) [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] resources: Parley. ([codex] 3).

name: Sgt. Earl Monroe
text: Elusive. (After this enemy attacks or is attacked while it is ready, it moves to a connecting location with no investigators and exhausts.) [action]: Parley. Test [combat] (4). Decrease the difficulty for this test by 1 for each damage on Sgt. Earl Monroe. If you succeed, ([codex] 4).

name: Abigail Foreman
text: Aloof. (This enemy does not automatically engage investigators at its location.) [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (X), where X is the number of clues on Abigail Foreman's location. If you succeed, place 1 clue (from the token pool) on Abigail Foreman's location. ([codex] 5).

name: Margaret Liu
text: Aloof. (This enemy does not automatically engage investigators at its location.) [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more at Margaret Liu's location: ([codex] 6).

name: Downtown
text: [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Gain 1 resource.
flavor: It's fairly easy to take out a loan from the First Bank of Arkham, but don't forget to read the fine print...

name: Downtown
text: [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at this location.
flavor: Of course, nobody mentions the sanatorium.

name: Uptown
text: [action]: Heal up to 2 damage from among investigators and/or [[Ally]] assets at this location. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: Arkham's only hospital is flush with patients and put-upon nurses.

name: Uptown
text: [action]: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. If no card was added in this way, draw 1 card.
flavor:
"Come to Ye Olde Magick Shoppe to discover the wonders of REAL magic. Stage magicians will not be served."
-Local Advertisement

name: Northside
text: [action] Spend 5 resources: Discover 1 clue from any revealed [[Arkham]] location. (Limit once per round.)

name: Easttown
text: [reaction] After you discover the last clue from Easttown: Search your deck for an [[Ally]] asset and play it (paying its cost). Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per game.)

name: Merchant District
text: [fast] During your turn, if there are exactly 1 or 2 investigators in the game: Move to a connecting location. (Limit once per round.)

name: Waterfront District
text: As an additional cost to investigate Waterfront District, you must spend 1 action.
flavor: Anyone who doesn't want to walk in waist-high water needs to hitch a ride from one of the locals.

name: Southside
text: [action][action]: Investigators at this location draw a combined total of 3 cards, divided as they choose. (Group limit once per round.)

name: French Hill
text: [action] Choose and discard 1 card from your hand: Place 1 charge or secret on an asset you control. (Limit once per round.)

name: Miskatonic University
text: Forced - When the investigation phase ends: Deal 1 direct damage to each player card with health at Miskatonic University.

name: Miskatonic University
text: [action]: Play a [[Tome]] or [[Spell]] asset from your discard pile, reducing its cost by 2. (Limit once per game.)

name: Arcane Lock
text: Revelation - Attach Arcane Lock to your location. Limit 1 per location. As an additional cost to enter or leave attached location, you must spend 1 action. [action]: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (4). If you succeed, discard Arcane Lock.

name: Downpour
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either lose 1 action or place 1 of your clues on your location.
flavor: "... there descended such a blinding sheet of torrential rain that shelter became imperative." -H.P. Lovecraft, "The Lurking Fear"

name: Flash Flood
text: Revelation - Attach Flash Flood to your location. Attached location gets +4 shroud. Forced - When the round ends: Discard Flash Flood.

name: Raising Suspicions
text: Revelation - Place 1 doom on the nearest enemy with no doom on it. If no doom was placed by this effect, Raising Suspicions gains surge.
flavor: At least you tried to keep a low profile.

name: Red Herring

Aloof. Hunter.

flavor: "It is vowed that the birds are psychopomps lying in wait for the souls of the dying..." -H.P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"

Easy / Standard

[elder_thing] -3. If you fail, draw the topmost copy of Fire! in the encounter discard pile.

text: Each enemy at a location with a copy of Fire! attached cannot be damaged.

[reaction] When you play an event, exhaust Miguel's Knapsack: Either play that event at a connecting location as if you were at that location, or draw 1 card.

name: Feline Hybrid
text:
Elusive. Hunter. Prey (Miguel de la Cruz only).
Feline Hybrid is immune to player card effects.
flavor: It kills for sport, not for sustenance.

name: Blood Drinker
text: Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - After Blood Drinker attacks: Heal 1 damage from it.

name: Daniel Jameson
text:
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] After you fail an attack or evasion, exhaust Daniel Jameson: Attempt that skill test again, with +1 skill value.
flavor: "This isn't normal animal fur, I'll tell you that much."

name: Hunting Dog
text: [reaction] When an enemy enters play, exhaust Hunting Dog: Move once toward that enemy's location.
flavor: She'll stay by your side, no matter what.

name: Loner
text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[fast] During your turn, exhaust Loner: Move to an empty connecting location.
flavor: "I know always that I am an outsider; a stranger in this century and among those who are still men." -H. P. Lovecraft, "The Outsider"

name: Old Compass
text: [action]: Investigate ([intellect]). Your location gets -1 shroud for this investigation. If you fail, you may exhaust Old Compass to attempt this skill test again.
flavor:
"That thing is bulky, it's cracked, and it's filthy."
"Yeah, but it still points north!"

name: Pocketknife
text: [action]: Fight ([combat] or [agility]). You get +1 skill value for this test. If this attack defeats an enemy, you may exhaust Pocketknife to gain 1 resource.
flavor: Good for skinning, whittling, and stabbing eldritch abominations in the eye.

name: Same Old Thing
text:
Uses (5 supplies). If there are no supplies on Same Old Thing, discard it.
You may spend supplies on Same Old Thing as resources to pay for events played by any investigator at your location.
flavor: "Just me, a cup of joe, and last night's snuff. I call that a good morning."

name: Decoy Trap
text: Fast. Attach to your location. Limit 1 [[Trap]] per location. [reaction] After an enemy enters attached location, exhaust Decoy Trap: Evade ([intellect] or [agility]). Evade that enemy. You get +1 skill value for this evasion. If this test succeeds, you may discard Decoy Trap to move to this location. (You may trigger this ability from any location.)

name: Glassing
text: Fast. Attach to your location. Limit 1 [[Trap]] per location. [reaction] After an enemy enters attached location, exhaust Glassing: Investigate ([intellect] or [agility]). You get +1 skill value for this investigation. If you succeed, you may discard Glassing to discover 1 additional clue at this location. (You may trigger this ability from any location.)

name: Guerrilla Tactics
text: Fight ([combat]) or Evade ([agility]). You get +1 skill value for this test and you may target an enemy at a connecting location as if you were engaged with that enemy.

name: Hidden Shelter
text: Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. [reaction] When the round ends, each investigator at this location may choose one of the following: Draw 1 card, gain 1 resource, heal 1 damage, or heal 1 horror. Forced - After an enemy enters this location: Discard Hidden Shelter.

name: Lie in Wait
text: Fast. Attach to your location. Limit 1 [[Trap]] per location. [reaction] After an enemy enters this location, exhaust Lie in Wait: Fight ([combat] or [agility]). Fight that enemy. name: Stalk Prey
text: Search the top 9 cards of the encounter deck for an enemy, draw it, and shuffle the encounter deck. Then, draw 1 card and discover 1 clue at your location. If that enemy is not at your location, you may move once toward its location.

name: Do-or-Die
text: If this skill test is successful, choose a [survivor] asset or event in your discard pile and add it to your hand.
flavor: It's now or never!

name: On the Brink
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test fails, return each other card committed to this test to its owner's hand.
flavor: Nobody knows what you'll do if you're pushed past your limits.

name: Extra Rations
text:
Uses (4 supplies). If there are no supplies on Extra Rations, discard it.
[fast] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Extra Rations: Heal 1 damage from your investigator or an [[Ally]] asset you control.
flavor: It's not much, but it's enough to keep you going.

name: Field Dressing
text:
Fast. Play after a [[Creature]] or [[Monster]] enemy at your location is defeated.
Heal up to 3 damage from among investigators and/or [[Ally]] assets at your location.

name: Rough
text: For every 2 damage on you (rounded up), Rough gains [wild].
flavor: Bouncers. Fish people. Monsters. If it's got a pulse, you can sure as hell punch it.

name: Canteen
text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Canteen: Heal 2 horror.
flavor: No matter what you put in it, there's always a faintly bitter taste.

Limit 1 per investigator. Uses (3 supplies).

flavor: "Shoot it! Don't swing it!"

Play only if there are no enemies at your location.
Choose up to 3 level 0 event and/or skill cards in your discard pile and shuffle them into your deck. Draw 1 card.

[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test (+2 [agility] instead if this test is on a scenario card).

text: Attach to your location. Limit 1 [[Trap]] attached. [reaction] After an enemy or investigator enters attached location, discard Makeshift Bomb: Deal 3 damage to each enemy and investigator at that location. (You may trigger this ability from any location.)

text:

[elder_sign] effect: +1. Place 1 ammo on an asset you control with uses (ammo).

flavor: Too eager to be cautious, too naive to know better.

Investigators at your location gain a total of X resources, distributed as your wish. X is that enemy's printed health (to a maximum of 6).

text: [fast] During an attack or investigation at your location, exhaust Police Dog: The performing investigator gets +2 skill value for this test.

Until the end of your turn, you get +3 skill value while investigating or parleying.

text: Move. After this move, heal 3 damage.

name: Lockpicks
text: Uses (3 supplies). If Lockpicks has no supplies, discard it. [action] Exhaust Lockpicks: Investigate. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this investigation. If you do not succeed by at least 2, remove 1 supply from Lockpicks.

name: The Black Fan
text:
Exceptional.
While you have...
- ...10+ resources, you get +1 health and +1 sanity.
- ...15+ resources, you may take one additional action during your turn.
- ...20+ resources, you get +1 to each of your skills.

name: Well Connected

Limit 1 per investigator.
[fast] Exhaust Well Connected: You get +1 skill value for this skill test for every 4 resources you have.
[fast] Spend 2 resources: Ready Well Connected. (Limit once per round.)

text: Exceptional. Uses (0 charges). Forced - After your turn begins: You may take all charges here, as resources. Place 1 charge here. If it has exactly... - 1 charge, you get +4 skill value for your next skill test. - 2 charges, you may move up to 3 times. - 3 charges, you may take 2 additional actions this turn.

name: Preposterous Sketches
text:
Play only if there is a clue on your location.
Draw 3 cards.

name: Deduction
text: If this skill test is successful while investigating a location, discover 1 additional clue at that location.

text:
Fast.

[fast] If there are no clues on your location: Return Magnifying Glass to your hand.

text: Forced - After Arcane Initiate enters play: Place 1 doom on it. [fast] Exhaust Arcane Initiate: Search the top 3 cards of your deck for a [[Spell]] card and draw it. Shuffle your deck.

name: Second Sight
text: Uses (3 charges). [action]: Investigate ([willpower]). If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to discover 1 additional clue at your location. If you reveal a [cultist] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Second Sight (if you cannot, take 1 horror and discard this card).

name: Torrent of Power
text:
As an additional cost to commit Torrent of Power to a skill test, spend up to 3 charges from among assets you control.
For each charge spent in this way, Torrent of Power gains [willpower] [wild].

name: Rabbit's Foot
text: [reaction] After you fail a skill test, exhaust Rabbit's Foot: Draw 1 card.
flavor: They claimed it would bring me good luck. I wouldn't say that's true. But now I feel like it would be even worse luck to get rid of it.

name: M1911
text: Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: Vicious Blow
text: If this skill test is successful during an attack, that attack deals +1 damage (+2 damage instead if it succeeds by 2 or more).
